job.title: Welder
job.description:
Location: Webster, NY
Employment Type: Full-Time | Direct Hire

Summary:  Nesco Resource is seeking skilled and dependable Structural Steel MIG Welders to join our client's manufacturing team in Webster, NY. This direct hire opportunity offers the chance to work in a fast-paced fabrication environment producing high-quality structural steel components. The ideal candidate will have MIG welding experience, the ability to interpret blueprints, and a strong commitment to safety, quality, and craftsmanship.

Pay:

  • $22.00 - $27.00/Hour (Based On Experience)

Schedule:

  • A shift - 6:30 AM - 3:00 PM (Monday - Friday)
  • B shift - 3:00 PM - 11:30 PM (Monday - Friday)
    • OT Required, As Needed

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform MIG welding on structural steel components in accordance with AWS D1.1 welding standards.
  • Prepare materials for fabrication by cutting, grinding, cleaning, fitting, and positioning metal components.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, work orders, and fabrication specifications.
  • Inspect completed welds to ensure quality, accuracy, and compliance with production standards.
  • Verify measurements, angles, and weld gaps using tape measures, calipers, micrometers, and other precision measuring tools.
  • Operate semi-automatic welding equipment and other fabrication tools safely and efficiently.
  • Grind, repair, and finish welds as needed to meet quality requirements.
  • Operate overhead cranes to safely transport steel materials and completed assemblies throughout the facility.
  • Complete production records and maintain accurate job documentation.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area while following all company safety policies and procedures.
  • Perform additional fabrication and production duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of one (1) year of MIG welding and metal fabrication experience.
  • Experience welding structural steel preferred.
  • Ability to successfully complete AWS D1.1 Structural Steel Welding certification provided by the client.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, work instructions, and technical drawings.
  • Basic computer proficiency and mechanical aptitude.
  • Strong math skills, including fractions, decimals, and accurate tape measure reading.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Reliable transportation.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to lift and move materials weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Stand for extended periods throughout the workday.
  • Frequently bend, twist, kneel, crouch, reach, push, and pull while performing fabrication tasks.
  • Ability to safely wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including welding helmet, gloves, hearing protection, safety glasses, flame-resistant clothing, and steel-toed boots.
  • Comfortable working in a manufacturing environment where temperatures may fluctuate with outdoor conditions.
  • Exposure to welding fumes and fabrication equipment in a facility equipped with ventilation systems that meet OSHA standards.

Employee Benefits:

  • Competitive hourly pay based on experience
  • Direct Hire opportunity
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Holidays
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Career Growth and Advancement Opportunities
  • Ongoing Training and Skill Development
  • Stable, Full-Time Employment

Ready to Join the Team?

Looking for a long-term career with a growing manufacturer, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!

job.title: A Shift Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Job Title: Maintenance Technician
Location: Rochester, NY
Employment Type: Full-Time | Direct Hire
 
Summary:
Nesco Resource is seeking a Maintenance Technician to support advanced manufacturing operations in Rochester, NY. This role is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing thin-film coating equipment, vacuum systems, and facility infrastructure to maximize equipment uptime and production efficiency. The ideal candidate has experience with industrial maintenance, vacuum systems, electronics, or automated manufacturing equipment and enjoys solving complex technical challenges in a fast-paced environment.
 
Key Responsibilities:

  • Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain thin-film coating equipment and associated vacuum systems
  • Diagnose equipment failures and perform root cause analysis to improve reliability and uptime
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on production equipment
  • Support continuous improvement projects focused on equipment performance and efficiency
  • Maintain and support facility systems, including HVAC, compressed air, and chilled water systems
  • Work closely with Engineering and Manufacturing to improve equipment reliability and production performance
  • Utilize electrical, optical, and mechanical test equipment to diagnose system performance
  • Maintain accurate maintenance documentation and records
  • Follow all safety procedures and company standards while supporting manufacturing operations
Qualifications:
  • Associate's Degree in a technical field plus 3+ years of relevant experience, or 6+ years of related industrial maintenance experience
  • Experience troubleshooting industrial equipment, vacuum systems, or automated manufacturing equipment
  • Experience with high-vacuum deposition systems preferred
  • Experience with ion sources and electron guns is a plus
  • Knowledge of electronics, mechanical systems, and industrial troubleshooting techniques
  • Experience with HVAC, compressed air, chilled water, or facility systems preferred
  • Familiarity with oscilloscopes, spectrophotometers, interferometers, and other diagnostic equipment is a plus
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment
Work Environment & Physical Requirements:
  • Manufacturing environment supporting advanced coating and machining operations
  • Frequent standing, walking, bending, and equipment troubleshooting throughout the shift
  • Exposure to industrial equipment, electronics, vacuum systems, and production machinery
  • Ability to work safely around electrical and mechanical equipment
  • Flexibility to support production with occasional overtime, weekends, or holidays as needed
Additional Requirements:
  • Must be eligible to access ITAR/EAR-controlled information (U.S. Citizenship or U.S. Permanent Resident status required)
 
 
Pay Rate:
$26.00 – $31.00/hour, based on experience
Shift:
Day Shift (6 am to 2:30 pm)
Some schedule flexibility required to support production needs, including occasional overtime, weekends, or holidays
 
Benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

job.title: Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Maintenance Technician
Location: Ravenna, OH
 
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Maintenance Technician to support the safe and efficient operation of manufacturing equipment. This position will troubleshoot, maintain, and repair electrical, electronic, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, mixing, and extrusion equipment. The ideal candidate has strong troubleshooting skills, a solid manufacturing maintenance background, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
 
Job duties to include but not limited to:

  • Troubleshoot, maintain, and repair electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, mixing, and extrusion equipment.
  • Read and interpret electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and automation drawings.
  • Perform mechanical repairs on conveyors, pumps, valves, motors, and mechanical drives.
  • Complete and document preventive maintenance and TPM activities.
  • Perform basic electrical repairs, welding/fabrication, and HVAC troubleshooting as needed.
  • Follow all safety procedures, including lockout/tagout and permit-to-work requirements.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Provide after-hours/weekend maintenance support and work overtime as needed.
  • Support equipment installations, modifications, and critical spare-parts planning.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
Additional experience in the following areas is a plus:
  • HVAC troubleshooting
  • Welding and fabrication
  • Construction-related work, including concrete, masonry, electrical, HVAC, and plumbing
Qualifications & Skills
  • 1–3 years of maintenance experience in a manufacturing environment required; 5+ years preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of electrical/electronic, hydraulic, mechanical, and pneumatic systems.
  • Experience coordinating or managing outside service providers for specialized equipment installation, maintenance, and repairs.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and daily maintenance activities while meeting deadlines.
  • Ability to work effectively with supervisors and cross-functional teams to identify problems and determine solutions.
  • Working knowledge of rotating equipment such as blowers, station equipment such as hoppers, and electric equipment such as motors.
  • Familiarity with OSHA, NFPA, EPA, and other applicable regulations.
  • Comfortable using workplace technology, including scheduling, inventory, and related software.
  • Ability to operate a tow motor and pallet jack.
  • Comfortable working in a variety of environments, including interior/exterior areas, confined spaces, elevated platforms, and heights.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
 
Hours of 2nd shift: Monday to Friday – 2:45 PM to 11:15 PM

Our client is one of Long Island's most respected and established aerospace and defense manufacturers. Following an exciting company merger, they are expanding their operations and creating outstanding career opportunities for skilled manufacturing professionals.
If you're an experienced CNC Programmer looking for long-term stability, excellent benefits, and the opportunity to work on precision aerospace components, we'd love to hear from you.

  • Program custom parts and tooling for specialized manufacturing applications.
  • Develop, edit, and optimize CNC programs for milling and lathe operations.
  • Set up CNC milling and lathe machines for production.
  • Create tooling methods and support tool design and manufacturing.
  • Test, verify, and troubleshoot CNC programs on production equipment.
  • Update programs to incorporate engineering changes and process improvements.
  • Collaborate with engineering and production teams to improve manufacturing efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate programming documentation and follow quality standards.

  • Minimum 5 years of CNC programming experience in a manufacturing environment.

    • Mills: Mazak, OKK, Niigata
    • Lathes: Puma
  • Proficiency with CAD/CAM software (CATIA experience preferred).
  • Experience using ERP systems (Epicor 10 preferred).
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and organizational abilities.

job.title: First Shift Production Team Member
job.description:
Job Summary
Are you a detail-oriented team player looking to build a career in modern manufacturing? We are seeking a dedicated Production Team Member to join our team. In this role, you will be the driving force behind ensuring our customers receive high-quality parts safely and on time. You will work in a collaborative environment, learn cutting-edge manufacturing methodologies, and participate directly in continuous improvement initiatives.

Major Responsibilities

  • Safety & Compliance : Maintain strict adherence to all safety procedures and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) requirements at all times.
  • Daily Operations : Report to your assigned work area on time daily to execute part loading and handling processes, ensuring precise production sequencing order.
  • Quality Assurance : Follow all quality inspection procedures consistently to deliver defect-free products to the customer.
  • Teamwork & Flexibility : Work closely with team members and rotate through various production jobs to build skills flexibility and comprehensive process knowledge.
  • Equipment Operation : Learn and follow proper operating procedures for Powered Industrial Equipment (P.I.E.) required for your specific area.
  • Problem Escalation : Immediately contact your Team Leader regarding any issues relating to safety, quality, production, or equipment.
  • Continuous Improvement (TPS) : Learn and actively apply Toyota Production System principles, including:
    • Kaizen : Participate in problem-solving and Continuous Improvement activities using the P.D.C.A. (Plan, Do, Check, Act) framework.
    • Standard Work : Understand and comply with established standard work procedures.
    • FMDS Compliance : Execute Floor Management Development System standards to take 5-S workplace organization to the next level.
  • Customer & Leadership Communication : Maintain respectful, accountable, and professional communication with customers and follow work instructions from your Team Leader.

Qualifications & Requirements
  • Strong commitment to workplace safety and quality standards.
  • Excellent attendance record and punctuality.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team and adapt to changing duties.
  • Willingness to cross-train on multiple jobs and learn new manufacturing systems (TPS, 5-S, FMDS).

job.description:
Nesco Resource is looking for a Quality Control Floor Insepctor on 2nd shift in Bethel, CT. This is a temp to hire position for the right candidate. Hourly pay is between $28-$30.00/hour depending on experience.

2nd Shift: Monday- Friday from 3:30 PM to 12:00 AM

Job Overview:
The QC Lead is responsible for the supervision and coordination of activities for workers engaged in inspecting incoming materials, components and finished products to ensure that products are meeting the requirements, quality standards and customer specifications. Types of parts typically being inspected include: gun parts, warheads, tank parts, aerospace parts and computer boxes.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct thorough inspections of incoming materials, components, and finished products to ensure they meet quality specifications and regulatory requirements.

  • At least 5 years of experience working in quality control or a similar role in a manufacturing or production environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot defects and deviations from quality standards.
  • Experience with GD&T
  • Proficiency in using Micrometers, Calipers, Height Gage,Plug Gage, and Thread Gage for quality inspections.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate and resolve quality issues effectively.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and collaborate effectively in a team environment.

Hudson, New Hampshire

We are seeking a highly resourceful, "MacGyver "-style Industrial Maintenance Mechanic / Electrician (Helpful) for our manufacturing facility in the area. This role is designed for a gifted "farm mechanic " who excels at creative problem-solving and can reliably keep legacy and modern machinery running. You will operate with high autonomy in a fast-paced environment, handling high-volume electrical, mechanical, and facilities repairs.
 
Key Responsibilities
Creative Troubleshooting & Machine Maintenance

  • Diagnose, bypass, or repair complex interlocking machine failures directly at the machine level. (Develop creative diagnostic workarounds to isolate faults and repair complex machine failures safely).
  • Keep legacy machinery operational through creative engineering and adaptation when standard parts are unavailable.
  • Perform comprehensive break-fix maintenance on overhead cranes and hoisting systems.
  • Rebuild, flush, and repair high-pressure hydraulic systems and industrial components.
  • Maintain and repair commercial HVAC units and motorized overhead garage doors. Welding desired
Electrical Systems & Schematics
  • Troubleshoot, repair, and install 3-phase and 4-phase industrial electrical infrastructure.

Sourcing & Structural Projects
  • Independently source replacement components online, utilizing specialized vendor networks to locate obsolete, hard-to-find parts for older machines.

  • Overtime as needed

job.description:
Glue Machine Adjuster
Location: Roanoke, VA
Direct Hire opportunity 
 

Are you an experienced gluer operator ready to take the next step in your career? This is a working lead opportunity with direct crew responsibility — a clear path toward a supervisory role for someone who combines hands-on technical skill with the ability to train, coach, and drive results on the floor. If you've got years in folding carton or sheet-fed lithography and you're ready to own a shift, this is worth a look.

 

Produces high-quality printed material to job specifications by setting up and operating gluing equipment and related auxiliaries. Responsible for achieving and maintaining adhesion quality to customer standards, coordinating and developing machine crew, documenting production results, and keeping equipment and supplies in order.

 
Responsibilities:

  • Execute the daily shift production schedule
  • Coordinate, train, and develop the glue machine crew; assign responsibilities and enforce safe work practices, housekeeping, GMP, and quality procedures
  • Document shift performance and report production results
  • Read and interpret job orders and specifications
  • Determine materials needed to fulfill order requirements

  • Perform machine make-ready using available make-ready stock
  • Achieve and maintain glue and adhesion quality in line with process and quality specifications
  • Inspect finished product to verify quality and process control; take corrective action on deviations

  • Maintain clean and organized work area
  • Return excess consumables and materials to designated storage locations
  • Follow all safety rules and regulations
  • Additional duties as assigned by finishing leadership
 
Skills & Abilities:
  • Able to read, write, record, and communicate production data effectively
  • Strong time management and follow-through
  • Solid troubleshooting and problem analysis skills
  • Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and develop a crew
  • Computer literate
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Good color vision
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer
job.description:
Manufacturing Engineer
Location: Avon, OH

We are seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to optimize production processes, support new product launches, and drive continuous improvement in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This role is responsible for developing manufacturing methods, implementing new equipment and automation, improving quality and productivity through Lean initiatives, and collaborating with engineering, production, maintenance, and customers to deliver efficient, cost-effective manufacturing solutions. The ideal candidate has a strong background in manufacturing engineering, CAD design, ERP systems, and process improvement, with experience supporting custom manufacturing and capital equipment projects.

Job duties

  • Develop, document, and improve manufacturing processes, methods, tooling, and work instructions to meet product specifications and ISO 9001:2015 standards.
  • Convert engineering designs into manufacturing documentation, including ERP routings, SolidWorks drawings, fixtures, and setup procedures.
  • Lead new product launches, prototype builds, first-article inspections, and capital equipment projects from design through commissioning and operator training.
  • Design and implement automated and semi-automated equipment, tooling, fixtures, and safe workstations in collaboration with Maintenance.
  • Drive Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives using production metrics, SQDC, root cause analysis, and waste reduction techniques.
  • Analyze production data to improve safety, quality, productivity, and overall manufacturing performance.
  • Provide technical support, cost estimates, project proposals, and customer-focused manufacturing solutions.
  • Support OSHA safety initiatives and maintain compliance with ISO 9001:2015 quality systems, audits, and corrective actions.

Requirements
  • Bachelor of Science in Manufacturing, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and hands-on manufacturing experience.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years' experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of SolidWorks and AutoCAD, 2D and 3D design.
  • ERP system proficiency (routings, BOMs); Syteline or SAP preferred.
  • Experience handling customer proposals, quotes, and pricing.
  • Ability to interact effectively with customers, management, and inter- and intra-departmental co-workers, including sales and production personnel. Heavy interaction and consultation with Production Supervisors.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, along with exceptional interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Experience in copper or nonferrous metals fabrication, high-current electrical products, or custom/engineer-to-order job-shop manufacturing.
  • Hands-on knowledge of CNC machining, waterjet or laser cutting, and welding/brazing/press-welding processes.
  • Lean manufacturing training or certification (e.g., Six Sigma Green Belt); experience leading Kaizen, 5S, or value stream mapping events.
  • Experience specifying, installing, or commissioning new capital equipment.
  • Familiarity with CMMS platforms and maintenance/reliability practices.

Shift: 1 st (Monday through Friday)
Salary: $82K-$98K a year based on experience

Job Description

Job Title: Manufacturing Technician $24 p/hr

7AM to 3:30PM
Summary: With regular guidance, operate Shaping equipment such as Polishing, automatic &/or manual indexing head coring, Scribing, Dicing, sawing, grinding, chamfering machines. Providing setups and operations of up to three machines simultaneously, while working with various sized and thickness optical filter plates. Performs in process and final spectral & Metrology (Interferometry) & environmental testing using several different possible instruments.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but not limited to the following; all other duties as assigned.
Adheres to efficient production cycle times
Determines operation sequence of up to three machines; select programs, adjust speeds, feeds, depths, etc.
Performs machine adjustments as specified in production orders; replace dull or damaged tooling as required.
Provides shaped substrates within process capabilities; inspect and document when process yields fall outside process capabilities.
Makes standard configuration changes
Delivers completed work to next operational station
Maintains work areas and equipment as clean, stocked, operational and in safe condition
Sets up spectrophotometer & other equipment per instructions.
Performs spectral, Metrology or environmental tests using spectrophotometer or other equipment per instructions.
Provides accurate test data to appropriate internal customers.
Evaluates data against specifications on work-order and, Mark off discrepant parts/areas.
Enters test results into computer database per instructions.
Perform adhesion, abrasion, humidity tests

Perform cosmetic evaluations


Competencies:
To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:
Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; uses time efficiently; able to multi-task; plans for additional resources; sets goals and objectives; organizes or schedules other people and their tasks; develops realistic action plans.
Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; responds well to questions.
Attention to Detail – Thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Qualifications:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education/Experience:
High School diploma
Operate up to three machines while following defined processes and process capabilities
Trained in more than one process

Language Ability:
Read and respond to work order instructions
Ability to interpret instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form.

Math Ability:
Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.

Reasoning Ability:
Ability to recognize practical problems and handle numerous process-related variables

Computer Skills:
To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of BARR's computer software, as well as an understanding of word processing software and general reporting software/programs, including working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, MS Word and/or Microsoft Access.

Work Environment:
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is exposed to work near moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles, and extreme heat (non-weather).
The noise level in the work environment is usually loud and typical of a manufacturing environment.

Physical Demands:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The employee must occasionally lift, carry and /or move up to 50 pounds.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, ability to distinguish color, use of peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach and lift with hands and arms above shoulder; frequently required to hear and smell; occasionally sitting, stooping, kneeling, crouch or crawling.[1]

job.title: Second Shift Production Team Member
job.description:
Job Summary
Are you a detail-oriented team player looking to build a career in modern manufacturing? We are seeking a dedicated Production Team Member to join our team. In this role, you will be the driving force behind ensuring our customers receive high-quality parts safely and on time. You will work in a collaborative environment, learn cutting-edge manufacturing methodologies, and participate directly in continuous improvement initiatives.

Major Responsibilities

  • Safety & Compliance : Maintain strict adherence to all safety procedures and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) requirements at all times.
  • Daily Operations : Report to your assigned work area on time daily to execute part loading and handling processes, ensuring precise production sequencing order.
  • Quality Assurance : Follow all quality inspection procedures consistently to deliver defect-free products to the customer.
  • Teamwork & Flexibility : Work closely with team members and rotate through various production jobs to build skills flexibility and comprehensive process knowledge.
  • Equipment Operation : Learn and follow proper operating procedures for Powered Industrial Equipment (P.I.E.) required for your specific area.

    • Standard Work : Understand and comply with established standard work procedures.
    • FMDS Compliance : Execute Floor Management Development System standards to take 5-S workplace organization to the next level.
  • Customer & Leadership Communication : Maintain respectful, accountable, and professional communication with customers and follow work instructions from your Team Leader.

Qualifications & Requirements
  • Strong commitment to workplace safety and quality standards.
  • Excellent attendance record and punctuality.

  • Strong communication skills with an emphasis on respect and accountability.
  • Ability to operate or learn to operate Powered Industrial Equipment (P.I.E.).
  • physical capability to handle repetitive tasks and stand for extended periods.

job.title: Purchasing Buyer
job.description:
Position Summary:
Directs the activities associated with the SCMG managed global spend for a designated commodity category. Responsible for identification and evaluation of North American opportunities within the commodity category for reduction of spend, consolidation of process, function and continuity of supply. Manages the Client contracts within the commodity category and reports the metrics associated with them. Delivers continuous improvement in cost processes and services within the commodity category. Will be responsible for requests for information (RFI) or quotes (RFQ). Generates recommendations based on Total Cost of Ownership comparisons. Monitors and reports on activities associated with named commodity categories. Major Duties and

Responsibilities:
Formulate annual business plans for achievement of cost reductions and year-over-year performance improvement.
Obtains and analyzes quotes to determine best value, then recommends global sourcing solutions based on data and facts collected.
Can layout and explain a commodity strategy. Follows and tracks to the strategy for basic commodities. Understands all aspects of commodity strategy templates. Can create a strategy but may be limited to current state (static) and not completely global. May be limited to more basic commodities. Utilizes capability matrices to develop strategy.
Provides proper documentation for review at sourcing councils, including total landed cost analysis taking into account duty, freight, packaging, surcharge, payment terms, and other financial factors. Includes understanding of SSA status and any financial risk. Consistently utilizes IPOs in quoting new business. Considers global spending for all suppliers.
Ability to maintain control of multiple projects to meet timing and anticipate and resolve 'roadblocks' for successful part PPAP and launch. Monitors technical review progress with cross-functional teams; ensures OISRs are updated and tracks to program milestones.
"Ability to clearly understand the financial and strategic impacts of agreed to 'gives' and 'gets' to optimize the value to Client and negotiate complex supplier issues with little to no supervision. Understands tactics to position Client with the most leverage possible.
Consistently sends out and reviews complete RFQ packages and negotiates the basic terms of a contract to support an agreement. Understand what type of contract is required. Understands key points to leverage beyond price. Understands Client's standard Terms and Conditions.
Monitors supplier(s) performance, audits results and elevates issues within the supplier's organization for resolution. Understands and review the corrective actions for sustained results. Holds regular performance review meetings with key stakeholders and measures compliance to agreements. Tracks Savings projects and reports accurate forecasts and actuals in the Savings Tracker. Understands supplier surcharge mechanisms.
Works proactively with other departments to find ways of reducing the need for inventory.
Manages the supply chain to ensure optimum workflows and takes active steps to remove non-value-added work. Challenges the status quo and engages help and support from other functional groups. Makes specific and comprehensive recommendations for process improvements. Understands DOS and can lead improvement activities with assistance.
Is able to lead Benchmarking, VA/VE, Lean, Resourcing, LPP analysis, Value Stream mapping events with no assistance. Thinks creatively about using what is learned from the savings toolbox to generate a range of improvement options for the business. Promotes cost reduction activities with key suppliers and shares best practices

Minimum Qualifications
Four-year degree in Business (Supply Chain Management or Purchasing is preferred) or four year degree in Engineering (Product or Manufacturing)
Professional Supply chain certification preferred
3-5 years of experience in procurement, preferred
Strong team player, able to work effectively on cross-functional teams.
Excellent communication skills, verbal and written.
Maintains an organized and professional manner when representing Client.
Willing to travel as required (estimate 10%).

Required Skills:
Ability to work on tasks along with prioritizing work and managing deadlines.
Understands interactions that affect outcomes for problem-solving. Uses analytical abilities to distill complex issues into workable parts for themselves. Anticipates consequences of alternative options.
Possesses and uses appropriate levels of intellectual ability to achieve objectives and maximize results. Demonstrates a determined, engaged, thoughtful approach to doing day-to-day work. Applies knowledge of global organizational issues to his/her own work.
Can identify areas of deficiency in processes and employ resources to optimize.
Can support and personalize the needed change within the group/dept./organization.
Develops relationships across the corporation to facilitate inter-divisional cooperation and cross-functional asset utilization
Provides prompt, courteous, and attentive service to both internal and external customers.
Accomplishes tasks and makes effective decisions without guidance, even outside the framework of their direct work responsibility.
Recognizes the talents, skills, and behaviors that the organization needs. Demonstrates self-awareness and takes action to improve individual performance/capabilities.
Inspires others in setting and achieving standards of excellence. Can get others on board, engaged and committed to objectives; can overcome resistance. Effectively get things done through others by delegating, motivating, focusing and leveraging the appropriate resources to meet objectives.
Establishes open, candid and trusting relationships. Treats others fairly and consistently. Effectively handles conflicts and issues impacting working relationships.
Actively supports the implementation and maintenance of lean value and the related value stream.
Demonstrates a high level of cooperation and collaboration with internal and external relationships.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to work with people at all levels within and outside Client in a professional manner.
Familiarity with Procurement and Quality Supplier Metrics with flow-down to supplier contracts and performance reviews.
Must have an understanding of blueprints and technical specifications. Strong personal computer skills required, including experience with MS Office Software

job.description:
Job Summary

Under limited supervision, operates equipment such as small presses, riveters, welders and drivers. The machines may be manual or automatic; adjustments are of a routine nature. Tolerances are normally close but not difficult to measure or maintain. Produces a variety of assemblies or subassemblies.

Other duties as required by Management.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  1. Operate machines and all auxiliary equipment with minimum supervision.
  2. Change over equipment and ensure quality of product.
  3. Make changes in prescribed operating conditions as necessary to produce quality products.
  4. Perform necessary test and measurements to assure product meets required specifications.
  5. Keep accurate products data and records as required.
  6. Correct or adjust any machine malfunction immediately to ensure continuity of production and quality of next process.
  7. Report any major machine malfunction immediately to Supervisor/Group Leader.
  8. Continually inspect products while performing other duties.
  9. Maintain a clean and safe work area.
  10. Assist in other duties as directed by your Supervisor/Group Leader.

job.title: Senior Systems Software Developer (RPG/AS400/System21)
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Senior Systems Software Developer to join its ERP Engineering team and support the design, enhancement, and maintenance of enterprise applications within the IBM iSeries and System21 ERP environment. This role focuses on delivering technology-enabled business processes that improve operational efficiency, data quality, and user experience across the organization.
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in IBM iSeries (AS/400), RPG development, and the System21 ERP platform, particularly within the Finance module. This position combines hands-on development, technical leadership, application modernization, and cross-functional collaboration to support critical business operations.

Core Responsibilities
• Support continuous improvement initiatives across ERP and related business systems to align technology with evolving business objectives.
• Analyze, document, maintain, and help modernize internally developed applications while supporting migration and consolidation efforts.
• Perform complex data transformations, migrations, and mass data updates in accordance with change control standards.
• Translate business and transactional process requirements into effective technical solutions.
• Contribute to enterprise systems architecture and technology standards.
• Communicate project status, deliverables, and expectations to technical teams and business stakeholders.
• Collaborate closely with business units to understand operational goals and optimize ERP platform capabilities.
• Mentor team members and foster strong cross-functional relationships.
• Develop and maintain integration interfaces using Boomi iPaaS while ensuring availability, performance, and data integrity.
• Apply advanced system configuration, process automation, and implementation practices within an agile environment.
• Partner with ERP and Financial Systems teams to represent organizational solutions within the broader ERP community and industry events.
• Perform additional duties as required.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor's degree in Business Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent business, financial, or technical experience.
• 8+ years of IBM iSeries RPG development experience, ideally including work with the IBM System21 ERP platform.
• 8+ years of experience as a Programmer Analyst supporting ERP, financial, or transactional enterprise business systems.
• Extensive experience with IBM iSeries, DB2, CLP, Sequel Viewpoint, and GoAnywhere.
• Proven ability to design, develop, and enhance applications on the IBM System21 ERP platform using RPG III/IV/ILE, RPG Free, CL, and SQL.
• Experience with development tools and source control systems such as Aldon Community Manager.
• Experience serving as a solution architect and translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
• Strong experience collaborating with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams to define specifications and deliver solutions.
• Ability to provide technical oversight and mentorship to other developers.
• Experience modernizing System21 applications through modularization, API development, and external system integrations.
• Strong troubleshooting, optimization, and maintenance skills for RPG-based applications, including performance, reliability, and compliance considerations.
• Deep understanding of System21 ERP modules, including Finance, Distribution, Manufacturing, and related functional areas.
• Strong knowledge of ERP data structures, business processes, and integration points.
• Hands-on experience with system performance tuning and debugging.
• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Experience in manufacturing or distribution environments.

Work Details
• Remote within the United States.
• Candidates must be located in the Eastern or Central Time Zone.
• Occasional travel is required.
• The role may require evening and weekend work to support meetings, conferences, and deployment schedules across multiple time zones.

job.title: Industrial Laborer 1st Shift
job.description:
Industrial Laborer

1st Shift
Pay $20-$25 per hour

We are seeking a dependable Industrial Laborer to support equipment disassembly, material handling, and preparation of industrial equipment and components for shipment. This position is ideal for someone with forklift experience who is comfortable working in a factory or industrial environment and understands the importance of working safely around heavy machinery and elevated work areas.

The work is hands-on and repetitive, requiring good attention to detail, the ability to follow directions, and a strong commitment to workplace safety.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Assist with the disassembly and demolition of equipment and robotic cells.
  • Separate equipment, components, and materials into the appropriate designated areas.
  • Prepare equipment and components for shipment, including organizing, palletizing, banding, and securing loads.
  • Operate a forklift to safely move materials, equipment, and components as needed.
  • Properly and evenly distribute materials and equipment on pallets to ensure safe and stable loads.
  • Band, strap, and secure pallets and loads according to established procedures.
  • Operate basic power tools and hand tools as needed.
  • Assist machinery and equipment operators by safely spotting and guiding when required.
  • Communicate clearly with employees operating machinery or working at elevated heights.
  • Safely monitor and guide workers working above ground level to help prevent hazards to employees working below.
  • Maintain awareness of active equipment and traffic areas and stay clear of unsafe zones.
  • Follow all required PPE, fall protection, forklift, and workplace safety procedures.
  • Follow instructions from supervisors and work independently when assigned.
  • Keep work areas clean, organized, and free of unnecessary hazards.
  • Perform other general labor duties as assigned.

Safety Expectations

Safety is a critical part of this position. The successful candidate should have a good understanding of basic industrial safety practices, including:

  • Proper use of required PPE.

job.title: Project Management Specialist - Biotech/Pharma
job.description:
Client is seeking a Project Manager to provide strategic and operational project leadership across API external manufacturing, supporting the management of commercial supply and related initiatives at a contract manufacturing organization (CMO). This role integrates activities across quality, supply chain, engineering, regulatory, and finance, translating program strategy into disciplined execution to ensure reliable commercial supply of key therapeutics.

Responsible for facilitating and supporting CMO oversight and project delivery, including the following:
Manage scope and support creation of an integrated project plan that articulates the strategy for the CMO relationship and its key initiatives, and provides the foundation for operational objectives and milestones.
Coordinate cross-functional obligations between Lilly and the CMO, including quality oversight, supply coordination, deviation/CAPA and change-control interfaces, and contract and governance commitments.
Create and execute project plans and drive delivery of project milestones across the initiative lifecycle.
Develop and implement team communication plans and drive communication of key decisions, risks, and results to stakeholders and leadership.
Monitor and prioritize project and supply risks, suggest ways to avoid or mitigate risks, and initiate contingency plans as needed.
Bring forward areas for continual process improvement to strengthen schedule discipline, reduce cost, and improve reliability of commercial supply and project delivery.
Drive development of an integrated project budget and support financial governance, ensuring alignment with functional representatives, finance, and leadership.
Proficient in self-management and organizational skills; able to manage workload, set personal and team priorities, and adjust as needed in a dynamic, multi-workstream environment.
Strong interpersonal and team-building skills; able to develop effective teamwork between Client and CMO team members with diverse styles and across organizational boundaries.

-Bachelor's degree in engineering, a scientific field, or a related technical discipline, and a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical operations.
-Advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., MS, MBA, Master's in Project Management, PMP, or a commissioning/qualification/validation credential) preferred.
-Experience overseeing project lifecycle of commercial or external manufacturing at a contract manufacturer (CMO/CDMO), including quality oversight, supply coordination, deviation/CAPA and change-control interfaces, and contract governance.

The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, able to read and write neatly in English, and capable of inspecting products using a magnifying glass.

  • Follow daily instructions from work orders and verbal guidance from Leads/Supervisors.
  • Tasks may vary daily and can include sitting, standing, or a combination of both throughout the day.

  • Use measuring equipment to test the accuracy of finished products.

  • Light Assembly
  • Manually wipe/clean small parts before packaging.

  • Reliability and excellent work ethic.

  • Prior manufacturing or cleanroom experience is a plus but not required.

  • Personal items (phones, keys, wallets, etc.) must be left outside the cleanroom; lockers are provided.

  • Employees must wear full-length pants or leggings/nylons if wearing capris. No shorts allowed.

job.title: Material Handler
job.description:
Nesco Resource is hiring for a Molding Material Handler in Shelbyville, TN,
2nd shift - 3:00pm - 11:00 pm.

POSITION SUMMARY
The Molding Material Handler is responsible for supporting the daily execution of Molding operations by ensuring materials, equipment, and production areas are prepared, maintained, and aligned with operational requirements. This position supports the Molding Working Lead and department leadership in meeting safety, quality, productivity, and housekeeping expectations while helping maintain a consistent and efficient production flow.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Adhere to all company policies, procedures, safety standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain adequate material flow by filling hoppers and dryers in support of active production schedules.
  • Empty grinders and manage regrind material in accordance with department expectations.
  • Prepare upcoming production materials by pre-drying materials as required to support scheduled mold changes and production needs.
  • Clean material loaders, grinders, and related equipment during color changes, material changes, and mold changeovers.
  • Verify molding machines are clean, prepared, and ready for startup.
  • Confirm auxiliary equipment is properly positioned and available to support efficient startup and production continuity.
  • Maintain organization, cleanliness, and overall appearance of material storage and production areas.
  • Operate a forklift safely and responsibly when required to support material movement and production needs.
  • Move finished product to the appropriate inventory or staging location as directed.
  • Escalate safety, housekeeping, material, or equipment concerns to leadership in a timely manner.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by the Working Lead, or management team.
  • Provide operational support and assume appropriate department responsibilities when the Working Lead is not present.

QUALIFICATIONS
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below represent the knowledge, skills, abilities, and experience required for the position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES
  • Demonstrated mechanical aptitude and ability to work with production-related equipment.
  • Ability to understand, interpret, and follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Ability to learn, retain, and apply operational procedures and department expectations.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to respond quickly and effectively to operational needs.
  • Basic math skills required.
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office applications preferred.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team-oriented manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced production environment with changing priorities.
  • Ability to lift to 50 pounds as required by the position.
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy, consistency, and safety.
  • Willingness and availability to work extended hours and/or overtime as business needs require.
  • Ability to learn forklift operation; forklift certification or prior forklift experience preferred.
  • Minimum of one year of experience in injection molding material handling preferred.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
Prior experience in injection molding material handling is preferred. Forklift certification or prior forklift experience is preferred; ability to learn forklift operation is required.

WORK ENVIRONMENT
This position operates in a manufacturing environment and requires regular interaction with molding, material handling, and production equipment. The employee is expected to follow all safety practices, wear required personal protective equipment, and maintain awareness of surrounding equipment, material movement, and production activity.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical requirements outlined below are representative of those necessary to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to stand for the duration of the shift and must be able to bend, twist, push, pull, grasp, and lift material weighing up to 50 pounds or more as required. The employee is regularly required to communicate verbally and listen effectively. Specific vision abilities required include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

job.title: Maintenance Tech
job.description:
Maintenance Technician – Aerospace Manufacturing

Location: Phoenix, AZ
Shift: 1st Shift | Monday–Friday

Position Summary

We are seeking a Maintenance Technician to support a precision manufacturing operation serving the aerospace and defense industries. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career maintenance professional looking to build their skills in a highly technical manufacturing environment.

The Maintenance Technician will assist with preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs of CNC machinery, production equipment, and facility systems. The ideal candidate will have at least one year of hands-on maintenance experience and a strong desire to learn and develop their technical skills.

Responsibilities

  • Perform preventative and routine maintenance on CNC machines, production equipment, and facility systems.
  • Troubleshoot basic mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic issues.
  • Assist with diagnosing equipment problems and identifying the appropriate repair.
  • Inspect, adjust, repair, and replace components such as belts, bearings, motors, sensors, switches, and other mechanical/electrical parts.
  • Use hand tools, power tools, multimeters, and other maintenance equipment.
  • Assist with electrical troubleshooting using wiring diagrams and schematics.
  • Respond to equipment breakdowns and maintenance requests to help minimize production downtime.
  • Complete scheduled preventative maintenance tasks and accurately document work performed.
  • Assist with the installation, setup, relocation, and modification of equipment.
  • Work with Production and Engineering personnel to identify and resolve equipment issues.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe maintenance work area.
  • Follow all company safety procedures and quality standards.
  • Perform other maintenance-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of hands-on industrial or manufacturing maintenance experience.
  • Basic mechanical and electrical troubleshooting experience.
  • Familiarity with pneumatic and/or hydraulic systems.
  • Comfortable using common hand tools and power tools.
  • Basic ability to read electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, or equipment manuals.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting mindset.
  • Basic computer skills.
  • Reliable, safety-conscious, and willing to learn.
  • Ability to work independently while also taking direction from experienced maintenance personnel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working around CNC machines or other precision manufacturing equipment.
  • Exposure to PLCs, sensors, motors, drives, or automated equipment.
  • Basic welding or fabrication experience.
  • Experience with preventative maintenance programs or CMMS systems.
  • Previous experience in aerospace, defense, CNC machining, or precision manufacturing.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk throughout the manufacturing facility for extended periods.
  • Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, reach, and work around machinery.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to safely work around operating machinery, electrical equipment, coolants, and other manufacturing processes.
  • Ability to wear required PPE.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a mid-level Maintenance Technician who can step onto the floor and immediately contribute. This person should be comfortable troubleshooting equipment independently, communicating with production teams, and taking ownership of preventative maintenance and repairs while maintaining the high safety and quality standards expected in an aerospace manufacturing environment.

job.title: Engineering Manager
job.description:
One of Long Island's finest manufacturers has an excellent career opportunity for a talented and successful Engineering leader! You won't find a company with a better work culture than this one. They have an awesome team and really value and take care of their employees.

Position Description:

The Manager of Engineering leads the Engineering team at and is responsible for maintaining, improving, and supporting existing products throughout their lifecycle. The role ensures product reliability, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams across the organization. The position provides technical and disciplinary leadership to the team and contributes to operational excellence and long-term product sustainability.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

Engineering Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate the Engineering function to support existing products throughout their lifecycle.
  • Manage New Product Introduction Processes for OEM products
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost optimization.
  • Ensure timely evaluation and implementation of engineering changes (ECR/ECO).
  • Support root cause analysis and corrective actions for field issues and quality concerns.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal standards.

Team Leadership and People Management

  • Provide technical and disciplinary leadership to the Sustaining Engineering team.
  • Support employee development, mentoring, and performance management.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and solution-oriented team culture.
  • Support hiring and onboarding activities as needed.

Work Experience Requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience leading engineering or technical teams.
  • Experience in sustaining engineering, product lifecycle management, or a related technical environment.
  • Experience working in regulated industries (medical or dental devices preferred).

Core Skills Requirements:

  • Strong understanding of product lifecycle management and change management processes.
  • Knowledge of FDA, CE, and applicable medical device regulations.
  • Ability to work effectively in an international and cross-functional environment.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Interest in future technologies and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Occasional travel is required

Education Requirements:

  • Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline required.
  • Master's in mechanical engineering is preferred.

job.description:
PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE OF ASSIGNMENT:

The purpose of this position is to maintain (keep in good working conditions) the injection molding machines, tools and production equipment to prevent unscheduled downtime.

POSITION QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:

High School or equivalent (GED) education.
Industry experience is preferred.
A minimum of two (2) years' molding experience is required.
The individual must be able to:

  • stand most of the time.
  • lift 50 pounds.
  • understand the molding process.
  • read and understand drawings (Part & Tool drawings).
  • understand the concept and structure tools.

PRINCIPLE DUTIES:

  • The associate must understand and comply with the YAHAGI Quality Policy, Objectives, company policies, procedures and instructions. The associate must understand the relevance and importance of their position and how they contribute to the achievement of the quality objectives.
  • The associate must understand and follow established procedures, instructions and control plans to ensure processes and products meet all customer requirements.
  • Perform required inspections, take basic measurements and record required data on production inspection records/logs or special logs provided for the purpose.
  • Identify and report to management when a process or product is nonconforming (not meeting process specifications or meeting customer product requirements). Follow the corrective action process.
  • Perform normal cleaning and maintenance on equipment and workstations and maintain the work area in a clean and orderly manner consistent with the YAMI 5-S philosophy.
  • Understand Requirements for ISO9001:2015.
  • Identify and recommend continual improvement suggestions. (Kaizen My Idea form)
  • Identify and recommend preventive actions to prevent a potential nonconformance from occurring.
  • Understand and report to senior molding personnel when a machine or molding tool is not operating properly.
  • Record data and information including reporting and replacement with shot number (quantity produced).
  • Other duties either temporary or permanent as required or assigned by management to support the application of best manufacturing practices at Yahagi America Molding, Inc.
  • Work overtime at a moment's notice or without prior notice.
  • Perform preventive maintenance work on any tool or equipment as needed.
  • Must be a team player with a good attitude and demonstrate leadership abilities.

The individual in this position will be responsible for performing preventive maintenance of all tools and equipment. This individual will also be responsible for changing molds when required.

APPLY TODAY & GET YOUR CAREER MOVING!

job.title: Industrial Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Maintenance Technician

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Maintenance Technician to support the ongoing operation and reliability of manufacturing equipment, facility systems, and utilities within a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. This position will be responsible for performing preventative and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting equipment issues, and supporting equipment installations and facility improvement projects.

The ideal candidate is mechanically strong, comfortable troubleshooting independently, and able to work safely within a highly regulated cGMP manufacturing environment. This role requires someone who can identify the root cause of equipment problems, make effective repairs, and clearly document maintenance activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventative, predictive, and corrective maintenance on production, facility, and utility equipment.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical and electromechanical equipment to identify the cause of equipment failures and determine appropriate repairs.
  • Maintain manufacturing equipment used in the production of pharmaceutical products, including pumps, agitators, mechanical seals, gaskets, compression equipment, encapsulation machinery, compactors, coating equipment, and related systems.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot facility and utility systems, including HVAC, compressed air, dust collection, refrigeration, boilers, electrical systems, purified water/RO systems, and other supporting utilities.
  • Read and interpret equipment manuals, mechanical drawings, layouts, specifications, and electrical/wiring diagrams.
  • Use precision measuring equipment such as calipers, micrometers, levels, and other diagnostic tools to evaluate equipment and components.
  • Make equipment adjustments, alignments, repairs, and component replacements using appropriate hand and power tools.
  • Fabricate or modify replacement components when necessary using machine shop equipment.
  • Assist with the installation, startup, modification, and maintenance of new equipment and facility systems.
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, equipment conditions, repairs, and follow-up requirements.
  • Provide technical information to assist with identifying and ordering replacement parts and maintaining appropriate spare-parts inventory.
  • Communicate equipment issues, maintenance needs, and ongoing work clearly with team members and other departments.
  • Respond promptly to maintenance requests while maintaining a strong focus on production needs and internal customer service.
  • Follow established SOPs, manufacturer recommendations, maintenance procedures, and cGMP requirements.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Follow all site safety policies and procedures, including proper lockout/tagout practices.
  • Perform confined-space work when required and in accordance with applicable safety procedures.
  • Complete assigned maintenance work safely, accurately, and efficiently with minimal supervision.

Qualifications

  • Previous maintenance experience in a pharmaceutical, biotech, food, chemical, or other highly regulated manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Strong mechanical troubleshooting and repair skills.
  • Experience maintaining pumps, seals, gaskets, agitators, production machinery, and other industrial equipment.
  • Working knowledge of facility and utility systems such as HVAC, compressed air, dust collection, boilers, refrigeration, and water purification systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, equipment layouts, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications.
  • Experience using precision measuring tools and common maintenance equipment.
  • Familiarity with Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures.
  • Confined-space training or experience is preferred.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize maintenance needs, and resolve equipment problems with limited supervision.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to accurately document work performed and communicate equipment conditions and outstanding issues.
  • Commitment to following safety procedures, quality standards, and established maintenance practices.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will be a hands-on maintenance professional who enjoys troubleshooting problems and keeping equipment operating reliably. You should be comfortable working independently, but also able to communicate effectively with production, engineering, and other maintenance team members.

Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment is highly valued, particularly for candidates who understand the importance of documentation, safety, preventive maintenance, and cGMP compliance.

COM067

job.title: Manufacturing Design Engineer
job.description:
Manufacturing Design Engineer in Hauppauge, NY:
Direct Hire
Salary Range: $110- 130,000

We are seeking a hands-on, detail-oriented Manufacturing Design Engineer with strong experience in metalworking, CNC and precision machining to support new and existing products from concept through production.

This role requires deep technical knowledge of turn/mill machining centers, grinding to tight tolerances, and CAD/CAM tools such as SolidWorks and SolidCam. The ideal candidate will bring a strong design and innovation mindset, creating and refining designs for new and existing metal or CNC-machined products, lead cross-functional projects, improve product designs for manufacturability, develop robust manufacturing methods, and work closely with suppliers to source high-quality components and services.

This is a great opportunity to join One of Long Island's most secure and diverse manufacturers servicing a wide variety of markets with excellent growth opportunity.

Key Responsibilities of the Manufacturing Design Engineer in Hauppauge, NY:

  • Create innovative designs for new metal and CNC-machined products, and continuously refine and improve existing product designs for performance, manufacturability, and cost.
  • Develop, document, and optimize manufacturing processes for precision metal components and assemblies.
  • Provide technical expertise in turn/mill machining centers, grinding operations, tooling, fixturing, and precision inspection methods.
  • Create and maintain manufacturing methods, routings, work instructions, setup documentation, and process controls to support efficient, repeatable production.
  • Lead projects from concept through implementation, coordinating activities across engineering, production, quality, and supply chain teams.
  • Design and redesign products, tooling, and processes with a strong focus on ease of manufacturing, cost effectiveness, quality, and scalability.
  • Use SolidWorks to support product and fixture design, and SolidCam to develop machining strategies and improve CNC programming efficiency.
  • Drive design innovation by exploring new materials, geometries, and machining approaches that improve product performance while reducing production complexity and cost.
  • Analyze production challenges, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to improve throughput, yield, and product quality.
  • Support grinding and machining operations that require tight tolerances, fine surface finishes, and consistent process capability.
  • Collaborate with production teams to improve workflow, reduce setup time, and standardize best practices.
  • Source components, raw materials, tooling, and outside services from qualified suppliers; evaluate supplier capabilities, quality, cost, and lead time.
  • Work with vendors and suppliers to support prototype development, new part introduction, cost reduction, and ongoing supply continuity.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to safety, quality, delivery, and manufacturing efficiency.
Qualifications of the Manufacturing Design Engineer in Hauppauge, NY:
  • Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in a metalworking or precision machining environment.
  • Strong knowledge of turn/mill machining centers, CNC machining practices, grinding processes, and tolerance-critical manufacturing.
  • Proven ability to design and innovate new metal or CNC-machined products, translating concepts into manufacturable, cost-effective designs.
  • Proficiency in SolidWorks and SolidCam or similar platforms,
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects and guide cross-functional teams through implementation and process improvement efforts.
  • Experience with design for manufacturability (DFM), process development, and new product introduction.
  • Experience developing comprehensive manufacturing methods and process documentation.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and individuals across all levels of the organization

A comprehensive benefits package will be offered which includes Medical, Vision, Dental, 401K, and paid time off.

As a CNC Mill Machinist, you will be responsible for shaping metal and various materials to precise dimensions using advanced machine tools. You will plan, set up, and execute the correct sequence of machine operations based on blueprints, layouts, or other technical instructions, writing both manual and computer-generated machine programs as necessary. This role requires proficiency in the use of various hand tools, micrometers, gauges, and other precision measuring instruments to ensure accuracy.

job.title: Integration & Data Analyst
job.description:
About the Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced analyst who enjoys getting into the details when systems, data, and financial information don't line up. This role sits between Technology, Finance, Accounting, Payroll, and Operations and is responsible for making sure information moves accurately between several business systems. You'll monitor integrations, investigate discrepancies, reconcile commission and accounting data, support production issues, and help maintain the controls needed to keep financial information accurate.

You'll also work with AI-enabled automation used to process incoming data, reviewing exceptions and making sure automated outputs can be trusted.

What You'll Be Doing

Systems Integration & Production Support

  • Monitor the flow of data between commission, CRM, benefits, payroll, accounting, reporting, and other business applications.
  • Investigate failed integrations, incorrect data, file-transfer problems, and other processing exceptions.
  • Identify root causes and resolve production issues.
Data Reconciliation & Financial Controls
  • Perform and improve recurring daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reconciliation processes.
  • Compare commission, revenue, compensation, payroll, and accounting information between multiple systems.
  • Research variances and trace discrepancies back to the underlying system, process, or data issue.
  • Create reconciliation procedures, exception reports, documentation, and supporting information for audits.
  • Assist with commission-related activities that support month-end close and financial reporting.

AI & Automation Support

  • Oversee automated processes used to interpret and process carrier or commission-related statements.
  • Review AI-generated data for accuracy and investigate information that falls into exception queues.
  • Develop checks and quality-control procedures that improve the reliability of automated outputs.
  • Partner with AI and automation teams on improvements to performance, scalability, and production readiness.
  • Make sure information remains consistent from the original source through commission calculations and downstream accounting systems.

Governance & Controls

  • Assist with SOX controls, audit preparation, compliance testing, and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain procedures, issue logs, operational documentation, and control processes.
  • Look for ways to improve data traceability, governance, and overall operational efficiency.
  • Strengthen processes that reduce financial, data, and operational risk.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work closely with Finance, Accounting, Payroll, Operations, Technology, and external vendors.
  • Help translate business needs into practical technical and operational solutions.
  • Take an active role in resolving production incidents and supporting system enhancements.
  • Become a go-to resource for commission systems, integrations, reconciliations, and data-quality controls.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience involving financial systems, accounting operations, commission administration, systems integrations, or data reconciliation.
  • Strong experience reconciling large datasets across multiple applications or data sources.
  • Ability to investigate data discrepancies and perform detailed root-cause analysis.
  • Experience supporting integrations and troubleshooting production data issues.
  • Experience working with AI-enabled automation or intelligent workflow processes.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation models, and data analysis.
  • Experience working with reporting platforms, data warehouses, or other operational data environments.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work comfortably with both technical and business teams.
Preferred Skills:
  • Experience with CaptivateIQ, Xactly, Varicent, SAP Callidus, or another incentive compensation platform.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Workday, Epic, payroll applications, ERP platforms, or accounting systems.
  • Experience working with APIs, ETL processes, middleware, integration monitoring, or data-validation tools.
  • Familiarity with SOX, auditing, and internal financial controls.
  • Experience supporting AI-driven automation and exception-management workflows.
  • Exposure to SQL, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, or similar data and analytics technologies.
