job.title: Maintenance Supervisor
job.description:
MAINTENANCE SUPERVISOR | $90K–$95K | DIRECT HIRE

Lead Maintenance. Drive Reliability. Develop Your Team.

Fayetteville, TN
$90,000–$95,000 Annually
Direct Hire | Full-Time

Are you an experienced Maintenance Supervisor with a strong background in automotive or manufacturing environments?

Do you have the leadership skills to guide a maintenance team, improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and support a high-performing manufacturing operation?

If so, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for!

We are seeking a Maintenance Supervisor to lead the overall maintenance operation, oversee team performance, coordinate preventive maintenance activities, and work closely with other departments to keep production running safely and efficiently.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead and direct the daily activities of the Maintenance Department.

  • Oversee overall plant maintenance and coordinate maintenance projects and schedules.

  • Develop, implement, and improve Planned Preventive Maintenance (PM) programs and equipment/asset care systems.

  • Analyze equipment downtime and recurring issues to identify root causes and implement effective countermeasures.

  • Evaluate staffing needs, coordinate schedules, and adjust resources as operational needs change.

  • Partner with Production and other departments to improve equipment reliability, efficiency, quality, cost, delivery, and safety.

  • Lead, train, mentor, and evaluate maintenance personnel and subordinate supervisors.

  • Provide technical guidance and review maintenance work, progress, and procedures.

  • Manage maintenance department expenses, budgets, cost estimates, and project proposals.

  • Research and recommend the purchase of maintenance equipment, tools, and supplies.

  • Manage and monitor spare parts inventory and ordering.

  • Obtain bids and oversee work performed by outside contractors.

  • Maintain accurate maintenance, safety, expense, and other departmental documentation.

  • Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards.

  • Support 5S, Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Quality, Safety, Delivery, and Cost initiatives.

  • Work with 2D and 3D CAD/CAM software.

  • Read and interpret blueprints and specifications and utilize measurement tools.

  • Support maintenance activities involving robotic equipment on production lines, including training maintenance personnel on robot operation and improvement activities.

  • Support welding process improvements and proper welding conditions.

  • Assist with administrative and IT-related duties as needed.

LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITIES

You will provide overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of the maintenance team and subordinate supervisors.

Responsibilities include:

  • Interviewing, hiring, and training employees

  • Planning and assigning work

  • Directing daily activities

  • Evaluating employee performance

  • Coaching and mentoring team members

  • Addressing employee concerns and resolving problems

  • Supporting company goals and performance expectations

QUALIFICATIONS

Required/Preferred Experience:

  • 2+ years of leadership experience in Maintenance, preferably within an automotive and/or manufacturing environment.

  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

  • Strong understanding of preventive maintenance, equipment reliability, and troubleshooting.

  • Experience analyzing downtime and implementing root-cause solutions.

  • Previous experience leading, training, and developing maintenance personnel.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

COMPUTER & TECHNICAL SKILLS

Experience with:

  • Microsoft Office — Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams

  • ERP systems

  • CAD/CAM or related engineering/manufacturing software

  • Blueprints, specifications, and measurement tools

  • Industrial equipment and maintenance systems

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL

The ideal candidate is a hands-on maintenance leader who can balance people, production, equipment, and budget responsibilities.

You should be comfortable analyzing problems, making decisions, communicating with management, developing your team, and stepping onto the production floor when technical guidance is needed.

SCHEDULE & TRAVEL

  • Schedule may vary based on operational and administrative needs.

  • Occasional overtime, holidays, or alternate shifts may be required.

  • Local, national, and international travel may occasionally be required.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This is a hands-on manufacturing leadership position. The role requires the ability to stand, walk, operate industrial equipment, use hands for repetitive tasks, and occasionally climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, and reach.

The position may require pushing, pulling, moving, and/or lifting up to 25 pounds.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The Maintenance Supervisor will work in an active manufacturing environment with exposure to:

  • Moving mechanical parts and machinery

  • Vehicles and electrical equipment

  • Industrial exhaust and production substances

  • Oils and vibration

  • Varying temperatures

  • Narrow aisles or passageways

Noise levels may range from moderate to loud.

READY TO TAKE THE LEAD?

If you're an experienced maintenance leader who knows how to develop people, improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and keep manufacturing operations running safely and efficiently, we want to hear from you!

Apply today for immediate consideration for this Direct Hire Maintenance Supervisor opportunity in Fayetteville, TN.

job.title: Engineering Technician - (Biotech)
job.description:
Electrical Engineering Technician
Location: Andover, MA
Department: Research & Development
Reports To: Senior Manager, Electrical Engineering

Role Overview:
The Electrical Engineering Technician is responsible for the assembly, testing, troubleshooting, repair, and rework of electronic hardware used in prototype and production medical devices.
The successful candidate will support electrical engineers by building and evaluating printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs), cable assemblies, and test fixtures while maintaining high- quality workmanship and documentation standards.

This position requires strong hands-on electronics skills, including soldering and rework of surface mount and through-hole components, as well as the ability to work independently once instructions and objectives are provided.

Key Responsibilities:

Hardware Assembly and Rework (40%)
Assemble prototype and production electronic hardware, including PCBAs, cable assemblies, and electromechanical systems.
Perform soldering, de-soldering, component replacement, and rework of both through- hole and surface mount devices.
Inspect assemblies for workmanship and compliance with drawings and specifications.
Support engineering investigations by modifying existing hardware and implementing design updates.

Testing and Troubleshooting (35%)
Build, configure, and operate electrical test setups and fixtures.
Perform functional, verification, validation, and debug testing of electronic circuits and systems.
Troubleshoot PCBAs and electronic assemblies to the component level.
Use oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, signal generators, and other laboratory equipment to diagnose issues.
Collect and document test results and provide feedback to engineering teams.

Documentation and Laboratory Support (15%)
Maintain accurate records of builds, repairs, test activities, and results.
Support development of work instructions, assembly procedures, and test protocols.
Maintain laboratory equipment and ensure a safe, organized work environment.
Assist with inventory management of components, tools, and consumables.

Engineering Support (10%)
Collaborate with engineers to support prototype development and product verification activities.
Assist with transferring designs from development into manufacturing.
Provide recommendations for improving assembly processes, test methods, and product reliability.

Required Qualifications

Education:
Associate degree in Electrical Engineering Technology, Electronics Technology, or related technical field preferred.
Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.

Experience:
3+ years of hands-on electronics technician experience.
Experience assembling, testing, troubleshooting, and repairing electronic assemblies.
Experience working with PCBAs and electronic test equipment.

Required Skills:
Excellent soldering and rework skills for both SMT and through-hole components.
Ability to read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, assembly drawings, and engineering documentation.
Strong troubleshooting skills for analog and digital electronic circuits.
Proficiency with common electronic laboratory equipment:
o Oscilloscopes
o Digital multimeters
o Power supplies
o Signal generators
o Data acquisition equipment

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision once objectives and instructions are provided.
Strong organizational and documentation skills.
Effective verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience in medical device, aerospace, industrial controls, or other regulated industries.
Experience building cable harnesses and test fixtures.
Knowledge of IPC-A-610 and IPC J-STD-001 workmanship standards.
Familiarity with design verification testing and engineering prototype development.

Physical Requirements:
Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while performing bench work.
Ability to use microscopes, soldering stations, and precision hand tools.
Ability to lift up to 25 lbs (11 kg) occasionally.

job.title: Maintenance Manager
job.description:
MAINTENANCE MANAGER

Lead Maintenance. Improve Reliability. Drive Plant Performance.

Location: Fayetteville, TN
Salary: $100,000–$105,000 Annually
Schedule: 1st Shift | Full-Time
Direct Hire Opportunity
Occasional On-Call Responsibilities

TAKE THE LEAD IN PLANT MAINTENANCE!

Are you an experienced Maintenance Manager, Maintenance Supervisor, Maintenance Leader, or Manufacturing Maintenance professional ready to take the next step in your career?

We are seeking a strong Maintenance Manager to lead the overall maintenance function within a manufacturing facility. This is a leadership opportunity for someone who understands that successful maintenance is about more than fixing equipment — it's about preventing downtime, developing people, improving processes, controlling costs, and keeping production moving.

In this role, you will have a direct impact on equipment reliability, preventive maintenance, employee development, safety, quality, and overall plant performance.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Direct and oversee all activities of the Maintenance Department.

  • Lead, train, mentor, and evaluate maintenance personnel and subordinate supervisors.

  • Develop maintenance schedules, assign work, and manage staffing requirements to support plant operations.

  • Establish and maintain effective Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) and equipment/asset care programs.

  • Analyze equipment downtime, recurring failures, and maintenance issues to identify root causes and implement countermeasures.

  • Partner with Production, Quality, Engineering, and other departments to improve plant efficiency and equipment reliability.

  • Provide technical guidance and review maintenance work to ensure projects are completed effectively.

  • Manage maintenance projects, including cost estimates, proposals, contractor bids, and outside contractor work.

  • Manage department expenses and budgets while identifying opportunities to control costs.

  • Monitor and manage spare parts inventory and ordering.

  • Research and recommend equipment, tools, supplies, and other resources for the Maintenance Department.

  • Maintain accurate maintenance, safety, expense, and equipment documentation.

  • Read and interpret blueprints, specifications, and technical documentation.

  • Utilize measurement tools and support technical problem-solving.

  • Work with 2D and 3D CAD/CAM software.

  • Support and improve welding processes and equipment conditions to maintain product quality.

  • Train and develop maintenance personnel in the operation, maintenance, and improvement of robotic production equipment.

  • Support 5S, Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Quality, Safety, Cost, and Delivery initiatives.

  • Ensure maintenance activities comply with company safety, quality, and environmental standards.

  • Assist with administrative and IT-related responsibilities as needed.

  • Provide occasional support outside normal hours when maintenance issues require attention.

LEADERSHIP & TEAM DEVELOPMENT

This position provides overall direction and leadership for the Maintenance Department.

Responsibilities include:

  • Interviewing, hiring, and training maintenance employees

  • Planning, assigning, and directing work

  • Developing and coaching maintenance personnel

  • Monitoring productivity and performance

  • Conducting performance evaluations

  • Addressing employee concerns and resolving problems

  • Communicating expectations and holding the team accountable

  • Building a strong culture around Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The ideal candidate will have:

  • A Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, or a related field OR approximately 5 years of supervisory/leadership experience in an automotive or manufacturing environment.

  • Proven experience leading and developing maintenance teams.

  • Strong knowledge of plant maintenance, equipment reliability, and preventive maintenance.

  • Experience analyzing downtime and performing root-cause analysis.

  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical specifications.

  • Experience with CAD/CAM, automated manufacturing equipment, and/or robotics is highly beneficial.

  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, and continuous improvement practices.

  • Experience managing maintenance projects, budgets, contractors, and spare parts.

  • Strong communication and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work effectively with employees at all levels of the organization.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

  • Experience with ERP or computerized maintenance systems is a plus.

WHY THIS OPPORTUNITY?

This is an opportunity to make a real impact on a manufacturing operation.

You won't simply be reacting to breakdowns — you'll be responsible for building a maintenance strategy focused on reliability, preventive maintenance, continuous improvement, employee development, and long-term plant performance.

If you're a maintenance leader who enjoys solving problems, developing people, improving equipment reliability, and driving results, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for.

SCHEDULE & WORK ENVIRONMENT

1st Shift | Full-Time

Occasional on-call responsibilities may be required when maintenance issues arise outside normal operating hours.

This is a manufacturing environment where you will regularly work around industrial machinery, moving mechanical parts, electrical equipment, vehicles, oils, vibration, and moderate-to-loud noise levels.

The position may occasionally require working holidays, other shifts, or overtime based on operational needs. Local, national, and international travel may also be required.

READY TO LEAD?

If you're ready to bring your maintenance leadership experience to a Direct Hire opportunity in Fayetteville, TN where you can improve reliability, develop a team, reduce downtime, and make a measurable difference, apply today!r.

job.title: Quality Inspector - 3rd shift
job.description:
**Prescreen required with all submittals**

FIRST COUPLE OF WEEKS WILL BE ON AM SHIFT FROM 6am-2:30pm


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

Job Summary:
The Quality Inspector will check the quality of all products as well as production procedures. The role will be an advocate for quality in our business. The Quality Inspector will ensure that products are made of flawless materials in compliance with customer specifications.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Inspect, test and measure materials or products and accurately record inspection and test data. This includes measuring products using rulers, calipers, gauges, coordinate measuring machines (CMM), thread gauges, gauge pins, optical comparator, surface testers, height gauges or micrometers to monitor operations to ensure they meet quality standards.
Accept or reject finished products including tagging or identifying all products and material that fail to meet specifications.
Read, interpret, and follow basic blueprints, diagrams, engineering drawings and other written
instruction. This includes understanding and applying Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerance (GD & T) symbology.
Recommend adjustments to the assembly or production process to improve quality.
Calibrate or verify test instruments.
Adhere to all safety procedures and promote continuous improvement.

Education and Experience (required):
High School diploma or equivalent.
1 year of inspection experience with common hand gages or equivalent.

Education and Experience (preferred):
1 year of experience programing and operating a Direct Computer Controlled (DCC) CMM.

Skills, Knowledge and Abilities (required):
Knowledge of computers and electronics.
Ability to calibrate or verify test instruments and keep detailed records.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to interact across multiple departments.
Proficient computer skills including MS Office.
Ability to analyze and problem solve with attention to detail.

Skills, Knowledge and Abilities (preferred)
Working knowledge and comprehension of quality standards.
American Society for Quality (ASQ) certified.
Ability to work overtime as needed including weekends.

Additional Information:
Direct Reports: None Travel Requirements: 5%
License and Certification Requirements: None

Physical Requirements:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee is regularly required to perform physical activities that require significant use of your arms and legs and moving your whole body, such as climbing, lifting, balancing, walking, stooping, standing for extended periods of time and handling of materials. The employee is required to lift up to 50 pounds on a regular basis. The employee is subject to loud noise, dirt, dust, grease, gases and odors and is required to wear personal protective equipment such as safety glasses and ear protection in required area. Typical vision abilities include close up for fine detailed work and
computer work, distance vision and ability to focus. Regular and predictable attendance is required.

job.title: Customer Service Specialist
job.description:
Customer Service & Military Pricing Coordinator

Position Overview

The Customer Service & Military Pricing Coordinator is responsible for maintaining customer satisfaction by providing timely and accurate product, service, account, quotation, and pricing support.

This position serves as the primary point of coordination for customer quotations and pricing requests, partnering closely with sales, contracts, divisions, and other internal teams to ensure quotes are accurate, competitive, and delivered on time. The role typically supports moderately complex or well-established customer accounts.

Employee Classification: Nonexempt
Citizenship Requirement: U.S. Citizen

Key Responsibilities

Customer Service & Account Support

  • Administer customer accounts by reviewing service and spare product requirements against existing purchase order terms, conditions, and maintenance agreements.
  • Establish and maintain strong customer relationships through courteous and efficient handling of customer requests.
  • Prepare and submit correspondence in response to customer inquiries.
  • Maintain appropriate confidentiality regarding customer and company information.
  • Respond to customer pricing inquiries, service concerns, and related requests.

Pricing, Quotations & RFQ Coordination

  • Coordinate the end-to-end pricing and quotation process.
  • Log incoming Requests for Quotation (RFQs) and verify completeness against customer requirements.
  • Complete cost and pricing analysis and route requests to appropriate divisions for cost development within established turnaround times.
  • Review draft quotations and proposals for:
    • Pricing reasonableness
    • Accuracy
    • Formatting
    • Consistency
  • Maintain price lists, quote logs, pricing history, rate sheets, and customer-specific pricing agreements.
  • Track open quotations and proactively follow up to prevent expired or outdated pricing.
  • Communicate quote status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with sales, price estimating, contracts, and other functions to keep the quotation process moving efficiently.

Order & Production Coordination

  • Coordinate with internal departments including:
    • Quality
    • Shipping and receiving
    • Accounting
    • Order entry
    • Planning
    • Shop personnel
  • Release repairs to production once customer approval is received.
  • Submit work orders to scheduling and update sales orders with delivery dates and repair costs.
  • Develop action plans to address past-due items.
  • May provide oversight of order entry and shipping activities for spare products.

Pricing Data & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate pricing and quotation records within applicable ERP and quoting systems.
  • Ensure pricing files, rate sheets, and customer-specific agreements remain current and consistent with approved pricing guidance.
  • Monitor customer accounts and prepare reports, including open-quote status reporting.
  • Collect and analyze data to support pricing and customer-service decisions.
  • Calculate discounts, proportions, percentages, and quote pricing as needed.

Process Improvement & Compliance

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Recommend opportunities for cost reduction and improvements to service quality and quoting efficiency.
  • Develop knowledge of:
    • Procurement practices
    • FAA regulations
    • Government procurement requirements, when applicable
    • Products and manufacturing processes
    • Pricing policies and procedures
  • Support cross-functional and project teams, including pricing and proposal initiatives.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • One to two years of related college-level coursework, certificate completion, or related job training in:
    • Business
    • Finance
    • Economics
    • Engineering
    • Data Analytics
    • Related field
  • Typically 4+ years of related experience in one or more of the following:
    • Customer service
    • Pricing
    • Quotation administration
    • Administrative support
    • Marketing/customer support
    • Product support

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Knowledge of customer service, pricing, and quotation administration practices.
  • Understanding of FAA regulations and government procurement requirements when applicable.
  • General understanding of manufacturing, inspection, and repair processes.
  • Ability to work independently on moderately complex assignments.
  • Strong judgment and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, and draw conclusions.
  • Ability to calculate discounts, percentages, proportions, and pricing.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to clearly communicate pricing, technical, and customer information.
  • Proficiency with standard business software applications.
  • Experience with specialized spreadsheet, quoting, database, ERP, and MRP systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple departments and functions.

Pricing Coordination Skills

  • Working knowledge of RFQ intake, quotation preparation, pricing analysis, and pricing workflow coordination.
  • Experience maintaining accurate pricing files, quote logs, rate sheets, and customer-specific pricing agreements.
  • Ability to track open quotes and proactively follow up on expiring pricing.
  • Experience coordinating between sales, contracts, price estimating, and other internal teams.
  • Strong attention to detail when reviewing quotations for accuracy and consistency before customer submission.

To test, troubleshoot and assemble electronic, microprocessor-based systems and radio communications equipment including cables and harnesses utilizing low voltage testing. job.title: Quality Technician
job.description:
Quality Technician – 1st Shift

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Technician to join our 1st shift team. The Quality Technician plays an important role in maintaining product quality and ensuring manufacturing processes remain on track.

This position will operate CMM and NDT equipment, perform dimensional and visual inspections, inspect welds using microscopes, and use precision measurement tools such as calipers and micrometers. The Quality Technician will work closely with Production and Engineering to ensure parts meet specifications and that quality issues are identified, documented, and addressed promptly.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Set up, calibrate, and operate Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM).
  • Develop and modify CMM programs using 3D CAD models and 2D engineering drawings.
  • Set up, calibrate, and operate Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) equipment as required.
  • Perform first-article, in-process, and final inspections.
  • Use precision measurement equipment, including micrometers, calipers, and other inspection tools.
  • Inspect welds using a microscope and perform visual inspections before and after E-coat.
  • Use weld maps and inspection criteria to verify product quality.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and 3D CAD models.
  • Apply Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) principles to ensure parts meet design requirements.
  • Prepare inspection reports and document non-conformances (NCRs).
  • Communicate inspection results and quality concerns to Production and Engineering.
  • Assist with troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective actions (CAPA).
  • Complete required quality documentation accurately and on time.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor or manager.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Associate degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, or a related technical field preferred.
  • Engineering degree is a plus.

Experience & Technical Skills

  • 2–5 years of experience in a precision manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Automotive manufacturing experience is a plus.
  • Experience operating and programming CMM equipment.
  • Experience with CMM inspection software preferred.
  • Ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings, blueprints, and 3D CAD models.
  • Strong knowledge of GD&T and ASME Y14.5 standards.
  • Experience using precision inspection and measurement equipment.
  • Comfortable using algebra, geometry, and trigonometry to calculate dimensions and tolerances.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office.

Additional Qualifications

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with Production and Engineering teams.
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.

Working Conditions

This is a shop-floor position in a manufacturing environment. The successful candidate must be able to:

  • Lift up to 30 lbs.
  • Stand and walk for most of the work shift.
  • Bend, crouch, reach, and move around equipment and parts as required.
  • Work effectively in a team environment.
  • Work in varying seasonal temperatures.
  • Work in an environment with production-floor noise.
  • Follow all safety procedures and PPE requirements.
  • Wear required safety equipment, including safety glasses, steel-toed shoes, sleeves, pants, and gloves.

Why Join Us?

This is an excellent opportunity for a quality professional who enjoys hands-on inspection work and wants to contribute directly to manufacturing quality, process improvement, and customer satisfaction.

job.title: Tear-Down Technician (Automotive Disassembler)
job.description:
The Tear-Down Technician is responsible for safely disassembling welded automotive components for weld validation and quality analysis. This position requires the use of hand and power tools to separate welded assemblies while preserving the integrity of the weld for inspection. The ideal candidate has strong mechanical aptitude, enjoys hands-on work, and thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Disassemble welded automotive components while maintaining weld integrity for inspection and validation.
  • Follow work instructions and visual guides to identify weld locations and ensure proper material separation.
  • Use hand tools, air hammers, chisels, pneumatic tools, torque tools, and other shop equipment safely and effectively.
  • Perform cut and etch processes, including cutting and sanding welded components for weld penetration analysis.
  • Inspect parts for defects, damage, wear, and quality concerns during the tear-down process.
  • Maintain a clean, organized work area in accordance with 5S standards.
  • Follow all company safety policies, PPE requirements, and environmental procedures.
  • Assist with material handling and movement throughout the facility.

  • Complete additional duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred.

Experience

  • Previous manufacturing, assembly, automotive, or mechanical experience preferred.
  • Experience using hand tools and power tools required.
  • Prototype or low-volume automotive manufacturing experience is a plus.
  • Forklift and overhead crane experience preferred.

Skills

  • Strong mechanical aptitude.
  • Ability to read and follow work instructions, diagrams, and basic technical documents.
  • Strong attention to detail and quality.
  • Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

  • Work overhead and in confined or awkward positions as needed.
  • Safely handle large automotive parts and assemblies.
  • Work in a manufacturing environment with varying temperatures, noise levels, and production activity.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE) at all times.

Work Environment

job.title: Infrastructure Discovery Analyst
job.description:
Overview
This role supports infrastructure discovery and visibility initiatives by ensuring reliable access, credential management, and connectivity across enterprise network and server environments. The position focuses on maintaining discovery coverage, resolving authentication issues, and supporting infrastructure data collection processes.
Working closely with network and hosting teams, the Infrastructure Discovery Analyst helps optimize discovery operations, maintain credential integrity, support service graph integrations, and document processes that contribute to broader ServiceNow modernization efforts.

Core Responsibilities
• Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve credential-related issues across network devices and server infrastructure using technologies such as SNMP, SSH, WMI, and WinRM.
• Manage and validate access to network and hosting environments to ensure complete infrastructure scanning coverage.
• Triage and diagnose connectivity and authentication issues across routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and server platforms.
• Collaborate with network and hosting teams to maintain accurate credential repositories and access policies.
• Support service graph connector configurations to ensure proper data flow from infrastructure sources.
• Manage and optimize discovery schedules to align with maintenance windows and scanning requirements.
• Document credential management processes, infrastructure issues, and resolution procedures.
• Provide subject matter expertise on network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and related device management.
• Support Windows Server, Linux/Unix, and virtualized hosting environments, including VMware and Hyper-V platforms.
• Manage credential access across diverse network and server device types and ensure adherence to established access policies.
• Troubleshoot enterprise connectivity and authentication issues involving SNMP v1/v2c/v3, SSH, Telnet, WMI, WinRM, and NetBIOS protocols.
• Analyze infrastructure accessibility issues related to IP address management, network segmentation, and firewall configurations.
• Independently triage infrastructure issues and escalate concerns appropriately to support operational stability.
• Provide subject matter expertise on network topology, device configurations, and server environments.
• Support broader ServiceNow modernization program objectives as needed.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• CompTIA Network+ certification or equivalent certification.
• Scripting experience using PowerShell or Python.
• Experience with infrastructure discovery or asset scanning tools.
• Familiarity with CMDB concepts and Configuration Item (CI) classification.
• Strong expertise in network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and related device management.
• Strong expertise in server and hosting environments, including Windows Server, Linux/Unix administration, VMware, and Hyper-V.
• Hands-on experience with credential management across diverse network and server device types.
• Deep understanding of network protocols, including SNMP v1/v2c/v3, SSH, Telnet, WMI, WinRM, and NetBIOS.
• Experience troubleshooting connectivity and authentication issues in enterprise environments.
• Familiarity with IP address management, network segmentation, and firewall rules affecting device accessibility.
• Ability to work independently, triage infrastructure issues, and escalate appropriately.
• Experience working in enterprise-scale environments with diverse and heterogeneous device types.
• Experience working within ITIL-aligned processes.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Experience with ServiceNow ITOM Visibility (Discovery) as a supporting tool.

job.title: ServiceNow SPM Enablement Specialist
job.description:
Overview
The ServiceNow SPM Enablement Specialist supports the rollout, adoption, and ongoing expansion of ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) capabilities across Client. This role focuses on process documentation, training development, stakeholder engagement, and user enablement for Resource Management, Idea Management, and Strategic Planning Workspace.
The position partners with IT leadership, business unit stakeholders, and program leadership to establish standardized processes, support onboarding initiatives, drive adoption, and maintain governance and documentation aligned with evolving platform capabilities.

Core Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain comprehensive process documentation for ServiceNow SPM modules, including Resource Management, Idea Management, and Strategic Planning Workspace.
• Create end-user and practitioner training materials, including guides, quick reference cards, and walkthroughs.
• Establish and document standard operating procedures (SOPs) for SPM workflows and governance.
• Maintain a living documentation library that reflects platform updates and process changes.
• Lead the rollout of Resource Management capabilities to IT teams.
• Define and document resource allocation processes, roles, and responsibilities.
• Partner with IT leadership to support adoption and alignment with organizational resource planning needs.
• Deliver training sessions and enablement activities to support Resource Management onboarding.
• Drive the ongoing rollout of Idea Management and Strategic Planning Workspace across business units.
• Engage stakeholders to gather requirements, tailor configurations, and support onboarding activities.
• Develop rollout plans, communication strategies, and adoption metrics for business unit deployments.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for business units during the SPM onboarding experience.
• Collaborate with business leaders to promote SPM adoption and collect ongoing feedback.
• Facilitate training sessions and workshops for end users and practitioners across organizational levels.
• Track adoption metrics and provide status updates to the ServiceNow Process Owner and program leadership.
• Support continuous improvement of SPM processes based on user feedback and organizational needs.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certification in SPM or ITBM.
• Experience with Strategic Planning Workspace and Innovation Management in ServiceNow.
• Background in change management or organizational change enablement methodologies.
• Familiarity with ITIL and portfolio or program management frameworks.
• Experience working in a global, matrixed organization with diverse business unit stakeholders.
• Familiarity with the ServiceNow Yokohama release or later.

job.title: Software Engineer (Test & Control)
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Software Engineer to develop Data Acquisition and Control Systems (DACS) for test stands and test facilities supporting aerospace hardware testing. This role focuses on designing, testing, and implementing applications that collect, monitor, and control data across a variety of test environments.
The ideal candidate will contribute to software development, instrument integration, networking solutions, troubleshooting, and modernization efforts, including rebuilding legacy systems using current-generation software and hardware technologies.

Core Responsibilities
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications for software development.
• Design, develop, test, and implement data acquisition and control system applications for testing environments.
• Develop and execute test plans to validate system functionality and compliance with requirements.
• Design and implement networking solutions that enable real-time data sharing and communication between multiple controllers.
• Troubleshoot and resolve software and hardware issues during development, testing, and deployment.
• Document software designs, build processes, installation procedures, and user documentation.
• Reverse-engineer existing software on legacy systems and rebuild solutions using modern software and hardware platforms.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
• Minimum of 2 years of experience in software development with a focus on data acquisition and test or process control systems.
• Experience with PLC programming, including Allen-Bradley and Beckhoff PLCs.
• Strong programming skills in LabVIEW or equivalent software development environments.
• Experience integrating test instruments into control systems, including power analyzers, power supplies, pressure scanners, temperature scanners, flow meters, pressure transmitters, and actuators.
• Understanding of networking concepts and experience with data-sharing protocols for multiple real-time controllers.
• Ability to prototype and execute tests, including experimental setup, hardware configuration, and software implementation.
• Strong problem-solving abilities and the capability to work independently and within a team environment.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly document technical processes.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Experience with MATLAB/Simulink.
• Experience with C/C++.
• Experience with Python.
• Experience with LabWindows/CVI.
• Familiarity with NI SystemLink, TestStand, or VeriStand.
• Experience with version control tools such as Bitbucket, Git, or SVN, and requirements tracking systems.
• Mechatronics work experience.

Work Details
• Hybrid work arrangement dependent on project support requirements.
• Three days onsite and two days remote.

job.description:

Potential to convert to full-time position

Job Description
We are seeking a talented and motivated Manufacturing Engineer to join our dynamic Machining Operations Center/Manufacturing Engineering Team. As part of this collaborative team, you will contribute to the creation and continuous improvement of special processes and small parts assembly for ultraprecision machined components. Your work will involve driving technology and automation into these operations.

What You Will Be Doing
As the Manufacturing Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting the Machining Operations Center (MOC) within the Missiles and Fire Control (MFC) facility located in Orlando, FL. The MOC specializes in producing ultra precision machined components that are the foundation of electro optical targeting systems and missile systems.

• Responsible for driving process improvements within small parts assembly, paint, and plating manufacturing areas
• Interpret drawing requirements and create detailed work instruction documentation to support production needs
• Perform root cause analysis of component non conformances and ensure implementation of effective corrective action
• Create fixture and tooling concepts, drawings, and models
• Identify, evaluate business case, and drive successful implementation of automation and IFF technologies
• Participate in capital investment/equipment evaluation, selection, and project management
• Provide shop floor support as necessary to resolve technical and manufacturing issues
• Monitor and report on quality, schedule, and cost performance of assigned projects/programs

Why Join Us
This role is a unique opportunity to work on first production machined components, along with long standing production components. Cutting edge software, machinery, and technology is utilized to produce components for our customers. This role is hands on and requires a desire to actively engage in shop floor daily production, troubleshooting, and improvement initiatives. The team members are a cohesive blend of experience focused on driving change and improvements into our processes.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:
•Bachelor's degree from an accredited college in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or related discipline
•Basic understanding of CAD software such as Siemens NX, CREO, Pro Engineer, or Solidworks (Experience: 3 years)
•Experience working in production manufacturing environment (Experience: 3 years)
•The candidate must be a US citizen

DESIRED EXPERIENCE:
•Working knowledge and experience using MES, PLM, and ERP systems (Experience: 3 years)
•Experience with small parts assembly operation including precision pin installation, rivet install, helicoils, etc. (Experience: 3 years)
•Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) interpretation skills (Experience: 3 years)
•Experience utilizing CREO or NX for CAD (Experience: 3 years)
•Experience working with MIL-SPEC and industry standard special processes (chem-film, anodize, passivation, organic coatings, plating, heat treatment, etc.) (Experience: 3 years)
•Experience with paint application and masking processes for components and assemblies (metallic and composite) (Experience: 2 years)
•Knowledge of precision measuring tools, gauges, and equipment (Experience: 3 years)
•Experience with implementing automation manuacturing solutions (Not required, nice to have)
•Experience with 3D Printing (Experience: 2 years)
•Experience with chemistry, including execution of titrations, pH analysis, large volume plating line evaluation and troubleshooting (Not required, nice to have)
•Familiarity with ISO9000 and AS9100 industry standards, and common military specifications (Experience: 3 years)

job.title: Electro-Mechanical Technician
job.description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Electro-Mechanical Technician to support the maintenance and reliability of a busy manufacturing operation. This position is responsible for troubleshooting, maintaining, repairing, and improving production equipment and facility systems to help keep operations running safely and efficiently.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on problem solver with strong mechanical and electrical skills who can diagnose equipment issues, perform preventative maintenance, and respond effectively to equipment breakdowns. The ability to work independently, prioritize repairs, and collaborate with production and maintenance team members is essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot, diagnose, repair, and maintain production machinery and related equipment.
  • Perform electrical and mechanical troubleshooting to identify the cause of equipment failures and determine appropriate repairs.
  • Perform preventative maintenance (PM) on production equipment according to established schedules.
  • Respond to equipment breakdowns and production maintenance needs in a timely manner.
  • Install, replace, adjust, and repair motors, bearings, belts, chains, gearboxes, sensors, switches, and other mechanical and electrical components.
  • Troubleshoot electrical circuits, controls, motors, and control components using appropriate test equipment.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, mechanical drawings, and equipment documentation.
  • Use tools and diagnostic equipment such as multimeters, electrical testers, and other maintenance instruments.
  • Perform basic fabrication, welding, cutting, and mechanical repair as needed.
  • Assist with equipment installation, modification, setup, and relocation.
  • Inspect equipment and identify potential mechanical or electrical problems before they result in downtime.
  • Make equipment adjustments and repairs to maintain safe and reliable operation.
  • Accurately document completed work orders, preventative maintenance, repairs, and parts used.
  • Maintain tools, equipment, and maintenance areas in an organized and safe condition.
  • Work closely with production personnel to troubleshoot problems and minimize equipment downtime.
  • Follow lockout/tagout (LOTO), OSHA, and all company safety procedures when performing maintenance activities.
  • Safely operate forklifts, scissor lifts, man lifts, and other equipment as required and authorized.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying recurring equipment problems and recommending practical solutions.
  • Perform other maintenance and facility-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications
  • Previous experience in industrial maintenance, manufacturing maintenance, electro-mechanical maintenance, or a similar role.
  • Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to diagnose equipment problems and determine the appropriate repair.
  • Ability to read and understand electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and mechanical drawings.
  • Working knowledge of motors, controls, sensors, switches, bearings, belts, chains, gearboxes, and other industrial equipment.
  • Experience using electrical test equipment such as a multimeter.
  • Ability to use common hand and power tools safely and effectively.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while also working effectively as part of a maintenance team.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple maintenance needs in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull materials and equipment as required.
  • Ability to stand, walk, climb, bend, kneel, and work in various positions throughout the workday.
  • Dependable attendance and a strong commitment to workplace safety.

Required Skills & Experience
  • Industrial electrical experience.
  • PLC troubleshooting experience.
  • Experience with pneumatic and hydraulic systems.
  • Experience with motors, VFDs, motor controls, sensors, and industrial control systems.
  • Welding and fabrication experience, including MIG or stick welding.
  • Experience with preventative maintenance programs and computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS).
  • Experience working in a manufacturing or production environment.
  • Forklift, scissor lift, or man lift experience.
  • Electrical or mechanical trade school, technical training, or relevant certification is a plus.

What Makes You Successful in This Role
The right person for this position is someone who can walk up to a piece of equipment that isn't running and methodically figure out why. You should be comfortable working with both electrical and mechanical systems, willing to get your hands dirty, and able to make safe, practical repairs that keep production moving. Strong troubleshooting skills, reliability, and a safety-first mindset are critical to success in this role.

Monday - Friday, occasional Saturdays 6am - 4:30 pm

The specialist will collaborate with eCommerce, marketing, creative, technology, content, and supplier management teams to determine how products should be presented online to create a high-quality customer experience and maximize performance.

Certificates of Analysis
Export documentation:

Other required export paperwork
Strong communication and coordination skills
Ability to prioritize and work with urgency
Comfortable presenting to senior leadership
Strong accountability and responsiveness
Decision-making skills in uncertain situations
Responsibilities
Analyze and develop logistics plans affecting production, distribution, and inventory
Create and review distribution and inventory management procedures
Maximize customer satisfaction while minimizing costs
Coordinate shipments and support global logistics operations
Ensure regulatory compliance for international transportation
Experience Level
Entry-level to early-career role
0–2 years of related experience
Associate degree or equivalent preferred
Works under supervision with established guidelines and procedures
Ideal Candidate
A candidate with foundational logistics, shipping, or supply chain experience who understands international transportation and export documentation, has strong organizational skills, and can work effectively with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
Prescreen questions:
1. Tell me about your experience coordinating international shipments and preparing export documentation.
What they're looking for:
Experience with air, ocean, road, or rail shipments
Export paperwork knowledge
Attention to detail
Strong answer should include:
"I have experience coordinating domestic and international shipments, preparing commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, and other export documentation. I work closely with freight forwarders and internal stakeholders to ensure shipments are compliant and delivered on schedule. I verify documentation accuracy before release to minimize customs delays."
2. How do you ensure compliance with hazardous materials and export regulations?
What they're looking for:
Knowledge of IATA, IMDG, DOT, and export controls
Understanding of compliance risks
Strong answer should include:
"I follow established shipping regulations and company procedures to ensure compliance. Before arranging shipments, I verify commodity classifications, destination requirements, hazardous material documentation, and export restrictions. If there is uncertainty, I collaborate with compliance or trade specialists before shipment release."
3. Describe a time when you had multiple urgent shipments competing for priority. How did you handle it?
What they're looking for:
Ability to prioritize
Communication skills
Decision-making under pressure
Strong answer should include:
"I assessed each shipment's business impact, customer requirements, and deadlines. I communicated proactively with stakeholders regarding priorities and potential risks, coordinated with carriers to secure capacity, and tracked critical shipments closely. By maintaining clear communication and focusing on the highest-impact items first, I ensured priorities were met and stakeholders remained informed."
Bonus Question
How would you handle a shipment that is delayed in customs?
Strong response:
"I would immediately identify the cause of the delay, contact the broker or freight forwarder, review documentation for errors, and work with the appropriate parties to resolve the issue quickly. I would also provide regular updates to stakeholders and develop alternative solutions if the delay could impact customer commitments."

job.description:
Schedule: 4X10 D (Thursday through Sunday ON | Monday through Wednesday OFF)
Potential to convert to full-time position

Job Description
We are seeking a talented and motivated Manufacturing Engineer to join our dynamic Machining Operations Center/Manufacturing Engineering Team. As part of this collaborative team, you will contribute to the creation and continuous improvement of special processes and small parts assembly for ultraprecision machined components. Your work will involve driving technology and automation into these operations.

What You Will Be Doing
As the Manufacturing Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting the Machining Operations Center (MOC) within the Missiles and Fire Control (MFC) facility located in Orlando, FL. The MOC specializes in producing ultra precision machined components that are the foundation of electro optical targeting systems and missile systems.

• Responsible for driving process improvements within small parts assembly, paint, and plating manufacturing areas
• Interpret drawing requirements and create detailed work instruction documentation to support production needs
• Perform root cause analysis of component non conformances and ensure implementation of effective corrective action
• Create fixture and tooling concepts, drawings, and models
• Identify, evaluate business case, and drive successful implementation of automation and IFF technologies
• Participate in capital investment/equipment evaluation, selection, and project management
• Provide shop floor support as necessary to resolve technical and manufacturing issues
• Monitor and report on quality, schedule, and cost performance of assigned projects/programs

Why Join Us
This role is a unique opportunity to work on first production machined components, along with long standing production components. Cutting edge software, machinery, and technology is utilized to produce components for our customers. This role is hands on and requires a desire to actively engage in shop floor daily production, troubleshooting, and improvement initiatives. The team members are a cohesive blend of experience focused on driving change and improvements into our processes.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:
•Bachelor's degree from an accredited college in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or related discipline
•Basic understanding of CAD software such as Siemens NX, CREO, Pro Engineer, or Solidworks (Experience: 3 years)
•Experience working in production manufacturing environment (Experience: 3 years)
•The candidate must be a US citizen

DESIRED EXPERIENCE:
•Working knowledge and experience using MES, PLM, and ERP systems (Experience: 3 years)
•Experience with small parts assembly operation including precision pin installation, rivet install, helicoils, etc. (Experience: 3 years)
•Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) interpretation skills (Experience: 3 years)
•Experience utilizing CREO or NX for CAD (Experience: 3 years)
•Experience working with MIL-SPEC and industry standard special processes (chem-film, anodize, passivation, organic coatings, plating, heat treatment, etc.) (Experience: 3 years)
•Experience with paint application and masking processes for components and assemblies (metallic and composite) (Experience: 2 years)
•Knowledge of precision measuring tools, gauges, and equipment (Experience: 3 years)
•Experience with implementing automation manuacturing solutions (Not required, nice to have)
•Experience with 3D Printing (Experience: 2 years)
•Experience with chemistry, including execution of titrations, pH analysis, large volume plating line evaluation and troubleshooting (Not required, nice to have)
•Familiarity with ISO9000 and AS9100 industry standards, and common military specifications (Experience: 3 years)

job.title: Quality Inspector
job.description:
Quality Inspector
Pay rate: $20.00-$24.00
Location: South
Requirements: Basic understanding of GD&T & knowledge of IPC-A-610 standards is preferred.

Job Description: Responsible for the incoming quality inspection of electronic, electro mechanical, microprocessor based systems, radio communication equipment, cables, harnesses, and mechanical components used in mining safety products. Ensures that all incoming materials meet quality, safety, and regulatory requirements before being released to production, recognizing the safety critical nature of mining applications.

  • Perform incoming, in-process, and final inspections of PCBAs, cable assemblies, subassemblies, finished products, aluminum housings, casted housings, machined components, plastic parts, and other purchased materials.
  • Verify product compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, work instructions, quality standards, and customer requirements.
  • Conduct visual inspections of electronic assemblies in accordance with IPC-A-610 workmanship standards.
  • Perform dimensional inspections using precision measuring equipment including calipers, micrometers, height gauges, thread gauges, pin gauges, and other inspection tools.
  • Verify cosmetic appearance, dimensional accuracy, labeling, markings, surface finishes, and overall product workmanship.
  • Identify, document, and segregate nonconforming materials following established quality procedures.
  • Complete inspection reports, First Article Inspection (FAI) documentation, inspection records, and nonconformance reports accurately and on time.
  • Support Material Review Board (MRB) activities by providing inspection results and objective evidence.
  • Verify product traceability and ensure proper identification throughout the inspection process.
  • Ensure compliance with Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, company procedures, and applicable industry standards.
  • Assist Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supplier Quality teams in investigating product quality issues and implementing corrective actions.
  • Maintain inspection equipment in good condition and ensure only calibrated equipment is used.
  • Follow ESD, safety, and housekeeping requirements while handling electronic components and assemblies.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring quality issues and recommending process improvements.

Minimum Qualifications:
  • High School Diploma or equivalent. (pre-requisite)
  • Driver license
  • Experience in QC Inspection of electro-mechanical assemblies or cable fabrication (favorable)
  • Current or past IPC-A-610 certification (favorable)
  • Working knowledge of computers, ability to support data collection and daily operations as needed; any additional requirements as implemented. (Microsoft word, excel, computer file system navigation, and ability to save data in multiple forms)

job.title: Bioprocess Manufacturing Technician
job.description:
Bioprocess Manufacturing Technician- Production Services (Contractor)
At Genentech, we are dedicated to pursuing groundbreaking science to Client and develop medicines for people with serious and life-threatening diseases.
As a Bioprocess Manufacturing Technician, you will be responsible for producing medicine in a highly automated and controlled environment. Each product has a specific recipe; you will follow this recipe, along with the standard operating procedures, to operate the production equipment across various areas, including raw material dispensing/aliquoting, cell culture and purification. You will maintain records and follow all the steps necessary to comply with regulatory requirements within a current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) environment.

The Opportunity
As a Manufacturing Technician, you will work within a team to produce and deliver quality products for patients around the world. We are a 24/7 site and the work load is divided across multiple organizations. Technicians are expected to work in a safe manner and follow our Standard Operating Procedures at all times. Doing these two critical aspects of our job helps us maintain our right to operate and commitment to governing bodies around the world.

Our Manufacturing process begins in Upstream, where we thaw and scale up our process. Some of the responsibilities for Upstream technicians are: preparing the medium needed for cell growth and maintaining our Cell Cultures which includes the set-up and breakdown of stainless steel bioreactors.

In Downstream, technicians work on a series of operations to isolate, purify, and concentrate the product. This includes preparation of Buffers, cleaning and steaming in place Chromatography skids, and supporting formulation.

This posting is for the Production Services Area within our Manufacturing organization
Technicians in this department perform the weighing and aliquoting of raw materials into intermediate bulk containers for use in our stainless steel facility.

The team also supports single-use operations by kitting materials and preparing small-scale solutions. Additional responsibilities include washing, autoclaving, and preparing small equipment parts and assemblies, as well as conducting environmental monitoring throughout the facility.

Who you are:
You are someone who wants to influence your own development and can work independently, with limited supervision. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your own interests; where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point. Experience with biologics manufacturing is not necessary but preferred.

Candidates must be able to work any of the following manufacturing shifts:
- 10 hr Day Shift, 6:00 am – 4:30 pm
- Sunday - Wednesday or
- Wednesday - Saturday
- 10 hr Swing Shift, 12:30 pm -11:00 pm
- Sunday - Wednesday or
- Wednesday - Saturday

Onboarding practices vary with area, but may consist of a multi-week schedule of Monday - Friday 8am - 5pm followed by on the job training for multiple weeks Monday - Thursday or Tuesday - Friday swing shift. Once onboarding and/or training is complete, you will be released to your assigned Manufacturing shift. Shift availability will be determined by matching candidates strengths to shift needs and are subject to change based on business needs and production schedules.
  • Shift availability will be determined by matching candidates strengths to shift demands and subject to change based on business needs.
  • Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal applicant:
  • Hardworking and fast learning individual that thrives in a high paced environment
  • Experience in clean room environment and familiarity with cGMP and ISO/FDA standards is strongly preferred
  • Ability to think critically and work both tactically and strategically
  • Strong quality mindset with attention to detail and a desire to deliver service excellence
  • Ability to work effectively with others, exhibiting a professional manner and establish constructive working relationship
Qualifications / Requirements:
  • Proficiency in the English language- reading, writing, and communication.
  • Must be able to work all shifts, required overtime as needed, and stand for extended periods of time.
  • Must be able to interface with computer systems to successfully operate manufacturing equipment. Experience with distributed control systems or other manufacturing automation is preferred.
  • Must be able to successfully pass all job-related tests and certifications required for working in a cGMP quality environment including but not limited to: inspections and GMP requirements to perform essential functions of the job.
  • Must re-qualify every year on all job-related training and certifications as job or qualifications require.
  • May climb upwards of 6 flights of stairs a day to maneuver within the manufacturing facility.
  • Lifting up to 25lb may be required.
  • The cleanroom environment requires that company provided gowning is worn. This may include plant uniform, coveralls, gloves and safety shoes. Additionally, regulations prohibit makeup, jewelry, and other personal items from entering the clean room environment.
Education / Experience / Attributes (By Level):
Scientific and technical degrees preferred, e.g. Life Science or Engineering
Experience in a GMP working environment with is highly desired with experience in the operation of complex mechanical equipment used in the washing, autoclaving, processing, and assembly of parts used in Upstream or Downstream processes
Target industries include pharmaceutical, biotechnology, biomedical, electronic, and chemical, food, cosmetics, and/or other medical industries.
Understands the theory, concepts, and regulations behind biopharma technology and processes.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.
Please note: We currently do not sponsor work visas for this position or offer relocation assistance.

job.title: Industrial Electrician
job.description:
Overview

Join our dynamic manufacturing team in Glendale, AZ, where you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of electrical systems and production equipment. Your expertise will ensure operations run safely and efficiently in a fast-paced environment. Ideal candidates will possess strong industrial electrical experience and a solid understanding of PLCs and industrial controls.

Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair industrial electrical systems and production equipment.
  • Minimize equipment downtime by troubleshooting electrical, controls, and automation issues.
  • Maintain and repair motors, drives, electrical panels, and power distribution equipment.
  • Work with PLCs, sensors, variable frequency drives (VFDs), and industrial control systems.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, blueprints, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals.
  • Perform preventive and predictive maintenance on electrical and mechanical equipment.
  • Run conduit, pull wire, terminate wiring, and safely connect/disconnect equipment.
  • Diagnose electrical faults and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Safely work within electrical panels and follow established electrical safety procedures.
  • Follow Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) and other company safety procedures.
  • Support the installation, maintenance, and repair of facility and plant electrical systems.
  • Use hand tools, power tools, and electrical testing equipment safely and effectively.
  • Assist with equipment installations, upgrades, and continuous improvement projects.
  • Communicate effectively with maintenance, production, engineering, and management teams.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

Required Qualifications

  • 5 years of industrial electrical or industrial maintenance experience.
  • Strong understanding of 3-phase electrical power, motors, VFDs, PLCs, and industrial controls.
  • Experience troubleshooting electrical and control systems in a manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, blueprints, and technical documentation.
  • Knowledge of preventive maintenance practices and rotating equipment.
  • Familiarity with industrial sensors, including flow, level, temperature, and proximity sensors.
  • Knowledge of electrical safety practices and Lockout/Tagout procedures.
  • Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a maintenance team.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate degree in Electrical Technology, Industrial Maintenance, or a related field preferred; equivalent apprenticeship, military, or hands-on experience will be considered.
  • Positive attitude and willingness to both receive and provide constructive feedback.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to climb ladders and work at heights of up to 25 feet.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, reach, and work in and around manufacturing equipment for extended periods.
  • Ability to work in a manufacturing environment and respond to equipment issues as needed.

job.title: Service Manager
job.description:
SERVICE MANAGER

LOCATION: Amsterdam, NY (Fully onsite)
SCHEDULE: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
SALARY: $100-130K

Some service departments need a manager.

Others need someone who can see the whole picture, figure out where things are getting stuck, and jump in to fix it.

We’re looking for the second kind.

Our client is a growing manufacturer of specialized industrial equipment looking for a hands-on Service Manager to take ownership of a multifaceted service operation. This person will oversee field service, parts, and installation coordination—and needs to be comfortable stepping into any of those areas when a customer, employee, or job needs help.

This is not a “stay in your lane” kind of role. It’s an opportunity for someone who understands how service, parts, installations, engineering, and operations all connect and enjoys making the entire operation work better.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:
• Lead and develop the service operation, including field service, parts, and installation coordination
• Oversee the Field Service Manager, Parts Coordinator, parts/shipping function, and Installation Coordinator
• Jump in to troubleshoot problems and keep jobs moving when issues cross departmental lines
• Handle escalated customer issues and provide technical guidance when needed
• Identify gaps between service, parts, installation, engineering, and operations and build better processes
• Develop procedures, performance metrics, and accountability measures
• Work alongside engineering and operations to solve technical and workflow issues
• Support installations or parts needs when necessary to stay connected to the operation
• Continually look for practical ways to improve the department and customer experience

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:
• 5+ years of management/leadership experience
• 7+ years in service operations, technical service, industrial equipment, project management, customer support management, or a related environment
• Strong technical aptitude—mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, or industrial equipment experience is valuable
• Someone who can manage people while also understanding the equipment and service issues they’re dealing with
• Experience building or improving processes and workflows
• Comfortable handling customers, including escalated or frustrated customers
• ERP/CRM/service ticketing experience

WHO MIGHT FIT?

Maybe you started as a field technician and worked your way into service or branch management.

Maybe you’ve managed a service operation for an industrial equipment company.

Maybe you’re the person everyone calls when something goes wrong—and you’ve developed the leadership background to go along with the technical knowledge.

The experience can vary. What matters is that you know how to lead people, understand the technical side, and make a complicated operation run better.

BENEFITS:
• Medical, dental and vision
• Company-paid $50K life insurance
• Company-paid long-term disability
• 401(k) with up to 4.5% company match
• Annual performance bonus opportunity
• Referral bonus

If you’re a technically minded manager who likes solving problems, developing people, and making an operation better—not just maintaining it—this could be a really interesting opportunity.

job.title: Structural Engineer
job.description:
Nesco Resource is in search of a Structural Engineer to join our client’s team in Lincoln, RI.
 
Position Summary:
We are seeking a Structural Engineer to join our interdisciplinary design team. This team is responsible for designing location-specific structures for mounting ceiling-suspended operating room equipment such as surgical lights, anesthesia booms, and air circulation systems. These designs utilize building materials such as I-beams, channel strut, structural tubing, and custom fabricated parts.
 
Primary Responsibilities:

  • Analyze construction documents and building plans to gather design criteria.
  • Assist in the development of building information models (BIM) to identify clashes with existing and planned construction.
  • Consult and collaborate with in-house and external engineers, architects, project managers, and general contractors to ensure designs meet expectations.
  • Conduct structural analyses through calculations and finite element analysis (FEA).
  • Model structures in 3D CAD programs using multi-component assemblies and parameterization.
  • Create as-designed and as-built technical drawings for fabrication and construction.
  • Support our in-house team of field service technicians before, during, and after installation.
  • Assist with the research and development of design alternatives and modifications to optimize performance and installation.
Required Skills:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Structural Engineering or equivalent with at least 1 year of experience.
  • Experience using 2D and 3D modeling software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks (or equivalent); Revit desirable.
Preferred Skills:
  • Experience with FEA programs such as ANSYS, Abaqus, Inventor Nastran, or equivalent.
  • Proficient in FEA for structural analysis; relevant software experience includes RISA, SAP2000, Robot Structural, or equivalent (STAAD).
  • Experience using structural engineering standards such as ACI and AISC.
  • Experience with FEA programs such as ANSYS, Abaqus, Inventor Nastran, or equivalent.
Required Interpersonal Skills:
  • Enjoys working in collaborative environments and interdisciplinary teams.
  • Resiliently adapts to change.
  • Has a proactive and intuitive approach to design and organization.
  • Thrives in open-ended projects, unstructured schedules, and community-based leadership.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:
  • Direct hire with benefits including health/dental/vision insurance and 401(k)
  • Schedule: 1st shift, Monday – Friday, 9am – 5pm (OT available on as needed basis)
  • Salary range: up to $80K + the opportunity to work OT

job.title: Direct Hire Controls Engineer
job.description:
Direct Hire Controls Engineer — North Kansas City, MO

Salary Range: $95,000 - $110,000

You'll be the go-to person keeping our automated production lines running and improving. This is a hands-on role, expect to spend most of your time on the plant floor (about 70%), not behind a desk. You'll troubleshoot PLCs, robotics, HMIs, and vision systems, support new equipment launches, and work side-by-side with Maintenance and Production to solve real problems as they come up.

Your involvement spans the full lifecycle, from early project sourcing and RFQ development through equipment launch and beyond. You'll program torque control systems, select error and mistake-proofing devices, and make sure all equipment and process documentation (manuals, BOMs, drawings, spare parts lists, PM schedules) gets handed off cleanly to the plant before start of production. You'll also help track capital budgets, work directly with automation vendors, and support Purchasing in evaluating new suppliers and technologies.

What We're Looking For

Someone who genuinely likes being where the action is. You understand PLC logic, but more than that, you understand how the equipment, the process, and the people on the floor all fit together. You're also comfortable driving lean initiatives (5S, OEE, TPM, Kanban) and enjoy mentoring Maintenance Technicians to help build up the team around you.

Qualifications of the Direct Hire Controls Engineer in North Kansas City, MO

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of Controls Engineering or advanced Maintenance experience in an automated environment
  • 2-4 years of PLC programming experience (Allen-Bradley MicroLogix, SLC 500, ControlLogix 5000) for manual assembly cells, automated assembly cells, and Power & Free conveyor systems
  • 2-4 years of vision system programming experience (Cognex, DVT, or Keyence)
  • 2-4 years of HMI programming experience (AB PanelView / PanelView Plus)
  • Experience with JIT, SPD, ILVS, and batch manufacturing systems, including broadcast analysis from customer trigger through installation
  • Comfort with industrial networking (EtherNet/IP, TCP/IP) and robotics
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, AutoCAD, RSLogix 5000/500, and RSView

A Few Benefits Highlights

  • Medical plans with the company covering the majority of premiums, plus an HSA option with company contributions
  • 401(k) match up to 4%, fully vested from day one
  • Tuition support up to $5,250/year through our education partnership program
  • Wellness incentive, EAP, and identity theft protection included
