job.title: Piping Engineer
job.description:
Piping Engineer

Position Overview

We are seeking a Piping Engineer to support piping engineering activities for a large-scale industrial refining project. This position will focus on the engineering, design, review, and coordination of process piping systems associated with process equipment and other major plant systems.

The Piping Engineer will work closely with Process, Mechanical, Structural, Instrumentation, Electrical, and other engineering disciplines to ensure piping systems are properly designed, coordinated, constructible, and compliant with project requirements and applicable industry standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, review, and coordinate piping engineering deliverables for large-scale industrial projects.
  • Review P&IDs, piping layouts, piping arrangements, and related engineering documentation.
  • Support development and review of piping specifications, material requirements, and technical documentation.
  • Coordinate piping requirements and equipment interfaces with Process, Mechanical, Structural, Instrumentation, and Electrical disciplines.
  • Review vendor drawings, equipment documentation, and technical information for piping impacts.
  • Support piping connections and interfaces associated with process equipment and plant systems.
  • Participate in engineering design reviews, interdisciplinary reviews, and constructability discussions.
  • Identify and resolve piping-related technical issues during engineering and project execution.
  • Ensure piping designs comply with project specifications, applicable codes, standards, and engineering requirements.
  • Provide technical support to project engineering and construction teams as required.
  • Coordinate design changes and ensure piping requirements are accurately incorporated into project deliverables.
  • Support project execution in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary industrial environment.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • Professional experience in piping engineering for industrial/process facilities.
  • Experience with process piping systems, P&IDs, piping layouts, and piping engineering deliverables.
  • Refining, petrochemical, chemical processing, oil & gas, or large-scale industrial EPC experience strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with applicable piping codes, standards, specifications, and engineering practices.
  • Experience coordinating piping requirements with multiple engineering disciplines.
  • Ability to review vendor documentation and equipment information.
  • Strong technical problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Ability to participate effectively in design reviews and constructability discussions.
  • Ability and willingness to work onsite in Houston, TX.

Preferred Background

Ideal candidates will have experience supporting major refinery, petrochemical, chemical processing, or oil & gas capital projects, particularly within an EPC/EPCM environment.

Experience working with process equipment such as pumps, vessels, heat exchangers, compressors, and associated piping systems is highly desirable.

job.title: ASIC/FPGA Verification Engineer
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking an engineer to support ASIC and FPGA development on research and development programs. This role focuses on developing, testing, integrating, and verifying complex digital systems, including digital signal processing, high speed digital designs, high speed communications, and system-on-chip solutions implemented on FPGA platforms.
The engineer will collaborate with systems architects, RF/analog and digital circuit designers, and ASIC/FPGA engineers to contribute to the design, simulation, verification, integration, and testing of advanced products. The role also supports automation and scripting efforts to improve FPGA development processes and affordability.

Core Responsibilities
• Develop, test, integrate, and verify ASIC and FPGA-based solutions for complex digital systems.
• Support digital signal processing (DSP), high speed digital design, high speed communications, and system-on-chip (SOC) implementations on FPGA platforms.
• Work with COTS-based control platforms and embedded processors implemented on FPGA platforms.
• Create and improve automation and scripting solutions to enhance FPGA development efficiency.
• Collaborate across disciplines with systems architects, RF/analog designers, digital circuit designers, and ASIC/FPGA engineers.
• Contribute to the design, simulation, verification, integration, and testing of complex high speed products and networking-based systems.

Education
Bachelors+ 6-10 years or Masters + 4-8 years

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor of Science degree or higher in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, a related discipline, or equivalent experience combined with education.
• Experience verifying digital ASICs/FPGAs and/or mixed-signal ASICs/FPGAs.
• HDL programming experience using VHDL, Verilog, and/or SystemVerilog.
• Possess an active Secret or Top Secret security clearance, or be willing and capable of obtaining the required clearance.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Experience leading or managing ASIC projects.
• Demonstrated self-starter with strong learning agility and high emotional intelligence.
• Space systems design experience.
• Understanding of system and hardware requirements related to space applications.
• Customer-facing communication experience in areas such as product sales, services, marketing, or field support.
• Proficiency in AI prompting as it relates to engineering practices and this type of role.

Work Details
• Onsite full-time.
• Secret clearance not required, however, preference given to candidates who already hold an active Secret clearance.

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
100% Onsite: Glendale, AZ

1st Shift, Mon-Fri, 8AM-5PM

Interview Process: 1 Teams/video Interview, then onsite interview & Tour

Summary: Encompasses the application of scientific and technological principles concerned with the integrity of manufactured products and processes from an engineering standpoint, esp. design specifications, testing procedures, and minimum quality standards.

  • Develops, modifies, applies and maintains quality evaluation and control systems and protocols for processing materials into partially finished or finished materials product.
  • Collaborates with engineering and manufacturing functions to ensure quality standards are in place.
  • Devises and implements methods and procedures for inspecting, testing and evaluating the precision and accuracy of products and production equipment.
  • Designs and analyzes inspection and testing processes, mechanisms and equipment; conducts quality assurance tests; and performs statistical analysis to assess the cost of and determine the responsibility for, products or materials that do not meet required standards and specifications.
  • Audits quality systems for deficiency identification and correction.
  • Ensures that corrective measures meet acceptable reliability standards and that documentation is compliant with requirements.
  • Contacts are primarily internal and may be outside of the immediate work group or organization. Rather infrequent external contacts.

Areas of specialization include:

  • Design, incoming material, production control, product evaluation and reliability, inventory control and/or research and development as they apply to product or process quality.
  • May be certified in lean and six-sigma quality engineering methodologies.
  • May also be responsible for the unit's Performance Excellence (Six-Sigma) project portfolio, assuring the effective use of different improvement methodologies (DMAIC, Lean, DESGN, etc) toward the achievement of division or plant strategic goals.

Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in engineering
  • Minimum Experience: 3+ Years in MFG quality or process Engineering.
  • Experience in DMAIC, 8D and 5-Why Methodologies.
  • Requires thorough understanding and application of standard engineering or scientific theories, concepts, principles, and techniques.
  • Requires the ability to develop and resolve solutions to a variety of technical problems of moderate scope and complexity.
  • Works under general direction with defined objectives.
  • Approach is consistent with established procedures.
  • Work is reviewed for soundness of technical judgment and overall adequacy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Keab/Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt Certification
  • PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC,. MSA experience4
  • Proficiency in Minitab, JMP, or Power BI
  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer- CQE or CQA
  • SAP, ETQ or similar ERP system experience
  • Project management experience

job.title: Production Operator
job.description:
Shift: 1st Shift | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Overtime: Overtime and weekend work required as needed

Job Summary

The Production Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring production equipment to support efficient manufacturing operations while maintaining quality and safety standards. Responsibilities include assembly, machine operation, loading and unloading materials, robotic cell operation, and performing quality inspections throughout the production process.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Complete all required start-up inspections and daily equipment check sheets, including robots, cranes, chillers, and other production equipment.
  • Operate production equipment and robotic cells according to standard operating procedures.
  • Load raw materials and parts into machines, fixtures, or jigs.
  • Perform assembly and fabrication using hand tools, power tools, and production equipment.
  • Monitor equipment during operation and perform basic troubleshooting to minimize downtime.
  • Meet production schedules, cycle times, and quality expectations.
  • Inspect parts for defects, proper assembly, weld quality, hardware installation, and overall workmanship.
  • Complete all required production documentation to ensure product traceability.
  • Read and follow blueprints, work instructions, and standard operating procedures.
  • Maintain a clean, organized work area using 5S principles.
  • Properly store tools, equipment, and materials at the end of each shift.
  • Report equipment issues, quality concerns, and safety hazards to supervision.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

Experience

  • Previous manufacturing or machine operator experience preferred.
  • Experience working in a production or assembly environment preferred.

Skills

  • Ability to read blueprints and follow work instructions.
  • Strong attention to detail and quality.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to identify defects and process abnormalities.
  • Strong organizational skills with a commitment to 5S and workplace safety.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently lift and move up to 50 pounds.
  • Stand and walk for extended periods throughout the shift.
  • Frequently bend, crouch, reach, and perform repetitive motions.
  • Work in a manufacturing environment with varying temperatures and noise levels.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, steel-toe shoes, gloves, sleeves, and long pants.

Work Environment

  • Manufacturing/shop floor environment.
  • Exposure to machinery, moving equipment, and production noise.
  • Overtime and weekend work may be required based on production schedules.

job.title: Quality Inspector- Manufacturing
job.description:
Quality Inspector – Manufacturing

1st Shift | Monday – Friday | 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM | $22–$24/Hour | Overtime Available

Are you detail-oriented and take pride in making sure things are done right? We are looking for an experienced Quality Inspector to join a busy manufacturing team.

This is a hands-on position where you will inspect incoming materials, work-in-process components, and finished products to make sure they meet quality standards and specifications. The ideal candidate has manufacturing experience, is comfortable using precision measuring tools, and understands how important accuracy and attention to detail are.

What You'll Do

  • Inspect incoming materials, in-process components, and finished products
  • Use calipers, micrometers, gauges, and other measuring tools to verify dimensions
  • Read and interpret technical drawings, work instructions, and quality specifications
  • Identify and document defects, discrepancies, and non-conforming products
  • Complete inspection records, reports, and other quality documentation
  • Communicate quality concerns to the Quality Supervisor and production team
  • Work with production to help identify and resolve quality issues
  • Assist with corrective actions and root-cause investigations
  • Participate in quality audits and continuous improvement activities
  • Support 5S and Lean manufacturing initiatives
  • Help maintain inspection equipment and ensure measuring tools are properly maintained
  • Assist with training and cross-training other Quality Inspectors as needed
  • Follow all safety and quality procedures
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area

What We're Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in quality inspection or manufacturing
  • Experience using calipers, micrometers, gauges, or similar inspection equipment
  • Ability to read and understand technical drawings and work instructions
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to identify defects and recognize when a product does not meet specifications
  • Basic computer skills and ability to complete quality documentation
  • Good communication and teamwork skills
  • Dependable attendance and a strong work ethic
  • Ability to work independently while also being part of a team
  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred

Schedule & Pay

Monday – Friday
1st Shift: 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM
$22.00 – $24.00 per hour
Overtime is likely and may be available based on production needs

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods
  • Frequent bending, reaching, and movement throughout the manufacturing floor
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds
  • Comfortable working around manufacturing equipment, noise, and varying temperatures

job.title: Technology Incident Manager - (Banking)
job.description:
Job Summary
The Incident Manager is responsible for leading the timely restoration of critical business services impacted by technology disruptions. This role manages cross-functional investigative teams and facilitates resolution of enterprise-level incidents through strong leadership, technical insight, and effective communication. The Incident Manager ensures that all incident response activities are executed efficiently, with a focus on minimizing business impact and improving system stability. This position may require overnight work hours and participation in a weekend on-call rotation.

Essential Functions

•Lead the identification, assessment, and resolution of critical technology incidents affecting enterprise operations.
•Facilitate and manage virtual incident response calls with diverse technical and business stakeholders.
•Quickly assess the scope and impact of incidents and determine the appropriate support teams and escalation paths.
•Guide troubleshooting efforts across multiple technology domains, including distributed systems, networks, applications, and mainframes.
•Collaborate with vendors and internal teams to drive resolution and ensure accurate, timely communication.
•Escalate critical issues to senior leadership and provide consistent progress updates.
•Partner with the communications team to ensure incident notifications are timely and accurate.
•Conduct post-incident reviews to identify root causes, process improvements, and documentation updates.
•Maintain and review critical application recovery documentation for accuracy and usability
•Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance incident detection, response, and recovery processes.
•Participate in production readiness reviews for critical projects to ensure alignment with incident management protocols.
•Adhere to ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library)-based processes and contribute to the development of incident management metrics and reporting.
•Must be able to work overnight shifts.
•Participation in weekend on-call rotation is required.
•Performs other duties as assigned; duties, responsibilities and/or activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice
•Complies with all policies and procedures, including without limitation, acting professionally at all times, conducting business ethically, avoiding conflicts of interest, and acting in the best interests of clients and company.

Education
•Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field or equivalent experience. (preferred)

Work Experience
•3+ years of experience leading technical projects, incident response efforts, or cross-functional technology initiatives (required)
•Experience in a high-pressure, 24/7 IT operations or incident management environment (preferred)
•Familiarity with enterprise IT infrastructure and application ecosystems (required)

Licenses and Certifications
•ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) Foundation certification (preferred)
•Incident management, project management (e.g., PMP), or technical discipline certifications (preferred)

Skills
•The ability to oversee and coordinate the response to unplanned service disruptions, ensuring timely restoration of services and minimizing business impact.
•Executing structured processes to detect, assess, respond to, and recover from incidents, while coordinating across technical and business teams
•Leading the organization's response during high-impact, time-sensitive events by making critical decisions, maintaining control, and ensuring continuity of operations
•The process of identifying the fundamental cause of an incident to prevent recurrence and support long-term stability and improvement.
•The practice of identifying, evaluating, and mitigating risks that could impact business operations, technology systems, or regulatory compliance
•The ability to clearly and effectively convey information across technical and non-technical audiences, especially during high-pressure situations.
•Managing and resolving disagreements or competing priorities among stakeholders to maintain focus and collaboration during incident response.
•Recognizing when an incident requires higher-level attention and ensuring timely communication and involvement of senior leadership or specialized teams.
•Ensuring that IT services can be recovered and maintained during and after a disruption, in alignment with business continuity and recovery objectives.
•Managing cybersecurity-related incidents, including detection, containment, investigation, and recovery, while minimizing impact and ensuring compliance.
•Understanding and applying organizational standards and protocols that govern the secure and effective use of IT systems and infrastructure.
•Guiding cross-functional teams during incident response, making informed decisions, and maintaining composure under pressure to drive resolution.
•Analyzing complex issues, identifying solutions quickly, and making sound decisions based on logic, data, and situational awareness.
•Prioritizing the needs and expectations of internal and external clients during incident response to minimize disruption and maintain trust.
•Accurately recording incident details, timelines, actions taken, and outcomes to support post-incident reviews, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Physical Demands
General Office - Prolonged sitting, ability to communicate face to face in person or on the phone with teammates and clients, frequent use of PC/laptop, occasional lifting/pushing/pulling of backpacks, computer bags up to 10 lbs.

Travel
Occasional travel to include overnights
This is 100% Onsite in Cleveland, OH

Production Coordinator / Production Scheduler
Hours:1st Shift, Mon-Thurs, 6am-430pm
Temp to Hire

Position Summary
The Production Coordinator / Production Scheduler supports manufacturing operations by coordinating production order execution, maintaining production schedules, and ensuring timely release of manufacturing orders through SAP. This position serves as a key link between Production Planning and Manufacturing by preparing, releasing, and distributing production documentation required for shop floor execution.

The role is responsible for releasing production orders, assembling production order packets, monitoring schedule adherence, and providing administrative support to planners to ensure efficient workflow and on-time production performance.

Key Responsibilities
Production Order Management
Release production orders in SAP in accordance with established planning and scheduling requirements.
Review released orders for accuracy and completeness prior to release to production.
Ensure production orders contain the appropriate documentation, routing, BOM, and work instructions.
Maintain production order status throughout the manufacturing process.
Monitor and communicate order priorities and schedule changes to manufacturing team

Production Packet Preparation
Print and assemble production order packets for manufacturing personnel.
Verify packets contain all required documentation, including:
Production orders
Bills of Material (BOM)
Routers/work instructions
Quality documentation
Engineering drawings and specifications


Distribute completed production packets to the appropriate production areas.
Maintain organized records of released and completed production orders

Production Scheduling Support
Support Production Planners in maintaining and executing manufacturing schedules.
Assist with schedule updates and order prioritization activities.
Monitor work center loading and report scheduling concerns to planners.
Track production progress and provide status updates on scheduled orders.
Coordinate with Production, Materials, Quality, and Engineering teams to resolve scheduling issues.


SAP System Administration
Execute production transactions accurately within SAP.
Maintain production order data and system accuracy.
Support inventory transaction activities as required.
Generate reports and production data for planners and operations leadership.
Assist in identifying and correcting system discrepancies impacting production execution.


Communication & Coordination
Serve as a liaison between Planning and Manufacturing
Communicate production priorities and schedule changes to shop floor personnel.
Escalate material shortages, documentation issues, and scheduling conflicts.
Participate in daily production and planning meetings as required.


Continuous Improvement
Support initiatives focused on improving schedule attainment and production efficiency.
Identify opportunities to streamline order release and documentation processes.
Maintain compliance with company procedures, quality standards, and safety requirements.



Required Qualifications
High school diploma or GED required; Associate degree preferred.
2+ years of experience in manufacturing, production control, planning, scheduling, or related operations support roles.

Experience working within an ERP system, preferably SAP.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel.

Strong organizational and administrative skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Effective written and verbal communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience in production planning, scheduling, or production control.

Knowledge of manufacturing processes and shop floor operations.

Experience supporting SAP Production Planning (PP) and Material Management (MM) modules.

Familiarity with Bills of Material (BOMs), routings, and work instructions.

Experience working in regulated or highly controlled manufacturing environments.



Key Competencies

Organization and Time Management

Attention to Detail

Problem Solving

SAP/ERP System Proficiency

Teamwork and Collaboration

Customer Service Mindset

Communication Skills

Operational Planning and Coordination



Typical Performance Metrics

Production order release accuracy

On-time production packet distribution

Schedule adherence support

SAP transaction accuracy

Documentation completeness

Planner and production customer satisfaction

Reduction of production delays due to documentation or scheduling issues

DIRECT HIRE | Competitive Pay | Multiple Shifts Available

Manchester, TN
$21.00–$36.00/HR — Based on Experience
1st Shift: 6:00 AM–6:00 PM
2nd Shift: 6:00 PM–4:30 AM
DIRECT HIRE | Full-Time Opportunity

Keep the Machines Running. Solve Problems. Make an Impact.

Are you an experienced Industrial Maintenance Technician looking for a great direct-hire opportunity where your skills are valued?

We're looking for a skilled maintenance professional who can troubleshoot, repair, and maintain industrial equipment while helping keep production running safely and efficiently. If you have experience with electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, PLC, welding, or machining systems, this is an opportunity to put your skills to work and grow with a strong manufacturing team.

WHY YOU'LL LIKE THIS OPPORTUNITY

DIRECT HIRE — Get hired directly by the company
$21.00–$36.00 per hour based on experience
1st & 2nd Shift Opportunities Available
Hands-on work with a wide variety of industrial equipment
Work with electrical, PLC, mechanical, hydraulic & pneumatic systems
Preventive maintenance and troubleshooting responsibilities
Opportunity to expand your technical skill set
Stable, full-time manufacturing opportunity

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Assist with machine improvements, modifications, and process enhancements.

  • Perform welding and basic machinist-related tasks as needed.

  • Use hand tools safely and effectively to complete maintenance and repair work.

  • Follow Lockout/Tagout (LO/TO) procedures and all company safety requirements.

  • Communicate equipment issues, repairs, and maintenance activities to supervisors and team members.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.

  • Complete required reports and documentation using Microsoft Word and Excel.

  • Work independently or collaboratively with other maintenance and production team members.

  • Maintain required forklift and boom lift certifications.

  • Continue developing technical skills through ongoing training and education.

  • Maintain flexibility to work varying schedules as production needs require.

SKILLS WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Candidates should be proficient in at least 11 of the following 20 skill areas:

  • Electrical Troubleshooting

  • PLCs

  • Mechanical Maintenance

  • Hydraulics

  • Pneumatics

  • Welding

  • Machining

  • Preventive Maintenance

  • Electrical Schematics

  • Mechanical Prints

  • Machine Troubleshooting

  • Equipment Repair

  • Machine Improvements

  • Hand Tools

  • Power Tools

  • Lockout/Tagout (LO/TO)

  • Forklift Operation

  • Boom Lift Operation

  • Computer Skills

  • Maintenance Documentation

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

  • 3+ years of industrial maintenance experience

OR

  • Associate's Degree in Electronics/Electrical with 2+ years of experience

OR

  • Military training in a related technical field with an honorable discharge

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical degree or vocational certification in Industrial Maintenance

  • Manufacturing or industrial production experience

  • Forklift and/or boom lift certification

  • Strong electrical and mechanical troubleshooting skills

  • Experience reading electrical schematics and mechanical prints

  • Experience with PLC troubleshooting and controls

SAFETY & TEAMWORK

Safety is a top priority. The ideal candidate will:

  • Follow all company safety rules and procedures.

  • Understand and properly utilize Lockout/Tagout (LO/TO) procedures.

  • Maintain a clean and organized work environment.

  • Communicate effectively with supervisors, maintenance team members, and production employees.

  • Be comfortable working independently while also contributing to a team.

  • Be willing to continue education and training to meet department goals.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

You're the person production calls when the machine goes down and they need someone who can figure it out.

You have strong troubleshooting skills, take safety seriously, communicate well with your team, and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty. You enjoy solving problems, improving equipment, and keeping production moving.

READY FOR YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY?

Apply today and take the next step in your maintenance career!

Material Handler

Schedule:
1st Shift: Monday through Friday 5:00 AM to 3:30 PM
OR

Description:

Join our team as a Material Handler, a full-time production role equivalent to a Rigger classification. In this role, you'll begin with a compulsory Training Period, setting you up for success in our fast-paced environment. After completing training, you'll be assigned to a production shift and may be required to work overtime.

  • Maintain Cleanliness: Perform yard and building cleaning tasks, contributing to the overall maintenance of our facilities and equipment.

Physical Requirements:

You'll need adequate strength, mobility, dexterity, vision, hearing, and stamina to perform these tasks with minimal assistance.

Other Qualifications:

  • Education: A high school education is preferred.

Why Join Us?

In this role, you'll find a supportive team environment where your skills and dedication are valued. You will work with advanced equipment and contribute to our production processes. With opportunities for overtime and growth, this position is both rewarding and fulfilling.

Join us and be part of a company that values hard work, precision, and teamwork. Apply now to start your journey as a Material Handler with us!

We're looking for a Project Coordinator to help manage automotive manufacturing and production launch projects from start to finish. This position works closely with customers and internal teams to keep projects on schedule, track progress, resolve issues, and ensure deadlines are met. You'll typically support two to three active projects at a time while working alongside engineering, production, quality, purchasing, logistics, and sales.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate assigned projects from kickoff through completion.

  • Schedule and participate in customer and internal project meetings.
  • Record meeting notes, action items, and follow up to ensure completion.
  • Coordinate activities between Engineering, Production, Quality, Purchasing, Logistics, Sales, and other departments.
  • Monitor supplier readiness, material status, and delivery timelines.
  • Identify potential project risks and communicate concerns to the PM Supervisor.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and records.

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.

Preferred Experience

  • Automotive manufacturing or Tier 1/Tier 2 supplier experience.
  • Experience supporting new product launches or production transfers.

job.title: Associate Product Owner
job.description:
Overview
Our Client is seeking a Associate Product Owner. This role focuses on enhancing mobile experiences, leveraging modern technologies, and delivering features that improve customer engagement while supporting broader product objectives.

The Associate Product Owner will work closely with teams across IT, UX, Analytics, and business functions to define, prioritize, and deliver mobile capabilities. The position requires a blend of product ownership, analytical thinking, and technical communication to drive customer-focused outcomes.

Core Responsibilities
• Collaborate with IT, UX, Analytics, and business stakeholders to understand customer behavior and develop mobile experiences aligned with product objectives.
• Support the vision and strategy for mobile platforms, ensuring features and tools contribute to a cohesive mobile customer experience.
• Conduct competitive benchmarking, research emerging technologies, identify product gaps, and recommend enhancements to improve customer experiences.
• Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, iteration planning, stand-ups, and other product management activities.
• Translate business objectives into technical requirements through clearly defined user stories and backlog management.
• Prioritize and manage the mobile platform backlog to focus development efforts on high-impact initiatives and measurable outcomes.
• Partner with third-party software vendors to support the development and enhancement of mobile tools and capabilities.
• Operate within a DevOps environment, helping troubleshoot technical issues, prioritize defect resolution, and support incremental product improvements.
• Work closely with technical leads and architects to develop solutions that deliver customer value while reducing operational costs.
• Conduct demonstrations of new software and communicate outcomes, updates, and learnings to stakeholders and team members.
• Partner with business units to create and validate user stories, ensuring both technical and business requirements are satisfied.
• Monitor product performance metrics and continuously iterate to improve customer outcomes and product effectiveness.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience/training.
• Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience, preferably in e-commerce environments.
• Product ownership experience with the ability to manage backlogs, define user stories, and support Agile delivery teams.
• Analytical background with the ability to evaluate customer behavior, measure outcomes, and drive data-informed decisions.
• Ability to communicate effectively using technical language across business and technology stakeholders.
• Understanding of mobile application technology frameworks and the differences between Android and iOS platforms.
• Understanding of how enterprise systems interact, including platforms such as Sabre, ITA, eTDS, and related technologies.
• Knowledge of Agile methodologies and product management practices.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask, prioritize work, and operate effectively with minimal direction.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including transparency, expectation setting, and stakeholder reporting.
• High level of intellectual curiosity and comfort working in ambiguous environments.
• Ability to build trust and foster collaboration across cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Master’s degree in a related field.
• Experience selecting and implementing third-party software development kits (SDKs) to enhance mobile applications and tools.
• Experience using Agile and other software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies to develop and deliver software.
• Experience working within a product operating model focused on outcomes and continuous customer experience improvement.
• Mobile application and travel or airline industry experience.
• Understanding of emerging mobile technologies and their application to customer engagement strategies.
• Demonstrated success delivering products that generate measurable business value.

Work Details
• Hybrid work schedule with onsite attendance Tuesday through Thursday and remote work on Monday and Friday.

job.title: Cost Accountant - Tulsa
job.description:
Cost Accountant – Manufacturing

Tulsa, OK, or Claremore, OK | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. | On-Site

Pay & Benefits

Compensation: $75,000–$90,000, depending on experience
Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Retirement Planning: 401(k) with company match
Time Away: Paid time off, holidays, and personal days
Additional Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Bonus Incentive Program
Coverage: Life and disability insurance
Work Environment: Established manufacturing company with a stable weekday schedule and a collaborative team environment

About the Role

We’re looking for a Cost Accountant with manufacturing experience to help track, analyze, and improve the financial performance of a production operation.

This role is focused on manufacturing costs, inventory, standard costing, and variance analysis. You’ll work closely with Finance, Production, Procurement, and Project Management to understand where costs are coming from, identify discrepancies, and provide information that helps the business make better decisions.

This is a strong opportunity for an accountant who enjoys going beyond basic general ledger work and wants to understand how products are made, what they cost, and where the company can improve profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Cost Analysis:

  • Analyze material, labor, production, and overhead costs to help identify trends and areas for improvement

  • Prepare cost accounting reports and provide analysis to support operational and financial decisions

  • Review production costs and identify opportunities for improved efficiency and cost reduction

Standard Costing & Variance Analysis:

  • Calculate and maintain standard costs for products and manufacturing activities

  • Analyze cost variances and investigate the underlying causes

  • Work with operational teams to understand significant changes in material, labor, and overhead costs

Inventory Accounting & Reconciliation:

  • Monitor inventory transactions and ensure costs are accurately captured

  • Perform inventory reconciliations and research discrepancies

  • Support accurate inventory valuation and related financial reporting

Financial Analysis & Profitability:

  • Perform profitability and cost-benefit analysis on products, projects, and operational activities

  • Provide financial insight to help management evaluate costs and potential savings

  • Identify trends and communicate findings clearly to Finance and operational leadership

Month-End Close & Accounting:

  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to inventory and manufacturing costs

  • Prepare reconciliations, reports, and supporting schedules

  • Ensure accounting activity is accurate and consistent with company policies and applicable accounting standards

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Process Improvement:

  • Partner with Production, Procurement, Project Management, and Finance to improve cost visibility and efficiency

  • Help develop and maintain cost accounting processes and procedures

  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting, systems, and overall cost-accounting accuracy

Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Experience:

  • 2+ years of cost accounting, manufacturing accounting, or financial analysis experience

  • Manufacturing or production-environment experience is strongly preferred

Technical Skills:

  • Strong understanding of accounting principles and U.S. GAAP

  • Experience with inventory accounting, standard costs, and variance analysis

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office

  • Experience with ERP systems is a plus

Analytical Skills:

  • Strong ability to analyze financial and operational data

  • Comfortable investigating variances and identifying the reasons behind cost changes

  • Strong problem-solving and organizational skills

Work Style:

  • Detail-oriented and committed to financial accuracy

  • Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating across departments

Communication:

  • Able to clearly communicate financial findings to both accounting and non-accounting team members

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Work Environment

This position is primarily office-based within a manufacturing environment, with regular interaction with production and operational teams. The role requires extended periods working at a computer, with occasional visits to the manufacturing floor. Employees entering the shop environment are required to wear appropriate PPE.

job.title: Welder
job.description:
We are seeking experienced Structural Welders and Fitters to join our fabrication team. This is a production-focused position working with heavy structural steel. Candidates must have proven experience welding wide flange beams and heavy plate using GMAW (MIG) welding procedures.

Please Note: We are not hiring entry-level welders or candidates whose experience is limited to automotive, equipment repair, TIG welding, or stick welding. This position requires previous structural steel fabrication experience.

Current Openings

  • 2nd Shift (Primary Need)

Schedule

1st Shift

  • 5:00 AM – 3:30 PM

2nd Shift

  • Perform structural welding on wide flange beams, columns, and heavy plate assemblies.
  • Complete high-quality fillet welds, multi-pass fillet welds, partial joint penetration (PJP), and complete joint penetration (CJP) welds using GMAW (MIG) processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience welding wide flange beams, heavy plate, and structural steel components.

  • Experience performing:
    • Fillet welds

    • Partial Joint Penetration (PJP) welds

  • Ability to read and interpret structural blueprints and weld symbols.

job.title: Quality Engineer- Manufacturing
job.description:
Quality Engineer – Manufacturing

Catoosa, OK | Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 7:00 AM–4:00 PM | On-Site
Eligible candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive Salary: $80-110k, (dependent on experience, can discuss higher)

Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

401(k) with Company Match

Paid Vacation, Personal Time & Holidays

Life & Disability Insurance

Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Ongoing Training & Career Growth Opportunities

Drive Quality Through Engineering.

We're seeking an experienced Quality Engineer to support quality performance across a complex industrial manufacturing operation. This position will develop and improve quality processes, investigate manufacturing issues, analyze quality data, and work directly with production and engineering teams to prevent defects and improve product consistency. The right candidate will bring a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a closely related technical discipline, along with hands-on quality engineering experience in manufacturing.

What You'll Own

Quality Engineering & Process Control

  • Develop, implement, and maintain quality processes and standards for manufacturing operations.
  • Perform inspections and audits of incoming materials, manufacturing processes, and finished products.
  • Evaluate processes and products against engineering requirements, customer specifications, and established quality standards.
  • Identify, document, and communicate nonconformances and quality concerns.
  • Develop inspection and testing methods that support consistent product quality.
  • Partner with production to address quality issues and prevent recurring defects.

Root Cause & Corrective Action

  • Lead investigations into product defects, process failures, customer complaints, and recurring quality issues.
  • Apply structured root cause analysis techniques to determine the source of problems.
  • Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Monitor corrective actions to verify effectiveness and prevent recurrence.
  • Work with production and engineering teams to address process-related quality concerns.
  • Support disposition and resolution of nonconforming material and product.

Quality Data & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze quality data to identify trends, recurring defects, process variation, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Apply quality tools such as SPC, FMEA, and other statistical and problem-solving methods.
  • Establish and monitor quality metrics and performance indicators.
  • Recommend process improvements that reduce defects, waste, rework, and customer issues.
  • Participate in Lean, Six Sigma, and other continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Use data and engineering judgment to support quality and manufacturing decisions.

Quality Systems & Compliance

  • Maintain quality procedures, inspection records, testing documentation, and corrective-action records.
  • Support implementation and maintenance of applicable quality management systems.
  • Ensure manufacturing processes meet customer requirements and applicable industry standards.
  • Support internal, customer, and third-party quality audits.
  • Assist with quality documentation for new and modified products.
  • Help ensure quality requirements are effectively communicated throughout manufacturing.

Manufacturing & Product Support

  • Work directly with production and engineering teams to resolve manufacturing quality issues.
  • Provide quality input during product development, design changes, and production implementation.
  • Evaluate manufacturability and quality risks associated with new or modified products.
  • Support product testing, inspection activities, and evaluation of materials and components.
  • Provide training and guidance to production personnel regarding quality requirements and corrective actions.
  • Serve as a technical quality resource for day-to-day manufacturing issues.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Engineering, Production, Supply Chain, and other departments to improve product quality.
  • Communicate technical quality issues clearly to both engineering and production personnel.
  • Participate in design and process reviews where quality risks or requirements need to be evaluated.
  • Work with suppliers or external partners when quality issues require investigation.
  • Support customer quality concerns and participate in customer audits when required.
  • Help drive accountability for corrective actions and sustained quality improvements.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline

3+ years of professional Quality Engineering or Manufacturing Quality Engineering experience

Experience working in a manufacturing, fabrication, industrial equipment, or similarly technical production environment

Demonstrated experience with root cause analysis and corrective action

Working knowledge of FMEA, SPC, quality systems, inspection methods, and process control

Ability to read and understand engineering drawings, specifications, technical documentation, and manufacturing requirements

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with industrial equipment, fabricated products, or engineered-to-order manufacturing.
  • Experience analyzing quality data and identifying process variation or recurring defects.
  • Experience conducting quality audits, inspections, and investigations.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies.
  • Experience supporting new product development or engineering changes.
  • Familiarity with ERP, QMS, or quality management systems.
  • CQE, Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, or similar quality certification.

Ideal Industry Background

We're especially interested in Quality Engineers who have worked in:

  • Industrial Manufacturing
  • Engineered Equipment
  • Metal Fabrication
  • Industrial Cooling or Thermal Equipment
  • Heavy Manufacturing
  • Custom Equipment Manufacturing
  • Mechanical Manufacturing
  • OEM Manufacturing

Work Environment

This position is primarily office-based with regular interaction throughout an active manufacturing facility. The production environment is non-temperature-controlled and may include noise, dust, dirt, metal particles, machinery, and other typical industrial conditions. Appropriate PPE is required when entering production areas.

Schedule & Travel

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM

Occasional evening or weekend work may be required based on business needs.

Travel: Travel is required for this position.

job.title: IBM ELM Digital Thread Engineer
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a key member of the engineering and systems team responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the IBM Engineering Lifecycle Management (ELM) platform in support of safety-critical aerospace workflows and Digital Thread initiatives.
This role focuses on supporting Requirements Based Engineering (RBE), enabling end-to-end traceability across engineering and manufacturing lifecycles, and integrating systems engineering data with enterprise engineering tools and processes.

Core Responsibilities
• Design, implement, and maintain integrations between IBM ELM and enterprise systems such as PLM, CAD, ERP, and MES platforms to support a unified Digital Thread.
• Build linked data pipelines using OSLC, REST APIs, and integration middleware to enable cross-platform data exchange and lifecycle visibility.
• Define data federation and synchronization strategies to support a single source of truth across the product lifecycle.
• Establish automated configuration management links between systems engineering data and product structures, including As-Designed and As-Built BOMs.
• Align IBM ELM workflows with ARP4754 guidelines for civil aircraft development and support development assurance level (DAL A through E) tracking.
• Create and maintain automated traceability and verification matrices to support compliance audits and reviews.
• Administer and configure the IBM ELM Suite, including DOORS Next Generation, Engineering Workflow Management (EWM), Engineering Test Management (ETM), Rhapsody, Global Configuration Management (GCM), and Jazz Team Server (JTS).
• Configure project areas, permissions, access controls, and workflow templates while maintaining platform performance and availability.
• Partner with Quality Assurance teams to align ETM processes with Requirements Based Engineering workflows.
• Manage change requests, defect tracking, and sprint planning activities within EWM.
• Ensure engineering and systems data comply with applicable regulatory, industry, and security requirements, including ARP4754, DO-178C, and DO-254.
• Develop automation scripts, plugins, and integrations using REST APIs, OSLC, JavaScript, and Python.
• Design and maintain automated reports, compliance dashboards, and reporting solutions using IBM Engineering Lifecycle Optimization, BIRT, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• U.S. Citizenship is required.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
• Minimum 5+ years of experience with software and systems engineering tooling.
• Deep hands-on expertise administering and configuring the IBM ELM ecosystem, including DOORS Next Generation, EWM, ETM, Rhapsody, GCM, and JTS.
• Proven experience supporting Requirements Based Engineering within aerospace environments using IBM ELM tools.
• Experience integrating IBM ELM with enterprise digital engineering tools and PLM platforms such as Siemens Teamcenter, PTC Windchill, or Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE.
• Strong practical experience with ARP4754A/B frameworks and familiarity with DO-178C and DO-254 compliance requirements.
• Experience with Digital Thread architectures, OSLC integrations, REST APIs, scripting, and automation.
• Familiarity with Safety-Critical Lifecycle Management, Agile, SAFe, and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
• Strong communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• IBM ELM certifications, including IBM Certified Specialist credentials.
• Experience creating enterprise dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or comparable analytics platforms.

Work Details
• Hybrid work arrangement.
• Two openings available.

job.title: Scientist
job.description:
Working Model: onsite (five days a week)

Working days: Monday through Friday

Working hours (e.g. 8 AM to 4 PM PT, 9 AM to 5 PM, etc.): Standard 8 hours

Position Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Scientist to join our Biochemical and Cellular Pharmacology Department. This hands-on, laboratory-based role focuses on the development and execution of induced proximity-based assays crucial for the discovery and validation of Client therapeutic compounds. The successful candidate will work at the heart of a multi-disciplinary environment, translating experimental data into actionable insights for our drug discovery programs.
In this role, the candidate will have the unique opportunity to pioneer new induced-proximity approaches and help shape the scientific direction of early-stage drug-discovery programs.

Key Responsibilities
Assay Development: Design and develop biochemical and cell-based assays for quantitative measurement of protein–protein and protein–small molecule interactions.
Screening & Validation: Conduct routine screening and deep-dive validation studies to support lead identification and optimization.
Data Analysis: Perform rigorous analysis of complex data sets, ensuring high quality and reproducibility.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with colleagues in Pharmacology, Protein Science, Medicinal Chemistry and Research Biology.
Communication: Prepare technical reports and present findings clearly during multi-disciplinary project team meetings.

Education & Experience
Degree: B.S. or M.S. in Biochemistry, Biophysics, Cellular/Molecular Biology, or a related scientific discipline.

Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on laboratory experience within an academic, biotechnology, or pharmaceutical industry setting.

Mandatory Skiils Requirements
Demonstrated experience designing, developing, validating, and executing cellular and biochemical assays, supported by a strong theoretical and practical understanding of biochemistry and biophysics relevant to complex protein systems.
Direct experience with induced proximity assays and modalities (molecular glues, bivalent degraders, ternary complexes and multicomponent binding systems).
Proficiency with data analysis methods and specialized software. Ability to move beyond default vendor fits and analyze complex system behavior using Prism, Python, R or comparable tools.
Proven ability to critically analyze and interpret complex data sets, troubleshoot experimental hurdles, and a proactive interest in adopting new technologies.

Preferred Technical Skills
Experience with protein biochemistry, recombinant protein expression and molecular biology methods (e.g. western blot, cell culture, cell growth assays).
Experience with nanoBRET, nanoBiT, TR-FRET, BRET as well as imaging-based approaches.
Familiarity with automated or semi-automated laboratory instrumentation (e.g., liquid handlers, plate washers).
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and remain productive through shifting priorities or project changes.
Proven ability to work effectively as part of a high-functioning, multi-disciplinary team.
A proactive approach to troubleshooting and a keen interest in learning new technologies as project needs evolve.

job.title: Materials Planner I - (Automotive)
job.description:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

Job Summary:
The Material Planner I will work with suppliers and operations to deliver the right material at the correct quantity and at the right time to meet production schedules. The role will communicate with suppliers, purchasing and operations team.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Ensure continuous production by utilizing the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system's material and production requirements, with a focus on forecast and dependent demand.
• Communicate and coordinate with suppliers to ensure they receive planning generated purchase orders or releases, as well as forecasts.
• Escalate and resolve any issues or discrepancies found during the planning process to the appropriate cross-functional team members.
• Effectively manage material requirement changes resulting from Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and forecast changes.
• Work closely with the operations team to ensure any changes in the schedule are covered and can be achieved.
• Participate in program end of life balance out meetings.
• Follow up and track the delivery of material to meet the schedule. The planner is responsible for tracking down and reporting supplier shipments and other duties as required.
• Analyze expedited requests as needed.
• Maintain compliance with all company policies and procedures.

Education and Experience (required):
• High school diploma or equivalent.
• Minimum of 3 years of supply chain experience.

Education and Experience (preferred):
• Associate's degree.

Skills, Knowledge and Abilities (required):
• Ability to be effective in a fast paced, dynamic team environment, handling multiple tasks.
• Must be able to work under pressure and meet deadlines, while maintaining a positive attitude.
• Ability to work independently and to carry out assignments to completion within parameters of instructions given, prescribed routines, and standard accepted practices.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including ability to effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
• Excellent computer skills including MS Office – Word, Excel (advanced formulas, pivots, if/ then), Outlook.
Skills, Knowledge and Abilities (preferred):
• Basic understanding of how a supply chain flows from the supplier's supplier to our customer's customer as well as general business practices.
• Proven ability to solve complex issues by triaging for short term recovery as well as identifying root cause. Material planner is key in assisting the team in putting corrective actions in place.
• Solid understanding of materials flow and inventory triggers.
• Self-starter who seeks out ways to improve processes before being asked.
• Association for Supply Chain Management (ASCM) certification.

job.title: Manual QA Tester (Mid)
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Manual QA Tester with experience validating both web applications and physical or connected devices. This role focuses on comprehensive software and device testing, test documentation, defect tracking, and quality assurance activities within a collaborative environment.
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience across multiple testing methodologies, strong analytical and documentation skills, and the ability to work independently while partnering effectively with cross-functional teams.

Core Responsibilities
• Execute manual testing activities for web applications and physical or connected devices.
• Create and maintain detailed test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and traceability matrices.
• Perform functional, integration, system, regression, exploratory, usability, compatibility, and end-to-end testing.
• Review application and device logs to identify issues and support defect analysis.
• Utilize browser developer tools and diagnostic utilities to investigate and troubleshoot application behavior.
• Track, document, and manage defects using Azure DevOps or equivalent test management and defect-tracking tools.
• Support requirements traceability, risk-based testing, and defect-management processes throughout the software development lifecycle.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure product quality and testing objectives are achieved.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• 5+ years of hands-on experience in manual software testing or quality assurance.
• Experience testing both web applications and physical or connected devices.
• Strong experience creating test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and traceability matrices.
• Hands-on knowledge of functional, integration, system, regression, exploratory, usability, compatibility, and end-to-end testing.
• Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, requirements traceability, risk-based testing, and defect-management processes.
• Experience with Azure DevOps or equivalent test management and defect-tracking tools.
• Knowledge of browser compatibility, client-server architecture, networking fundamentals, and device connectivity.
• Ability to analyze application and device logs using browser developer tools and diagnostic utilities.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Experience in the medical device, healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated industry.
• Familiarity with medical device verification and validation processes.
• Knowledge of ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, IEC 62366-1, and applicable FDA regulations.
• Experience producing regulated test documentation and objective test evidence.
• Experience testing Virtual Reality applications, headsets, controllers, sensors, or related devices.

Work Details
• Location: Dublin, California.
• On-site role requiring attendance in the Dublin office five days per week.

job.title: Director of Capital Projects – Manufacturing
job.description:
Director of Capital Projects – Manufacturing

Tulsa, OK | Full-Time | Monday–Friday | On-Site

Pay & Benefits

Compensation: $125,000–$180,000, depending on experience
Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Retirement Planning: 401(k) with company match
Time Away: Paid time off, holidays, and personal days
Additional Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Bonus Incentive Program
Coverage: Life and disability insurance
Work Environment: Established manufacturing organization with significant capital investment and a strong focus on long-term growth and operational improvement

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Director of Capital Projects – Manufacturing to lead a growing portfolio of construction, facility, equipment, expansion, and infrastructure projects within an established manufacturing environment.

This is a high-level leadership position with responsibility for the company’s capital planning, project execution, and overall CAPEX investment strategy. You’ll oversee multiple projects at various stages, lead Construction Project Managers, manage external contractors and engineering partners, and work directly with executive leadership to determine where and how capital should be invested.

The ideal candidate is someone who can operate at both the strategic and project level—someone who can look at a multi-year capital plan with executive leadership one day and work through a construction issue, budget variance, or contractor challenge the next.

Key Responsibilities

Capital Portfolio Leadership:

  • Lead a portfolio of concurrent construction, facility expansion, equipment installation, renovation, and infrastructure projects

  • Oversee projects from initial concept and business case development through design, permitting, construction, commissioning, and closeout

  • Establish project priorities, schedules, budgets, milestones, and performance expectations

  • Monitor scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and resource requirements across the project portfolio

CAPEX Strategy & Financial Management:

  • Own the company’s overall CAPEX budget and capital spending process

  • Develop annual and long-range capital plans in partnership with Executive Leadership and Finance

  • Evaluate capital requests and make recommendations regarding project priorities and funding

  • Monitor actual spending against approved budgets and forecast remaining project costs

  • Partner with Finance on capitalization, project accounting, forecasting, and financial reporting

Project Management Leadership:

  • Lead and develop Construction Project Managers and additional project resources as the organization grows

  • Establish accountability, performance expectations, and consistent project management practices

  • Provide coaching, mentoring, and technical guidance to the project management team

  • Implement standardized tools, processes, reporting, and project controls across the organization

Construction & Contractor Management:

  • Oversee contractors, engineering firms, architects, consultants, and other external project partners

  • Review bids, contracts, scopes of work, change orders, and project commitments

  • Ensure contractors deliver against expectations for safety, quality, schedule, cost, and overall performance

  • Manage construction changes, claims, disputes, and other issues that could affect project outcomes

Executive & Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Partner with Operations and site leadership to execute projects while minimizing disruption to ongoing production

  • Work closely with Finance, EHS, Legal, Facilities, and other departments throughout the project lifecycle

  • Provide executive leadership with clear reporting on project status, CAPEX spending, risks, timelines, and key decisions

  • Make recommendations to senior leadership regarding project priorities, funding, and resource allocation

Risk, Safety & Compliance:

  • Ensure capital projects meet applicable building codes, permitting requirements, environmental requirements, safety standards, and company policies

  • Identify and proactively manage project and portfolio-level risks

  • Ensure appropriate safety expectations are built into construction planning and contractor management

  • Address issues early to protect project timelines, budgets, employees, and business operations

Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Business, or a related field

Experience:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience managing construction, capital projects, facilities, engineering projects, or a combination of these

  • Proven experience managing multiple large-scale projects simultaneously

  • Demonstrated experience managing significant CAPEX budgets and capital planning

  • Previous experience leading Project Managers or other project professionals

  • Manufacturing, industrial, or other complex operating-environment experience strongly preferred

Project & Financial Expertise:

  • Strong understanding of construction processes, contracts, project controls, scheduling, budgeting, and cost management

  • Experience evaluating project costs, forecasts, change orders, and financial performance

  • Ability to balance long-term capital strategy with day-to-day project execution

Leadership & Communication:

  • Proven ability to lead, develop, and hold project teams accountable

  • Strong negotiation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

  • Comfortable communicating with executive leadership, operations teams, contractors, engineers, and other stakeholders

  • Able to translate complex project and financial information into clear recommendations

Leadership Style:

  • Strategic thinker who is also willing to get into the details

  • Highly organized and comfortable managing competing priorities

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability

  • Confident making decisions and resolving issues in a fast-moving environment

Work Environment

This position operates primarily within a professional office and manufacturing environment, with regular interaction across production, facilities, engineering, and construction activities. The role will involve time in active manufacturing and construction areas, where appropriate PPE and site safety requirements must be followed.

job.title: Assembly - Production 1st
job.description:
Description:
Help production by performing duties such as supplying or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

Duties:
  • Load and unload items from machines, conveyors, and conveyances.
  • Operate machinery used in the production process, or assist machine operators.
  • Place products in equipment or on work surfaces for further processing, inspecting, or wrapping.
  • Examine products to verify conformance to quality standards.
  • Start machines or equipment to begin production processes.
  • Observe equipment operations so that malfunctions can be detected, and notify operators of any malfunctions.
  • Remove products, machine attachments, or waste material from machines.
  • Lift raw materials, finished products, and packed items, manually or using hoists.
  • Transfer finished products, raw materials, tools, or equipment between storage and work areas of plants and warehouses, by hand or using hand trucks or powered lift trucks.
  • Pack and store materials and products.
  • Count finished products to determine if product orders are complete.
  • Measure amounts of products, lengths of extruded articles, or weights of filled containers to ensure conformance to specifications.
  • Separate products according to weight, grade, size, or composition of materials used to produce them.
  • Dump materials such as prepared ingredients into machine hoppers prior to mixing.
  • Mix ingredients according to specified procedures or formulas.
  • Tie products in bundles for further processing or shipment, following prescribed procedures.
  • Record information, such as the number of products tested, meter readings, or dates and times of product production.
  • Prepare raw materials for processing.
  • Maintain a clean and safe work area
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Skills/Qualifications:
  • Prior experience working in a manufacturing environment is preferred
  • Must be able to read and understand instructions and possess basic arithmetic skills.
  • Must be able to work efficiently and repetitively with hands and have physical strength, stamina and coordination to perform duties.
  • Must be a team player and able to work well with others

job.title: Cost Accountant- Manufacturing
job.description:
Cost Accountant – Manufacturing

Tulsa, OK, or Claremore, OK | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. | On-Site

Pay & Benefits

Compensation: $75,000–$90,000, depending on experience
Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Retirement Planning: 401(k) with company match
Time Away: Paid time off, holidays, and personal days
Additional Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Bonus Incentive Program
Coverage: Life and disability insurance
Work Environment: Established manufacturing company with a stable weekday schedule and a collaborative team environment

About the Role

We’re looking for a Cost Accountant with manufacturing experience to help track, analyze, and improve the financial performance of a production operation.

This role is focused on manufacturing costs, inventory, standard costing, and variance analysis. You’ll work closely with Finance, Production, Procurement, and Project Management to understand where costs are coming from, identify discrepancies, and provide information that helps the business make better decisions.

This is a strong opportunity for an accountant who enjoys going beyond basic general ledger work and wants to understand how products are made, what they cost, and where the company can improve profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Cost Analysis:

  • Analyze material, labor, production, and overhead costs to help identify trends and areas for improvement

  • Prepare cost accounting reports and provide analysis to support operational and financial decisions

  • Review production costs and identify opportunities for improved efficiency and cost reduction

Standard Costing & Variance Analysis:

  • Calculate and maintain standard costs for products and manufacturing activities

  • Analyze cost variances and investigate the underlying causes

  • Work with operational teams to understand significant changes in material, labor, and overhead costs

Inventory Accounting & Reconciliation:

  • Monitor inventory transactions and ensure costs are accurately captured

  • Perform inventory reconciliations and research discrepancies

  • Support accurate inventory valuation and related financial reporting

Financial Analysis & Profitability:

  • Perform profitability and cost-benefit analysis on products, projects, and operational activities

  • Provide financial insight to help management evaluate costs and potential savings

  • Identify trends and communicate findings clearly to Finance and operational leadership

Month-End Close & Accounting:

  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to inventory and manufacturing costs

  • Prepare reconciliations, reports, and supporting schedules

  • Ensure accounting activity is accurate and consistent with company policies and applicable accounting standards

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Process Improvement:

  • Partner with Production, Procurement, Project Management, and Finance to improve cost visibility and efficiency

  • Help develop and maintain cost accounting processes and procedures

  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting, systems, and overall cost-accounting accuracy

Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Experience:

  • 2+ years of cost accounting, manufacturing accounting, or financial analysis experience

  • Manufacturing or production-environment experience is strongly preferred

Technical Skills:

  • Strong understanding of accounting principles and U.S. GAAP

  • Experience with inventory accounting, standard costs, and variance analysis

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office

  • Experience with ERP systems is a plus

Analytical Skills:

  • Strong ability to analyze financial and operational data

  • Comfortable investigating variances and identifying the reasons behind cost changes

  • Strong problem-solving and organizational skills

Work Style:

  • Detail-oriented and committed to financial accuracy

  • Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating across departments

Communication:

  • Able to clearly communicate financial findings to both accounting and non-accounting team members

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Work Environment

This position is primarily office-based within a manufacturing environment, with regular interaction with production and operational teams. The role requires extended periods working at a computer, with occasional visits to the manufacturing floor. Employees entering the shop environment are required to wear appropriate PPE.
