job.title: Production Technician I - 1st Shift
job.description:
Job Title

Production Operator – Dyneema Manufacturing Location: Mesa, AZ Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Production Operator to join our manufacturing team in Mesa. In this hands-on role, you will set up, operate, monitor, and maintain equipment used to produce high-performance Dyneema products. You will play a key part in ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production while following strict safety, quality, and operational standards.

This position is ideal for someone who takes pride in precise work, enjoys operating manufacturing equipment, and thrives in a structured, safety-first environment.

Key Responsibilities

Safety, Security & Compliance

  • Follow all Safety, Health, Environment (SHE) and Security policies, procedures, and site requirements.
  • Immediately address unsafe behaviors and report any incidents, near misses, or observed risks to management.
  • Handle and manage hazardous materials and waste safely, including proper documentation, inspection, and transport within the facility when required.
  • Maintain confidentiality of company intellectual property and follow all security protocols (including restricted use of personal devices).

Production Operations

  • Set up, operate, adjust, and clean production equipment according to work instructions and standard operating procedures.
  • Run equipment safely and efficiently to meet quality and output targets.
  • Monitor process conditions and make approved adjustments to maintain product specifications.
  • Perform minor preventative maintenance as needed.
  • Move raw materials, intermediates, and finished products using pallet jacks, overhead cranes, and other material-handling equipment.
  • Operate forklifts and overhead cranes as required.

Quality & Documentation

  • Conduct in-process quality checks and prepare samples for offline testing.
  • Accurately record raw materials used and products produced in computer systems and tracking tools.
  • Maintain complete and accurate production, quality, and process records.
  • Identify and report any issues that could affect product quality, packaging, efficiency, or safety.

Continuous Improvement & Teamwork

  • Troubleshoot equipment, setup, and process issues and recommend practical solutions.
  • Participate in near-miss investigations, root cause analysis (RCA), and job safety analyses (JSA).
  • Contribute to SHE, Quality, or other cross-functional improvement teams.
  • Support Manufacturing Excellence initiatives by following standardized work processes.
  • Complete and maintain all required training.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum 1 year of manufacturing experience (textile, composites, or similar production environment preferred) or equivalent military technical experience/training.
  • Ability to follow detailed work instructions, SOPs, and safety procedures.
  • Basic computer skills (Microsoft Word, data entry systems).
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to detect process or product defects.
  • Ability to perform basic math and solve routine problems.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Ability to operate forklifts and overhead cranes (certification preferred or willingness to obtain).
  • Ability to perform manual material handling and heavy lifting.
  • Mechanical aptitude and comfort with equipment assembly/setup.
  • Ability to read gauges, dials, meters, and controllers.
  • Willingness to work with and around hazardous materials under proper controls.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in continuous or batch manufacturing environments.
  • Existing forklift and/or overhead crane certification.
  • Experience with process troubleshooting and continuous improvement activities.
  • Familiarity with quality systems and accurate production record-keeping.

Physical & Working Conditions

  • Stand, walk, and perform repetitive manual tasks for extended periods.
  • Lift, push, pull, and move materials (heavy lifting required).
  • Work in a manufacturing environment that may involve noise, temperature variations, and exposure to chemicals/hazardous materials (with appropriate PPE and controls).
  • Use of PPE is mandatory.
  • Shift work may be required depending on production needs.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work with advanced high-performance materials in a structured manufacturing environment.
  • Strong focus on safety, training, and continuous improvement.
  • Clear processes and support for skill development.
  • Competitive pay and benefits package (details provided during the hiring process).

Equal Opportunity Employer We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

job.title: Commercial Banking UAT Tester
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Commercial Credit Servicing Testing Analyst to provide dedicated testing support for system conversions, platform upgrades, business process enhancements, automation initiatives, and production releases impacting Commercial Credit Servicing.
This role is responsible for preparing and executing test scripts, documenting defects, validating system functionality, and ensuring business requirements are met prior to production implementation. The analyst will collaborate with Business Analysts, Technology teams, Product Owners, and Operational SMEs to support successful delivery of enhancements, upgrades, conversions, automation initiatives, and releases.

Core Responsibilities
• Execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT), functional testing, regression testing, and validation testing activities.
• Prepare, maintain, and update test scripts, test scenarios, test data, and testing documentation.
• Review business requirements, user stories, process documentation, and acceptance criteria to ensure adequate test coverage.
• Perform end-to-end testing across multiple servicing platforms and applications.
• Document, track, and retest defects through resolution while maintaining appropriate supporting documentation.
• Validate that system enhancements, conversions, upgrades, and process changes meet documented business requirements.
• Support release readiness activities by confirming testing results and identifying potential implementation risks.
• Assist with testing schedules, status reporting, and execution progress updates.
• Participate in project meetings, defect triage sessions, and testing reviews with cross-functional stakeholders.
• Execute post-release validation activities to confirm successful production implementations.
• Maintain testing evidence and documentation in accordance with project governance and audit requirements.
• Identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, standardization, and quality assurance practices.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Minimum 1 year of experience in testing, quality assurance, business operations, banking operations, or a related discipline.
• Minimum 1 year of Commercial Banking, Commercial Servicing, Loan Operations, or Financial Services experience.
• Experience executing structured test cases and documenting test results.
• Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) or Quality Assurance (QA) activities.
• Experience writing business UAT test cases based on business requirements and/or executing test cases in JIRA/Xray.
• Experience working with JIRA, Azure DevOps, Quality Center, or similar testing and defect management tools.
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify issues, inconsistencies, and defects.
• Ability to manage multiple testing efforts simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and SharePoint.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Commercial Banking experience, preferably within Commercial Credit Servicing environments.
• Familiarity with Loan IQ.
• Familiarity with Salesforce, nCino, SharePoint, or other enterprise servicing platforms.
• Experience supporting system conversions, platform upgrades, or transformation initiatives.
• Experience with business and system test case execution.

Work Details
• Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
• Testing scope includes system conversions, platform upgrades, business process enhancements, automation initiatives, regulatory and compliance changes, and production defect remediation.

job.title: Mechanical Engineer– Sheet Metal & Structural Design
job.description:
Mechanical Engineer – Structural & Sheet Metal Design

Tulsa, OK | Full-Time | Monday–Friday | Primarily On-Site with Remote Flexibility

$100,000–$150,000, depending on experience

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship.

Design It. Calculate It. See It Built.

We're partnering with an established industrial manufacturer seeking a Mechanical Engineer to design custom industrial equipment, structural assemblies, sheet metal components, and fabricated systems.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys taking a design from concept and engineering calculations through fabrication and production. You'll work closely with manufacturing and fabrication teams to develop equipment and structures that are not only structurally sound, but practical to build.

The ideal candidate has experience with structural steel, sheet metal, fabricated equipment, equipment supports, frames, skids, platforms, or similar industrial applications.

A PE license is not required at the time of hire, but candidates must have the education and professional experience necessary to pursue PE licensure in the future.

What You'll Do

Mechanical & Structural Design

  • Design custom industrial equipment, frames, supports, platforms, enclosures, and fabricated assemblies.

  • Design with structural steel, sheet metal, and other fabricated materials.

  • Develop 3D models, engineering drawings, and fabrication documentation.

  • Select appropriate materials, structural members, fasteners, welds, hardware, and components.

  • Account for equipment loads, mounting requirements, lifting, transportation, and operating conditions.

  • Evaluate how individual components and assemblies work together within the overall equipment design.

  • Maintain accurate models, drawings, BOMs, and engineering documentation.

Engineering Calculations & Analysis

  • Perform engineering and structural calculations to validate equipment and fabricated structures.

  • Evaluate applicable wind, snow, rain, dead, live, equipment, lifting, transportation, and operating loads.

  • Determine appropriate material thicknesses, structural members, connections, and support arrangements.

  • Evaluate frames, skids, platforms, equipment supports, mounting points, and similar structures.

  • Identify potential design issues and apply sound engineering judgment before designs reach production.

  • Use appropriate engineering and analysis tools to validate designs.

  • Document calculations and engineering decisions supporting the final design.

CAD & Engineering Documentation

  • Create detailed 3D CAD models and production-ready engineering drawings.

  • Develop drawings communicating dimensions, materials, tolerances, weld requirements, and fabrication details.

  • Produce documentation suitable for structural steel, sheet metal, welding, machining, and assembly.

  • Use CAD and engineering software to support mechanical and structural design.

  • Experience with AutoCAD, Inventor, SolidWorks, Advance Steel, or similar software is valuable.

  • Maintain accurate revisions, drawings, models, BOMs, and engineering records.

Manufacturing & Fabrication Support

  • Work directly with manufacturing and fabrication teams throughout the design process.

  • Apply design-for-manufacturing principles to create practical, buildable designs.

  • Consider welding, forming, press brakes, cutting, machining, and other fabrication processes when developing designs.

  • Provide engineering support when production encounters design or fabrication challenges.

  • Recommend design changes that improve manufacturability, quality, cost, and efficiency.

  • Support projects from engineering through fabrication, assembly, testing, and completion.

Cross-Functional Engineering

  • Work with Engineering, Project Management, Purchasing, Manufacturing, and other teams throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Translate customer requirements and project specifications into practical engineering solutions.

  • Communicate technical requirements clearly to engineering and manufacturing personnel.

  • Support engineering changes and revisions as project requirements evolve.

  • Provide technical input related to quality, cost, schedule, manufacturability, and performance.

  • Take ownership of assigned engineering projects and drive designs through completion.

Codes & Engineering Standards

  • Apply applicable engineering, structural, fabrication, and safety standards to designs.

  • Develop designs that meet customer requirements and project specifications.

  • Familiarity with IBC, AISC, AWS, OSHA, or similar standards is beneficial.

  • Review designs for structural integrity, safety, and manufacturability before release.

  • Maintain supporting calculations and engineering documentation.

  • Stay current with applicable engineering standards and requirements.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.

  • Professional experience designing mechanical equipment, fabricated structures, structural assemblies, or industrial products.

  • Experience with structural steel, sheet metal, fabricated equipment, or similar materials/applications.

  • Strong understanding of engineering calculations and structural loading.

  • Ability to develop and interpret detailed engineering and fabrication drawings.

  • Strong engineering judgment and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work effectively with manufacturing, fabrication, and cross-functional teams.

  • Eligible to pursue a Professional Engineer (PE) license in the future.

Experience That Can Translate Well

We're open to engineers coming from a variety of backgrounds, including:

  • Structural steel design

  • Industrial equipment design

  • Custom machinery

  • Heavy manufacturing

  • Metal fabrication

  • Equipment frames and supports

  • Industrial skids

  • Platforms and structural assemblies

  • Sheet metal equipment and enclosures

  • Process equipment

  • Engineered-to-order manufacturing

  • Industrial facilities or infrastructure

You do not need to have worked in this exact industry. We're most interested in engineers who understand how to design structures or equipment that can withstand real-world loads and can work effectively with the people who build them.

PE Pathway

An active PE license is not required for this position.

The ideal candidate will have an engineering degree and professional experience that makes them eligible to pursue PE licensure in the future.

A current PE license is a plus, but it is not a requirement for consideration.

Why This Role

  • Design real industrial equipment and structures that move from your drawings into production.

  • Work directly with engineers, fabricators, welders, machinists, and manufacturing teams.

  • Take ownership of projects from concept through fabrication and completion.

  • Apply engineering calculations to practical, real-world design challenges.

  • Work with structural steel, sheet metal, fabricated assemblies, and custom equipment.

  • Have the opportunity to grow technically and pursue PE licensure.

  • Join an established organization offering long-term career growth.

Work Environment

This position is primarily office-based with regular interaction throughout an active manufacturing facility. You'll work closely with engineering, fabrication, production, and operations teams while supporting projects from design through fabrication and assembly.

PPE is required when entering designated production areas. The manufacturing environment includes typical industrial conditions such as machinery, welding and fabrication activities, elevated noise, dust, and varying temperatures.

job.description:
Cash Accountant – Manufacturing

Tulsa, OK | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. | On-Site

Pay & Benefits

Compensation: $70,000–$85,000, depending on experience
Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Retirement Planning: 401(k) with company match
Time Away: Paid time off, holidays, and personal days
Additional Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Bonus Incentive Program
Coverage: Life and disability insurance
Work Environment: Established manufacturing company with a stable weekday schedule and a collaborative accounting team

About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Cash Accountant to take ownership of daily cash activity, bank reconciliations, electronic payments, and cash-related accounting processes for an established manufacturing organization.

This is a great opportunity for an accountant who enjoys working with numbers, banking activity, reconciliations, and financial accuracy and wants a role with visibility across the organization. You’ll work closely with Accounting, AP, AR, Purchasing, Sales, and banking partners while helping ensure the company’s cash position and financial records remain accurate and well controlled.

If you’re organized, analytical, comfortable working independently, and have experience with cash accounting, treasury functions, or general ledger accounting, this could be a strong fit.

Key Responsibilities

Cash Management & Banking:

  • Monitor daily cash balances across company bank accounts and maintain accurate cash position reporting

  • Process and monitor ACH payments, wire transfers, positive pay, and other electronic banking transactions

  • Maintain banking records, account documentation, and authorized signer information

Bank Reconciliations & Accounting:

  • Perform daily, weekly, and monthly bank reconciliations, researching and resolving discrepancies

  • Prepare cash-related journal entries and ensure transactions are accurately recorded in the general ledger

  • Support month-end and year-end close through reconciliations, schedules, and supporting documentation

Cash Forecasting & Financial Planning:

  • Prepare short-term cash forecasts and assist with longer-term cash flow planning

  • Monitor upcoming receipts and disbursements to help maintain appropriate cash availability

  • Review bank fees and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary costs

AP/AR Coordination:

  • Work with Accounts Receivable on cash application and resolution of unapplied cash

  • Coordinate with Accounts Payable regarding payment timing and cash requirements

  • Partner with internal departments to resolve cash-related questions and discrepancies

Controls, Compliance & Process Improvement:

  • Help maintain effective controls over cash receipts, payments, and banking activity

  • Assist with internal and external audit requests related to cash and treasury accounts

  • Identify opportunities to improve, standardize, or automate cash-management processes

Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Experience:

  • 3–5 years of accounting experience, preferably with exposure to cash accounting, treasury, or general ledger functions

  • Experience with bank reconciliations and cash management is strongly preferred

Technical Skills:

  • Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial controls

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office

  • Experience with an ERP system and online banking platforms is a plus

Work Style:

  • Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines

  • Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with other departments

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail

Core Strengths:

  • Accurate and analytical

  • Dependable and organized

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfortable handling confidential financial information

Work Environment

This position is primarily office-based within a manufacturing environment and involves regular interaction with accounting and operational teams. The role requires extended periods working at a computer, with occasional movement throughout the office and manufacturing facility. Employees entering the shop environment are required to wear appropriate PPE.

We're seeking an experienced R&D Engineer with direct heat exchanger experience to support the development, application, and continuous improvement of engineered thermal equipment. This role combines hands-on engineering with product development, customer application support, and manufacturing collaboration, making it ideal for someone who understands both heat transfer technology and how engineered products are actually built.

What You'll Own

Thermal & Application Engineering

  • Provide technical expertise for air-cooled heat exchangers, dry coolers, CRAHs, and related thermal systems.

  • Support equipment selection, sizing, configuration, and customization based on customer requirements.

  • Apply thermodynamics, heat transfer, and air/fluid dynamics principles to equipment applications.

  • Develop and maintain selection tools, application methods, and technical documentation.

  • Support Sales and Business Development with technical product and application guidance.

  • Serve as a technical resource for customers, consultants, contractors, and internal teams.

Product Development

  • Own assigned products through development, launch, manufacturing release, and ongoing improvement.

  • Translate customer feedback, market requirements, and operational needs into product requirements.

  • Establish product specifications, performance targets, and improvement priorities.

  • Evaluate opportunities to improve product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost.

  • Support new product development and enhancements to existing equipment.

  • Coordinate technical requirements and readiness activities prior to production release.

Manufacturing & Engineering Support

  • Work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain throughout product development.

  • Review designs and changes for manufacturability, production feasibility, and cost effectiveness.

  • Identify and resolve product-readiness issues before they impact production.

  • Support the transition of new and modified products into manufacturing.

  • Incorporate manufacturing feedback and field experience into product improvements.

  • Support product change management and continuous improvement activities.

Product Strategy & Improvement

  • Analyze customer feedback, product performance, market information, and competitive data.

  • Identify opportunities for new products, product enhancements, and process improvements.

  • Help establish product priorities, performance goals, and development roadmaps.

  • Balance customization, standardization, cost, quality, and delivery requirements.

  • Evaluate new technologies and engineering methods that may improve product performance.

  • Support applicable product approvals and certifications, including UL, CE, EMC, and other requirements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Engineering, R&D, Manufacturing, Sales, Supply Chain, Quality, and customer teams.

  • Translate technical requirements into clear engineering and development priorities.

  • Participate in design reviews, product development meetings, and release activities.

  • Provide technical guidance when product or application issues arise.

  • Communicate engineering concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Help resolve customer, manufacturing, and product-performance challenges.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of engineering experience involving heat exchangers, thermal equipment, HVAC systems, or related cooling technology

Direct heat exchanger experience is required

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a related engineering discipline

Strong understanding of thermodynamics, heat transfer, and air/fluid dynamics

Experience with product development, engineering release processes, or product-line support in a manufacturing environment

Strong understanding of manufacturability, production readiness, and practical engineering trade-offs

Experience with thermal modeling, equipment selection software, and CAD tools

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills

Ability to work effectively with Engineering, Manufacturing, Sales, Supply Chain, Quality, and customer teams

Ideal Industry Background

We're especially interested in professionals with experience in:

  • Air-Cooled Heat Exchangers

  • Dry Coolers

  • CRAH Systems

  • Industrial Cooling Equipment

  • HVAC & Thermal Equipment

  • Heat Transfer Equipment

  • Mission-Critical Cooling

  • Process Cooling

  • Custom-Engineered Equipment

Work Environment

This position is based in an active industrial manufacturing environment that may include noise, dust, dirt, metal particles, machinery, welding, and other typical fabrication conditions.

Regular time on the production floor is required. Appropriate PPE, including hearing protection, safety glasses, and OSHA-compliant safety footwear, is required in designated areas. The role may require extended periods of standing and walking, along with occasional climbing, bending, kneeling, stooping, and lifting or moving materials up to approximately 50 pounds.

Schedule & Travel

Schedule: Monday–Thursday, 5:00 AM–3:30 PM

Occasional evening or weekend work may be required based on business needs.

Travel: No travel required.

job.title: Customer Support
job.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a customer-focused Customer Support Representative to provide accurate, timely, and efficient support to members, clients, providers, sales representatives, and internal/external business partners.

This position handles a variety of customer inquiries ranging from routine to complex and requires strong problem-solving, communication, and multitasking skills. The ideal candidate has experience working in a fast-paced customer service environment and is comfortable navigating multiple systems while assisting customers.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Service & Support

  • Respond to routine and complex customer inquiries via telephone, email, internet, and other communication channels.
  • Assist members, clients, providers, sales representatives, and internal/external business partners.
  • Research customer questions, issues, and complaints and determine appropriate resolutions.
  • Handle situations that may not have a standard or "cookie-cutter " solution.
  • Ask appropriate questions to identify customer needs and provide accurate solutions.
  • Educate customers and prospective customers on available products, services, solutions, and benefits.
  • Maintain established customer service and support-level standards.
  • Accurately document customer interactions, resolutions, and agreements.

Account, Order & Transaction Support

Depending on the assigned line of business, responsibilities may include:

  • Providing information regarding prescriptions, plans, products, services, and procedures.
  • Assisting with online purchasing and e-commerce inquiries.
  • Processing payments and payment collections.
  • Verifying customer or member eligibility.
  • Providing order status, shipping status, and stock availability information.
  • Completing required documentation, letters, and forms.
  • Supporting customer order inquiries from Sales Representatives.
  • Serving as a point of contact for Sales Representatives on non-order-related inquiries.
  • Processing claims based on business needs and workflow.
  • Performing quality assurance testing for company software.

Issue Resolution & Business Support

  • Identify customer trends and communicate findings to appropriate business partners and leadership.
  • Recommend potential corrections, process improvements, or solutions based on customer feedback.
  • Escalate situations that may have a broader organizational impact.
  • Remain current on customer service policies, procedures, products, services, and solutions.
  • Apply appropriate discretion and judgment when following customer and call-handling guidelines.
  • Balance customer service, transaction processing, research, and documentation in a fast-paced environment.
  • Depending on the line of business, attend benefit fairs, open enrollment meetings, or client meetings to provide information to attendees.
  • Occasional overnight travel may be required depending on the assignment.

Qualifications

  • 1–2 years of customer service experience handling moderate to complex customer inquiries.
  • Experience may come from a call center, insurance, manufacturing, software, telecommunications, retail, eyewear, or similar customer-facing environment.
  • Ability to work various shifts, potentially including weekends, holidays, and/or overnight hours.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
  • Strong internet knowledge, including basic browser settings.
  • Ability to navigate and work within multiple software applications simultaneously.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal and rapport-building abilities.
  • Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities while remaining available for incoming calls and inquiries.
  • Ability to accurately document customer situations and prepare written correspondence.
  • Ability to listen, process transactions, document information, and interact with customers simultaneously.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion when resolving customer issues.

Additional Requirements

  • If the position acts as a third-party administrator for payment processing, candidates may be subject to a credit check.
  • Candidates must be able to meet the required internet and home-network specifications for remote work.

Remote Work & Technical Requirements

Equipment Provided:

  • Windows 10 computer
  • Client Core i5-7500 processor or equivalent provided equipment
  • 16 GB memory
  • 256 GB solid-state hard drive
  • Wired headset
  • Wired connection cable

Candidate Requirements:

  • Router/modem is not provided.
  • A wired connection to the router/modem is required.
  • Minimum download speed: 50 Mbps per user on the home network.
  • Minimum upload speed: 10 Mbps per user on the home network.
  • Loaded latency: Less than 150 ms.

job.title: CNC Machinist
job.description:
Description:
2nd Shift 3pm - 11pm
3rd Shift 11pm - 7am
Overtime when required*

Position Overview:
We are seeking a skilled Machinist to join our team. The Machinist will use blueprints, sketches, or computer-aided design (CAD) and manufacturing files to produce precision metal parts. This role involves setting up and operating computer-controlled and manual equipment with a focus on accuracy, safety, and production efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Review blueprints, drawings, and technical documents to understand specifications and requirements.

  • Plan machining activities and sequence of operations to meet production goals.

  • Measure, mark, and prepare materials for cutting or shaping.

  • Set up and operate appropriate machines such as lathes and milling machines.

  • Inspect and measure finished products to ensure quality and accuracy to specifications.

  • Maintain detailed records of production output, defects, and machine maintenance.

  • Perform regular machine maintenance and make minor repairs as needed.

  • Familiarity with manual, semi-automated, and automated tools and equipment.

  • Proficient in reading and interpreting blueprints, schematics, and technical manuals.

  • Skilled in the use of precision measurement tools such as calipers, micrometers, and gauges.

  • Strong understanding of metal properties and machining processes.

  • Ability to perform accurate part inspections and quality checks.

  • Strong math and analytical skills.

  • Physical stamina and strength to lift and handle heavy materials.

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; vocational training or apprenticeship preferred.

Work Environment:

  • Industrial or manufacturing setting.

  • Requires standing for extended periods and manual handling of materials.

  • Use of personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.

If you're a detail-oriented Machinist with a passion for precision and craftsmanship, we'd love to hear from you!

job.title: Principal Engineer – Electrical & Controls
job.description:
Principal Engineer – Electrical & Controls

Tulsa, OK | Full-Time | Monday–Friday | Primarily On-Site with Remote Flexibility

$120,000–$150,000, depending on experience

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship.

Be the Technical Authority Behind Complex Industrial Electrical Systems.

We're partnering with an established industrial manufacturer seeking a Principal Engineer to provide senior technical leadership for electrical and controls systems used in custom-engineered equipment.

This is a high-level, hands-on engineering role for someone who has developed deep expertise in industrial electrical systems and can serve as the technical resource for complex design decisions, customer requirements, engineering standards, and difficult technical problems.

You'll work across Engineering, Applications, Estimating, Project Management, Manufacturing, Quality, and Operations to evaluate requirements, review designs, solve complex electrical and controls challenges, and establish engineering practices that improve quality and consistency.

This is an opportunity for an experienced engineer who wants to have significant technical influence without leaving engineering for a management role.

What You'll Do

Electrical & Controls Engineering

  • Provide senior technical expertise for the design and integration of industrial electrical and control systems

  • Evaluate customer specifications, project requirements, and applicable standards to determine appropriate electrical and controls solutions

  • Review complex electrical schematics, control drawings, and system designs for technical accuracy and compliance

  • Provide technical direction on power distribution, protection and control, control panels, automation, and electrical equipment integration

  • Identify technical risks and design issues early and recommend practical solutions

  • Support complex troubleshooting, equipment integration, testing, and commissioning activities

Industrial Power & Electrical Systems

  • Apply advanced knowledge of industrial power distribution and electrical systems

  • Provide technical guidance involving electrical distribution, protection, motor systems, transformers, switchgear, and related equipment

  • Evaluate electrical protection and control requirements for industrial applications

  • Support the integration of electrical equipment with industrial controls and automation systems

  • Assist engineering teams with technically complex electrical design decisions

  • Evaluate new technologies and engineering approaches that can improve system performance, reliability, and manufacturability

Engineering Standards & Design Quality

  • Establish and maintain engineering standards, design practices, and technical guidelines

  • Develop standardized design tools, templates, and review processes

  • Review engineering designs and documentation prior to production release

  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering efficiency, consistency, and repeatability

  • Investigate design issues and support root-cause and corrective-action efforts

  • Help ensure engineering practices remain aligned with customer requirements and applicable industry standards

Codes, Standards & Compliance

  • Ensure electrical and controls designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and customer specifications

  • Apply requirements associated with NEC / NFPA 70

  • Apply NFPA 79 requirements where applicable

  • Maintain familiarity with UL 508A requirements for industrial control panels

  • Review designs for electrical safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance

  • Stay current with changes to applicable electrical and industrial standards

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a technical resource to Engineering, Applications, Estimating, Project Management, Manufacturing, Quality, and Operations

  • Help teams resolve complex electrical and controls issues throughout the project lifecycle

  • Review technical requirements and help identify potential design or execution risks

  • Balance engineering requirements with cost, manufacturability, schedule, quality, and customer expectations

  • Communicate technical recommendations clearly to both engineering and non-engineering personnel

‍ Mentorship & Engineering Development

  • Mentor engineers and designers on complex electrical and controls applications

  • Provide technical feedback and guidance to strengthen engineering capabilities

  • Help establish consistent engineering practices across the organization

  • Participate in design reviews and technical problem-solving sessions

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives within Engineering and Manufacturing

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline

Significant professional experience designing and supporting industrial electrical and/or controls systems

Strong experience with industrial electrical systems and power distribution

Ability to independently evaluate and review complex electrical designs

Strong understanding of electrical schematics, control drawings, power distribution, protection, and electrical equipment

Working knowledge of NEC, NFPA, UL, and other applicable electrical standards

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and technical problem-solving abilities

Ability to provide technical direction and make sound engineering decisions independently

Strong communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, manufacturing, project management, and operations

Experience That Stands Out

We're especially interested in engineers with backgrounds in:

  • Industrial Electrical Engineering

  • Electrical Power Distribution

  • Industrial Controls & Automation

  • Protection & Control Systems

  • Medium-Voltage Electrical Systems

  • Custom-Engineered Equipment

  • Industrial Manufacturing

  • Electrical Equipment Integration

  • Control Panel Design

  • Engineered-to-Order Equipment

Additional experience with PLC systems, VFDs, instrumentation, industrial networking, commissioning, or equipment startup is valuable.

Certification

UL 508A Manufacturer Technical Representative (MTR) certification is required or must be obtained within 12 months of employment.

A Professional Engineer (PE) license is preferred.

Why This Role

  • Serve as a senior technical authority without moving into a traditional management position

  • Influence electrical and controls engineering standards across the organization

  • Work on custom-engineered industrial equipment and complex electrical systems

  • Have visibility across Engineering, Manufacturing, Project Management, Quality, and Operations

  • Solve challenging technical problems from initial design through production and startup

  • Mentor engineers while remaining deeply involved in the technical work

  • Join an established organization offering long-term career growth

Work Environment

This position is based in an industrial manufacturing environment with regular interaction between Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Operations. The role combines engineering and technical design work with exposure to an active production facility and custom-engineered equipment.

PPE is required when entering designated production areas. The manufacturing environment may include machinery, electrical equipment, fabrication activities, elevated noise, dust, and varying temperatures.

Compensation & Benefits

$120,000–$150,000 depending on experience

Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

401(k) with Company Match

Paid Vacation, Personal Time & Holidays

Life & Disability Insurance

Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

job.title: Electrical Engineer – Power Distribution & Industrial Systems
job.description:
Electrical Engineer – Power Distribution & Industrial Systems

Tulsa, OK | Full-Time | Monday–Friday | Primarily On-Site with Remote Flexibility

Salary: $100,000–$130,000 DOE

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship.

Design the Electrical Infrastructure Behind Custom Industrial Equipment.

We're partnering with an established industrial manufacturer seeking an Electrical Engineer with strong experience in electrical power distribution and industrial electrical systems.

This engineer will be responsible for designing and supporting electrical systems used in custom-engineered industrial equipment and facilities. You'll work closely with mechanical engineering, manufacturing, project management, and production teams to develop electrical solutions from initial design through fabrication, testing, installation, and startup.

This is a hands-on engineering opportunity for someone who enjoys solving real-world electrical problems and seeing their designs move from drawings to completed equipment.

What You'll Do

Electrical Distribution & System Design

  • Design and develop electrical power distribution systems for industrial equipment and applications
  • Develop electrical schematics, one-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, and distribution drawings
  • Size and select transformers, switchgear, disconnects, breakers, motor starters, VFDs, and other electrical components
  • Perform electrical calculations related to load requirements, voltage drop, short-circuit current, and system capacity
  • Design systems in accordance with applicable NEC, NFPA, UL, and industry standards
  • Review electrical designs for safety, reliability, performance, and manufacturability

Engineering & Project Support

  • Develop and maintain electrical drawings, BOMs, specifications, and other engineering documentation
  • Review customer requirements and project specifications and translate them into practical electrical designs
  • Coordinate electrical engineering activities with mechanical engineering, manufacturing, purchasing, and project teams
  • Participate in design reviews and provide technical input throughout project execution
  • Support engineering changes and continuous improvement initiatives

job.title: Production Technician II - 2nd Shift
job.description:
Production Operator – Dyneema Manufacturing

Location: Mesa, AZ Employment Type: Full-time

Manufacturing experience is required.

Job Overview

We are hiring a Production Operator to join our manufacturing team in Mesa. This is a hands-on role focused on the safe and efficient production of high-performance Dyneema products. You will set up, operate, monitor, and maintain production equipment while ensuring quality, accuracy, and strict adherence to safety and security standards.

This position is ideal for candidates with solid manufacturing experience who take pride in precise work, follow procedures carefully, and contribute to continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Safety, Health, Environment (SHE) & Security

  • Follow all SHE and Security policies, procedures, and site-specific requirements.
  • Address unsafe behaviors and immediately report incidents, near misses, or observed risks.
  • Handle hazardous materials and waste safely, including proper documentation, inspection, and internal transport when required.
  • Protect company intellectual property and follow all security protocols (including restrictions on personal devices).

Production & Equipment Operation

  • Set up, operate, adjust, and clean production equipment according to work instructions and standard operating procedures.
  • Run equipment safely and efficiently to meet quality and production targets.
  • Monitor process conditions and make approved adjustments within specified limits.
  • Perform minor preventative maintenance.
  • Move raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods using pallet jacks, overhead cranes, and other material-handling equipment.
  • Operate forklifts and overhead cranes as needed.

Quality Control & Documentation

  • Conduct in-process quality checks and prepare samples for offline testing.
  • Accurately record raw materials, intermediates, and finished products in computer systems and tracking tools.
  • Maintain complete and accurate production and quality records.
  • Identify and report any issues that could affect product quality, packaging, efficiency, or safety.

Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

  • Troubleshoot equipment, setup, and process issues and recommend practical solutions.
  • Participate in near-miss investigations, root cause analysis (RCA), and job safety analyses (JSA).
  • Contribute to SHE, Quality, or other improvement teams.
  • Support Manufacturing Excellence initiatives by following standardized work processes.
  • Complete and maintain all required training.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Manufacturing experience is mandatory.

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • At least 1 year of manufacturing experience (textile, composites, or similar production environment strongly preferred) or equivalent military technical experience/training.
  • Knowledge of safety procedures and ability to follow detailed work instructions and SOPs.
  • Ability to perform basic math and solve routine problems.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to detect defects or process issues.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Basic computer skills (Microsoft Word and data entry systems).
  • Ability to operate forklifts and overhead cranes (certification preferred or willingness to obtain).
  • Ability to perform manual material handling and heavy lifting.
  • Mechanical aptitude, including equipment setup and assembly.
  • Ability to read gauges, dials, meters, and controllers.
  • Willingness to work with hazardous materials under proper controls and procedures.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and consistently meet production and quality standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in continuous or batch manufacturing environments.
  • Existing forklift and/or overhead crane certification.
  • Experience with process troubleshooting and continuous improvement activities.
  • Familiarity with quality systems and production record-keeping.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

  • Prolonged standing, walking, and repetitive manual tasks.
  • Regular lifting, pushing, pulling, and moving of materials (heavy lifting required).
  • Manufacturing environment that may include noise, temperature variations, and exposure to chemicals/hazardous materials (appropriate PPE provided and required).
  • Shift work may be required based on production needs.

job.title: HR Business Partner
job.description:
ROLE:
The HR business partner (HRBP) position is responsible for aligning business objectives with employees and management in designated business units. The position serves as a consultant to management on human resource-related issues. The successful HRBP acts as an employee champion and change agent. The role assesses and anticipates HR-related needs especially focused on the areas of employee retention and engagement. Communicating needs proactively with our HR department and business management, the HRBP seeks to develop integrated solutions. The position formulates partnerships across the HR function to deliver value-added service to management and employees that reflects the business objectives of the organization. The HRBP maintains an effective level of business literacy about the business unit's financial position, its midrange plans, its culture and its competition.

TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Conducts weekly meetings with respective business units.
  • Consults with line management, providing HR guidance when appropriate.
  • Analyzes trends and metrics in partnership with the HR group to develop solutions, programs and policies.
  • Manages and resolves complex employee relations issues. Conducts effective, thorough and objective investigations.
  • Maintains in-depth knowledge of legal requirements related to day-to-day management of employees, reducing legal risks and ensuring regulatory compliance. Partners with the legal department as needed/required.
  • Provides day-to-day performance management guidance to line management (e.g., coaching, counseling, career development, disciplinary actions).
  • Works closely with management and employees to improve work relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.
  • Provides HR policy guidance and interpretation.
  • Develops letters for new hires, promotions and transfers.
  • Manages the employee off-boarding process.
  • Provides guidance and input on business unit restructures, workforce planning and succession planning.
  • Identifies training needs for business units and individual executive coaching needs.
  • Participates in evaluation and monitoring of training programs to ensure success. Follows up to ensure training objectives are met.
  • Drive other special projects where needed.

COMPETENCIES
  1. Business Acumen.
  2. Communication.
  3. Consultation.
  4. Ethical Practice.
  5. Global & Cultural Awareness.
  6. HR Expertise.
  7. Relationship Management.

Location: Rochester, NY

Summary: Nesco Resource is seeking a detail-oriented Quality Assurance Technician to support manufacturing quality operations in Rochester, NY. This role is ideal for individuals with manufacturing experience who have strong computer skills and a keen eye for detail. The Quality Assurance Technician will assist with inspecting parts, reviewing documentation, and supporting process audits to ensure products meet established quality standards.

This opportunity is open to candidates with some QA experience or individuals with a manufacturing background who are interested in transitioning into quality assurance. If you are organized, comfortable working with computers, and capable of following detailed procedures, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Accounting & Billing Administrator
job.description:
Accounting & Billing Administrator (Temp)
Job Overview
The Accounting & Billing Administrator is responsible for managing key aspects of the company’s accounts payable, accounts receivable, and billing functions. This position oversees the monthly billing cycle, customer invoicing, payment tracking, cash application, and collection activities while ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with established accounting procedures.

Location: Albany, NY
Compensation: $18 - $21/hr.
Essential Responsibilities and Duties

  • Manage the full monthly billing cycle for underwriting accounts, ensuring accurate and timely invoicing, payment processing, and cash application.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for business clients regarding billing procedures, payment status, account questions, and discrepancies.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex billing and accounts receivable issues in collaboration with sales, office staff, and clients.
  • Monitor outstanding accounts receivable and follow established collection procedures to ensure timely payment of customer balances.
  • Communicate professionally with clients regarding overdue balances while maintaining positive and productive business relationships.
  • Prepare and maintain accounts receivable aging reports, payment tracking reports, billing records, and other financial documentation to support the Controller’s reporting and decision-making.
  • Track underwriting sales activity and maintain commission and bonus reporting spreadsheets with a high degree of accuracy.
  • Assist with month-end close activities, account reconciliations, financial reporting, audits, and related accounting processes.
  • Perform other accounting and administrative duties as assigned by the Controller.
Qualifications and Skills
  • Associate degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Finance, Office Management, or a related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.
  • Previous experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, billing, accounting administration, or a related financial role preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while consistently meeting recurring monthly deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify billing discrepancies, determine appropriate solutions, and resolve issues collaboratively.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel, with the ability to use spreadsheets for tracking, reporting, reconciliation, and data management.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with the Controller and other departments.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling financial and customer information

job.description:
Title: Warehouse Associate I
Contract to Hire
Pay: $17.00
Schedule: M-F 6:00 AM - 2:30 PM

GENERAL DESCRIPTION: The Associate operates equipment to fulfill job function in one or more function of the department to be either shipping, receiving, inventory or production set up.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES/FUNCTIONS:
Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Complete safety training and follow all safety rules.
  • Safely operate forklift at all times.
  • Operate forklift to pull/receive inventory from/into specific locations in the warehouse
  • Pull/receive accurate count of product for each pick/receipt.
  • Responsible for reporting any product, equipment or forklift damage to the supervisor immediately.
  • May also provide support for production in the staging components.
  • Handle inventory individually by placing onto pallet(s) to complete shipment/receipt per work order/instructions.
  • Shrink wrap pallets to secure product using hand, shrink wrapper, or automated pallet wrapper.
  • Secure the load by bracing and blocking the product with pneumatic or small tools.
  • Alert respective Supervisor of any problems with orders being pulled, loaded or shipped.
  • For shipments, must follow the Process Sheet (i.e., what country the product is being shipped to, Job #, what product should be shipped, etc.) for each country.
  • Maintain assigned aisle in warehouse area for cleanliness and organization.
  • Comply with Company SOPs and Policies.
  • Participate in year-end inventory by helping with the counting of product and literature, working overtime if necessary.
  • Assist the front office in moving/delivering items when requested.
  • Assist other departments when requested.
  • Assist in replacement of racks and/or beams in warehouse.
  • Additional duties may be assigned as needed.
SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:
N/A

COMPETENCIES:
  • Attention to detail
  • Collaborative skills
  • Communication proficiency
  • Cooperation
  • Decision making
  • Focus on quality
  • Independence
  • Initiative
  • Problem solving
  • Results driven
  • Technical capacity
  • Time management
  • Verbal expression
  • Written expression

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS REQUIRED TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:
  • Knowledge of safe forklift operation or able to be trained to drive a forklift safely.
  • Ability to read and write English to read and follow procedures and equipment instructions.
  • Good math skills to measure and count product.
  • Accurate and legible record-keeping skills.
  • Be familiar with the use of Automated Process Control Inventory System (computer bar code system) as it pertains to the Shipping Department.
  • Knowledge of use of hand tools to ensure proper bracing of containers and/or trailers. (i.e., nail, hammer, air hose, etc.)
  • Sit-down Propane Forklift Experience
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:
  • Lift up to 50 pounds on a regular basis.
  • Good hand/eye coordination.
  • Safely fit into the forklift.
  • Able to use hand tools.
  • Manual dexterity skills to use hand tools.
  • Able to use controls (gears and mechanisms) to operate and drive forklift.
  • Sit, stand/remain seated and lift for long periods of time.
  • Bend, squat, kneel, balance, turn and stoop.
  • Reach forward and overhead.
EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE REQUIRED TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:
  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • 6 months to 2 years of work experience in a similar work environment.
  • Prior warehouse safety training preferred.

The Material Handling Coordinator is responsible for the physical and administrative tasks involved in the shipping, receiving, storing, and distributing of materials, parts, supplies, and equipment. Unpacks and checks goods received against purchase orders or invoices, maintains records of received goods, and rejects unsatisfactory items as necessary. Manage the process as needed.
May coordinate the functions of shipping, receiving, and/or inventory, possibly working with other departments to ensure customer satisfaction.
May conduct audits to monitor inventory level and to determine status of current orders and to forecast needs for future orders
Specialized knowledge generally of particular area, system or equipment.
May on occasion, do the job of a Process Specialist as a backup.

High School diploma or equivalent.
3 year of related experience
Thorough understanding of the principles and applications of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and ISO 9001.
Computer skills with competency using standard software packages (Word and Excel).
Experience in SAP or other inventory systems.
Good oral and written communication skills.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work independently and in a team environment.

job.title: Billing Administrator
job.description:
This role is ideal for someone who takes pride in accuracy, organization, and keeping financial processes running smoothly. As a Billing Administrator, you will play a meaningful role in ensuring invoices are prepared correctly, submitted on time, and fully aligned with client expectations and contractual requirements. You'll collaborate daily with Operations, Project Management, and Financial Controls, making this a great opportunity for someone who enjoys both independent work and cross-functional interaction.

This position offers stability, structured processes, and the ability to grow your skill set within billing, client platforms, and financial operations.

Prepare and track billing information using Microsoft Excel, Smartsheet, and similar tools
Create and submit invoices through a variety of client billing portals

What Makes This Role Appealing

Meaningful responsibility in supporting project success and revenue accuracy
A structured, supportive environment designed to help you succeed and grow

job.title: Production Assembler
job.description:
Job Title: Production Assembler
Location: Rochester, NY

Summary: Nesco Resource is seeking Production Assemblers to support HVAC equipment manufacturing in Rochester, NY. This hands-on position is responsible for assembling HVAC units and components using hand and power tools while following drawings, specifications, and quality standards. The ideal candidate has strong mechanical aptitude, is comfortable working with tools, and is looking for an opportunity to grow into a permanent manufacturing position.

Pay Rate:

  • Starting at $20.00/hour
    • Candidates with specific relevant experience may qualify for higher pay

Shift:

  • Monday – Thursday | 6:00 AM – 4:30 PM
  • Friday | 6:00 AM – 11:00 AM
    • Currently running some overtime
      • Optional Saturday overtime may be available

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assemble HVAC units, subassemblies, and components using hand and power tools
  • Read and follow work instructions, assembly drawings, blueprints, and specifications
  • Install mechanical and electrical components including wiring, motors, fans, coils, compressors, and controls
  • Inspect parts and completed assemblies to ensure quality standards are met
  • Perform functional testing and basic troubleshooting as required
  • Identify and report defective materials, equipment issues, or production concerns
  • Accurately complete production and quality documentation
  • Meet daily production goals while maintaining quality and efficiency

  • Participate in continuous improvement efforts to increase productivity and reduce waste
  • Follow all safety procedures and wear required PPE

Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred
  • Previous manufacturing or assembly experience preferred
  • HVAC manufacturing or sheet metal fabrication experience is a plus
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and experience using hand and power tools
  • Ability to read assembly instructions, basic blueprints, and measuring devices
  • Basic math and problem-solving skills
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Experience with pneumatic tools, torque tools, or measuring instruments is a plus
  • Forklift experience or certification is a plus but not required

Work Environment & Physical Requirements:

  • Fast-paced manufacturing and assembly environment
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, and reach for extended periods
  • Ability to frequently lift and carry up to 50 pounds

job.title: Material Expeditor
job.description:
Material Expeditor — Hybrid

Do not submit the same candidate to requisitions #22593 and #222596 — they are under the same manager.

Position Overview

The Material Expeditor is responsible for monitoring and coordinating the flow of materials and parts throughout the supply chain to ensure production schedules are met. The person will review production schedules, identify shortages or delays, communicate with suppliers, and take corrective action to keep material moving.

This is a hands-on supply chain/procurement role where strong communication, SAP experience, and the ability to work under tight deadlines are important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and material requirements to identify current or potential shortages.
  • Expedite materials, parts, and components to support production requirements.
  • Communicate with suppliers regarding delivery dates, shortages, delays, and material status.
  • Coordinate the routing and dispatching of materials and parts.
  • Arrange repairs or replacement of damaged materials when necessary.
  • Coordinate with internal transportation/logistics teams to move materials efficiently.
  • Track purchase orders and completed orders to ensure schedule commitments are met.
  • Prepare and maintain material status and progress reports.
  • Document material changes, substitutions, shortages, schedule changes, and other supply-chain issues.
  • Escalate critical shortages or delays to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Work cross-functionally with procurement, production, manufacturing, planning, engineering, logistics, and suppliers.
  • Use SAP and Microsoft Office to track, analyze, and communicate material status.
  • Resolve supplier and material issues quickly to prevent production interruptions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university.
  • 3–5 years of Material Expediting experience.
  • 3+ years of professional experience using SAP and Microsoft Office.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Procurement/commercial knowledge and business acumen.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Dual citizenship with another country is not permitted for this position.

Ideal Candidate

  • Material Expeditor
  • Material Planner
  • Supply Chain Analyst
  • Supply Chain Specialist
  • Procurement Specialist
  • Buyer/Planner
  • Production Planner
  • Material Coordinator
  • Supplier Management/Expediting Specialist

The best fit will have direct experience expediting materials in a manufacturing, aerospace, defense, automotive, or other production environment, particularly someone comfortable working in SAP and dealing directly with suppliers.

Important Logistics

  • Minimum 2 days onsite.
  • Must be willing to work up to 4 days onsite when required by the program.
  • Travel/driving to East Camden, AR and/or Lufkin, TX may be required during the assignment.

job.title: Project Manager/Delivery Lead - Kinaxis Maestro Demand Planning
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking an experienced Project Manager/Delivery Lead to lead the delivery of a Kinaxis Maestro Demand Planning implementation for its Optical Communications business. This role is responsible for driving execution across business, IT, SAP ECC, and vendor teams while enabling Agile ways of working throughout the implementation lifecycle.
The ideal candidate brings strong delivery leadership experience, a servant leadership mindset, and a proven track record leading enterprise implementations in manufacturing environments. This position emphasizes communication, stakeholder alignment, governance, financial tracking, issue resolution, and iterative execution within an Agile product delivery model.

Core Responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end delivery of the Kinaxis Maestro Demand Planning implementation using Agile, Scrum, and iterative product delivery practices.
• Serve as a servant leader by enabling collaboration, removing blockers, supporting decision-making, and driving accountability across cross-functional stakeholders.
• Manage delivery planning, governance reporting, status updates, RAID management, executive communications, and escalation management.
• Coordinate business, IT, SAP ECC, implementation partner, and vendor teams to ensure aligned execution across workstreams.
• Drive backlog and workflow management through Kanban-based delivery practices and support sprint and release planning activities.
• Track project financials, delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and key milestones.
• Support integration planning, data migration readiness, testing coordination, cutover execution, and go-live planning.
• Ensure adherence to SOX, regulatory, and enterprise governance requirements.
• Provide executive-level updates to senior leadership and maintain stakeholder engagement throughout the delivery lifecycle.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• 7+ years of experience leading enterprise technology implementations as a Project Manager, Delivery Lead, or similar role.
• Strong project leadership experience in communications, stakeholder management, problem resolution, governance and status reporting, executive communications, financial tracking, and vendor coordination.
• Experience leading teams in Agile/Scrum environments with strong knowledge of iterative and incremental delivery methodologies.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience working from a Kanban board.
• Scrum Master certification or PMI-ACP certification.
• Experience with SAP ECC implementations and SAP ECC platform landscapes.
• Experience delivering solutions involving integration, data migration, and cutover coordination.
• Knowledge of demand planning within a manufacturing environment.
• Knowledge of SOX, regulatory compliance, and structured enterprise governance practices.
• Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• PMP certification.
• Product Owner certification such as CSPO or PSPO.
• First-hand experience implementing Kinaxis Maestro Demand Planning.
• Experience implementing complex SAP ECC solutions.
• Hands-on experience with Planview AgilePlace.
• Experience presenting to and influencing senior leadership.

Work Details
• Contract role.
• Charlotte, NC preferred; New York preferred. Qualified remote candidates will also be considered.
• Minimum travel requirement of one trip per month to Charlotte, NC.
• Standard work schedule of 8:00 AM ET to 5:00 PM ET.
• Some weekend and after-hours work will be required during scheduled go-live events.

job.title: Warehouse Associate
job.description:
Job Title: Warehouse Associate
Location: Dallas, TX
Pay: $17.00 per hour
Shift: M-F 5:00 AM - 1:30 PM
 
GENERAL DESCRIPTION:  The Retail Management Associate operates equipment to fulfill job function in the pulling, labeling, and shipment of retail orders accurately and on time.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES/FUNCTIONS:
Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Complete safety training and follow all safety rules.
  • Safely operate forklift at all times.
  • Create and package combo kits using the shrink wrap machine, sealer, and heat tunnel according to established standards.
  • Printing barcodes and then attaching them to the product.
  • Operate forklift to pull/receive inventory from/into specific locations in the warehouse
  • Pull/receive accurate count of product for each pick/receipt.
  • Responsible for reporting any product, equipment or forklift damage to the supervisor immediately.
  • May also provide support for production in the staging components.
  • Handle inventory individually by repacking product back into original shipping containers, or new ones, placing onto pallet(s), and completing shipment/receipt per work order/instructions.
  • Shrink wrap pallets to secure products using hand, shrink wrapper, or automated pallet wrapper. 
  • Secure the load by bracing and blocking the product with pneumatic or small tools.
  • Alert respective Supervisor of any problems with orders being pulled, loaded or shipped.
  • Maintain area for cleanliness and organization.
  • Comply with Company SOPs and Policies.
  • Participate in year-end inventory by helping with the counting of product and literature, working overtime if necessary.
  • Assist other departments when requested.
  • Assist in replacement of racks and/or beams in warehouse.
  • Additional duties may be assigned as needed.
 
COMPETENCIES:
  • Attention to detail
  • Collaborative skills
  • Communication proficiency
  • Cooperation
  • Decision making
  • Focus on quality
  • Independence
  • Initiative
  • Problem solving
  • Results driven
  • Technical capacity
  • Time management
  • Verbal expression
  • Written expression

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS REQUIRED TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:
  • Knowledge of safe forklift operation or able to be trained to drive a forklift safely.
  • Ability to read and write English to read and follow procedures and equipment instructions.
  • Good math skills to measure and count product.
  • Accurate and legible record-keeping skills.
  • Be familiar with the use of Automated Process Control Inventory System (computer bar code system) as it pertains to the Shipping Department.
  • Knowledge of use of hand tools to ensure proper bracing of containers and/or trailers. (i.e., nail, hammer, air hose, etc.)
  • Sit-down Propane Forklift Experience
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:
  • Lift up to 50 pounds on a regular basis.
  • Good hand/eye coordination.
  • Safely fit into the forklift.
  • Able to use hand tools.
  • Manual dexterity skills to use hand tools.
  • Able to use controls (gears and mechanisms) to operate and drive forklift.
  • Sit, stand/remain seated and lift for long periods of time.
  • Bend, squat, kneel, balance, turn and stoop.
  • Reach forward and overhead.
  • Able to climb ladders.
EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE REQUIRED TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:

job.title: Solder
job.description:
Solder/Assembly l
Orlando
7AM-3:30PM

Duties:

  1. Advanced Soldering Techniques: Apply advanced soldering techniques to assemble high-precision frequency control devices, including oscillators, filters, and frequency synthesizers, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
  2. Component Placement and Calibration: Accurately place and calibrate electronic components, such as quartz crystals, surface acoustic wave (SAW) devices, and specialized frequency control ICs, according to engineering specifications and tight tolerances.
  3. Soldering Equipment Operation: Operate and maintain specialized soldering equipment, including reflow soldering systems and selective soldering machines, to achieve precise solder joint formation and minimize thermal impact on sensitive components.
  4. Fine-Pitch Soldering: Proficiently handle fine-pitch soldering of components with tight lead spacing, ensuring a high level of precision in assembly work.
  5. Quality Control: Implement stringent quality control measures, including visual inspections, solder joint analysis, and functional testing, to verify conformance to industry standards and product specifications.
  6. Rework and Repair: Perform skilled rework and repair tasks on frequency control devices, addressing any soldering defects or performance issues while maintaining the integrity of delicate components.
  7. Collaboration with Engineering: Collaborate closely with engineering teams to understand and implement design changes, improvements, and enhancements to the soldering and assembly processes.
  8. Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of soldering processes, calibration procedures, and quality control records, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and quality management systems.
  9. Continuous Improvement: Actively participate in continuous improvement initiatives, contributing insights and recommendations to enhance soldering processes, efficiency, and overall product quality.
  10. Adherence to Standards: Understands all aspects of Sn63 solder assembly including: Thru-hole components, Recognize J-STD-001 standard regarding materials, methods, and acceptance criteria for producing solder electrical and electronic assemblies.

job.description:
Nesco Resource is looking for candidates for a Dock Loader/Unloader/Sorter position we have available to start ASAP!! The Warehouse is located in Orlando, 32832.

POSITION AVAILABLE WITH QUICK START DATE!!

The position schedule is Sunday - Friday. Saturdays Off, plus 0-3 other rotating days OFF in the week.


2nd shift: 2pm-Finish $15


Hourly rate will be assessed on a week by week basis as follows:

If you Call out, are late, leave early from your shift, or Quit your rate will be $15/hr for the week.
