job.title: Data Warehouse & BI Engineer
job.description:
Overview
The Data Warehouse & BI Engineer supports Client’s manufacturing environment by designing, developing, and delivering data warehouse, reporting, and analytics solutions that improve operational visibility and support business decision-making.
This role is responsible for the full solution lifecycle, including requirements gathering, architecture and design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in data warehousing, SQL development, ETL, and reporting, and enjoys building scalable, reliable solutions that enable informed decisions across manufacturing and enterprise operations.

Core Responsibilities
• Lead the end-to-end delivery of data warehouse, reporting, and analytics solutions, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, implementation, and support.
• Design, develop, and maintain data warehouse and business intelligence solutions that support manufacturing and enterprise priorities.
• Partner with business stakeholders and technology teams to understand requirements, define solution approaches, and deliver reporting and analytics capabilities.
• Develop and maintain T-SQL procedures, functions, queries, and scripts to support data integration, reporting, and analytics needs.
• Design, build, and support ETL processes for the intake and transformation of data from manufacturing and enterprise systems.
• Research, analyze, and troubleshoot data issues, stored procedures, and associated SSRS or Power BI reports.
• Collaborate with database administration teams to assess server health, database performance, and query optimization opportunities, including indexing and query tuning.
• Develop and support data migration procedures and scripts for project and operational initiatives.
• Contribute to the ongoing evolution of data warehouse architecture, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with best practices.
• Maintain analytics and data warehouse code in version control and follow established SDLC standards.
• Support operationally critical work and project timelines, including global support needs when required.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
• 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and supporting Data Warehouse and Business Intelligence solutions.
• 5+ years of experience with Microsoft BI technologies, including SQL Server, SSRS, SSIS, and SSAS.
• Strong experience with T-SQL development, including stored procedures, functions, performance tuning, and query optimization.
• Experience developing data warehouse, ETL, and end-user reporting solutions, including Power BI or similar dashboard and reporting tools.
• Experience working within a Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) process.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Experience using Agile project methodologies.
• Experience supporting manufacturing or factory floor systems and processes.
• Familiarity with Camstar or other Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).
• Experience with manufacturing-related systems such as MES, CMMS, SPC, and OSI PI, including knowledge of their underlying data models.
• Knowledge of industry best practices in data warehousing, business intelligence architecture, and analytics delivery.
• Experience working with relational databases in Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle.
• Experience using TFS, GitLab, or similar source control platforms.
• Understanding of cubes and complex reporting or information models.
• Clear understanding of OLTP and OLAP systems.
• Experience supporting analytics or reporting solutions in a regulated or operationally sensitive environment.

Work Details
• Position may be based in New York or Charlotte, North Carolina, with a hybrid work model or regional proximity preferred.
• Travel requirement: 0% to 25%, including domestic and international travel.
• This position does not support immigration sponsorship.

Pay: $20–$27 per hour, depending on experience
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–3:30 PM

Employment Type: Direct Hire

Quality Inspector

We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Inspector to join a growing manufacturing team. This position is responsible for inspecting incoming materials, in-process components, and finished products to ensure they meet established specifications and quality standards.

The ideal candidate has manufacturing or quality inspection experience, strong attention to detail, and the ability to use precision measuring tools and read technical drawings. Qualifications

job.title: System Integration Lab Engineer
job.description:
Description:
The System Integration Lab Engineer provides hands on technical support and engineering expertise to Sikorsky's Flight Controls Autonomy & Electrical (FCA&E) organization. Reporting to the FCA&E Lab Lead, the incumbent will contribute to the design, development, integration, and verification of high fidelity hardware in the loop (HWIL) and closed loop test facilities and capabilities within the System Integration Laboratories (SILS). This role blends systems engineering, test bed design / operation, and collaborative problem solving in a fast paced, cross functional environment. The engineer will help ensure laboratory activities align with business objectives, program priorities, and Sikorsky technical standards while driving continuous improvement initiatives that increase lab productivity and capability.

looking for candidates with more schematic and experience designing the facilities/labs where tests will be conducted.
Not interested in electrical test engineers
Must have minimum 4+ years with Zuken

Core Responsibilities
•HWIL/Closed Loop Development: Assist the FCA&E Lab Lead in designing, building, integrating, and testing HWIL and closed loop configurations within the SILS, ensuring compliance with design specifications, safety standards, and Sikorsky engineering practices.
•Hardware Integration: Receive, stage, and integrate hardware from subsystem teams; manage interface control documents; and coordinate cross functional wiring, power, and data connections across system, segment, and supporting engineering groups.
•Technical Collaboration: Participate actively in technical interchange meetings, provide clear status updates, and contribute to the preparation of deliverables for internal and external customers.
•Risk & Issue Management: Track laboratory level risks and issues, maintain issue logs, and promptly elevate concerns to the FCA&E Lab Lead or program management while proposing mitigation actions.
•Metrics & Reporting: Capture key performance indicators (KPIs) for SILS activities, generate concise status reports, and assist in metrics dashboards that reflect progress, resource utilization, and test outcomes.
•Equipment & Facility Support: Help manage procurement of capital equipment, support facility modification projects, and assist with laboratory infrastructure planning (e.g., power distribution, network cabling, shielding, cooling).
•Logistics Management: Order, receive, and track parts and consumables required for lab activities; maintain accurate inventory records; and coordinate with vendors and internal supply chains to ensure timely availability of components.
•Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline lab processes, update work instructions, and adopt new tools or methodologies that enhance test efficiency and data quality.
•Documentation: Produce and maintain engineering documentation—including schematics, block diagrams, procedures, results, and lessons learned packages—in accordance with Sikorsky configuration control requirements.
•Design Tools: Develop detailed schematics and system block diagrams using industry standard tools such as Microsoft Visio, Mentor Graphics, Zuken, and Siemens NX/3DX.


Technical Skills:
•Proficiency with real time simulation tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, LabVIEW, NI VeriStand).
•Strong understanding of hardware integration, signal conditioning, power distribution, and data acquisition systems.
•Familiarity with aerospace standards and specifications (e.g., Arinc-429, MIL-STD-1553, DO 160, MIL STD 810, ARP 4754).
•Ability to create schematics and block diagrams using Visio, Mentor Graphics, Zuken, and 3DX.
•Experience managing parts logistics—ordering, receiving, inventory control, and vendor coordination

job.title: PCB Test & Repair Technician
job.description:
PCB Test & Repair Technician

Location: Stratford, CT
Pay: $20–$24 per hour, depending on experience
Schedule: Full-Time
Employment Type: Temp-to-Hire, with Direct Hire consideration for the right candidate

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced PCB Test & Repair Technician to join a growing electronics manufacturing team. This position plays an important role in ensuring the quality and functionality of printed circuit boards used in electronic assemblies.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on electronics experience and is comfortable troubleshooting and repairing PCBs down to the component level. Troubleshoot failures, support production, and help improve testing and repair processes.

This is a great opportunity for a technically skilled electronics professional looking for a long-term position with the potential to transition directly to the company.

What You'll Do

  • Troubleshoot printed circuit boards (PCBs) down to the component level.
  • Diagnose and repair electronic circuits and identify defective components.
  • Replace surface-mount (SMT) and through-hole components as needed.
  • Perform SMT rework and repair in accordance with IPC standards.
  • Set up and operate automatic and manual test equipment.
  • Perform in-circuit, functional, and bench testing.
  • Use diagnostic equipment including oscilloscopes, multimeters, and other electronic test equipment.
  • Read and interpret PCB schematics, assembly drawings, test procedures, and work instructions.
  • Identify and track PCB failure trends.
  • Support new product introductions and the transition of new products into production.
  • Provide training and guidance to production operators on testing and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and communicate issues effectively with engineering and production teams.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts and other technical projects as assigned.

What We're Looking For

  • Associate's degree in Electronics (A.S.E.E.) Preferred with a minimum of 2 years of experience troubleshooting microprocessor-controlled circuits to the component level OR 10 years of equivalent hands-on experience in a similar role.
  • PC Certification required.
  • Strong understanding of electronic circuits and component-level troubleshooting.
  • Experience with SMT rework and repair to IPC standards.
  • Ability to confidently use oscilloscopes, multimeters, and other electronic diagnostic equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret PCB schematics and assembly drawings.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow detailed procedures and work instructions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with engineering and production teams.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • $20–$24 per hour, based on experience
  • Temp-to-hire opportunity with Direct Hire potential
  • Opportunity to work with advanced electronics and PCB technology
  • Hands-on component-level troubleshooting and repair
  • Opportunity for long-term growth and development

job.title: Sys Integratn/Test Eng
job.description:
Systems Integration & Test Engineer
 

Position Overview

We are seeking a Systems Integration & Test Engineer to support the integration, verification, and validation of complex hardware, software, subsystems, and complete systems. This role will be responsible for developing and executing system-level test solutions, troubleshooting electrical and hardware interfaces, integrating test equipment, and analyzing test results to ensure systems meet contractual, technical, and performance requirements.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with electrical troubleshooting, test equipment, wiring diagrams, test procedures, and software development in test environments, particularly using NI LabVIEW and/or TestStand.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, implement, test, document, and maintain solutions for the integration and testing of in-house developed and COTS/GOTS components, subsystems, and systems.
  • Translate customer contractual requirements into practical and comprehensive system integration and test solutions while considering technical, schedule, and cost constraints.
  • Develop functional and technical specifications, test standards, and requirements for system and subsystem testing.
  • Troubleshoot hardware/software interface issues, electrical connections, cables, circuit cards, and associated test equipment.
  • Define system input/output parameters and ensure proper integration and functionality across complete systems and subsystems.
  • Review and evaluate system requirements to identify testability requirements and potential integration challenges.
  • Develop, document, and execute comprehensive test plans, test procedures, test schedules, and verification activities.
  • Integrate and verify test equipment used to support system and subsystem testing.
  • Coordinate subsystem and system-level testing with engineering, program management, manufacturing, and other technical organizations.
  • Perform electrical troubleshooting using equipment such as digital multimeters, oscilloscopes, and other electrical test instruments.
  • Develop, modify, and maintain test software/code using programming languages and tools commonly used in automated test environments.
  • Utilize NI LabVIEW and/or NI TestStand to develop or update automated test applications and test sequences.
  • Read, interpret, create, and update wiring diagrams, equipment drawings, test requirements, schematics, and test procedures.
  • Analyze test data and results to determine whether systems meet specified performance and verification requirements.
  • Prepare comprehensive system and subsystem test evaluation reports documenting test results and findings.
  • Identify, document, and track discrepancies discovered during integration and testing.
  • Perform integration and regression testing following software, hardware, component, or subsystem changes to verify that corrective actions have been successfully incorporated.
  • Support root-cause investigations and troubleshooting of integration and test failures.
  • Ensure all testing and documentation are performed in accordance with applicable engineering, quality, safety, and program requirements.

Required Qualifications

Candidates must have at least 2 years of hands-on experience with the following:

  • Electrical troubleshooting of cables, wiring, circuit cards, and/or electronic hardware.
  • Use of electrical test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and related instrumentation.
  • Integration and verification of test equipment.
  • Software/code development, modification, or troubleshooting within a test or automated test environment.
  • Experience with NI LabVIEW and/or NI TestStand is highly preferred/required.
  • Ability to read, interpret, write, and develop:
    • Wiring diagrams
    • Equipment drawings
    • Electrical schematics
    • Test requirements
    • Test plans
    • Test procedures
  • Experience executing system or subsystem-level integration and verification testing.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Ability to document technical findings and communicate test results effectively.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with automated test systems and test station development.
  • Experience integrating hardware and software components into complete systems.
  • Experience with COTS/GOTS hardware and software integration.
  • Experience writing automated test sequences using TestStand.
  • Experience developing test applications in LabVIEW.
  • Experience working with aerospace, defense, electronics, communications, or other highly regulated technical systems.
  • Familiarity with requirements verification, validation, regression testing, and discrepancy tracking.
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary engineering and program teams.

What This Role Is Really Looking For

The strongest candidates will typically come from backgrounds such as:

Systems Test Engineer | Integration & Test Engineer | Electrical Test Engineer | Hardware Test Engineer | Automated Test Engineer | Test Engineer | Systems Integration Engineer

The biggest screening areas are hands-on electrical troubleshooting + test equipment integration + LabVIEW/TestStand + ability to read/develop wiring diagrams and test procedures. A candidate who only has software testing experience or only performs electrical troubleshooting without system integration/test experience would likely be a weaker match.

job.title: Production Associate - 3rd Shift
job.description:
Shift: 11:00 PM – 7:30 AM
Schedule: Sunday night start

Position Overview

We are seeking a reliable and mechanically capable Production Associate (Extrusion Operator) to join our manufacturing team. The ideal candidate has prior manufacturing experience, preferably in extrusion, demonstrates strong attendance and dependability, is open to coaching and feedback, and possesses strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.

Under the direction of the Shift Leader and Production Supervisor/Manager, the Extrusion Operator is responsible for setting up and operating machinery used to combine dry and liquid chemicals into customer products.

Safety is the #1 priority. The Extrusion Operator is responsible for producing high-quality products efficiently and cost-effectively while meeting customer specifications, production requirements, and company policies and procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up, start, operate, and monitor production machinery in accordance with operating procedures, safety requirements, and ISO standards.
  • Weigh and load ingredients according to recipe specifications, or ensure the correct pre-blended materials are delivered and loaded into the machinery.
  • Monitor production processes and equipment to ensure safe, efficient, and consistent operation.
  • Troubleshoot equipment and processing issues and communicate problems to the Production Lead or Shift Supervisor as appropriate.
  • Operate machinery used to mix, extrude, discharge, and handle materials according to established procedures.
  • Visually and/or physically inspect materials and finished products to ensure they meet established quality standards.
  • Work effectively in both Food Grade and Industrial operations, as required.
  • Collect and deliver product samples to the laboratory for evaluation and follow instructions regarding batch adjustments when necessary.
  • Perform required machine cleaning, including major and minor changeovers.
  • Complete and maintain all required production system entries, transactions, logs, reports, and documentation.
  • Maintain accurate records and ensure data integrity.
  • Follow all safety policies, work rules, operating procedures, and company regulations.
  • Maintain departmental housekeeping and cleanliness standards.
  • Participate in training, retraining, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Communicate production, equipment, quality, and safety issues to the appropriate Lead or Supervisor.
  • Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Ability to read and comprehend written and verbal instructions in English, including safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, procedure manuals, and product recipes/material specifications.
  • Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, and apply these skills to weights, measurements, volume, and distance.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Basic computer proficiency, including email, internet, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Manual dexterity and ability to safely use various hand tools.
  • Ability to operate a forklift.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Mechanical aptitude and ability to troubleshoot basic equipment/process issues.
  • Demonstrated reliability and strong attendance.
  • Ability to accept coaching and feedback and apply it to job performance.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team.

Education & Experience

  • U.S. High School diploma, GED, or equivalent experience.
  • 1–3 years of industrial or manufacturing experience required; extrusion experience preferred.
  • Experience working with production machinery, manufacturing processes, or chemical/material handling is a plus.

job.title: Change Management Lead
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking a Change Management Lead to support a large-scale digital transformation initiative focused on modernizing business processes, tools, and operations. This role partners with executive leaders, managers, and frontline employees to drive awareness, acceptance, and adoption of new systems and processes through organizational change management and learning strategies.

The Change Management Lead will develop and execute change management solutions that help stakeholders successfully adopt new tools and ways of working. The role requires strong collaboration, communication, training, and stakeholder engagement capabilities in a dynamic environment.

Core Responsibilities

• Conduct change impact analyses, stakeholder analyses, role mapping activities, and assessments to support organizational readiness.

• Develop and execute stakeholder engagement strategies to drive change adoption and user acceptance.

• Design, deploy, and analyze surveys, incorporating feedback into change management approaches and training strategies.

• Create and deliver training materials and learning solutions based on stakeholder feedback and business needs.

• Develop end-user communications related to process, system, and organizational changes.

• Create presentations, executive briefings, and talking points for audiences ranging from executives to individual contributors.

• Develop and execute change management plans for ongoing system releases and post-implementation improvement initiatives.

• Facilitate meetings and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to support successful adoption of new tools and processes.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

• Knowledge and experience in organizational change management using ADKAR methods and practices.

• PROSCI certification.

• Hands-on experience with change management activities, including change impact analysis, stakeholder analysis, role mapping, survey construction and deployment, analysis of survey results, and incorporation of feedback into training development and delivery.

• Experience with stakeholder engagement, communication development, instructional design, course and training material creation, meeting facilitation, and executive briefings.

• Experience developing and delivering instructor-led and web-based training, including quick reference guides and related learning materials.

• Experience with Captivate, Enable Now, WalkMe, and other digital adoption platforms.

• Leadership Development Program graduate.

Preferred Skills or Experience

• Approximately 4-8 years of experience in organizational change management or related disciplines.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities and business needs.

• Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills.

• Experience developing creative solutions to support organizational adoption and engagement.

• Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical audiences.

• Exceptional writing, editing, and presentation development skills.

• Demonstrated ability to drive projects to completion with minimal oversight.

• Experience creating and building product branding or organizational change identities.

Work Details

• Remote.

• Approximately 25% travel required based on business needs. Travel requirements may vary depending on project demands.

job.title: Test Engineer - Interim Clearance
job.description:
Description:
Test Engineer responsible for detailed hardware and software design, updates, and integration/verification support for both new and existing test sets used in the testing of the Client 3/MSE missile and its subsystems. Applicant should be a proven problem solver who can multi-task in a complex interrelated environment. Candidates should be skilled in test equipment design, interface test adapter (ITA) design, and interfacing with test equipment. Candidates must understand electronics testing methods. Requires knowledge of industry wide tests and test equipment. Candidate will provide flow charts, block diagrams, schematics, and interface control documents. This role will support the writing of test requirements, test description documents, operating instruction, and installation procedures. This role will support Peer Reviews, Design Assurance Reviews, Pre/Post Verification Readiness Reviews, etc. Candidate provides technical solutions to a wide range of difficult problems. Solutions are imaginative, thorough, practicable, and consistent with organization objectives. Candidate is expected to work under only general direction. This role will be required to work to the assigned tasks as laid out in the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) within constraints defined by the Test System Technical Lead. This role is expected to provide timely and frequent communication on progress and significant issues to the Test System Technical Lead and other Program and Functional Stakeholders to prevent surprises. Candidate will be required to work with cross functional teams - Test System Technical Lead, Systems Engineering (SE) SME, Unit Under Test (UUT) SME, Group Technical Staff (GTS), and Functional Design Assurance SME - to ensure the test system design is in-line with Enterprise standards and to ensure the test system meets requirements. Candidate will occasionally be required to travel to *** production facilities, supplier's facilities, and customer facilities.

Basic Required Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or related degree.
• Skills in troubleshooting Analog and Digital Electronics.
• Familiarity with test software design and proficiency with software debugging in support of troubleshooting.
• Skilled in Root Cause and Corrective Action.
• Test equipment hardware (Oscilloscopes, power supplies, DMM, signal Generators, spectrum analyzers, AC/DC power distribution systems).
• Hardware and software configuration management process.
• Microsoft VISIO, Excel, Project, PowerPoint skills.
• Test Equipment Interface Test Adapter (ITA) and cable design experience.
• LabVIEW/Test Stand experience

Need to obtain minimum interim secret clearance before starting. Please only submit candidates with active interim or secret clearance.
Start date will be pushed up if candidates is identified sooner.

job.title: Wirer
job.description:
Join Our Team as a Wirer

We're seeking motivated individuals to join our team as a Wirer. In this role, you'll be responsible for the final wiring and connection of electrical and electronically controlled components, helping ensure our products meet the highest quality and performance standards.

We offer competitive pay, with an additional shift differential available for overnight shifts, along with comprehensive training designed to help you develop specialized wiring skills and advance your career.

Job Duties

  • Perform final wiring of electrical and electronically controlled components
  • Route, connect, and secure electrical wiring according to specifications
  • Follow electrical diagrams and assembly instructions
  • Inspect work to ensure quality and accuracy
  • Use a variety of hand tools, including:
    • Hammers
    • Pliers
    • Screwdrivers
    • Wrenches
    • Air guns
    • Wire strippers
    • Soldering guns
    • Cutters
    • Ratchets
  • Maintain a safe and organized work area
  • Perform other manufacturing duties as assigned

Requirements
  • Mechanical aptitude and willingness to learn electrical assembly skills
  • Ability to learn how to read and interpret electrical drawings and schematics
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship
  • Ability to follow safety procedures and work instructions
  • Dependable attendance and positive work ethic
  • Previous manufacturing or electrical experience is helpful but not required
Physical & Work Environment
  • Ability to stand and move throughout the workday
  • Ability to use hand tools safely and effectively
  • Ability to perform repetitive assembly tasks with attention to detail
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

Training & Qualification Process
We invest in your success by providing a structured training program:

  • Successfully complete a wiring pre-test
  • Complete the required Wiring Class
  • Participate in 30 days of on-the-job training with guidance from an experienced trainer
  • Undergo a skills evaluation to achieve Qualified Wirer status
  • Maintain wiring qualifications through periodic re-certification

job.title: System Integration/Test Engineer (Secret Clearance)
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Systems Integration & Test Engineer to support the planning, implementation, integration, testing, documentation, and maintenance of in-house developed and COTS/GOTS components, subsystems, and systems. This role focuses on developing and executing system test solutions that align with technical, schedule, and cost requirements.
The position supports complex electro-optic sensor solutions for military platforms and involves subsystem and system-level integration, test execution, analysis, validation, and reporting in a production environment.

Core Responsibilities
• Plan, implement, test, document, and maintain solutions for the integration and testing of hardware and software components, subsystems, and systems.
• Translate customer requirements into effective system test solutions while considering technical, schedule, and cost constraints.
• Establish functional and technical specifications, define input/output parameters, and resolve hardware and software interface issues.
• Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, procedures, and schedules for complete systems and subsystems.
• Coordinate subsystem and system testing activities across programs and organizations.
• Analyze test results and prepare subsystem and system-level evaluation reports to verify and validate performance.
• Create discrepancy reports and perform integration regression testing to verify and validate implemented fixes.

Education Level
Bachelors and 6+ years or Masters' and 4+ years of experience

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• 4 to 6 years of experience with software development using C, C++, and/or LabVIEW.
• 4 to 6 years of experience supporting production environments.
• 6+ years of experience in test equipment design.
• 6+ years of experience in electronic testing.
• 6+ years of experience in mechanical testing.
• Active Secret Security Clearance required prior to start.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Experience with LabVIEW, LabWindows/CVI, and National Instruments (NI) technologies in both development and maintenance of complex systems.
• Strong software development skills in C and C++ combined with Automated Test Equipment (ATE) hardware integration expertise, including switches, VXI/PXI chassis, electro-optic testing, and automation.
• Experience developing and maintaining automated test equipment in a high-volume production environment.
• Experience supporting electro-optic sensor solutions for military platforms.

Work Details
• Onsite Full Time.
• 1st Shift schedule.
• 4/10 work schedule.
• Safety shoes are required for this position.

job.title: SR CNC Programmer/Lead
job.description:
Senior CNC Programmer & Lead
Mesa, AZ | 1st Shift

Seeking a skilled machinist with extensive experience in CNC programming and Mastercam. The ideal candidate will work primarily on machine operations, interpret technical drawings, and lead within their team. They will be responsible for ensuring machine efficiency. The position requires the programmer to develop complete CNC program packages using CAD and CAM software (SolidWorks and MasterCAM) for 4-5 axis CNC Milling equipment, CNC Lathes, and CNC Mill-Turn machines. Packages include, but are not limited to, machining programs, cutter selection, setup documentation, tooling, fixture design and drafting, CNC tooling programs, verification, and shop aid sketches.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Analyze job orders, blueprints, specifications, and design data in order to calculate part dimension compatibility with machines, tool selection, machine speeds, and feed rates.
  • Write, store, and modify original and/or existing CNC programs to enhance efficiency.
  • Store, retrieve, and transfer CNC data as required.
  • Coordinate with other functional areas of workshop as needed to implement and change CNC programs.
  • Provide progress, status, and troubleshooting reports to management.
  • Wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in all designated areas of facility.
  • Comply with all standard safety requirements, policies, and procedures to maintain a clean and safe work environment.
  • Participate in required ongoing professional training.
  • Perform all physical functions of position: standing, stooping, bending, sitting, walking, twisting, kneeling, turning, and lifting materials up to 35lbs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, REQUIRED SKILLS:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 5+ years of experience in the machining industry
  • 5+ years of CAD and CAM experience (SolidWorks and MasterCAM preferred)
  • Ability to work with complicated drawings, sketches, and specifications
  • Ability to read Blueprints and understand measuring devices, both standard and metric
  • Ability to interpret engineering documentation and write appropriate machine-level instructions, including revisions to existing programs.
  • Good computer skills and ability to query, monitor, and input NC machine system data
  • Attention to detail, and ability to multitask, and handle multiple priorities at a time.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, work cooperatively with others, be adaptable and problem solve when needed, and be a team player.

job.title: Active Directory Administrator/Engineer
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking an experienced Active Directory Administrator/Engineer to support and maintain enterprise-scale directory services environments. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and troubleshooting Active Directory infrastructure that supports a large user and device population.

The position requires deep technical expertise across Active Directory, identity and access management, Windows Server environments, and infrastructure security. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional IT teams to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable directory services.

Core Responsibilities
• Design, deploy, and manage Active Directory infrastructure, including domains, forests, and trust relationships.
• Administer user and computer accounts, organizational units, security groups, and Group Policy.
• Implement and maintain Active Directory security best practices and compliance standards.
• Manage identity and access management solutions and directory synchronization tools.
• Monitor Active Directory performance, health, and replication across multiple sites.
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex Active Directory issues and escalations.
• Collaborate with network, security, and application teams to support integrated infrastructure solutions.
• Document configurations, procedures, and technical runbooks.
• Plan and execute Active Directory upgrades and migrations.
• Implement disaster recovery and business continuity procedures for directory services.
• Provide technical support and training to IT staff and end users.
• Stay current with security updates, industry trends, and emerging technologies.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• 5+ years of hands-on experience administering Active Directory in enterprise environments.
• Strong knowledge of Active Directory architecture, replication, and Group Policy management.
• Experience with Windows Server 2016, 2019, 2022, or newer versions.
• Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation and administration.
• Knowledge of DNS, DHCP, and network protocols.
• Experience with directory synchronization tools such as Azure AD Connect, Okta, or similar solutions.
• Understanding of security principles, least-privilege access, and compliance requirements.
• Excellent troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
• CompTIA Security+ or Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator certification, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Microsoft Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert or a comparable advanced certification.
• Experience with hybrid cloud identity solutions, including Azure AD/Entra ID.
• Knowledge of LDAP, Kerberos, and SAML protocols.
• Experience with privileged access management (PAM) solutions.
• Familiarity with IT service management tools and ticketing systems.
• Experience working in healthcare, finance, or other regulated industries.

Work Details
• Onsite daily at a Client office in New York City.
• Onsite daily at Bloomberg office required. Work location can be between (3 client sites)
• Limited local travel may be required between Client office locations within New York City.
• Interview process consists of an initial screening followed by a Client interview.

job.description:
Job Title: Mechanical Designer
Onsite - Wilmington, NC (M - F, 8am - 5pm)
40 hours/week. Flexibility is required, with occasional overtime (10–20 hours per week) during peak project periods.


Role Summary
We are seeking Mechanical Designer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating and refining mechanical equipment designs and layouts using advanced CAD tools, ensuring strict adherence to *** Machine Drafting Standards. Your work will directly contribute to optimizing production systems, resolving design challenges, and delivering innovative solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, exceptional problem-solving skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and deliver mechanical equipment designs and layouts using AutoCAD and Inventor, ensuring compliance with *** drafting standards.
Produce and maintain detailed drawing packages, build packages, machine part lists, illustrations, and equipment specifications for production systems.
Redesign mechanical components to reduce installation costs, resolve equipment interferences, and correct design deficiencies.
Execute design changes to address equipment or process challenges, ensuring all designs meet functional and performance requirements.
Provide detailed sketches and marked-up drawings to address evolving project needs.

Required Education & Skills
Associate's degree (AAS) in Mechanical Engineering Technology or a Bachelor's degree (BS) in Mechanical Engineering Technology or Mechanical Engineering.
A minimum of 3–5 years of professional experience in mechanical design, preferably in an industrial or manufacturing setting. Ability to interpret electrical schematics and translate engineering solutions into equipment design requirements.
Demonstrated commitment to job site safety.
Familiarity with manufacturing processes, including machining and fabrication, to ensure efficient and practical designs.

Desired Skills
Highly motivated and results-oriented professional with excellent organizational skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing project requirements.
Comfortable working in small teams and collaborating across departments to meet deadlines.
Experience with precision measurement tools (e.g., tape measures, calipers, micrometers).

Travel Requirements
Occasional travel may be required to vendor locations to gather equipment-related information; travel is expected to be minimal.

Travel will be required to Optical Fiber and Cable Manufacturing sites in North Carolina.

Hours of Work/Work Schedule
40 hours/week. Flexibility is required, with occasional overtime (10–20 hours per week) during peak project periods.

Position Overview: We are seeking a hands-on Head of Finance to lead the Finance function for a small, PE-backed fintech organization operating in a lean, fast-paced environment. This is a Finance leadership role first and foremost, with Financial Planning & Analysis as the top priority. The ideal candidate will bring strong FP&A expertise, solid accounting and controllership capabilities, and the flexibility to handle basic payroll, benefits, and employee administration in a small-company setting. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys operating close to the business, working directly with executive leadership and private equity stakeholders, and personally owning the work rather than managing a large team.

Key Responsibilities
Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Lead annual budgeting and ongoing forecasting
  • Own monthly budget reconciliation and variance analysis
  • Build and maintain financial models
  • Provide clear visibility into cash flow and financial performance
  • Prepare management reporting and financial analysis for executive leadership
  • Explain actual performance versus plan and identify key drivers behind variances
  • Support strategic planning and financial decision-making
  • Prepare accurate and timely reporting for private equity and investor stakeholders
Accounting & Controllership
  • Oversee month-end close and general accounting activities
  • Ensure accuracy of financial statements and reconciliations
  • Maintain appropriate financial controls and accounting processes
  • Manage accounting operations in a lean environment
  • Support audit, tax, and compliance activities as needed
  • Ensure the Finance function can operate effectively without requiring another senior accounting leader
HR & People Administration
Because the company operates with a small employee population, this role will also oversee basic day-to-day HR administration, including:
  • Payroll
  • Benefits administration
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans
  • 401(k) administration
  • Basic employee administration
  • Onboarding support
  • Coordination with external vendors and service providers as needed
The HR portion of the role is expected to remain significantly smaller than the Finance responsibilities.

Ideal Background
  • Significant experience in FP&A, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modeling
  • Strong accounting and controllership fundamentals
  • Experience working directly with CEOs, executive teams, boards, investors, or private equity sponsors
  • Experience in a startup, PE-backed organization, small company, or other lean operating environment
  • Comfortable personally owning both strategic and tactical Finance responsibilities
  • Experience building or improving processes rather than simply inheriting mature systems
  • Comfortable operating without a large Finance or administrative support team
  • Exposure to payroll, benefits, or basic HR administration
  • Strong executive communication skills
SaaS, fintech, software, or professional services experience is helpful but not required.

Leadership & Working Style
The successful candidate will be confident, resilient, and comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy.
They should be able to:
  • Work effectively in a high-volume, fast-moving environment
  • Communicate directly and candidly with executive leadership
  • Challenge assumptions and push back when appropriate
  • Remain composed during difficult conversations
  • Support their recommendations with data and sound judgment
  • Balance confidence with humility
  • Build strong relationships without being overly political or hierarchical
  • Roll up their sleeves and handle work at all levels when needed
This role requires someone with a strong point of view who can hold their ground without becoming abrasive or difficult to work with.

Work Arrangement
  • Fully remote within the United States
  • Full-time position
  • Required core operating hours: 8:30 AM–2:00 PM Pacific, Monday through Friday
  • Flexibility outside core hours while maintaining a normal full-time workload

job.title: CCA Design Engineer
job.description:
CCA Design Engineer – Aerospace & Defense

Location: Orlando, FL
Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite
Industry: Aerospace & Defense

Please do not submit any candidates that were submitted to this manager's previous Request #21637.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced CCA Design Engineer to support the design and development of advanced aerospace and defense products. This position will focus on the design of Circuit Card Assemblies (CCAs), including component and connector selection, layout, engineering documentation, and coordination of testing and integration activities.

The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of hands-on CCA design experience using Creo Parametric and Zuken, along with experience applying IPC standards within aerospace and defense product development environments.

This is an engineering design position not a CAD/drafting role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop Circuit Card Assemblies (CCAs) for aerospace and defense applications.
  • Perform connector and component selection and layout on CCAs.
  • Create and release IDX files and associated engineering documentation.
  • Develop detailed layouts, sketches, drawings, and design documentation.
  • Release drawings and documentation through Windchill.
  • Design major components and portions of functional systems and advanced prototypes.
  • Develop and improve products while supporting manufacturing operations.
  • Evaluate designs for manufacturability, material availability, interchangeability, replaceability, strength-to-weight efficiency, cost, and contractual requirements.
  • Coordinate design development with engineering, manufacturing, and other affected organizations.
  • Review completed layouts and drawings for accuracy, completeness, clarity, and compliance with applicable standards and specifications.
  • Identify design errors, omissions, and deficiencies and recommend appropriate design improvements.
  • Produce high-quality engineering documentation.
  • Support and guide test and integration activities.
  • Apply applicable IPC standards throughout the design process.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on Circuit Card Assembly (CCA) design experience.
  • 3+ years of Creo Parametric experience specifically related to CCA design.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Zuken experience.
  • 3+ years of experience working with IPC standards.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting aerospace and/or defense product development cycles.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and project management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high-quality design documentation.
  • Ability to support and guide testing and integration activities.
  • Ability to work 100% onsite in Orlando, FL.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Zuken E3 and electrical harness design.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing and product improvement initiatives.
  • Experience working within structured engineering documentation and release processes.

Important Note

This position is specifically seeking candidates with CCA design engineering experience. Candidates whose backgrounds are primarily CAD, drafting, or general mechanical/electrical design without substantial CCA design experience will not be considered.

If you have hands-on CCA design experience with Creo Parametric and Zuken and have worked within aerospace/defense product development, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Assembler
job.description:
Position Overview

The Production Assembly and Packaging Associate builds finished goods from prepared components, hardware, and partially completed assemblies. This position also inspects, packages, and identifies completed units according to production documentation, customer requirements, and internal procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review job travelers, production instructions, bills of materials, and related documentation before beginning work.

  • Notify the appropriate production leader or quality representative when documentation conflicts, missing components, assembly concerns, or packaging issues are identified.

  • Assemble manufactured products using components, subassemblies, and fasteners in accordance with established specifications.

  • Examine materials and components during the production process and identify items that do not meet quality expectations.

  • Test and visually inspect completed units for correct operation, cleanliness, workmanship, and possible defects.

  • Correct assembly or quality issues when authorized and escalate concerns requiring additional review.

  • Make ongoing quality decisions to ensure only acceptable products are approved for shipment.

  • Complete the final quality review before finished units are packed and released to the customer.

  • Package completed products in the designated containers and apply accurate labels to prevent shipping or product-identification errors.

  • Help orient and train newly assigned employees on relevant processes and expectations.

  • Participate in hand and body stretching or warm-up activities at the beginning of the shift and following meal and rest breaks to reduce the risk of repetitive-motion injuries.

  • Keep the assigned work area orderly, clean, and compliant with workplace safety requirements.

  • Communicate and work effectively with supervisors, quality personnel, and other team members.

  • Perform additional production-related responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Ability to communicate clearly and work cooperatively with others.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to read, write, and speak English.

  • Functional reading and basic math proficiency.

  • Ability to understand and follow written and verbal work instructions.

  • Ability to safely operate common hand tools and selected powered equipment, which may include cutting equipment and a stationary drill.

  • Ability to remain accurate and make sound quality decisions while performing repetitive production tasks.

  • Willingness to accept responsibility for determining whether completed products meet requirements before shipment.

Physical Requirements

The physical requirements below reflect activities commonly necessary to perform this position successfully.

  • Remain standing for extended periods during the workday.

  • Frequently use the hands and fingers to handle components, tools, controls, and packaged goods.

  • Frequently perform activities involving balance or climbing.

  • Occasionally walk, reach, bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.

  • Communicate verbally and hear workplace instructions or warnings.

  • Regularly lift, carry, or reposition materials and products weighing up to 50 pounds.

job.title: Project Coordinator
job.description:
Role Summary
The Project Scheduler serves as the primary source for developing, maintaining, and optimizing integrated schedules across a portfolio of capital projects. This role supports projects through all phases of the project lifecycle, from design and planning through execution, commissioning, and closeout. The Scheduler drives schedule accuracy, visibility, and accountability by partnering with Project Leaders, engineers, contractors, and stakeholders to identify risks, manage constraints, and ensure successful milestone delivery. This position also leads to implementation of the Last Planner System (LPS), facilitating collaborative planning processes that improve project performance and execution reliability.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop, maintain, and analyze integrated project schedules across multiple active projects.
  • Establish project baselines, conduct critical path analysis, and evaluate schedule impacts and recovery plans.
  • Partners with Project Leaders and project teams to monitor progress, forecast completion dates, and manage schedule risks.
  • Facilitate Last Planner System (LPS) activities, including pull planning, look-ahead planning, weekly work planning, and constraint management.
  • Track and report schedule performance metrics, including Percent Plan Complete (PPC) and portfolio health indicators.
  • Prepare portfolio-level dashboards, status reports, and executive summaries.
  • Support project reviews, governance processes, and leadership reporting.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to scheduling processes, planning standards, and project execution effectiveness.
  • Provide training, coaching, and guidance on scheduling best practices and LPS methodologies.

Required Education & Skills
  • AAS degree or higher, experience in Construction Management, Project Management, or related field. At least 2 - 7 years of experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • 5+ years of scheduling, project controls, or project management experience. Strong teamwork, adaptability, and commitment to safety.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or comparable scheduling tools.
  • Strong understanding of Critical Path Method (CPM), schedule forecasting, resource planning, and risk management.

Experience with Lean Construction principles and Last Planner System preferred.
PMP, PMI-SP, or Lean Construction certifications are a plus.
Advanced Microsoft Excel and reporting/dashboard development skills.

Desired Skills
  • Serves as the organization's scheduling SME Background in manufacturing or construction environments.
  • Coaches and trains project teams on scheduling best practices Experience in optical fiber manufacturing is a plus.
  • Promote adoption of LPS and standard work processes
  • Strong knowledge of Last Planner System principles and application
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or equivalent scheduling software
  • Understanding of Sequencing construction activities and field execution
  • Experienced Critical Path Method scheduling

Travel Requirements

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Accountant to manage full-cycle accounting activities, including general ledger maintenance, accounts payable and receivable, payroll processing, tax compliance, reconciliations, month-end close, and financial reporting.

The ideal candidate will have strong QuickBooks experience, a solid understanding of U.S. GAAP, and experience supporting accounting operations within a manufacturing or technology environment. Experience with ERP migrations, Oracle EBS, and M&A/acquired-entity accounting is highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Full-Cycle Accounting

  • Manage full-cycle accounting activities in QuickBooks, including general ledger maintenance, journal entries, and account reconciliations.
  • Process vendor invoices/accounts payable (AP) and customer invoices/accounts receivable (AR) accurately and timely.
  • Process vendor payments and manage payment schedules in accordance with contractual terms.

Collaboration

Employment Type: Direct Hire
Pay Rate: $27.90–$42.30/hour
Schedule: 1st Shift | Monday–Thursday, 5:00 AM–3:30 PM (4x10s)
Location: Onsite
Citizenship Requirement: Must be a U.S. Citizen

Position Overview

We are seeking an NDT Technician 2 to join an aerospace manufacturing team supporting the inspection of high-quality aircraft components. This position is responsible for performing non-destructive testing (NDT) on a variety of sheet metal and aircraft components, identifying potential defects, accurately documenting inspection results, and ensuring all inspections meet company and customer specifications.

Years of experience are not required for this opportunity. However, candidates MUST have documented NDT hours and applicable NDT certification(s).

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in NDT inspection, understands aerospace manufacturing requirements, can interpret engineering drawings and inspection results, and is comfortable working with precision measurement equipment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform non-destructive testing on a variety of aircraft and sheet metal components.
  • Process parts and accurately interpret NDT findings in accordance with company and customer specifications.
  • Perform inspections using established NDT techniques and procedures.
  • Work with Fluorescent Penetrant Inspection (FPI), Radiographic Inspection, and Digital X-Ray methods.
  • Generate X-ray film for components with both simple and complex geometries.
  • Work under direct oversight while performing conventional X-ray inspections and with limited oversight during FPI activities.
  • Accurately document inspection findings and maintain required quality records.
  • Create and revise NDT technique sheets in accordance with applicable requirements.
  • Identify faulty manufacturing or inspection processes and communicate issues to the appropriate NDT Technician or Supervisor.
  • Evaluate NDT methods and techniques and recommend improvements that enhance inspection efficiency, quality, and productivity.
  • Support NDT Technician 1 personnel and provide assistance with inspection activities.
  • Perform dimensional checks using calipers, micrometers, and other precision inspection equipment.
  • Properly document quantities and inspection information within manufacturing planning systems and paperless timekeeping systems.
  • Read and interpret written instructions, engineering drawings, sketches, schedules, manufacturing plans, and other technical documentation.
  • Follow established aerospace quality, safety, and inspection procedures.
  • Assist with demonstrating basic inspection operations to other team members when needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must have documented NDT hours.
  • Must possess applicable NDT certification(s).
  • Certification/qualification in FPI, Radiographic Inspection, and Digital X-Ray Inspection is highly preferred/required based on applicable method assignments.
  • Ability to read and understand manufacturing plans, engineering drawings, blueprints, and sketches.
  • Basic understanding of Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T).
  • Knowledge of shop mathematics and precision measurement principles.
  • Ability to use inspection equipment such as calipers and micrometers.
  • General understanding of aerospace manufacturing and NDT processes.
  • Ability to identify potential inspection or manufacturing issues and escalate them appropriately.
  • General knowledge of welding and forming processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately document inspection results.
  • Ability to follow technical instructions, established procedures, and safety requirements.

Experience

Specific years of experience are not required.

Candidates may be considered with limited professional experience provided they have the required NDT training/hours and certifications.

This is an excellent opportunity for an individual who has completed the necessary NDT training and accumulated qualifying hours and is looking to build or advance their career in aerospace NDT inspection.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Direct-Hire position
  • Competitive pay: $27.90–$42.30/hour
  • Consistent 1st shift schedule
  • Monday–Thursday, 4x10 schedule
  • Friday–Sunday off
  • Opportunity to work in the aerospace manufacturing industry
  • Opportunity for candidates with NDT certifications to advance their technical inspection career
  • Years of experience are not required if the required NDT hours and certifications are in place

Important Screening Requirement

Candidates must be U.S. Citizens and must have NDT hours and applicable certifications. Candidates without NDT certifications/hours will not be considered.

job.title: Distribution Coordinator
job.description:
BASIC FUNCTION:
Plans, schedules, and coordinates the movement of assigned refined products and/or intermediates from the source of supply to the bulk point of sale for smaller, less complex assignments to ensure continuity of marketing supply under limited supervision.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:
Schedules and coordinates oil movements and/or various light oil and/or heavy fuel oil products associated with appropriate refinery by pipeline, rail car, and/or truck
Assists with handling crisis management for situations involving conflicts arising out of short-term or long-term refinery/logistical problems causing product outages, customer complaints, human error causing product outages, etc., escalating as needed
Monitors assigned light oil and/or heavy fuel oil product inventories which may include daily monitoring of oil movements, inventory positions and communicating with appropriate departments
Schedules Common Carrier Pipelines, rail cars, and/or truck movements
Coordinates product movement nominations or tendering loads with appropriate pipeline companies and terminals or truck or railcar carrier and enters nomination in SAP TSW/TMW

A minimum of one year of job related and industry experience is required.

EDUCATIONAL LEVEL:
Associate's degree, in a technical or related field, or equivalent years of work experience in lieu of a degree, is required.

PREFERRED EDUCATION:
A Bachelor's degree in business or related field is preferred.

REQUIRED SKILLS OR TOOLS:
Basic knowledge of the Company's business process including but not limited to tank farm blending, loading, transfer, inspection and shipping procedures, product marketing, refining procedures, invoicing, and cash to order business process. Advanced analytical and research skills required to analyze various data. Intermediate computer skills particularly in MS Excel to provide written reports and spreadsheets as well as the ability to learn new programs such as internet rail programs. Interpersonal, customer service, and communication skills are necessary to create mutual respect with peers and a positive work environment. Knowledge of safety, environmental and transportation regulations and procedures, reading blueprints, capable of writing effective instructions. Ability to maintain positive and productive working relationship within department and with other departments. Ability to communicate effectively with others, both wirtten and verbal communication, ability to perform intermediate mathematical calculations, advanced reading and writing skills.

PREFERRED SKILLS:
SAP TSW, BI, ECC functional/end user experience and Geometrix rail car tracking system experience preferred.

WORK CONDITIONS:
Office based with occasional refinery visits from time to time and with travel up to 30% by land and air required. Petroleum refinery/industrial environment, including but not limited to, working near moving mechanical parts and/or rotating equipment, petroleum products, chemicals, pressure vessels, and/or tanks. Subject to all varying road and weather conditions.

job.title: Purchasing Buyer
job.description:
Position Summary:
Directs the activities associated with the SCMG managed global spend for a designated commodity category. Responsible for identification and evaluation of North American opportunities within the commodity category for reduction of spend, consolidation of process, function and continuity of supply. Manages the Client contracts within the commodity category and reports the metrics associated with them. Delivers continuous improvement in cost processes and services within the commodity category. Will be responsible for requests for information (RFI) or quotes (RFQ). Generates recommendations based on Total Cost of Ownership comparisons. Monitors and reports on activities associated with named commodity categories. Major Duties and

Responsibilities:
Formulate annual business plans for achievement of cost reductions and year-over-year performance improvement.
Obtains and analyzes quotes to determine best value, then recommends global sourcing solutions based on data and facts collected.
Can layout and explain a commodity strategy. Follows and tracks to the strategy for basic commodities. Understands all aspects of commodity strategy templates. Can create a strategy but may be limited to current state (static) and not completely global. May be limited to more basic commodities. Utilizes capability matrices to develop strategy.
Provides proper documentation for review at sourcing councils, including total landed cost analysis taking into account duty, freight, packaging, surcharge, payment terms, and other financial factors. Includes understanding of SSA status and any financial risk. Consistently utilizes IPOs in quoting new business. Considers global spending for all suppliers.
Ability to maintain control of multiple projects to meet timing and anticipate and resolve 'roadblocks' for successful part PPAP and launch. Monitors technical review progress with cross-functional teams; ensures OISRs are updated and tracks to program milestones.
"Ability to clearly understand the financial and strategic impacts of agreed to 'gives' and 'gets' to optimize the value to Client and negotiate complex supplier issues with little to no supervision. Understands tactics to position Client with the most leverage possible.
Consistently sends out and reviews complete RFQ packages and negotiates the basic terms of a contract to support an agreement. Understand what type of contract is required. Understands key points to leverage beyond price. Understands Client's standard Terms and Conditions.
Monitors supplier(s) performance, audits results and elevates issues within the supplier's organization for resolution. Understands and review the corrective actions for sustained results. Holds regular performance review meetings with key stakeholders and measures compliance to agreements. Tracks Savings projects and reports accurate forecasts and actuals in the Savings Tracker. Understands supplier surcharge mechanisms.
Works proactively with other departments to find ways of reducing the need for inventory.
Manages the supply chain to ensure optimum workflows and takes active steps to remove non-value-added work. Challenges the status quo and engages help and support from other functional groups. Makes specific and comprehensive recommendations for process improvements. Understands DOS and can lead improvement activities with assistance.
Is able to lead Benchmarking, VA/VE, Lean, Resourcing, LPP analysis, Value Stream mapping events with no assistance. Thinks creatively about using what is learned from the savings toolbox to generate a range of improvement options for the business. Promotes cost reduction activities with key suppliers and shares best practices

Minimum Qualifications
Four-year degree in Business (Supply Chain Management or Purchasing is preferred) or four year degree in Engineering (Product or Manufacturing)
Professional Supply chain certification preferred
3-5 years of experience in procurement, preferred
Strong team player, able to work effectively on cross-functional teams.
Excellent communication skills, verbal and written.
Maintains an organized and professional manner when representing Client.
Willing to travel as required (estimate 10%).

Required Skills:
Ability to work on tasks along with prioritizing work and managing deadlines.
Understands interactions that affect outcomes for problem-solving. Uses analytical abilities to distill complex issues into workable parts for themselves. Anticipates consequences of alternative options.
Possesses and uses appropriate levels of intellectual ability to achieve objectives and maximize results. Demonstrates a determined, engaged, thoughtful approach to doing day-to-day work. Applies knowledge of global organizational issues to his/her own work.
Can identify areas of deficiency in processes and employ resources to optimize.
Can support and personalize the needed change within the group/dept./organization.
Develops relationships across the corporation to facilitate inter-divisional cooperation and cross-functional asset utilization
Provides prompt, courteous, and attentive service to both internal and external customers.
Accomplishes tasks and makes effective decisions without guidance, even outside the framework of their direct work responsibility.
Recognizes the talents, skills, and behaviors that the organization needs. Demonstrates self-awareness and takes action to improve individual performance/capabilities.
Inspires others in setting and achieving standards of excellence. Can get others on board, engaged and committed to objectives; can overcome resistance. Effectively get things done through others by delegating, motivating, focusing and leveraging the appropriate resources to meet objectives.
Establishes open, candid and trusting relationships. Treats others fairly and consistently. Effectively handles conflicts and issues impacting working relationships.
Actively supports the implementation and maintenance of lean value and the related value stream.
Demonstrates a high level of cooperation and collaboration with internal and external relationships.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to work with people at all levels within and outside Client in a professional manner.
Familiarity with Procurement and Quality Supplier Metrics with flow-down to supplier contracts and performance reviews.
Must have an understanding of blueprints and technical specifications. Strong personal computer skills required, including experience with MS Office Software

job.title: Production Associate
job.description:
Shift: 6am-3pm, overtime when required

Description:

Produces product by monitoring and adjusting production line operations.

Duties:

  1. Prepares production equipment for operation by making equipment setup adjustments; assisting with equipment changeovers.
  2. Documents production and production process by completing production logs; calculating production statistics; noting the receipt, flow, and return of materials; noting bins, racks, deliveries, move tickets and log sheets.
  3. Maintains quality standards by conducting first-piece and line-clearance inspection; completing production control charts; analyzing recordings and statistics; making equipment adjustments.

  6. Maintains production operations by following policies and procedures (equipment, raw and in-process materials, and finished goods); reporting needed changes.
  7. Maintains safe and clean working environment by complying with procedures, rules, and regulations.

job.description:
Schedule: 7AM-3:30PM

As an Operator I, you'll work under direct supervision, performing routine and repetitive assembly operations and processes.
What You'll Work On
Ensure that relevant job documentation for cell operations and functions is accurate and up to date - Troubleshooting skills - Interpersonal skills such as conflict resolution, active participation, active listening, Interpreting, cooperation, and flexibility to allow for a successful self-managed team

Positively represent the company during tours by demonstrating techniques and sharing appropriate information
Positively represents and supports the company's policies and procedures
Maintain a positive attitude when interacting with internal customers and external customers, such as tours
Follow safety guidelines and utilize appropriate safety devices when performing all operations
Participate in continuous improvement/quality initiatives to enhance production processes to achieve quality and profitability metrics
Perform routine/preventative maintenance on applicable equipment to maximize efficiency, minimize accidents to enhance longer life of equipment and tools
Maintain accurate records to ensure traveler and quality documents are accurate, all parts are traceable, and quality issues can be addressed to assure the quality of all products
Demonstrates a basic understanding of Lean Manufacturing.
Demonstrates a basic understanding of continuous improvement
Participate with the Manufacturing Supervisor/Manager in setting and monitoring individual goals and cell performance metrics that continuously seek to improve the quality of operations
Support all Divisional initiatives as identified by divisional management and in support of Quality Management Systems (QMS), Environmental Management Systems (EMS), and other regulatory requirements
Required Qualifications
Ability to read, comprehend, and follow written procedures at a 7th grade level; understand and follow verbal instructions at a 7th grade level
Understanding of and ability to utilize electronic data collection systems and computer software packages
Ability to prioritize work by determining the sequencing and timing of different jobs based on precedence and importance
Ability to handle and maneuver small components and parts
Ability to make critical decisions and judgments with minimal supervision
Ablity to use microscope 50% - 90% of work day based on line assignment
Preferred Qualifications
Prefer 6 months of experience working in a medical or other regulated production environments
Previous medical device, manufacturing, or assembly experience is helpful
High school degree or equivalent preferred
Ability to work OT on Fridays and Saturdays based on business needs
Dress Code Requirements
Wear clean, non-shedding clothing free of loose fibers, frays, glitter, sequins, or other detachable items.
Clothing must fully cover the torso, upper arms, and legs and fit under the required lab coat/gown.
No sweaters, fleece, sleeveless tops, short skirts, above-ankle pants, or loose-fitting clothing.
Closed-toe, closed-heel shoes with socks/stockings are required. No sandals, clogs, slippers, or heels over 2 inches.
No makeup, nail polish, artificial nails, strong fragrances, or unsafe jewelry/piercings.
Religious/cultural head coverings are permitted if fully covered by required PPE.
Cover any open wounds with a bandage.
Clothing and appearance must be professional, clean, and non-offensive.
