job.title: Mobile Platform Product Owner
job.description:
Overview
Join Client’s team focused on advancing a rapidly growing mobile customer channel. This role helps drive mobile product strategy and execution, leveraging modern technologies to improve customer experiences, address customer pain points, and support business objectives.
The Mobile Platform Product Owner will bridge business, product, and IT teams to define and deliver the mobile platform foundation. This position combines strategic planning, technical analysis, stakeholder collaboration, and Agile product ownership to support the ongoing evolution of Client’s mobile applications.

Core Responsibilities
• Collaborate with IT, UX, Analytics, and other business partners to understand customer behavior and deliver effective mobile experiences.
• Promote mobile tools and features that support broader product goals while maintaining a cohesive mobile experience.
• Communicate outcomes, insights, and updates to stakeholders throughout product development initiatives.
• Conduct competitive benchmarking and research emerging technologies to identify opportunities for mobile platform enhancements.
• Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and stand-ups to support feature delivery.
• Translate business objectives into technical requirements through clearly defined user stories and backlog management.
• Prioritize and manage the mobile platform backlog to align team efforts with defined objectives and key results.
• Partner with third-party software vendors to implement mobile tools and platform capabilities.
• Support a DevOps operating model by helping prioritize defect resolution, small enhancements, and larger feature initiatives.
• Work closely with architects and technical leads to deliver customer value while reducing operational complexity and costs.
• Lead software demonstrations and collaborate with business teams to validate requirements and accept completed user stories.
• Monitor product performance metrics and continuously refine solutions to improve customer outcomes.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience/training.
• Understanding of mobile application technology frameworks and key differences between Android and iOS platforms.
• Understanding of how enterprise systems integrate and interact with one another.
• Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience, preferably within e-commerce environments.
• Product ownership experience.
• Strong analytical background with the ability to evaluate data, outcomes, and customer behavior.
• Ability to communicate effectively using technical language across business and technology stakeholders.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal direction.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including transparency, expectation setting, and results reporting.
• Demonstrated ability to build trust and foster collaboration across cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Master’s degree in a related field.
• Experience selecting and implementing third-party software development kits (SDKs) to enhance mobile applications.
• Experience using Agile methodologies and software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices to deliver software solutions.
• Experience working within a product operating model focused on measurable outcomes and continuous customer experience improvement.
• Mobile application experience within the travel or airline industry.
• Knowledge of current mobile technologies and their application to customer engagement initiatives.
• Proven track record of delivering products that generate meaningful business value.
• High level of intellectual curiosity and comfort working in ambiguous environments.

Work Details
• Hybrid schedule with onsite work Tuesday through Thursday and remote work on Monday and Friday.
• Work location will include both Client facilities.
• Interview process consists of two rounds: an initial virtual interview followed by an onsite interview.

job.title: Winterization Coordinator
job.description:
Winterization Coordinator
Industry: Property Management / Residential Services
Position Type: Full-Time (Remote / Hybrid Options Available)

Job Summary
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Winterization Coordinator to oversee the dispatching and completion of property winterization and de-winterization services. This position offers a flexible remote or hybrid work schedule for qualified candidates. In this role, you will review job site photos to verify the quality of plumbing work, manage vendor performance, and negotiate pricing and timelines. You will serve as a critical communication link between clients, brokers, and vendors, ensuring all services are completed with a strong sense of urgency and high-quality standards.

Essential Job Functions

  • Track and monitor residential service orders from initial dispatch to final completion, providing timely updates to clients.
  • Review active and completed job photos to verify successful winterization/de-winterization and identify issues requiring plumbing bids.
  • Recruit and manage vendors, negotiate bids and timelines, and monitor overall performance and quality control.
  • Respond professionally to client inquiries regarding billing, timelines, and service updates using internal software and Microsoft Office.
Key Qualifications
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a professional demeanor.
  • Excellent negotiation, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) and the ability to quickly learn proprietary software.

job.title: Purchasing Buyer
job.description:
Position Summary:
Directs the activities associated with the SCMG managed global spend for a designated commodity category. Responsible for identification and evaluation of North American opportunities within the commodity category for reduction of spend, consolidation of process, function and continuity of supply. Manages the Client contracts within the commodity category and reports the metrics associated with them. Delivers continuous improvement in cost processes and services within the commodity category. Responsibilities:
• Formulate annual business plans for achievement of cost reductions and year-over-year performance improvement.

Can create a strategy but may be limited to current state (static) and not completely global. May be limited to more basic commodities. Utilizes capability matrices to develop strategy.
• Provides proper documentation for review at sourcing councils, including total landed cost analysis taking into account duty, freight, packaging, surcharge, payment terms, and other financial factors. Includes understanding of SSA status and any financial risk. Consistently utilizes IPOs in quoting new business. Considers global spending for all suppliers.

• Monitors supplier(s) performance, audits results and elevates issues within the supplier's organization for resolution. Understands and review the corrective actions for sustained results. Holds regular performance review meetings with key stakeholders and measures compliance to agreements. Tracks Savings projects and reports accurate forecasts and actuals in the Savings Tracker. Understands supplier surcharge mechanisms.
• Works proactively with other departments to find ways of reducing the need for inventory.

Makes specific and comprehensive recommendations for process improvements. Understands DOS and can lead improvement activities with assistance.
• Is able to lead Benchmarking, VA/VE, Lean, Resourcing, LPP analysis, Value Stream mapping events with no assistance. Thinks creatively about using what is learned from the savings toolbox to generate a range of improvement options for the business. Promotes cost reduction activities with key suppliers and shares best practices

Minimum Qualifications
• Four-year degree in Business (Supply Chain Management or Purchasing is preferred) or four year degree in Engineering (Product or Manufacturing)

job.description:
Job Description:
The Process Development Engineer will operate within the Global Toppings, Creams, and Culinary Solutions Center of Excellence (TCCS COE), as part of the Research, Innovation, and Compliance (RIC) team. This maternity role focuses on supporting current short- to mid-term projects (13 year timeline) and serves as the engineering technical lead on these projects, involving process and product innovation, renovation, optimization, and cost savings across assigned product categories.

The Engineer will support new product development, network standardization, and plant engineering optimization by researching, designing, developing, managing, and executing innovations in both individual equipment and complete process systems.

POSITIONS KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:
Technology Development and Deployment
Supports existing team through applying engineering methods and practices to problem solving and project execution.
Applies existing and emerging engineering/scientific knowledge to solve problems independently.
Engages with internal and external centers of expertise, including equipment vendors, patent/literature searches, and open innovation platforms.
Evaluates and integrates input from vendors, consultants, design groups, engineering teams, and packaging suppliers to identify potential solutions.

 

Communication & Influence
Provides technical support to cross-functional teams including Marketing, Sales, Manufacturing, and external customers.
Delivers presentations on new and existing products to category leadership and stakeholders.
Offers technical leadership and contributes significantly to both product and process development initiatives.

 

Business Acumen
Builds strong relationships with internal customers and stakeholders.
Develops and renovates solutions that meet financial objectives and improve profitability.

Strategic Thinking
Aligns project work with broader business strategy and understands the roles impact on organizational goals.
Serves as support engineer for current and future product and process related projects.


Skills & Competencies
Strong verbal and written communication skills, including presentation capabilities.
Proven ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment.
Demonstrated success in driving technological innovation and process improvements.
Ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word), databases, statistical software, and ability to learn relevant tools (e.g., PLM).
 

Required Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, preferably with 5 years of industrial/applied research experience.  [Masters or Ph.D. will be considered, but not a requirement for the role. ]
Demonstration of accomplishment in product/process development or experimental design.
Demonstrated experience in identifying and/or specifying equipment suitable for use in the production of FMCG products.
Demonstrated experience in working directly with manufacturing facilities, and supporting with any production related issues.
Looking for someone with familiarity with liquid processing/liquid processing equipment.


Preferred Experience
Engineering experience with dairy/non-dairy products and/or emulsion technology.
Experience in process optimization and operational efficiency
Strong research skills, including setting up design of experiments utilizing bench or pilot equipment and performing research individually or as part of a broader team.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Expected to conduct experiments in laboratory, test kitchen, pilot plant, and production facility environments.
Follow company associate and product safety procedures.
Occasionally lift up to 50 lbs.
Stand and/or sit for extended periods.
Distinguish differences in ingredients and materials through taste, smell, touch, and visual inspection.
Occasionally work extended hours in environments with noise, odors, and high temperature and humidity.
Attend global video meetings outside standard work hours, including evenings and early mornings as needed.
Physical dexterity required to operate equipment such as scales and balances.
Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.

job.title: Measurement Systems Software Engineer
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Measurement Systems Software Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and deployment of software for industrial measurement and inspection systems used in manufacturing environments. This role focuses on C#/.NET software development, hardware integration, and the delivery of reliable, production-ready measurement solutions.
The engineer will work with distributed software applications that coordinate imaging, motion, I/O, sequencing, and data handling for product inspection and quality control. The role also includes evaluating and applying AI-assisted software development practices to improve engineering workflows and productivity.

Core Responsibilities
• Design, develop, test, maintain, and support software for industrial measurement and machine vision systems using C#/.NET.
• Develop and support distributed measurement system applications, including software communication, coordination, configuration, and data handling.
• Support software build, release, deployment, system integration, and technology transfer activities from development into manufacturing.
• Evaluate, adopt, and apply AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to improve software development workflows, code quality, testing, and engineering efficiency.
• Contribute to best practices for incorporating AI development tools into day-to-day software engineering activities.
• Create and maintain technical documentation, including software specifications and support documentation.
• Train engineering, maintenance, and operations personnel on the use, support, and maintenance of deployed systems.
• Provide remote and onsite troubleshooting for software and integrated measurement systems.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• BS, MS, or PhD preferred in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
• Experience developing software applications in C#/.NET for production use, system integration, or industrial applications.
• Experience designing, developing, and troubleshooting software for distributed, multi-process, or integrated systems.
• Familiarity with software communication and messaging methods such as publish/subscribe architectures, message queues, or similar approaches.
• Experience with source control, software versioning, and build/release workflows using tools such as Git, GitLab, automated build systems, and package management tools.
• Experience supporting software deployment, troubleshooting, and long-term support in development or manufacturing environments.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical work and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Interest in applying AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to improve software development workflows, code quality, testing, and engineering productivity.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Experience with WPF user interface development frameworks in .NET.
• Experience with motion control systems, cameras, image acquisition hardware, and integrated imaging platforms.
• Hands-on experience working with imaging hardware, cameras, measurement equipment, or related instrumentation.
• Experience applying machine learning or computer vision methods to inspection, classification, or measurement problems.
• Familiarity with databases, containerization, or high-performance computing environments.
• Experience evaluating, adopting, or helping define best practices for AI-enabled software development workflows.
• Knowledge of machine vision and image processing methods such as feature extraction, edge detection, morphology, classification, inspection, and metrology.
• Experience with machine vision or image processing libraries such as Halcon, OpenCV, LabVIEW, or similar tools.

Work Details
• 40 hours per week with a flexible schedule as needed.
• Up to 10% to 30% domestic and international travel may be required, with trips ranging from one day to several weeks.
• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Schedule: Must be available to work CST, MST, or PST business hours
Employment Type: Contract
Citizenship Requirement: Must be a U.S. Citizen

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Government Subcontracts / Procurement Specialist to support procurement activities for development, production, and global sustainment programs. This position will be responsible for developing and administering subcontracts for specialized materials, equipment, and services across multiple contract types.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in government procurement, subcontracting, FAR/DFARS, supplier negotiations, RFQ/RFP processes, proposal evaluation, price analysis, and SAP S/4HANA. Experience supporting both CONUS and OCONUS procurement activities is required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure procurement activities comply with applicable government contracting requirements, including FAR and DFARS.
  • Support both CONUS and OCONUS procurement activities.
  • Execute supplier agreements and purchase orders within established delegated authority.

Required Qualifications

  • Government procurement experience.
  • Experience working with FAR and DFARS requirements.

Work Environment

This is a 100% remote position. Candidates must be comfortable working within CST, MST, or PST business hours and collaborating virtually with cross-functional teams, suppliers, and government/prime-contract stakeholders.

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Exciting career opportunity for an experienced Quality Engineering professional to join an excellent team of hard-working professionals at one of the islands finest defense / aerospace manufacturers. This is a well-established yet rapidly growing company that offers a very generous benefits package, flexible work schedule and awesome work culture!

We are seeking a highly motivated Quality Assurance Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate will provide quality assurance support to customers, suppliers, product development and manufacturing teams, resolving defects and ensuring products meet both customer and regulatory specifications. This role requires collaboration throughout the production lifecycle to ensure compliance with quality standards and continuous improvement of processes.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure products meet both customer and regulatory specifications
  • Develop and implement quality control plans and procedures
  • Conduct quality audits and inspections to identify defects and non-conformities
  • Investigate and resolve quality issues, including root cause analysis and corrective actions
  • Monitor and analyze quality performance metrics to identify areas for improvement
  • Participate in design and process reviews to ensure quality requirements are met
  • Provide training and support to production teams on quality standards and procedures
  • Create test procedures and quality plans to ensure product scope, requirements, and product functions are clearly defined, recommending improvements where needed.
  • Ensure products meet organizational, customer, and industry quality standards, including AS9100, AS9102, and other relevant aerospace regulations.
  • Support product development and operations teams by providing analysis and expertise during inspection and quality control stages.
  • Collaborate on root cause and corrective action plans to prevent recurrence of defects or process deviations and ensure timely responses from responsible parties.
  • Generate and Analyze quality data to identify trends, with the goal of reducing defects and improving product reliability.
  • Coordinate and support First Article Inspection (FAI) per AS9102 requirements to ensure products meet both internal and external quality standards.
  • Assist in supplier quality activities including developing inspection plans for purchased products and parts, reviewing supplier first articles and performing on-site audits.
  • Lead quality planning efforts while collaborating with design engineering on new product development, including quality control strategies and ensure timely and compliant project execution.
  • Develop inspection plans for purchased products and parts.
  • Identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement within the Quality Management System through procedural and product internal audits, supporting customer and 3rd party audits.
  • Support or lead internal, customer and 3rd party audits.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field
  • Strong knowledge of quality control methodologies and tools
  • Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action processes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Knowledge of, or the ability to learn, the organization's production processes and quality management systems (QMS).
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across departments, including developers, project managers, and customer support teams.
  • Proficient in, or the ability to learn, root cause analysis and corrective action methods.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

Desired Experience:

  • Experience with root cause – corrective action investigation.
  • Knowledge about First Article Inspection Reports per AS9102.
  • Familiarity with Material Review Board (MRB) processes.
  • Quality certifications such as CQE (Certified Quality Engineer), CQA (Certified Quality Auditor), or similar.
  • Experience with AS9100, ISO 9001, FAA or NADCAP regulations.
  • Experience with quality inspection tools such as Net-Inspect, InspectionXpert, or similar software preferred

This position involves exposure to projects and contracts subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). As a result, only U.S. Citizens or Permanent Residents (Green Card holders) are eligible for employment in this role. Applicants must meet these requirements to be considered.

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer-Entry Level
job.description:
Manufacturing / Process / Design Engineer

Position Overview
We are seeking a Manufacturing/Process/Design Engineer to support engineering activities related to manufacturing processes, production systems, and product/design applications. Under direct supervision, this position performs a variety of engineering tasks designed to build experience and familiarity with company engineering methods, practices, standards, and programs.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with technical data, engineering documentation, and established procedures to develop practical solutions to routine engineering problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support manufacturing, process, and design engineering activities.
  • Perform routine engineering assignments under the direction of experienced engineers.
  • Review engineering drawings, specifications, procedures, and other technical references.
  • Use established engineering methods, standards, and readily available references to resolve straightforward technical problems.
  • Collect, organize, and evaluate engineering and manufacturing data to support decision-making.
  • Assist with developing engineering plans, procedures, and recommendations for assigned projects.
  • Support the design and application of engineering solutions to manufacturing and production challenges.
  • Assist with evaluating existing processes and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare engineering documentation, reports, calculations, and presentations as required.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, design, and other engineering teams.
  • Follow company engineering standards, procedures, safety requirements, and quality practices.
  • Gain familiarity with the company's engineering programs, processes, tools, and best practices.

What They're Really Looking For

The strongest candidates will have:

  • A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Internship, co-op, or early-career experience in manufacturing, process engineering, product design, or production engineering.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.
  • Experience working with engineering/manufacturing data.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with CAD/design software is beneficial.
  • Understanding of manufacturing processes and engineering principles.
  • Ability to work under the guidance of senior engineers while progressively taking on more responsibility.

Seniority Level

Entry-Level / Junior Engineer approximately 0–3 years of engineering experience, although relevant internship/co-op or hands-on manufacturing experience can be highly valuable.

job.title: Test Technician
job.description:
Test Technician
We are looking for a collaborative, detail oriented professional who thrives in a mission critical environment. This role offers direct impact on product performance and reliability, giving you the chance to shape the quality of systems that protect our nation. If you are proactive, analytical, and passionate about delivering excellence, you will find a purpose driven home here.

As the Test Technician you will start by preparing documentation and performing the setup fixture that is necessary for the testing of accelerometers. You will be responsible for initiating and maintaining specific test operations from start to completion. This will include all rate table and vibration related testing. After internal testing, you will move on to final testing of the product by performing similar tests on the customer's equipment as the final validation before delivery.
• Prepare accurate documentation related to test preparation as well as maintaining detailed daily process logs for all tests being performed and all related faults or anomalies.
• Collaborate with the electrical engineer and the production manager regarding testing strategies, troubleshooting, and planning of all test related matters.
• Finalizing the product - i.e. disassemble from test fixture, cleaning, etc.
• Prepare the product for final inspection - gather and validate paperwork and database routing before delivery to the customer.
• Perform other production related tasks during periods of testing that doesn't require observation.

Basic Qualifications:
• High School diploma or equivalent
• Previous test experience or equivalent education
• MUST BE A U.S. PERSON

Desired Skills:
• IPC J-STD-001 certification
• Technical degree in electronics related curriculum
• Work experience in production, test, or related fields
• Electrical and/or mechanical troubleshooting
• Computer skills: MS Outlook, Excel, Word, Access
• Knowledge of Electrostatic Discharge and ESD mitigation principles

job.title: Senior Project Analyst
job.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced HR Compliance Analyst to independently manage regulatory compliance activities for U.S. retirement plans, including Defined Benefit (DB), Defined Contribution (DC), VEBA, and Health & Welfare Benefit Plans.

This position is responsible for preparing, coordinating, and submitting required regulatory filings while ensuring adherence to ERISA, IRS, DOL, ACA, HIPAA, COBRA, FMLA, and applicable state regulations. The HR Compliance Analyst will work cross-functionally with HR, Legal, Finance, auditors, third-party administrators, and other stakeholders to maintain compliance, mitigate risk, and ensure audit readiness.

Work Schedule & Environment

  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
  • Shift: 1st Shift
  • Work Model: Hybrid – 3 days onsite / 2 days remote
  • Timekeeping: SAP Fieldglass
  • Interview Process: Video interview

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Filings & Benefits Compliance

  • Manage the preparation, coordination, and submission of IRS Form 5500 filings, including applicable schedules, across benefit plans.
  • Support SEC Form 11-K filings and ensure alignment with required financial disclosures.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, including:
    • ERISA
    • IRS requirements
    • Department of Labor (DOL) regulations
    • Affordable Care Act (ACA)
    • HIPAA
    • COBRA
    • FMLA
    • State disability regulations
  • Support ACA reporting, including IRS Forms 1094-B/C and 1095-B/C.
  • Coordinate applicable state disability filings.
  • Maintain and update Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs), ACA Summaries of Benefits and Coverage (Clients), and other required disclosures.
  • Monitor regulatory changes and implement necessary updates to policies, processes, and documentation.
  • Maintain a comprehensive compliance calendar to track regulatory deadlines and deliverables.

Audit & Risk Management

  • Support internal and external audits for employee benefit plans.
  • Coordinate and complete audits prior to regulated deadlines, including audits of retirement plan financial statements.
  • Manage audit findings and associated remediation activities.
  • Analyze and validate plan data to ensure accuracy and integrity across regulatory filings and supporting documentation.
  • Identify potential compliance risks and work with appropriate stakeholders to address them.
  • Maintain audit-ready records and documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Process Improvement

  • Partner with third-party administrators (TPAs), auditors, legal counsel, HR, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely submissions.
  • Drive process improvements related to benefits compliance and regulatory reporting.
  • Develop and maintain compliance reporting and performance metrics.
  • Support enterprise governance and compliance processes.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in Accounting and Auditing.
  • Experience with public company financial statements preferred.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and regulatory deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with benefits compliance, ERISA, retirement plans, or Health & Welfare plans.
  • Experience managing or supporting IRS Form 5500 filings.
  • Knowledge of U.S. benefits regulations, including ERISA, IRS, DOL, ACA, HIPAA, and COBRA.
  • Experience supporting SEC Form 11-K filings.
  • Familiarity with ACA reporting, including Forms 1094-B/C and 1095-B/C.
  • Experience supporting audits of employee benefit plans.
  • Experience with HRIS or benefits platforms such as Workday, SAP, or ADP.

job.title: Drafting/CAD Technician II
job.description:
100% Onsite-Mon-Fri, 8-5pm with 1hr lunch
No travel required

We are seeking a contract CAD Technician to support engineering, maintenance,
and operations teams with the creation, revision, control, and management of
technical drawings and related project documentation.

This role will focus on developing and maintaining accurate CAD drawings, supporting design detailing from initial engineering concepts, and ensuring drawing updates are properly reviewed, documented, and controlled within the established drawing
management/PDM system.

The CAD Technician will work closely with engineers to convert conceptual or
modeled designs into complete drawing packages, update existing drawings based
on field conditions, field markups, legacy drawings, or project changes, and
maintain drawing accuracy throughout the revision process.

This position will also
support project documentation needs, including drawing organization, redline
incorporation, legacy drawing digitization, revision tracking, basic engineering
computations, specification updates, and coordination of supporting technical
information.

In addition to supporting the engineering team, this role will interface with internal
customers, primarily operations and maintenance personnel, to document requests,
retrieve existing drawings, clarify drawing needs, and help ensure accurate
technical information is available to support daily plant activities, troubleshooting,
and project execution.

The ideal candidate will have strong CAD drafting capability, experience working in
a controlled documentation environment, attention to detail, and the ability to
communicate effectively with engineering and plant personnel.

Experience with SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar CAD platforms is preferred, along with familiarity with PDM or drawing vault systems, manufacturing environments, mechanical or electrical equipment documentation, and continuous improvement of drawing/documentation workflows.

EDUCATION
• Associate degree or 2-year technical degree in CAD/CAM, Mechanical
Engineering Technology, Electrical Engineering Technology,
Electromechanical Engineering Technology, Manufacturing Technology
• Minimum of 3 years of relevant CAD drafting, design support,
manufacturing documentation, or engineering support experience.

Required Skills:
Candidates must possess the following:
• Proficiency with SolidWorks or comparable 3D CAD software.
• Ability to create, revise, and maintain detailed drawings and drawing
packages.
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing
drawings.
• Working knowledge of GD&T and standard drafting practices.
• Experience updating drawings from redlines, field changes,
engineering input, or project documentation.
• Experience converting legacy drawings, sketches, field markups, or
other source documentation into accurate, controlled CAD drawings.
• Ability to support basic engineering calculations and prepare or revise
technical specifications under engineering direction.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and general computer-based
documentation tools.
• Strong attention to detail, organization, and document control
discipline.
• Ability to identify and recommend improvements to standard drawing,
documentation, and workflow processes.
• Able to train new employees or team members on established drawing
management, CAD, and documentation procedures.
• Self-motivated and able to work both independently and as part of a
team, with the ability to follow through on tasks with minimal
supervision while coordinating effectively with engineering,
maintenance, and operations personnel.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with AutoCAD.
• Experience working in a manufacturing, industrial, or plant engineering
environment.
• Familiarity with SolidWorks PDM or similar drawing vault/document
control systems.
• Experience supporting mechanical and/or electrical equipment
documentation.
• Familiarity with revision control, drawing release processes, and
controlled documentation practices.
• Hands-on understanding of manufacturing equipment, maintenance
needs, or field installation details.
• Experience with additive manufacturing or 3D printing is a plus.

• Strong troubleshooting skills with experience resolving rendering, delivery, and sending issues.

job.title: Administrative Support Specialist
job.description:
Position Overview

The Administrative Support Specialist provides intermediate-level administrative and technical support to various departments under general supervision. This position supports day-to-day office operations, document management, data entry, reporting, supply coordination, and other administrative functions.

Key Responsibilities

Administrative & Office Support

  • Perform daily office responsibilities, including answering phones, faxing, copying, filing, processing mail, and typing.
  • Process incoming and outgoing mail, overnight packages, certified mail, and other correspondence.
  • Meet and greet visitors and coordinate with vendors and consultants as needed.
  • Order, distribute, and maintain inventory of office supplies, food, badges, and other items.
  • Perform various data entry assignments accurately and efficiently.
  • Provide general administrative support to departments as assigned.
  • Provide receptionist coverage as needed.
  • Coordinate travel arrangements when required.

Documentation, Reporting & Process Support

  • Coordinate administrative processes and maintain related documents and records, which may include audit documentation.
  • Prepare, monitor, and maintain files, reports, records, systems, invoices, spreadsheets, and other business documents.
  • Perform analysis and review of assigned transactions as needed.
  • Maintain accurate and organized department records.
  • Serve as a department document control coordinator when assigned.
  • Ensure documentation is maintained according to established procedures and requirements.

Office & Facilities Support

  • Maintain the organization and cleanliness of conference rooms, boardrooms, reception areas, kitchens, and other assigned areas.
  • Ensure related office equipment and common areas remain organized and operational.
  • Travel to the local post office when required.
  • Perform additional assignments or administrative tasks as directed by management.

Qualifications

Education

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

Experience

  • 3–5 years of administrative, clerical, office support, data entry, or related experience.

Required Skills

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products, particularly Microsoft Excel and Word.
  • Ability to perform intermediate-level administrative, clerical, and data entry assignments.
  • Ability to follow established procedures and guidelines.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize responsibilities and take initiative.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Good problem-solving and listening skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Basic mathematical, reading, and writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
  • Ability to develop and maintain professional business relationships.
  • Dependable, punctual, flexible, and able to remain composed under pressure.
  • Ability to work effectively with employees at all levels of an organization.
  • Ability to lead scheduled safety meeting discussions and complete required safety training modules, depending on assignment.

Preferred Qualifications
Depending on the specific assignment and location, experience or knowledge in the following areas is preferred:

  • Commercial insurance
  • ACORD insurance forms
  • Procurement
  • ISO certification

Supervisory Responsibilities

job.title: Warehouse Management Systems Manager
job.description:
WMS Manager – Distribution Center

Location: Tifton, GA
Work Environment: On-Site
Department: Information Technology / Distribution Operations
Reports To: VP, Information Technology

Position Summary

Nesco is seeking an experienced WMS Manager to serve as the on-site subject matter expert for the Warehouse Management System at our client's Tifton, GA Distribution Center.

This position will work closely with Distribution Operations, IT, WMS vendors, and warehouse automation partners to ensure warehouse technology supports efficient receiving, inventory management, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, and fulfillment operations.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on WMS expertise with a strong understanding of distribution center operations. This individual will troubleshoot system and process issues, support warehouse automation, improve operational efficiency, and help optimize a recently implemented WMS environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary on-site owner and subject matter expert for the Distribution Center's WMS.

  • Provide daily WMS support for receiving, inventory, replenishment, allocation, waving, picking, packing, shipping, and fulfillment.

  • Troubleshoot issues involving the WMS, ERP integrations, automation, data, hardware, and warehouse processes.

  • Partner with Distribution Operations, IT, and technology vendors to resolve system and operational issues.

  • Monitor WMS performance and identify issues affecting productivity, inventory accuracy, and order flow.

  • Support warehouse automation technologies, including Exotec goods-to-person automation and Tompkins T-Sort.

  • Monitor interfaces and data flow between the WMS, ERP, automation platforms, and other warehouse technologies.

  • Support RF scanners, printers, mobile devices, and other technology used throughout the Distribution Center.

  • Analyze warehouse data, KPIs, inventory movement, and order flow to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.

  • Recommend and implement WMS configuration changes and process improvements to improve throughput, inventory accuracy, and efficiency.

  • Support WMS enhancements, upgrades, testing, deployments, and post-go-live stabilization.

  • Develop test scenarios and coordinate testing for system changes and integrations.

  • Create and maintain WMS documentation, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures.

  • Train warehouse supervisors, managers, super-users, and associates on WMS functionality and process changes.

  • Serve as the primary liaison between Distribution Center Operations and Corporate IT for WMS-related issues and initiatives.

  • Coordinate with WMS, automation, hardware, and technology vendors through issue resolution.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience supporting Warehouse Management Systems in a high-volume distribution or fulfillment environment.

  • Strong hands-on understanding of distribution center operations and fulfillment processes.

  • Experience supporting enterprise WMS platforms such as Manhattan, Blue Yonder/JDA, Körber/HighJump, Infor, SAP EWM, Intra1, or similar systems.

  • Experience troubleshooting WMS and warehouse process issues in a live production environment.

  • Experience with WMS configuration, testing, upgrades, deployments, implementations, and post-go-live support.

  • Strong knowledge of receiving, inventory control, replenishment, allocation, waving, picking, packing, shipping, and fulfillment.

  • Experience supporting ERP-to-WMS integrations and system interfaces.

  • Experience working with RF scanners, printers, mobile devices, and warehouse technology.

  • Experience with warehouse automation is strongly preferred.

  • Working knowledge of SQL and warehouse reporting tools is a plus.

  • Experience developing operational reports, dashboards, and KPIs.

  • Strong problem-solving, communication, vendor management, and project coordination skills.

Preferred Background

  • Experience in consumer products, apparel, retail, e-commerce, wholesale, or direct-to-consumer distribution.

  • Experience supporting automated picking, goods-to-person, sortation, or other warehouse automation technologies.

  • Experience with Exotec, Tompkins Robotics/T-Sort, or Hy-Tek Intra1 is a plus.

  • Experience supporting a WMS implementation, major upgrade, or post-go-live stabilization.

  • Previous leadership or management experience within Distribution Center Operations or Warehouse Systems is highly desirable.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on WMS professional to take ownership of a critical warehouse technology environment and play a key role in improving system performance, operational efficiency, and fulfillment capabilities at a high-volume Distribution Center.

job.title: Equipment Technician III
job.description:
Position Summary
Responsible for optimizing furnace performance and achieving OEE targets for assigned furnaces used in the production of glass boules. This role develops furnace run plans, monitors key process variables and equipment performance, and coordinates operational and maintenance activities to support safe, efficient, and high-quality production. The position works closely with management, maintenance, engineering, and equipment specialists to ensure reliable furnace operation and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities
Observe furnaces during production runs to ensure correct operation to set points.
Ensure furnaces adhere to furnace standards from a process, equipment, and operational perspective.
Analyze data output from furnaces for any variables or data that could impact quality.
Observe production process for adherence to specific tolerances.
Review and create docs and run plans for new production runs.
Prioritize maintenance and equipment issues for production meetings.
Analyze and review past runs to identify areas of improvement to address to Engineering.
Conduct rigorous review of any runs that produce a defective part to ensure high OEE.
Answer operator questions.
Ensure equipment and process are in line with standards and are completed in a timely manner.

Required Experience and Skills
Experience in a manufacturing, production, process, or equipment-related environment.

job.title: Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Semiconductor Equipment Maintenance Technician

Location: Albuquerque, NM
Shift: 6am -6pm (Sun-Tues AND Sun - Wed -- every other week)
Pay: $35-$45 hourly +Monthly KPI based Bonus 

****Direct hire - NOT contract or temp

Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Semiconductor Equipment Maintenance Technician to support the maintenance, troubleshooting, calibration, and continuous improvement of semiconductor wafer fabrication equipment. This position will work in a cleanroom manufacturing environment supporting advanced production equipment and thin-film semiconductor processes.
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience maintaining semiconductor processing equipment, strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills, and the ability to safely work with complex vacuum, chemical, and process systems.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Maintain standard operating conditions on assigned semiconductor production and facility-related equipment.
  • Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain semiconductor wafer fabrication equipment and supporting systems.
  • Perform preventative maintenance, equipment inspections, alignments, and calibrations in accordance with manufacturer and internal specifications.
  • Support thin-film semiconductor production equipment, including:
    • LPV – Low Pressure Vapor processes/equipment
    • LPCVD – Low Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition
    • CVD – Chemical Vapor Deposition
    • PVD – Physical Vapor Deposition
  • Maintain and troubleshoot AMAT Epi reactors and ASM Epi reactors.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot Wet Benches and associated semiconductor processing systems.
  • Troubleshoot equipment and process issues involving mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, vacuum, temperature, and process-control systems.
  • Assist with equipment installation, setup, qualification, and process improvements.
  • Support semiconductor production equipment such as thin-film deposition systems, wafer fabrication equipment, wet benches, and related process equipment.
  • Assist in identifying root causes of equipment failures and implementing corrective actions.
  • Maintain and improve equipment and process Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Document preventative maintenance, repairs, calibrations, and equipment performance.
  • Assist with training employees on equipment operation, maintenance procedures, and safety requirements.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work area in accordance with cleanroom and semiconductor manufacturing standards.
  • Follow all environmental, health, and safety (EHS) requirements, including proper PPE and chemical-handling procedures.
  • Participate in safety activities, drills, meetings, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Perform other maintenance and technical duties as assigned.
Required Qualifications
  • Associate degree, technical degree, certificate, or equivalent combination of education and hands-on experience.
  • 2+ years of experience working with semiconductor wafer fabrication or semiconductor manufacturing equipment preferred.
  • Experience troubleshooting and maintaining complex production equipment.
  • Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes and cleanroom protocols.
  • Experience with LPV, LPCVD, CVD, and/or PVD thin-film equipment strongly preferred.
  • Ability to troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, vacuum, and process-control systems.
  • Ability to safely work with chemicals and follow established EHS procedures.
  • Strong understanding of preventative maintenance, equipment calibration, and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Ability to read and follow technical documentation, equipment specifications, and SOPs.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work effectively in a highly controlled manufacturing environment.
Preferred Semiconductor Equipment Experience

Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:
  • LPV equipment
  • LPCVD systems
  • CVD systems
  • PVD systems
  • Thin-film deposition equipment
  • Semiconductor wafer fabrication equipment
  • Vacuum systems
  • Wet benches
  • Gas delivery systems
  • Process control systems
  • Temperature control systems
  • Semiconductor cleanroom equipment
  • Equipment alignment and calibration

Work Environment
This is an on-site semiconductor manufacturing position requiring work in a cleanroom/controlled manufacturing environment. The technician must be comfortable working around complex equipment, chemicals, vacuum systems, and semiconductor production processes while following strict safety and contamination-control procedures.

CTD113

job.title: CNC Operator
job.description:
CNC Operator

We are seeking an experienced CNC Operator/Machinist to join a growing manufacturing team. This position is ideal for someone with strong machining experience who can independently set up and operate CNC equipment while producing high-quality precision components. Candidates should be comfortable working from blueprints, maintaining tight tolerances, and contributing to a safe, team-oriented production environment.

Responsibilities

  • Set up and operate CNC lathes and/or mills to manufacture precision machined parts.

  • Read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, and work instructions.

  • Edit machine programs, speeds, and feeds as needed to optimize production.

  • Perform precision measurements using calipers, micrometers, gauges, and other measuring equipment.

  • Maintain close tolerances of ±0.001 " or better while ensuring product quality.

  • Perform machine setup changes for a variety of part configurations and production runs.

  • Operate secondary equipment such as drill presses, saws, tapping machines, and punch presses.

  • Deburr, clean, and inspect finished parts.

  • Troubleshoot machining issues and communicate production concerns to supervision.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.

  • Assist with training less experienced machinists when needed.

  • Follow all company safety policies and quality standards.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of CNC machining experience in a manufacturing environment.

  • Experience setting up and operating CNC lathes and/or mills.

job.title: Maintenance Technician (Mechanic)
job.description:
This position is responsible for ensuring equipment integrity and timely repair.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Effectively supporting the Preventative Maintenance (PM) program with a goal of continually reducing unscheduled downtime.
  • Analyzing problems and interpreting technical information necessary to make required repairs, including troubleshooting equipment issues.
  • Performing mechanical and electrical maintenance and repairs on production machinery and facility support equipment.
  • Inspecting, operating, and testing machinery or equipment to diagnose machine malfunction and validate work performed.
  • Ensuring safety by following all company policies, including safety rules, procedures, Lock-out/Tag-out procedures, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP's), personal safety standards, food safety standards, as well as OSHA standards.
  • Troubleshooting PLC controlled equipment and all plant electrical and mechanical systems, including motors, instrumentation, distribution, and feed control systems, and developing sustainable solutions accordingly.
  • Completing all assigned work orders within the time allotted.
  • Maintaining complete records of work performed using software, work orders, and detailed logs, and having good communication skills across all groups/departments.
  • Assisting with equipment changeovers and line startups, troubleshooting issues as needed.
  • Identifying required parts and maintaining current inventories and parts reorder lists.
  • Assuring that all products are manufactured to the highest standard of quality.
  • Participating in Continuous Improvement, providing suggestions to improve processes, and participating in team projects.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to lift 50-80 lbs. Performs highly repetitive motions, stand for eight plus hours, talk, and hear.
  • Ability to climb ladders, stairways, use a manlift/scissorlift at ceiling heights or above with proper safety equipment, and work in a non-air conditioned environment.
  • While performing job duties, the associate will frequently walk, use hands to feel or handle, and reach with hands and arms. Frequent exposure to oils and greases or coolants.
  • While performing job duties, the associate will occasionally sit, climb or balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, and smell. Occasional exposure to wet and/or humid conditions; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; outside weather conditions; extreme heat; and vibration.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Location: Defiance, OH
Position Type: Contract to Hire (Staffing)
Pay Range: $19.00

Position Summary
The Operator will properly carry out all duties as defined below under the Work Performed category. This person will be charged with correctly following all SOP guidelines related to this job. All work will be performed in a safe and sanitary manner. Duties include, but are not limited to, proper mixing of powdered products to meet customer-defined specifications as measured by bulk density, particle size, customer liquification tests, and powder flow. Proper cleanup and sanitation of all equipment surfaces during and after production are essential. A thorough knowledge and understanding of all equipment and controls is necessary for successful qualification.
Essential Functions

  • Properly and safely set up all operational parameters and related equipment prior to production start-up as described in the SOP.
  • Operate all necessary equipment during production to maintain powder quality and consistency.
  • Properly and safely shut down machinery and related equipment per SOP requirements.
  • Clean and sanitize all equipment associated with operations, including product contact surfaces.
  • Complete all operating and cleaning checklists accurately.
  • Maintain peak operating efficiency of all equipment.
  • Keep work areas clean, neat, and dry throughout the shift.
  • Attend all required company training sessions, including Safety and GMP training.

job.title: Maintenance Mechanic
job.description:
Maintenance Mechanic – 2nd Shift
Manufacturing | Connecticut | $30 – $36/hr

Are you a hands-on maintenance professional who takes pride in keeping a facility running at peak performance? We're partnering with a well-established Connecticut manufacturer to place a skilled Maintenance Mechanic on their 2nd shift team. This is a direct opportunity to join a company that invests in its people, values safety above all else, and offers a highly competitive hourly rate for the right candidate.

What You'll Do

You'll play a critical role in maintaining the equipment and systems that keep production moving. Day to day, you can expect to:

  • Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair a wide range of mechanical equipment — from compressors and motors to conveyor systems, cranes, forklifts, and production machinery
  • Dismantle and rebuild equipment, identify defective components, and coordinate with your supervisor when outside services or parts orders are needed
  • Test machinery post-repair to confirm proper operation, with support from toolmakers and qualified operators
  • Operate metalworking tools including brake and shear equipment, cutting torches, and plasma cutters; perform welding and electrical wiring repairs
  • Fabricate guards and frames for production machines
  • Maintain the facility's Wastewater Treatment System in compliance with all current regulations
  • Execute preventative maintenance inspections, complete required documentation, and keep equipment properly lubricated and cleaned
  • Support facility needs including snow removal as required
  • Champion a safe work environment by adhering to all safety protocols and maintaining current certifications in Lock-Out/Tag-Out, Welding & Cutting Safety, Confined Space Entry, Fall Protection, Respiratory Protection, and HAZWOPER

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of maintenance experience in a manufacturing environment
  • Ability to perform hands-on repairs including welding, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts — you can work through a problem methodically and communicate your process to the team
  • Self-starter mentality with the ability to prioritize multiple issues as they arise
  • Team player who isn't afraid to ask for help and knows when to loop in support
  • Commitment to safety as a non-negotiable standard, not an afterthought

Physical Requirements

This role is active and physical in nature. You'll be on your feet in a manufacturing environment, regularly walking, standing, stooping, kneeling, and reaching. Must be able to lift up to 35 lbs. The environment involves moderate to high noise levels, vibration, moving mechanical parts, and exposure to fumes or airborne particles. Close vision, depth perception, and manual dexterity are required.

job.title: Quality Engineer - (Automotive)
job.description:
Contract to Direct Hire opportunity for the right candidate!

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

Job Summary:
The Quality Engineer is responsible for developing, controlling, and assuring quality processes and product requirements are executed for a given customer program, including applicable site-specific requirements. The role will develop, control, and apply inspection procedures and controls that allow for the determination and evaluation of risk. The Quality Engineer will employ tools and techniques to resolve deficient quality processes and resulting output.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Develop comprehensive quality plans to assure program quality objectives and customer requirements are satisfied and train affected personnel on quality plan elements.
Support International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 9001 compliance within assigned sites.
Participate in the Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) process with the objective of developing and maintaining program specific control plans and related documentation.
Assist in the assessment and selection process of suppliers, including resolving supplier quality issues when necessary.
Support as necessary incoming, in-process, and End of Line (EOL) inspection and testing,
including equipment calibration or verification.
Track and resolve quality issues with customers and suppliers, including managing Material Review Board (MRB) and Return to Vendor (RTV) process and product disposition.
Approve and submit first article Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) in support of program requirements for suppliers and customers.
Perform problem solving and continual improvement activities where process or product quality is deficient.
Perform written and verbal reporting and communication, present quality presentations as required and participate in internal and external meetings.
Support reporting Quality of Service (QOS) metrics for assigned operating group and programs.


Education and Experience (required):
Associates Degree in a relevant manufacturing or technical field.
3 years of related quality experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Education and Experience (preferred):
Bachelor's Degree in technically related field.
American Society of Quality (ASQ) certification.

Skills, Knowledge and Abilities (required):
Experience in APQP process preparation of PPAP documentation including submission to customer and a thorough understanding of problem-solving and quality improvement tools and techniques.
Able to interpret engineering drawings, related specifications and requirements and communicate them to the cross-function team.
Working knowledge of a quality management system its implementation and associated documentation requirements with the ability to plan, control and assure quality processes and product in accordance with quality plan and customer requirement.
Understanding of the audit process including planning, preparation, execution, reporting results and follow-up.
Ability to interact professionally on a technical level with all company functional groups, suppliers, customers, and demonstration of strong PC skills.

Skills, Knowledge and Abilities (preferred):
Knowledge of second stage vehicle conversion and upfit of vehicles.
Knowledge of manufacturing engineering skills.

job.description:

This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled machinist with hands-on CNC experience and strong programming capabilities to play an important role in producing high-quality plastic components.

The ideal candidate will have practical machining experience, including CNC programming, machine setup, fixturing, and operation of 3- and 4-axis CNC equipment. Experience with Mastercam or similar CAD/CAM software is required.

Mon-Fri
1st shift: 7 to 3
Pay $22-$35 based on experience

Key Responsibilities

  • Program, set up, and operate 3- and 4-axis CNC machines and CNC routers.
  • Develop and modify CNC programs using Mastercam or similar CAD/CAM software.

The successful candidate will be a detail-oriented, hands-on professional who understands machining processes and can effectively program, set up, operate, and troubleshoot CNC equipment. A strong understanding of machining principles, tooling, feeds and speeds, and quality control is essential.

job.title: Instrumentation Technician
job.description:
Multiple Levels and Positions! $25-$40/hour Depending on Experience.  
Schedule: 4, 10s; Monday-Thursday 6am to 4:30pm (occasional OT)  
Position Type: 6 Month Contract 

Top Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship required – due to work on a Department of Energy (DOE) site 
  • No Green Card holders or Visa candidates – must be a U.S. citizen to access the site.
  • Site Location: Industrial/nuclear environment.

Role Overview:

  • While the role includes calibration duties, it is expanding into instrumentation and controls (I&C)—broader in scope than traditional calibration.
  • Looking for candidates with instrumentation experience beyond just calibration, ideally with electrical troubleshooting skills.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Install, connect & troubleshoot various measurement & control devices (instrumentation).
  • Valve work is a major part of the role — knowledge in this area is essential.
  • Set up and maintain devices such as temperature, pressure, and flow sensors, switches, valves, and control panels.
  • Work with pneumatic and electronic systems.
  • Use tools like Set Route (software program) to verify electrical components & wiring.
  • Troubleshoot malfunctioning devices & assist calibration techs in determining whether the issue is with the device or a calibration issue.
  • Repair or replace equipment depending on diagnostics and cost-benefit analysis (e.g., when to quote vs. replace).
  • Understand the mechanical and electrical aspects of industrial instruments.
  • Collaborate closely with the calibration team — act as the instrumentation expert who can support and mentor calibration staff.

Ideal Background:

  • Experience in industrial environments: petrochemical, pharmaceutical, or nuclear sectors.
  • Solid knowledge of instrumentation and control systems.
  • Basic knowledge of calibration is a plus.
  • Strong electrical troubleshooting ability.
  • Able to interpret technical diagrams (e.g., P&ID) and manufacturer specifications.
  • Hands-on experience with installation, repair, and maintenance of instrumentation equipment.
  • Team-oriented and capable of mentoring less experienced calibration techs.
  • Experience working with multimeters and similar diagnostic tools.
  • P&ID diagrams to verify system setups and processes is a plus.

Additional Notes:

  • Candidates should not expect a typical calibration-only role — this position goes well beyond and is focused on instrumentation, field diagnostics, and system repair.
  • Strong candidates may come from an I&E Technician background, with experience in:
    • Plant lighting systems
    • Thermostat systems
    • Programmable logic controllers (PLCs)
    • Reading and interpreting blueprints
    • Disassembling/reassembling complex instrumentation systems

job.title: Consultant, Consumer Analytics
job.description:
Consultant – Consumer Analytics

Position Overview

The Consultant, Consumer Analytics is responsible for supporting the effective and efficient deployment of analytics, intelligence, and resources across Consumer Analytics, Paid Media, Central Capabilities, and Business Unit functions.

This role will develop a deep understanding of U.S. consumer data sources and create processes to test, analyze, and communicate key findings to business decision-makers. A strong emphasis will be placed on performance marketing and performance marketing analytics, ensuring consumer investments are effectively measured, optimized, and translated into actionable recommendations across media channels.

The Consultant will connect campaign performance, audience behavior, attribution, and business outcomes to enable agile decision-making and improve overall marketing effectiveness. This individual will also be a key contributor to the integration and coordination of analytics and data throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement designed experiments, attribution analyses, and other analytical approaches to optimize investments across consumer channels.
  • Translate analytical outputs into actionable business insights and recommendations for media optimization.
  • Lead the design and execution of brand analytics priorities and learning agendas, including:
    • Audience design
    • Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA)
    • Multicultural Marketing
    • Creative Analysis
    • DMA strategy
    • Behavioral journeys
  • Develop a strong understanding of Brand and Business Unit consumer strategies, key decision points, and specific analytical needs.
  • Integrate and analyze relevant data to answer key business questions.
  • Leverage Agentic AI to enhance analytical processes, insights, and outputs.
  • Identify and prioritize capability investments and data requirements needed to achieve consumer objectives.
  • Develop and operationalize intelligence as a product in partnership with Customer Insights & Analytics product teams.
  • Manage analytical priorities and recommend appropriate sourcing strategies, including internal resources and external suppliers.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy requirements and contractual obligations related to the use of data.
  • Support additional key initiatives and special projects as needed.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in Consumer Media, Media Analytics, and/or Performance Marketing.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with performance marketing, consumer media analytics, and media optimization.
  • Experience working with first- and third-party data sources, including:
    • Meta
    • TikTok
    • Reddit
    • DSP platforms
    • Google Analytics
    • Adobe Analytics
    • Log files
  • Experience analyzing media channels and associated data, including:
    • Linear TV
    • Over-the-Top (OTT)
    • Direct Digital
    • Programmatic Digital
    • Social Media
  • Experience with Multi-Touch Attribution, audience analytics, campaign measurement, and media performance analysis.
  • Experience with statistical modeling techniques.
  • Experience with Agentic AI, including creating agents, artifacts, or related solutions.
  • Knowledge of SAS, R, SQL, SSIS, or other statistical and data-mining tools.
  • Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio, or other data visualization platforms.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong analytical skills combined with business acumen and the ability to think strategically in ambiguous environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal, influencing, and prioritization abilities with excellent attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively lead, influence, and challenge stakeholders ranging from associate through executive levels.
  • Experience with consumer media and/or optimization consulting.
  • Highly motivated with the ability to develop creative solutions to challenging business problems.

Travel

  • Approximately 10–20% travel, depending on business needs.

job.title: Mechanical Engineer - CATIA V5 (Secret)
job.description:
Description:
This position supports all Flight Test Instrumentation based out of the LM Aero Marietta site.

Responsibilities will include instrumentation mechanical design and support for AMMM and Advanced Development Programs. Primary responsibility will be drafting mechanical drawings for C-130 aircraft.

Candidate will design, develop, document, and support the installation and operation of data acquisition systems for aircraft flight testing. Daily tasks will include mechanical and hardware design and system integration. Designs for instrumentation will include, but are not limited to, strain gages, thermocouples, pressure transducers, accelerometers, displacement transducers, synchro's, microphones, calibration methods, and aircraft test instrumentation racks. Will coordinate with the Electrical instrumentation and Systems engineers on the solutions to data acquisition products. Will work with union-represented technicians and mechanics to fabricate and install instrumentation designs. Implement designs with CATIA V5 and CCD (CADAM Computer Drafting).

•Minimum of 5 years of experience in part design, assembly design, and drawing in CATIA V5.
•Minimum of 5 years of experience with CADAM Computer Drafting (CCD) or other 2D drafting software
•Minimum of 3 years of experience with test instrumentation (strain gages, pressure transducers, accelerometers, thermocouples, etc.)
•Must be able to obtain DoD Security clearance at a minimum level of Secret

Desired Skills
•Minimum of 2 years with C-130 or other aircraft structural design
•Experience working in a machine shop with fabrication mechanics
•Minimum of 1 year of experience with CAD Datanet
•DoD Security clearance at a Secret level or higher

This role focuses on building data pipelines, validating and integrating data from multiple sources, and delivering analytical insights through reporting and dashboarding solutions.

The position works closely with technical developers, data scientists, suppliers, and business stakeholders to support data governance, project tracking, document processing, and AI-driven initiatives designed to identify trends and improve team effectiveness.

• Python 3.10+ experience with production-level scripting and development of deterministic data pipelines, including ETL processes, linking logic, and data validation.
• Experience with AWS services including S3, Lambda, and boto3.
• Strong data cleaning, data integration, and document processing capabilities.
• Experience designing data models and entity-linking solutions, including key and join design across datasets.
• SQL proficiency.
• Experience with dashboarding tools, including Tableau.
• Experience using Databricks.
• Experience with API development, including FastAPI and basic frontend-backend integration.
• Ability to collaborate cross-functionally, build consensus, influence stakeholders, and communicate future-state solutions.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Frontend development experience, including technologies such as React.

job.title: Compounder
job.description:
Title: Compounder
Shift: M-Th 5AM-3:30PM
Pay: $21.00 per hour

GENERAL DESCRIPTION: The Compounder I is responsible for weighing batches and manufactures product batches according to formula procedures and operating processing equipment in one or more functions of manufacturing. This position is under the direct supervision of the Compounding Supervisor and Sr. Compounding Supervisor.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES/FUNCTIONS:
Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• Weigh ingredients as required following formulas/written procedures using approved/calibrated scales.
• Ensure all ingredients are weighed and placed into the proper sanitized containers.
• Wash, sanitize, and set up all necessary manufacturing equipment used in making cosmetic and/or drink batches using cGMP procedures.
• Compound lotions, creams, shampoos, soap products, drinks etc., by combining and mixing the ingredients per formula and written procedures.
• Use Drum Manipulator to dump ingredients into holding tank or container with no waste due to mishandling.
• Properly operate processing equipment (i.e., pumps, tanks, mixers, etc.)
• Draw a sample of product from the tank to be taken to lab for testing.
• Initial batch sheets and sign tank cards to verify that the formulas/procedures were followed when compounding each product.
• Identify incorrectly prepared batches and inform Supervisor(s) immediately.
• Fix incorrectly prepared batches by following formulas/written procedures and using math skills to problem-solve formulas.
• always Keep compounding area clean.
• Safely operate forklift to move pallets, drums, tanks around the department.
• Use the current inventory system for weighing
• Comply with Company SOPs and safety guidelines.
• Adjust the speed of the mixer when necessary.
• Make minor repairs to the facilities and equipment such as cleaning air conditioning vents and cleaning off insulation of pipe work.
• Fill in for employees on vacation or call-ins when necessary.
• Assist packaging and lab personnel when needed.
• Additional duties may be assigned as needed.


SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:
N/A

COMPETENCIES:

• Accountability
• Adaptability
• Attention to detail
• Communication proficiency
• Customer/client focus
• Flexibility
• Focus on quality
• Initiative
• Problem solving
• Technical capacity
• Verbal expression
• Written expression


QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS REQUIRED TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:
• Understand the full process of the Compounding Department.
• Knowledge of safe forklift operation or able to be trained to drive a forklift safely.
• Ability to read and write English to read and follow formulas, procedures and equipment instructions.
• Ability to accurately convert measurements.
• Computer proficiency: Microsoft Office and data entry.
• Manage multiple tasks at one time.
• Be familiar with the current inventory system (RF Gen).

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:
• Able to lift up to 50 pounds on a regular basis.
• Manual dexterity for record keeping.
• Stand/remain upright for periods of up to 4 hours at a time.
• Bend, squat, kneel, balance, turn, and stoop.
• Reach forward and overhead.
• Good eye/hand coordination.
• If driving a forklift, ability to operate and drive forklift safely.
• Able to meet and follow all OSHA recommendations per product compounded
• Able to climb ladders up to 10 feet.
• Ability to use controls to operate and drive a forklift.

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE REQUIRED TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:
• High school education or GED required.
• 1 year of work experience in a manufacturing environment preferred.
• 1 year of work experience in compounding required.

The Inventory Control Clerk is responsible for the performance of inventory control functions to maintain the accuracy and integrity of data and ensure the proper storage of materials per internal and external requirements. They will perform record keeping activities, auditing, data entry activities, and coordinate information among related departments, monitor inventory, report problems, and meet company and department objectives.

Why join?

  • Opportunities for career growth

Job Summary

  • Performs visual verification of material items, monitors inventory levels, and reports or anticipates problems and shortages.

  • Performs general housekeeping activities in storage areas.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • Must be able to open and close wooden crates by using crowbars, hammers, nails, staple guns, or other related equipment.
