job.title: Project Finance Manager- Construction/Utilities
job.description:
Project Finance Manager- Construction/Utilities

Finance + Projects + Customer Relationships

We're looking for an experienced finance professional who understands how projects operate in the real world. This role combines financial analysis, project management, customer communication, and operational support within a construction, industrial, manufacturing, or oil & gas environment.

The ideal candidate has a strong accounting or finance background, hands-on P&L experience, and the confidence to work directly with customers and project teams. This is a primarily office-based role with customer meetings and occasional site visits.

Pay & Benefits

Compensation: $80,000–$100,000 (based on experience)

Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans

Retirement: 401(k)

Time Off: Paid time off and paid holidays

Additional Coverage: Life and disability programs

Employment Type: Direct hire, long-term opportunity

What You'll Do

  • Manage financial reporting and project cost analysis for active projects.

  • Monitor project budgets, costs, revenue, margins, and overall financial performance.

  • Prepare and analyze P&Ls, forecasts, budgets, and financial reports.

  • Build reports and financial models using Excel and internal financial/ERP systems.

  • Work closely with project managers and operations leadership to identify financial issues and opportunities.

  • Communicate directly with customers regarding project financial information, status, and business needs.

  • Participate in customer meetings and visit customer or project sites as needed.

  • Investigate cost variances and recommend ways to improve project profitability.

  • Support project planning, forecasting, and financial decision-making from project start through completion.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration with an Accounting focus, or a closely related field.

  • 4–5+ years of professional experience in finance, accounting, project finance, project controls, or a similar role.

  • Previous hands-on P&L experience is required.

  • Professional experience in construction, industrial, manufacturing, oil & gas, or another heavy project-based environment is required.

  • Strong understanding of project financials, job costing, budgets, forecasting, and profitability.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including building financial reports from scratch.

  • Experience working with ERP, accounting, or financial reporting systems.

  • Proven ability to communicate directly with customers and internal operational teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large or complex projects.

  • Experience working directly with project managers, field personnel, or operations leadership.

  • Construction, industrial, manufacturing, or oil & gas project finance experience.

  • Experience presenting financial information to customers, leadership, or project stakeholders.

  • Experience identifying opportunities to improve project margins and financial performance.

What Makes Someone Successful Here?

  • Business-minded: Understands what the numbers mean, not just how to calculate them.

  • Confident communicator: Comfortable talking with customers, project managers, and operations teams.

  • Detail-oriented: Catches discrepancies before they become expensive problems.

  • Hands-on: Comfortable moving between financial analysis, project discussions, and customer-facing responsibilities.

  • Accountable: Takes ownership and follows issues through to resolution.

  • Adaptable: Can operate effectively in a fast-moving construction or industrial environment.

Work Environment

This is a project-driven, operational environment—not a traditional corporate finance role. The position is primarily office-based but includes customer meetings, project discussions, and occasional visits to customer or job sites. Candidates should be comfortable working with both financial professionals and hands-on project and operations teams.

Why Join Us?

  • High-visibility role with direct impact on project and business performance

  • Regular interaction with customers, project managers, and operational leadership

  • Opportunity to combine finance expertise with real-world project management

  • Long-term career opportunity with room for professional growth

The Cell Technician will perform a variety of simple to complex assembly and testing operations with minimal supervision. This position is responsible for assembling products to established procedures and specifications, operating testing equipment, performing dimensional inspections, and ensuring completed assemblies meet customer and quality requirements.

The ideal candidate is mechanically inclined, detail-oriented, comfortable working with tools and measuring equipment, and able to read and interpret assembly drawings, procedures, and work instructions.

job.description:
Job Description

Manufacturing Engineering Technician

Hours: M-F 8-5pm (OT as needed)

Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced Manufacturing Engineering Technician to support engineers in improving manufacturing processes through machine setup, production trials, sample collection, testing, and data analysis. This role works closely with Manufacturing Engineers and production operators to evaluate process performance, identify issues, and recommend improvements that enhance quality, efficiency, safety, and operator effectiveness.

The ideal candidate will have 7+ years of manufacturing experience, strong hands-on troubleshooting skills, the ability to work independently, and experience using Excel to collect, organize, and analyze production data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support Manufacturing Engineers with process development, improvement, and optimization activities.
  • Perform machine and equipment setups for production and experimental trials.
  • Plan and execute sequences of operations for experimental and process trials.
  • Collect production samples and perform testing, measurements, and analysis throughout the manufacturing process.
  • Collect, organize, and analyze manufacturing and process data using Microsoft Excel.
  • Monitor key process variables and evaluate whether processes remain within established controls and requirements.
  • Identify manufacturing problems by reviewing relevant facts, evidence, production data, and process conditions.
  • Independently troubleshoot and resolve the majority of day-to-day manufacturing issues.
  • Work closely with Manufacturing Engineers, Process Engineers, Operators, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Evaluate different manufacturing methods while considering cost, efficiency, process requirements, and operator safety and comfort.
  • Coordinate activities beyond routine assignments and support engineering trials and process improvement projects.
  • Recommend improvements to manufacturing processes, equipment setups, procedures, and operating methods.
  • Support production deadlines and engineering project schedules.
  • Escalate issues that cross functional areas or may have broader operational impact.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and protect confidential technical and manufacturing information.
  • Follow all applicable safety, quality, manufacturing, and compliance requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • AAS/Associate degree preferred but not required.
  • 7+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong hands-on understanding of manufacturing processes and production environments.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and manufacturing operators.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot problems and make sound technical decisions.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Excel, including organizing and analyzing production data.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

job.title: Data Engineer
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Data Engineer to develop, maintain, test, and debug software and data integration solutions in both traditional and cloud-based environments. This role focuses on building and supporting scalable applications, data pipelines, and modern data platform solutions using technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, Oracle, Microsoft SQL, .NET, and related tools.
The position involves designing and maintaining ETL/ELT processes, defining system requirements through research and analysis, preparing detailed technical specifications, and ensuring reliable, high-quality data integration solutions that support business needs.

Core Responsibilities
• Develop, maintain, test, debug, document, and support software applications and data integration solutions across traditional and cloud environments.
• Design, build, and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data processing solutions using modern cloud data platforms.
• Formulate and define system scope, objectives, and technical requirements through research, analysis, and fact-finding.
• Prepare detailed specifications, data mappings, and technical documentation for application and data integration development.
• Develop and support cloud-based data pipelines and storage solutions utilizing Azure Data Factory and Azure Data Lake Storage.
• Design, implement, and maintain Snowflake-based data solutions, including streams, tasks, and pipeline processing.
• Monitor, troubleshoot, tune, and support production data environments to ensure performance, reliability, and data integrity.
• Collaborate within development and data engineering workflows using Git, CI/CD processes, and Azure DevOps.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) and Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) for cloud-based data pipelines and storage.
• Strong knowledge of Snowflake architecture, including streams, tasks, and pipeline processing.
• Experience with data ingestion tools such as Fivetran and HVR, and data transformation using dbtLabs.
• Understanding of batch and near real-time data integration patterns.
• Ability to design, implement, and support scalable cloud data architecture.
• Experience with Git, CI/CD practices, and Azure DevOps in data engineering environments.
• Experience documenting ETL designs, data mappings, and technical architecture.
• Knowledge of data integrity, governance, lineage, production monitoring, and performance tuning.
• Experience working with technologies such as PL/SQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL, .NET, Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, and related data platform tools.

Associate Director, Business Insights & Analytics – HCP Media

Position Overview

The Associate Director, Business Insights & Analytics (BI&A) – HCP Media will partner across teams to evolve best-in-class analytical approaches and measurement practices for digital and direct Healthcare Professional (HCP) Media.

This individual will collaborate closely with HCP Media, Omnichannel, Marketing, Business Insights & Analytics, Technology, Media Agency teams, and other cross-functional partners. The Associate Director will serve as a player-coach, developing enterprise-wide analytical approaches while helping others adopt and effectively deliver these capabilities.

The ideal candidate brings experience with HCP media and thrives in a constantly evolving, data-driven environment. This individual should have a demonstrated track record of using analytics to influence key business decisions while working with a diverse group of technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This position reports to the Senior Director, BI&A Media Product.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop a strong understanding of current HCP media execution and performance, brand and business unit strategies, media objectives, and available data sources.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to enhance existing analytical solutions or develop new approaches that improve media efficiency, effectiveness, and measurement.
  • Collaborate with BI&A expertise and delivery teams, including U.S.- and India-based teams, throughout analytical discovery and development.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize analytical approaches, methodologies, and best practices across the organization.
  • Ensure analytical methodologies and code are clearly documented to increase scalability, reusability, and efficiency.
  • Identify and prioritize capability investments and data requirements needed to support BI&A and U.S. media objectives.
  • Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with a broad range of stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
  • Ensure business decisions are supported by strong analytical evidence and objective, data-driven insights.
  • Effectively challenge and influence stakeholders ranging from individual contributors through senior leadership.
  • Coordinate learning and knowledge-sharing across BI&A teams and cross-functional partners.
  • Ensure analytical insights and best practices are shared and applied across brands.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy requirements and contractual obligations related to the use of data.
  • Support additional strategic initiatives and special projects as needed.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Marketing, Mathematics, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may also be considered.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant industry experience.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employment visa sponsorship.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Direct experience analyzing digital and/or direct media performance.
  • Experience with HCP Media, HCP Marketing, and/or Omnichannel strategies.
  • Knowledge of R, SQL, SSIS, or another statistical/programming language.
  • Strong Excel modeling capabilities.
  • Experience working with first- and third-party data sources, including:
    • CRM data
    • SOA data
    • DMP platforms
    • DSP platforms
    • Google Analytics
    • Log files
  • Experience with Tableau or other data visualization platforms.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience applying statistical modeling techniques.
  • Experience working with prescription claims data.
  • Strong analytical capabilities combined with business acumen and strategic thinking.
  • Ability to operate effectively in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment.
  • Strong ability to simplify complex information, communicate findings clearly, and educate others.
  • Demonstrated success influencing without direct authority, including interactions with senior leadership.
  • Proven success delivering complex, cross-functional projects.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, interpersonal, organizational, and prioritization skills.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Highly collaborative approach and ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
  • High level of motivation with a demonstrated ability to develop creative solutions to challenging business problems.

Work Environment & Travel

  • Location: Indianapolis, IN
  • Work Arrangement: Indianapolis-based; remote candidates may be considered.
  • Travel: Less than 10%.

job.title: Production Worker - 1st Shift
job.description:
Title: Production Worker
Shift: 1st Shift 5AM-3:30PM - Monday through Friday
Pay: $16.00 per hour

GENERAL DESCRIPTION: Ensures that the quality and quantity of packaged goods conforms to the company’s standards and works under the general direction of production management.

*This position is a safety-sensitive position. Safety-sensitive positions are defined as positions where the employee operates, repairs, maintains or monitors the performance or operation of a motor vehicle, equipment, machinery, or power tools. Safety-sensitive positions also include jobs where the tasks or duties required of the employee could affect the safety or health of the employee performing the task or others.*
ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES/FUNCTIONS:
  • Follow all Good Manufacturing Practices.
  • Follow good health and hygiene practices including gowning.
  • Follow procedures for changing gloves in between raw materials.
  • Follow GMPs at all times.
  • Clean equipment, utensils and room according to approved cleaning procedures.
  • Follow directions on batch production record.
  • Inspect all pouches coming off the line for imperfections.
  • Put the product into the shippers and seal them with tape that’s provided.
  • Stack full shippers on pallets and repeat process while production is running.
  • Look for any imperfections on the shippers.
  • Notify maintenance with any issues that need attention on the packaging line.
  • Work cooperatively with co-workers and supervisors
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance at work.
  • All other duties as assigned.
 
MARGINAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
  • Setting up the processes to run product for production.
  • Confirm that everything is set up and running safely.
  • Spot check product quality while production is running.
 
QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS REQUIRED TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units of measure.
  • Ability to speak, read and write in English.
  • Operate a pallet jack
 
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:
  • Stand and walk on hard surfaces for long periods of time, up to 4 hours at a time.
  • Stand/remain upright and stationary for long periods of time, up to 4 hours.
  • Kneel, bend, stoop and squat repetitively.
  • Twist and turn repeatedly.
  • Reach down, forward and overhead repeatedly.
  • Use personal protective equipment (PPE), ear plugs, gloves, lab coat, hair net, face mask, etc.
  • Lift up to 50lbs.
 
EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE REQUIRED TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:
  • High School diploma or GED preferred.

Description:
This position is to support our IAMD development in Integration and Test Discipline.

Plans, implements, tests, documents, and maintains solutions for the integration and testing of in-house developed and COTS/GOTS components, elements, subsystems and/or systems.

Writes discrepancy reports and performs integration regression testing to verify/validate incorporated fixes to software, components, subsystems and systems.

Candidate must be capable of developing advanced test plans, test procedures, test execution schedules, and test reports to support customer and key stakeholder reviews.

job.title: Project Engineer – Modular Data Center Infrastructure
job.description:
Position Overview

Our team is seeking an experienced Project Engineer to support the engineering, design, and delivery of modular data center infrastructure projects. This position is ideal for a hands-on Mechanical Engineer or Electrical Engineer with 7+ years of engineering and design experience, particularly within data centers, industrial facilities, large-scale infrastructure, or complex manufacturing environments.

The Project Engineer will take ownership of key technical aspects of projects from initial design through construction, commissioning, and final delivery. The role requires strong mechanical and piping knowledge, the ability to interpret and approve engineering documentation, and the communication skills necessary to work directly with clients and cross-functional project teams.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Engineering Leadership

  • Support the Engineering Manager in delivering complex data center projects.
  • Take ownership of assigned engineering and technical workstreams.
  • Coordinate with Project Management, Sales, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Construction, and other engineering disciplines.
  • Lead technical discussions and provide guidance to engineering team members.
  • Assist with onboarding and mentoring engineers as project demands increase.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Engineering Design & Technical Oversight

  • Review and approve engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, and technical documentation.
  • Ensure designs meet customer requirements, applicable codes, safety regulations, and engineering best practices.
  • Develop engineering scopes of work, execution plans, schedules, and technical deliverables.
  • Coordinate designs across multiple projects and customers.
  • Identify technical issues and develop practical engineering solutions.

Mechanical & Piping Engineering

Develop and review engineering deliverables including:

  • Equipment lists
  • Valve lists
  • Piping layouts and line lists
  • Mechanical equipment datasheets
  • Pipe sizing calculations
  • Pipe stress analysis
  • Piping load information for structural engineering
  • Mechanical system specifications
  • Technical requisitions for mechanical equipment and systems

Support the engineering and design of:

  • Mechanical systems
  • Industrial piping systems
  • Fire protection and fire suppression systems
  • Equipment mounting and installation systems
  • Modular infrastructure and related mechanical systems

Client & Construction Support

  • Serve as a technical point of contact for customers and project stakeholders.
  • Participate in customer meetings, design reviews, site visits, and commissioning activities.
  • Answer technical questions and provide engineering support during construction.
  • Troubleshoot engineering and installation issues in the field.
  • Review and manage engineering changes and technical documentation.
  • Support projects through construction, startup, and commissioning.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, cost, and project execution.
  • Stay current with data center technologies, engineering practices, and industry trends.
  • Evaluate coatings, mounting systems, installation methods, and other technical solutions.
  • Promote engineering best practices and lessons learned across projects.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • 7+ years of mechanical engineering and design experience.
  • Experience supporting industrial facilities, large infrastructure projects, data centers, manufacturing facilities, or similar complex environments.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical and piping systems.
  • Experience with fire protection/fire suppression systems.
  • Experience supporting construction and commissioning activities.
  • Ability to review and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
  • Strong understanding of engineering codes, standards, and regulations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities.

Preferred Technical Experience

Experience with the following software is preferred:

  • SolidWorks
  • Autodesk Revit
  • AutoCAD
  • BIM 360
  • Navisworks

Experience with the following codes and industry standards is highly desirable:

  • AISI – American Iron and Steel Institute
  • ANSI – American National Standards Institute
  • ASME B&PV Section VIII, Section IX, and B31.3
  • ASTM – American Society for Testing and Materials
  • AWS – American Welding Society
  • IBC – International Building Code
  • MFMA – Metal Framing Manufacturers Association
  • Client – Manufacturers Standardization Society
  • OSHA – Occupational Safety and Health Administration
  • NACE – National Association of Corrosion Engineers
  • NFPA – National Fire Protection Association
  • PFI – Pipe Fabrication Institute

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a senior-level, hands-on engineer who can bridge the gap between engineering design, project execution, construction, and the customer. They should be comfortable taking technical ownership, reviewing engineering work, solving field issues, and communicating with both internal teams and external clients.

Candidates with backgrounds in data centers, industrial facilities, process/manufacturing plants, modular construction, piping engineering, mechanical infrastructure, EPC projects, or large-scale capital projects are encouraged to apply.

Additional Requirements

  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
  • Willingness to travel to project sites as required.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to engineering quality and safety.

job.title: Electrician - 1st shift
job.description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
Perform a variety of maintenance, repairs, continuous improvement, and new installation functions on plant equipment and machinery with limited direction and guidance. Support manufacturing operations in a spirit of teamwork and cooperation. Troubleshoot and resolve issues in a timely fashion. Safely, professionally and efficiently, complete wiring projects and new installations per electrical line-up and documentation. Competencies:

  • Knowledge of industrial, mechanical and electrical codes, techniques and standards. Familiarity with government regulations for industry, and safe work practices dealing with high voltage circuits.
  • Must have strong background in electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, robotic arms, and overall machine troubleshooting skills.
  • Skilled understanding and experience with electrical schematics and ladder diagrams. Expertise with meters and diagnostic instruments used to evaluate electrical systems, both low and high voltage and AC/DC circuits.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics, specify and gather material and complete wiring installation or repairs with minimal supervision.
  • Familiarity with complex machinery, electrical circuits and plant operating equipment. Should maintain a sense of urgency, self-motivation and overall good work ethic while performing tasks in a safe manner.
  • Skilled in interpersonal relations and written and oral communications.


Key Responsibilities/Deliverables:
1. Troubleshoot and repair machinery and equipment with minimal supervision using safe electrical techniques, schematics and diagnostic instruments. Perform mechanical functions and incidental work as needed to achieve assigned task. Verify equipment as functional and leave the area clean and safe.
2. Operate in response to requests by maintenance supervisor or support personnel, and set priorities as required to maximize equipment uptime.
3. Gather and maintain a complete set of required tools, including electrical meters and diagnostic devices. Utilize diagnostic tools and electrical schematics to define problem areas and assist with resolution. Develop PLC skills to troubleshoot controls related issues.
4. Participate in preventive and predictive maintenance programs to improve operational uptime and equipment life. Recommend improvements and/or changes to PM systems/tasks when applicable.
5. Follow designated work instructions as outlined for specific functions. These include, but are not limited to; PM work orders, continuous improvement tasks, new installation line-ups and repair/refurbish assignments.
6. Update drawings/prints, suggest spare parts and suitable replacements, run conduit/wire-way and power drops. Build, label and wire panels/boxes in a professional manner per line-up and schematics.
7. Follow standard practices and governmental regulations and laws relating to powered equipment.
8. Perform other related duties as assigned by immediate supervisor and management.

Education Required/Preferred: High School Diploma or equivalent. Electrical Journeyman's card or equivalent work experience. Ability to pass an Electrician aptitude test.

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking a Senior L3 Network Engineer to provide advanced engineering, solution design, and operational support across enterprise, data center, cloud, WAN, manufacturing, and Operational Technology network environments. This role requires deep networking expertise, hands-on microsegmentation and OT experience, BGP routing, and network automation using Terraform and Ansible.

Core Responsibilities

  • Gather detailed project requirements and design, develop, and implement network solutions.
  • Provide L3 engineering and support across enterprise, data center, cloud, WAN, manufacturing, and OT network environments.
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Cisco routing and switching infrastructure.
  • Configure and support BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, route redistribution, VLANs, STP, EtherChannel, HSRP, and QoS.
  • Implement network microsegmentation, Zero Trust architecture, and IT/OT security controls.
  • Administer Palo Alto Strata Next-Generation Firewalls, Panorama, GlobalProtect, NAT, and security policies.
  • Design, deploy, and support Cisco SD-WAN using Viptela and Palo Alto Prisma SD-WAN.
  • Manage WAN connectivity across MPLS, Internet, DIA, VPN, and hybrid network environments.
  • Design and support networking across Azure, AWS, and GCP, including ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, Cloud VPN, Transit Gateway, and Virtual WAN.
  • Support manufacturing and OT networks, including environments with SCADA, PLC, HMI, MES, and industrial systems.
  • Develop and maintain network automation using Terraform, Ansible, Python, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Perform root-cause analysis, problem management, and major incident resolution for network outages.
  • Monitor network performance, security, and availability; create technical documentation; and support network modernization initiatives.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • 10+ years of enterprise network engineering experience.
  • Experience gathering detailed requirements and designing network solutions.
  • Strong L3 routing and switching background, including hands-on BGP experience.
  • Hands-on network microsegmentation experience, including Cisco Client, Security Group Tags, PVLANs, or related segmentation controls.
  • Operational Technology networking experience supporting environments with PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, MES, or industrial systems.
  • Hands-on Terraform and Ansible experience for network automation; exposure alone is not sufficient.
  • Strong Cisco routing and switching experience with Catalyst, Nexus, ISR, and ASR platforms.
  • Hands-on Palo Alto experience with Strata, Panorama, GlobalProtect, NAT, and security policies.
  • Experience with Cisco SD-WAN using Viptela and Palo Alto Prisma SD-WAN.
  • Cloud networking experience across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
  • Experience with Zero Trust, network security, and IT/OT segmentation.
  • Experience with Wireshark, SolarWinds, ThousandEyes, and Splunk.

Preferred Skills or Experience

  • CCNP certification.
  • PCNSE certification.
  • VMware vSAN project experience.

Work Details

  • 12-month assignment.
  • Hybrid role in Durham, North Carolina.
  • Onsite at least 3 days per week.
  • No travel required.

job.title: Electrical Controls Engineer- Manufacturing
job.description:
Electrical Controls Engineer- Manufacturing
Tulsa, OK | Full-Time | Monday–Friday
Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship.

Build Reliability. Solve Problems. Keep Production Running.

We're looking for an Electrical Engineer who enjoys working in a manufacturing environment where every day brings new challenges. This is a hands-on plant engineering role focused on maintaining, troubleshooting, and improving the low-voltage electrical and control systems (480V and under) that keep production running safely and efficiently.

You'll work closely with maintenance, production, and engineering teams to identify root causes, improve equipment reliability, support and improve PLC-based automation and control systems, and drive continuous improvement throughout the facility. If you prefer being on the plant floor solving real-world problems instead of sitting behind a desk all day, we'd like to hear from you.

Compensation & Benefits
Salary: $110,000–$135,000, depending on experience
Benefits include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid vacation, personal time, and holidays
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Ongoing training and career growth opportunities

What You'll Do

  • Troubleshoot electrical equipment and production systems to minimize downtime and improve reliability
  • Support and maintain low-voltage power distribution, motor controls, control panels, and electrical infrastructure (480V and under)
  • Troubleshoot, program, and modify PLC, HMI, and VFD systems on automated manufacturing equipment
  • Partner with maintenance teams to identify root causes and implement long-term corrective actions
  • Support preventive and predictive maintenance initiatives to improve equipment performance
  • Assist with equipment upgrades, control circuit design and modifications, and new equipment installations
  • Maintain electrical drawings, schematics, and technical documentation
  • Ensure work is performed in compliance with NEC, NFPA 70E, OSHA, and company safety standards
  • Collaborate with operations, maintenance, and engineering teams to improve plant performance and safety

What We're Looking For
Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • 3+ years of electrical engineering experience within a manufacturing, industrial, processing, or heavy production environment
  • Experience troubleshooting industrial electrical and control systems in a live production setting
  • Working knowledge of:
    • PLCs
    • HMIs
    • VFDs
    • Motor controls
    • Low-voltage power distribution systems (480V and under)
    • Industrial control circuits
  • Experience with AutoCAD Electrical or similar electrical drafting software
  • Ability to work comfortably in a manufacturing facility and support production equipment on the plant floor
  • Must be able to commute to or relocate to the Tulsa, OK area

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing, programming, or modifying PLC-based control systems
  • Experience supporting continuous improvement or equipment reliability initiatives
  • Experience with equipment upgrades, retrofits, or capital improvement projects
  • Familiarity with preventive and predictive maintenance programs

Schedule & Work Environment
Schedule: Monday-Friday | 7:00 AM-4:00 PM
Travel: Occasional travel between local facilities
This position is based in a manufacturing facility and combines office work with regular time on the production floor. PPE, including steel-toe footwear, safety glasses, and hearing protection, is required.

job.title: R&D Scientist - Materials Development
job.description:
Responsibilities:
• Support R&D and Development Engineering work focused on polymeric, dielectric, adhesive, and coating materials for advanced semiconductor packaging applications.
• Perform hands-on laboratory activities including polymer synthesis, formulation, dilution, filtration, purification, sample preparation, and experimental batch preparation.
• Prepare test samples, coating solutions, formulations, and lab-scale materials with strong attention to accuracy, consistency, and safe chemical handling.
• Support experiment execution under the direction of senior scientists and engineers, including following experimental plans, recording observations, and escalating issues when needed.
• Operate and maintain laboratory equipment and analytical tools used for synthesis, formulation, filtration, characterization, and material testing.
• Conduct routine and non-routine material characterization using methods such as GPC / SEC, HPLC, UPLC, NMR, FTIR, UV-Vis, solids content, titration, viscosity, density, surface tension, particle size analysis, DSC, TGA, microscopy, SEM, and film or coating evaluation, as applicable.
• Collect, organize, analyze, and summarize experimental data to support project decisions, troubleshooting, process learning, and technical recommendations.
• Maintain accurate laboratory records including notebooks, batch records, formulation details, raw material information, test results, sample tracking, inventory records, and method updates.
• Support sample labeling, packaging, shipment, receipt of materials, chemical inventory, raw material ordering, and general lab logistics needed for timely project execution.
• Assist with process optimization, scale-up support, technology transfer, root cause investigations, customer sample support, manufacturing support, and other project-related lab activities.
• Follow all site safety, EHS, chemical handling, waste management, and laboratory operating procedures while maintaining a clean, organized, and safe laboratory environment.
• Collaborate effectively with R&D, Development Engineering, Analytical, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional partners to support project execution and timely delivery of materials and data.

Qualifications:
• BS or MS in Chemistry, Polymer Science, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline.
• Hands-on laboratory experience in formulation development, materials development, polymer synthesis, electronic materials, coatings, adhesives, dielectric materials, or related R&D laboratory work.
• Demonstrated ability to safely handle wet chemistry, solvents, monomers, polymers, formulations, and hazardous chemicals while following site EHS requirements and laboratory procedures.
• Experience operating standard laboratory equipment and analytical instrumentation; experience with GPC / SEC, HPLC, UPLC, NMR, FTIR, DSC, TGA, rheology, chromatography, particle size analysis, microscopy, SEM, viscosity, density, titration, or related testing is preferred.
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to follow procedures, document work clearly, maintain accurate records, and execute experiments with repeatability and discipline.
• Ability to organize data, summarize results, troubleshoot experimental issues, and communicate observations clearly to scientists, engineers, project leaders, and cross-functional partners.
• Highly motivated, hands-on, and comfortable working in a fast-paced R&D laboratory environment with changing priorities and multiple active projects.
• Effective verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to work independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team.
• Experience with sample logistics, chemical inventory, raw material ordering, sample shipment, laboratory organization, or project support activities is a plus.
• Familiarity with JMP, Minitab, statistical analysis tools, structured problem solving, or Six Sigma methods is a plus.

job.title: CNC Machinist
job.description:
CNC Machinist

Brodhead, KY | Right-to-Hire | Full-Time

Precision. Skill. Opportunity.

Are you mechanically inclined and enjoy working with precision equipment? Do you take pride in producing quality parts and working with tight tolerances? If you're looking for a company where you can showcase your skills and earn a permanent position, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for!

We're seeking a CNC Machinist to join a growing manufacturing team in Brodhead, KY. This is a Right-to-Hire position, offering the chance to prove your skills and become a permanent member of the team.

What You'll Do:

Set up and operate CNC machinery to cut, shape, and form metal components to precise specifications.

Perform machine shop operations using mills, lathes, grinders, jig borers, shapers, and other machining equipment.

Install and secure tooling, fixtures, cutting tools, and workpieces.

Adjust machine controls, speeds, feeds, coolant flow, and cutting depths.

Read and interpret blueprints and engineering drawings.

Inspect finished parts using micrometers, calipers, gauges, and other precision measuring equipment.

Document inspection results and ensure products meet quality standards.

Identify and report material defects or machine concerns.

Maintain a clean, organized, and safety-focused work environment.

What We're Looking For:

Mechanical aptitude and a willingness to learn

Experience using micrometers, calipers, and other precision measuring tools

Ability to read and understand blueprints

Strong math and problem-solving skills

Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality

Dependable attendance and a positive attitude

Why You'll Love This Opportunity:

Right-to-Hire position with long-term career potential

Opportunity to grow your CNC machining skills

Clean, team-oriented manufacturing environment

Work with precision equipment and modern machining technology

Join a company that values quality, safety, and continuous improvement

Ready to Build Your Future?

If you're looking for more than just a job and want the opportunity to grow into a long-term career with a respected manufacturer, we want to hear from you!

Apply today and take the next step in your machining career!

Location: Defiance, OH

The Operator will properly carry out all duties as defined below under the Work Performed category. This person will be charged with correctly following all SOP guidelines related to this job. Duties include, but are not limited to, proper mixing of powdered products to meet customer-defined specifications as measured by bulk density, particle size, customer liquification tests, and powder flow. Proper cleanup and sanitation of all equipment surfaces during and after production are essential. A thorough knowledge and understanding of all equipment and controls is necessary for successful qualification.

  • Ability to write clearly and in an organized manner.

job.title: Plant Controller
job.description:
Plant Controller

Northern New Jersey | High-Tech Manufacturing | Direct Hire

Nesco Resource is partnering with a global high-tech manufacturer to identify an experienced Plant Controller to lead the financial operations of its Northern New Jersey manufacturing facility.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on manufacturing finance leader who enjoys partnering with Operations and senior management, analyzing plant performance, and using financial data to improve profitability and efficiency.

The Opportunity

The Plant Controller will have overall responsibility for the financial operations of the NJ manufacturing site, including month-end close, budgeting, forecasting, cost accounting, inventory valuation, financial analysis, and internal controls.

This individual will serve as a key business partner to the Plant Manager and leadership team, providing financial insight into production performance, product profitability, cost drivers, and opportunities for improvement.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the financial operations and accounting activities for the manufacturing plant.
  • Partner with the Plant Manager and leadership team to analyze business performance, profitability, production costs, and key financial drivers.
  • Lead the annual budgeting process and quarterly forecasting for the U.S. business unit.
  • Oversee the monthly, quarterly, and year-end close process.
  • Ensure financial reporting and accounting practices comply with GAAP and SOX internal controls.
  • Serve as the primary financial contact for internal and external audits.
  • Oversee product costing, including material, labor, and manufacturing overhead allocations.
  • Analyze production costs and manufacturing variances to identify opportunities to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor inventory valuation and ensure accurate financial reporting of inventory.
  • Develop and monitor financial and operational KPIs to measure plant performance and cost control.
  • Partner with Operations, Procurement, Engineering, and other departments on cost-reduction initiatives and process improvements.
  • Provide financial analysis and recommendations to support strategic business decisions and long-term planning.
  • Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate financial information into actionable recommendations for plant leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting/finance experience, including experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Previous Plant Controller, Controller, or senior manufacturing finance experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of cost accounting, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and inventory accounting.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and the financial impact of production costs and cost drivers.
  • Experience working with ERP systems and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP and internal controls; SOX experience preferred.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong communication and leadership abilities with the ability to work effectively across departments.
  • CPA or CMA designation is preferred but not required.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Join an established global high-tech manufacturer.
  • Leadership role with significant visibility across the organization.
  • Opportunity to partner directly with Plant and business leadership.
  • Play a key role in improving profitability, cost control, and operational performance.
  • Strong opportunity for career growth within a global organization.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

job.title: Senior Lead ML Encoder
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking a hands-on senior Machine Learning Encoder Lead to develop a shared learned customer representation for downstream GenAI and analytics products. This role will design pretraining objectives, train and evaluate encoder models, and build production-quality ML solutions using longitudinal customer data.

The ideal candidate brings deep representation-learning expertise and can independently determine whether the approach provides meaningful downstream value. Evaluation rigor is a core deliverable, including clear evidence, uncertainty assessment, and recommendations on whether to continue or stop an approach.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design pretraining objectives for customer representation and embedding models.
  • Train, evaluate, and refine encoder models using longitudinal transaction, sales, interaction, and behavioral-event data.
  • Develop dense customer representations that downstream GenAI and analytics products can reuse.
  • Build inductive representations that can model entities with limited historical data using their own features.
  • Apply self-supervised, contrastive, temporal, sequence, transformer, graph neural network, or recommender-based modeling approaches as appropriate.
  • Design rigorous evaluation frameworks using time-based splits, leakage detection, cold-start analysis, held-out population transfer testing, and hard baselines.
  • Assess incremental downstream value of embeddings, including calibration, stability, drift, uncertainty, and subgroup performance.
  • Build production-quality Python code, training pipelines, data contracts, model versioning, serving, monitoring, and reproducible workflows.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to communicate findings, risks, uncertainty, and recommendations.
  • Recommend discontinuing modeling approaches when evaluation evidence does not support continued investment.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • Experience personally training an encoder or embedding model and designing its pretraining objective.
  • Deep expertise in representation learning, including self-supervised learning, contrastive pretraining, temporal or sequence modeling, transformers, graph neural networks, or recommender embeddings.
  • Experience modeling large-scale, sparse, longitudinal event data such as transactions, claims, clickstream, customer journeys, or engagement histories.
  • Experience developing inductive representations for entities with limited history.
  • Strong evaluation discipline, including time-based splits, leakage detection, cold-start analysis, held-out population testing, uncertainty assessment, and hard baselines.
  • Ability to assess incremental signal and downstream embedding quality through calibration, stability, drift, and subgroup analysis.
  • Strong Python development experience using PyTorch or JAX.
  • Experience with SQL, distributed data processing, and cloud-based model training at scale.
  • Experience moving models from research into production, including pipelines, versioning, serving, monitoring, data contracts, and reproducibility.

Preferred Skills or Experience

  • Experience with customer-360 representations, behavioral embeddings, recommender systems, or foundation models trained on event data.
  • Familiarity with privacy, fairness, and re-identification risk for learned representations of individuals.
  • Publications, patents, or public applied work in representation learning.
  • Experience working with large-scale behavioral event data in consumer technology, marketplaces, streaming, financial services, payments, or advertising technology.

Work Details

  • Bay Area-based hybrid role.
  • Minimum three days per week onsite.

job.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Senior DevOps Engineer

Overview

Client is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to support and enhance cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, and deployment automation in a remote-friendly environment. This hands-on role focuses on designing, operating, and optimizing scalable, secure, and reliable AWS-based infrastructure while improving operational efficiency and platform consistency.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, and observability tooling, along with the ability to independently drive technical decisions in complex environments. This role also requires practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, and delivery while maintaining high standards for security, correctness, and operational excellence.

Core Responsibilities

• Design, implement, and operate AWS cloud infrastructure and automation using Terraform across services including EC2, S3, EKS, ECR, Route 53, IAM, and networking components.

• Manage Kubernetes and EKS platforms, including cluster lifecycle management, upgrades, autoscaling, workload scheduling, capacity planning, performance optimization, and cost management.

• Build and enhance Kubernetes platform capabilities such as networking, ingress, DNS integration, service discovery, RBAC, policy enforcement, secrets management, and multi-environment consistency.

• Develop and maintain CI/CD and GitOps deployment workflows using GitLab CI/CD, Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD, Flux, and related technologies.

• Implement and improve observability solutions, including metrics, logging, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and incident diagnostics.

• Support and optimize Kubernetes-based application workloads to improve resilience, scalability, runtime efficiency, and operational performance.

• Strengthen infrastructure and platform security through IAM least-privilege access, secrets management, image scanning, admission controls, policy-as-code, workload isolation, and runtime hardening.

• Support PostgreSQL/RDS reliability, availability, backup integrity, performance tuning, and operational support activities.

• Collaborate with development and platform teams to improve deployment strategies, developer experience, runtime reliability, and operational standards.

• Monitor system health, troubleshoot infrastructure and application issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventative improvements.

• Drive technical decision-making, evaluate tradeoffs, prioritize work, and deliver solutions with limited oversight.

• Utilize AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate infrastructure design, Terraform development, Kubernetes troubleshooting, CI/CD workflow creation, observability analysis, and operational documentation while validating outputs for security and production readiness.

• Document and refine infrastructure standards, DevOps practices, deployment workflows, operational procedures, and support runbooks.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

• Minimum 7 years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or related disciplines, with demonstrated success designing and operating scalable cloud infrastructure.

• Strong expertise with AWS services including EC2, S3, EKS, ECR, Route 53, IAM, and cloud networking and security concepts.

• Advanced hands-on Kubernetes experience, including cluster operations, upgrades, autoscaling, networking, ingress, RBAC, policy enforcement, and production workload management.

• Strong experience using Terraform for infrastructure-as-code, environment management, and repeatable platform provisioning.

• Experience with Kubernetes deployment and packaging tools such as Helm and Kustomize.

• Experience with GitLab CI/CD and GitOps methodologies using tools such as Argo CD, Flux, or similar technologies.

• Strong experience with observability and monitoring platforms including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or comparable solutions.

• Experience with Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as ingress controllers, operators, Cluster Autoscaler, and Karpenter.

• Strong experience supporting PostgreSQL/RDS environments, including performance tuning, reliability, and operational support.

• Solid understanding of cloud and container security practices, including IAM least privilege, secrets management, image scanning, admission controls, and policy enforcement.

• Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, or similar languages.

• Practical fluency with AI-assisted engineering tools, including LLMs, code assistants, and workflow automation solutions, with the ability to evaluate and refine generated outputs responsibly.

• Excellent problem-solving, communication, teamwork, and collaboration skills.

• Ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions in ambiguous environments.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Skills or Experience

• Certifications in AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, or related platform technologies.

• Experience with additional cloud platforms such as GCP or Azure.

• Experience improving incident response processes, operational readiness, and platform standards for distributed engineering organizations.

• Experience designing internal platform capabilities that enhance developer self-service and reduce operational overhead.

job.title: Solderer
job.description:
Nesco Resource is looking for Solderers for our long-time client in Rochester Hills, MI. This shift operates Monday through Friday from 7 AM until 3:30 PM. Pay is based on experience, must have an updated resume. The associate will perform all soldering, bonding, wiring, routing, assembly, disassembly, touch-up, rework, cleaning, and minor modifications, assemblies and sub-assemblies within the facility using electronic parts and components and a variety of hand tools.

Payrate is 20 to 25 an hour depending on experience

The associate will work from approved visual aids, change notices (CN's), deviations and routes and/or any engineer-approved changes that apply to them. Solderers will also move the completed product to the next production operation. You will also use various measuring instruments and equipment to perform a visual and dimensional inspection of printed circuit boards, harnesses, sub-assemblies, and assemblies. Inspects assemblies after machine soldering and complete required paperwork, logs, and records.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 
  • Perform manual and automated soldering of electronic components onto printed circuit boards
  • Read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and work instructions
  • Set up and operate soldering equipment, including wave soldering machines and reflow ovens
  • Inspect solder joints and completed assemblies for quality and conformance to specifications
  • Clean and maintain soldering equipment and work area
REQUIREMENTS
  • Previous experience in electronic soldering, preferably in a manufacturing environment Ability to follow verbal and written instructions in English
  • Proficiency in various soldering techniques, including through-hole and surface mount technology Ability to identify electronic components
  • Ability to frequently lift/carry products weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to read and understand technical documents and schematics
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Good hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity
  • Good time management and organizational skills
OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES
  • Must complete soldering training course and pass soldering proficiency test
  • Ability to maintain hourly run rates in a fast-paced environment
  • Basic Math Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) training Electronic component identification training

Position Level: Entry Level

Position Overview

The Customer Service Associate serves as an internal point of contact for customers, providing value-added support and helping deliver a positive customer experience. Primarily through telephone and electronic communication, this position responds to customer requests, questions, concerns, and complaints while supporting the overall order management process.

The Customer Service Associate is expected to use sound judgment, develop strong problem-solving skills, and maintain professional relationships with customers and internal teams. Work is performed under general supervision and guidance.

job.title: Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Pay Rate: $35-40/hr based on shift and experience level.

Shift Availability: 1 st and 2 nd shift available. Ten hour shifts Monday through Thursday.

Professional Summary / Core Responsibilities

  • Preventive & Predictive Maintenance: Execute scheduled maintenance routines, inspections, and system checks across plant machinery and facility infrastructure to maximize equipment reliability and minimize operational downtime.
  • Multi-Craft Troubleshooting & Repair: Diagnose, resolve, and repair complex electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and control system issues across production machinery.
  • Electrical Safety & High Voltage: Safely troubleshoot, repair, and install industrial electrical components up to 480 VAC in full compliance with safety codes.
  • Schematics & Technical Blueprint Reading: Interpret electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and mechanical schematics, mechanical drawings, and work instructions to guide precision repairs and installation projects.

  • Root Cause Analysis & Fabrication: Support continuous improvement efforts by performing failure diagnostics, implementing long-term corrective solutions, and custom-fabricating replacement components as needed.
  • Facility Maintenance & Contractor Support: Oversee core plant utilities (compressed air, HVAC, lighting, plumbing) and partner with external contractors and production units for major installations and overhauls.
  • Equipment Handling & Safety Operations: Safely operate material handling gear including forklifts, aerial/scissor lifts, and overhead cranes while enforcing strict Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), 5S, and housekeeping protocols.

Key Technical Skills & Qualifications
  • Electrical & Automation: Industrial Electrical (up to 480 VAC), Control Systems, PLC/Ladder Logic Troubleshooting & Programming.
  • Mechanical & Fluid Power: Hydraulics, Pneumatics, Mechanical Drive Systems, Precision Component Fabrication, Machining.
  • Machinery Experience: CNC Equipment, Laser Cutters, Press Brakes, Automated Manufacturing Systems, Overhead Cranes.
  • Systems & Software: CMMS Software, Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word), Schematic Interpretation, Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

job.title: Customer Service Representative(Manufacturing)
job.description:
Storeroom Customer Service Representative

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and customer-focused Storeroom Customer Service Representative to support procurement, purchasing, inventory, and vendor management activities within an onsite manufacturing environment.

This position is responsible for purchasing products, goods, and materials while ensuring customer requirements for price, quality, delivery, and reliability of supply are consistently met. The ideal candidate is professional, detail-oriented, comfortable communicating with customers and vendors, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced industrial setting.

Candidates with experience in procurement, purchasing, metals manufacturing, inventory management, or blueprint reading are especially well suited for this opportunity. Training may be provided for candidates who demonstrate strong initiative and an interest in learning the industry.

Position Details

  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:30 AM–4:00 PM
  • Assignment Length: 6-month temporary assignment
  • Potential for extension or conversion to a permanent position based on business needs
  • Work Location: 100% onsite; remote work is not available
  • Occasional overtime may be required
  • Business casual dress; jeans/long pants and collared shirt or blouse are acceptable
  • Steel-toe shoes and safety eyewear are required

Required Onboarding Requirements

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen
  • Must present a valid U.S. passport or certified birth certificate with raised seal on the first day
  • Site-specific background screening and badging requirements must be completed
  • Candidate must bring required background screening documentation on the first day for badging
  • Additional onboarding and badging procedures will be provided prior to start

Key Responsibilities

Procurement & Purchasing

  • Perform procurement activities to ensure current and anticipated demand for products and materials is met.
  • Purchase stock, non-stock, and spot-buy materials in accordance with established purchasing strategies.
  • Review inventory forecasts and replenishment recommendations generated through ERP or inventory management systems.
  • Assess existing orders and determine appropriate expediting or de-expediting actions to optimize delivery.
  • Create and process purchase requisitions and vendor purchase orders.
  • Research products and vendors to identify options that meet required specifications, pricing, quality, and delivery expectations.
  • Conduct price comparisons and identify purchasing opportunities that provide the best overall value.
  • Follow up with vendors regarding purchase order status and ensure timely delivery of materials.

Vendor & Inventory Management

  • Communicate directly with vendors to resolve delivery, product quality, pricing, and order-related issues.
  • Monitor the quality and timeliness of products and materials received.
  • Coordinate returns and replacement of damaged or nonconforming goods when necessary.
  • Negotiate and coordinate vendor returns for aging, expired, or excess inventory.
  • Support inventory liquidation activities as required.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with suppliers, vendors, and internal customers.

Customer Service & Administrative Support

  • Respond quickly and professionally to customer requests and inquiries.
  • Provide timely updates regarding order status, delivery schedules, and purchasing issues.
  • Research and resolve invoice and accounts payable discrepancies with suppliers.
  • Support expedient invoice processing and resolution.
  • Identify and document customer cost-saving opportunities.
  • Produce and maintain customer KPI measurement data.
  • Maintain accurate purchasing, inventory, and vendor documentation.
  • Follow established Standard Operating Procedures and LEAN operating practices.
  • Maintain a professional, organized, clean, and safe work environment.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Strong customer service skills.
  • Strong computer skills with the ability to learn ERP and inventory management applications.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Basic mathematical aptitude.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent organizational and execution skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take initiative.
  • Professional demeanor and ability to communicate effectively with customers and vendors.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field.
  • 1+ year of procurement, purchasing, supply chain, inventory, or related experience.
  • Experience working within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Familiarity with metals manufacturing.
  • Ability to read or interpret blueprints.
  • Experience with ERP and inventory management systems.
  • CPM certification or other relevant purchasing/procurement certification.

job.title: Python Developer
job.description:
Nesco Data Center and Infrastructure is seeking a Python Developer for Project opportunities that works in conjunction with a premiere Infrastructure Provider.

Senior Python / Azure Integration Engineer – VM Refactor & Application Modernization

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Python / Azure Integration Engineer to support the modernization and refactoring of an existing virtual-machine-based application and integration environment.

The individual will be responsible for analyzing the existing environment, refactoring legacy Python-based processes and integrations, migrating appropriate workloads from the existing virtual machine architecture into an Azure Function App, and establishing a more maintainable, automated, and observable application environment.

This role requires strong hands-on experience with Python development, Azure, REST APIs, cloud integrations, data movement, source control, application deployment, and production monitoring. The ideal candidate is comfortable working within an existing codebase and integration ecosystem and can translate a current-state architecture into a cleaner, cloud-oriented target state.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze the existing virtual machine-based application and integration environment and understand current workflows, dependencies, scheduled processes, scripts, and data flows.

  • Review and refactor existing Python code and Python-based automation.

  • Migrate appropriate application functionality from the existing VM environment into Azure Function App architecture.

  • Develop and maintain Python-based serverless functions and supporting application components.

  • Integrate with external systems through REST APIs, including systems such as:

    • Adaptive Insights

    • Workday

    • Salesforce

    • Azure Blob Storage

    • Other REST/API-based services

  • Work with existing R scripts, MySQL databases, SFTP processes, and file-based data exchanges as part of the modernization effort.

  • Understand and refactor existing scheduled processes currently operating through Task Scheduler.

  • Develop reliable data ingestion, transformation, processing, and export workflows.

  • Refactor legacy integrations while maintaining required business functionality and data integrity.

  • Work with RaaS REST APIs and other application-specific APIs where required by the target architecture.

  • Manage and maintain source code using GitHub.

  • Establish or support automated code deployment from GitHub into the Azure environment.

  • Implement appropriate error handling, logging, exception management, and retry mechanisms.

  • Configure and utilize Azure Application Insights for application monitoring and troubleshooting.

  • Develop and configure alerting/notification rules for application failures, integration issues, and other operational events.

  • Troubleshoot application, API, integration, and data-processing failures.

  • Document application architecture, integrations, dependencies, deployment processes, and operational procedures.

  • Coordinate with technical stakeholders to validate functionality during the transition from the current state to the target state.

  • Support testing, deployment, stabilization, and production handoff.

Required Technical Experience

Python Development

  • Strong professional experience developing applications and automation using Python.

  • Experience working within and refactoring an existing Python codebase.

  • Strong understanding of Python application architecture, modular design, error handling, logging, testing, and maintainability.

  • Experience converting scripts and scheduled automation into production-quality applications or services.

  • Ability to troubleshoot existing Python code rather than relying solely on greenfield development.

Microsoft Azure

  • Hands-on experience developing and deploying applications within Microsoft Azure.

  • Strong experience with Azure Functions / Function Apps.

  • Understanding of serverless application architecture and event-driven processing.

  • Experience with Azure Blob Storage.

  • Experience with Application Insights and Azure application monitoring.

  • Experience configuring application alerts and operational monitoring.

  • Familiarity with Azure authentication, permissions, secrets, and secure application configuration.

API & Integration Development

  • Strong experience developing and consuming REST APIs.

  • Experience integrating multiple third-party and enterprise applications.

  • Understanding of authentication methods, API credentials, tokens, headers, payloads, pagination, rate limits, and error handling.

  • Experience troubleshooting API connectivity and integration issues.

  • Experience working with structured data formats such as JSON and XML.

  • Ability to develop reliable integrations between cloud applications, databases, file systems, and external APIs.

Data & Database Experience

  • Working knowledge of MySQL.

  • Experience querying, transforming, and moving data between systems.

  • Understanding of data integrity, validation, transformation, and reconciliation.

  • Experience working with cloud object storage such as Azure Blob Storage.

  • Experience with SFTP-based data exchanges.

  • Ability to work with data originating from SaaS applications, APIs, databases, and flat files.

Source Control & Deployment

  • Strong experience with Git and GitHub.

  • Experience managing application source code and branches.

  • Experience deploying Python applications/code through GitHub-based workflows.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and automated application deployment.

  • Ability to establish repeatable and controlled deployment processes.

Monitoring & Operations

  • Experience implementing application logging and monitoring.

  • Experience with Azure Application Insights preferred.

  • Ability to establish meaningful application health and error monitoring.

  • Experience creating operational alerts and notifications.

  • Strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills.

  • Understanding of production application support and reliability.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience migrating applications from traditional VM-based architectures to Azure serverless/cloud architectures.

  • Experience modernizing legacy Python scripts and scheduled jobs.

  • Experience replacing Windows Task Scheduler-based processes with cloud-native scheduling or event-driven architecture.

  • Experience with Azure Functions in production environments.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise SaaS platforms such as Workday, Salesforce, and Adaptive Insights.

  • Experience with Workday APIs or Workday RaaS.

  • Experience with Salesforce APIs.

  • Experience with Adaptive Insights integrations.

  • Experience working with both Python and R within the same environment.

  • Experience with SFTP automation.

  • Experience with enterprise data integration or ETL processes.

  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps or comparable CI/CD platforms.

  • Familiarity with automated testing and deployment pipelines.

Professional Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software development or integration engineering experience.

  • Strong professional experience with Python.

  • Demonstrated experience delivering production applications in Azure.

  • Demonstrated experience integrating multiple enterprise systems.

  • Experience taking ownership of an existing application/codebase and improving its architecture.

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.

  • Ability to independently understand unfamiliar systems and code.

  • Strong documentation and communication skills.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with application owners, infrastructure teams, data teams, and business stakeholders.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is not simply a Python developer. They should be an experienced Python/Azure integration engineer who can look at an existing VM-hosted environment, understand how the various integrations and scheduled processes work, and methodically transform that environment into a more modern Azure-based architecture.

The candidate should be comfortable working across the entire application lifecycle—from code analysis and refactoring through API integration, Azure deployment, GitHub-based code management, testing, monitoring, alerting, and production support.

Experience with the specific systems shown in the architecture is highly valuable, particularly Adaptive Insights, Workday/RaaS, Salesforce, Azure Blob Storage, REST APIs, MySQL, SFTP, Python, GitHub, Azure Functions, and Application Insights.

Core Skills

Required:

  • Python

  • Azure Functions / Azure Function Apps

  • REST APIs

  • Azure Blob Storage

  • Git / GitHub

  • Application monitoring

  • API integrations

  • MySQL

  • Data transformation

  • Production troubleshooting

  • Application modernization

  • Cloud migration/refactoring

Strongly Preferred:

  • Workday / Workday RaaS

  • Salesforce integrations

  • Adaptive Insights

  • SFTP

  • R scripting

  • Task Scheduler migration

  • Azure Application Insights

  • CI/CD

  • Serverless architecture

  • Enterprise integration development

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred, but equivalent professional experience may be substituted for formal education.

Engagement Summary

This position is best suited for a Senior-level Python/Azure engineer capable of taking ownership of an existing integration environment and helping transition it from a VM-centric architecture to a more modern, cloud-based application model.

The successful candidate will be expected to contribute hands-on technical development rather than serving solely in an architectural or project-management capacity.

job.title: Manufacturing Planner- (Secret Clearance)
job.description:
Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced Manufacturing Planner to develop detailed manufacturing work instructions, process plans, and supporting documentation used to manufacture and assemble complex products. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of manufacturing processes and the ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, CAD models, and other technical documentation and translate those requirements into clear, practical instructions for production. This position works closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Production, Tool Design, Tooling, and Quality to ensure manufacturing processes accurately reflect engineering requirements and can be executed efficiently on the production floor.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze engineering drawings, CAD models, specifications, processes, and technical documentation to determine appropriate manufacturing operations and sequences.
  • Develop comprehensive manufacturing work instructions and supporting documentation for production.
  • Plan manufacturing operations involving machine parts, composite details and assemblies, airframe structures, aircraft systems, electrical/wiring, plumbing, coatings, aircraft maintenance, MRB, or other applicable manufacturing processes.
  • Apply knowledge of manufacturing processes, tooling, fabrication methods, inspection requirements, and shop practices when developing process plans.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Tool Design, Tool Shops, Quality, and Production to resolve manufacturing and documentation issues.
  • Interpret engineering requirements and provide input regarding tooling, manufacturing methods, process sequencing, and production requirements.
  • Investigate discrepancies between engineering requirements and manufacturing processes and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support changes to manufacturing documentation resulting from engineering revisions, process improvements, or production requirements.
  • Ensure work instructions and manufacturing documentation accurately communicate requirements to production personnel.
  • Support alignment between Engineering BOMs (EBOM), Manufacturing BOMs (MBOM), and Order BOMs (OBOM).
  • Utilize manufacturing, ERP, PLM, CAD, and other technical systems to create and maintain manufacturing documentation and product data.
  • Maintain effective communication with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and improve manufacturing processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience creating manufacturing work instructions, process plans, or equivalent manufacturing/engineering documentation.
  • Demonstrated experience developing comprehensive work instructions for one or more of the following:
    • Machine parts
    • Composite details or assemblies
    • Airframe structures
    • Aircraft systems
    • Aircraft check-outs
    • Wiring/electrical systems
    • Plumbing
    • Aircraft maintenance
    • MRB/nonconformance
    • Coatings
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications, and technical documentation.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, fabrication methods, tooling, and inspection requirements.
  • Strong technical/instructional writing skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Engineering, Manufacturing, Production, Tooling, Quality, and other cross-functional organizations.
  • Experience using manufacturing or engineering documentation systems such as SAP, Teamcenter, Solumina/iBASEt, 3DX, CAPP/SFM, or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Aerospace or aviation manufacturing experience.
