job.title: Human Relations Generalist(Manufacturing)
job.description:
Human Relations Generalist

Position Summary

The Human Relations Generalist (HRG) serves as a champion of People, Diversity, and Inclusion, supporting plant and sales operations across multiple shifts and locations. This position partners closely with the Plant Manager, Sales Directors, local leadership, and hourly associates to provide comprehensive HR support and best-in-class services that improve organizational effectiveness.

The ideal candidate brings strong HR generalist and labor relations experience, with the ability to influence leaders, engage employees, manage change, and align human resources initiatives with business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

HR Business Partnership & Organizational Support

  • Serve as a strategic HR Business Partner and Change Agent to the Plant Manager, Sales Directors, and local leadership.
  • Provide HR support across plant operations, three shifts, and multiple sales locations.
  • Partner with leadership on staffing, organizational effectiveness, employee engagement, and workforce planning.
  • Support Manufacturing Transformation and business initiatives through HR consultation and change management.
  • Coach leaders and associates on company values, behaviors, policies, and HR best practices.

Employee & Labor Relations

  • Support the development and implementation of effective Positive Associate Relations programs.
  • Partner with managers and supervisors regarding performance, attendance, staffing, safety, and employee relations concerns.
  • Participate in meetings with supervisors and hourly associates to address workplace issues and support positive employee relations.
  • Administer and interpret company policies and Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBAs).
  • Support investigations, grievances, hearings, and employment-law compliance matters.
  • Administer employee Rewards & Recognition programs.

Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

  • Develop and manage an annual hourly staffing plan.
  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for hourly positions and designated salaried positions.
  • Maintain a strong pipeline of qualified talent to support ongoing workforce needs.
  • Serve as the plant and sales HR point of contact for salaried recruiting activities managed through centralized recruiting.
  • Interview salaried candidates as needed in the absence of the HR Manager.
  • Maintain compliant recruitment documentation, including resumes, interview notes, and related hiring records.
  • Develop and continuously improve onboarding programs to support new-hire integration and retention.

Learning & Development

  • Conduct new-hire orientation and HR-related training programs.
  • Facilitate new-hire safety orientation and other required training.
  • Conduct training needs assessments based on plant and sales business requirements.
  • Support leadership, Diversity & Inclusion, Labor Relations, Respect in the Workplace, and other organizational training initiatives.

Talent & Performance Management

  • Manage talent-management processes including:
    • Employee profiles
    • Goal setting
    • Development plans
    • Mid-year reviews
    • Annual performance evaluations
    • Succession planning
  • Partner with people managers to determine appropriate actions related to employee performance and development.
  • Lead communication and administration of annual merit and performance-review processes.
  • Coach salaried leaders on performance management and employee development.

HR Administration & Compliance

  • Support headcount management, turnover reporting, exit interviews, and attendance tracking.
  • Maintain current job descriptions as positions and organizational needs evolve.
  • Manage and maintain HR files and Form I-9 documentation in accordance with compliance requirements.

job.title: Production Supervisor
job.description:
Production Supervisor
Position Summary
The Production Supervisor is responsible for leading the daily activities of the manufacturing team to ensure assembly operations are completed safely, efficiently, on schedule, and to the highest quality standards. This role provides hands-on leadership, coaching, and support to production employees while driving continuous improvement in quality, throughput, and overall team performance.
The ideal candidate brings strong manufacturing knowledge, proven leadership capabilities, excellent communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across departments. The Production Supervisor must be adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, accountability, and customer satisfaction.

Location: Slingerlands, NY
Compensation: $36.00 - $40.00/hr.
Position Type: Contract Assignment with Possibility for Permanent Hire!

Core Duties and Responsibilities
  • Lead daily production activities by assigning team responsibilities, coordinating workflow, and ensuring manufacturing deliverables are achieved on schedule. Provide hands-on assembly and manufacturing support when needed.
  • Maintain current knowledge of products, assembly processes, and manufacturing protocols. Provide ongoing training, coaching, and communication to team members.
  • Establish team goals and drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, productivity, throughput, and other key production metrics.
  • Partner with the Production Manager and Cell Leaders to communicate expectations, monitor performance, and ensure production activities meet established standards.
  • Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement. Identify and address quality issues that may impact final product testing and implement appropriate corrective actions.
  • Cross-train employees across multiple assembly and manufacturing processes to strengthen team capabilities, improve flexibility, and support employee development.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to develop and maintain assembly procedures and related training materials. Deliver procedural training to employees as required.
  • Build and maintain effective cross-functional relationships and collaborate with other departments to resolve issues, improve processes, and achieve shared business objectives.
  • Lead 5S initiatives and promote a clean, organized, efficient, and safe work environment through consistent leadership and example.
  • Partner with Production Scheduling to manage material usage, maintain inventory accuracy, and ensure production schedules are consistently met.
  • Monitor and analyze production data and prepare reports to support operational decision-making and performance improvement.
  • Maintain strict adherence to safety standards, OSHA requirements, and facility safety procedures. Promote and enforce safe work practices throughout the team.
  • Support employee performance management activities, including performance evaluations, employee recognition, coaching, and disciplinary actions, in partnership with management and Human Resources.
  • Promote a positive, inclusive, and high-performance team environment through effective communication, coaching, and leadership.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
Education and Experience
  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate degree preferred.
  • Previous experience in a manufacturing environment required; experience in a technology-focused manufacturing facility preferred.
  • Previous supervisory or team leadership experience highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with continuous improvement methodologies and practices.
  • Six Sigma certification preferred but not required.
  • Experience working effectively in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.

job.description:
JOB SUMMARY
The Project Engineer is responsible for all mechanical engineering aspects of a project from start to finish. Responsible for ensuring the technical solutions on a project will meet the project requirements including project scope, project metrics, budget, and schedule. Lead, guide, and direct a team of mechanical engineers on the project to ensure project goals are met.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Researches and analyzes data including customer request for quote, customer specifications, and proposals to develop or determine feasibility of design or application.
  • Concept layout of complete system and capitalize on common design for efficiency.
  • Work within time constraints, schedule constraints, and overall machine budget constraints.

job.title: Sr. DevOps/Deployment Engineer
job.description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer with strong experience building and improving software deployment and release processes in Linux environments. This role is best suited for someone who understands the full software delivery lifecycle — not just how to maintain an existing pipeline. You should be comfortable designing deployment solutions, working through complex technical problems independently, and understanding how decisions made within a pipeline or deployment process impact the broader application environment.

The immediate focus will be on Linux virtual machine deployments, release automation, application packaging, and CI/CD. Longer term, the environment is expected to continue evolving toward greater use of containerization.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and YAML.
  • Develop reusable pipeline templates and deployment processes that can support multiple applications and environments.
  • Create and maintain Ansible playbooks, roles, inventories, and automation workflows.
  • Build and support automated application deployments into Linux virtual machine environments.
  • Package and deploy applications using Debian-based deployment methods.
  • Support the build, packaging, versioning, release, and deployment of .NET applications and services.
  • Develop deployment solutions appropriate to different .NET frameworks and application architectures.
  • Help establish consistent release, versioning, and deployment practices across technical teams.
  • Support deployments across environments with varying levels of connectivity, including restricted or disconnected environments.
  • Troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines, Linux systems, application builds, package deployments, configuration issues, and release failures.
  • Work closely with software engineering, infrastructure, QA, database, and other technical teams to improve the overall deployment process.
  • Research technical issues through product documentation and other authoritative resources and independently develop solutions.
  • Contribute to the organization's longer-term transition toward containerized and orchestrated application deployments.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of DevOps, Release Engineering, Deployment Engineering, Infrastructure Automation, or comparable experience.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with Ansible, including creating and maintaining playbooks and roles.
  • Strong experience working within Linux environments.
  • Direct experience building and/or deploying Debian packages to Linux virtual machines.
  • Strong experience designing and developing Azure DevOps YAML pipelines.
  • Experience creating reusable YAML templates and structured CI/CD pipeline frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of software versioning, packaging, build processes, release management, and deployment patterns.
  • Experience supporting the build and deployment lifecycle of .NET applications.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot complex deployment and pipeline problems.
  • Strong understanding of how application builds, infrastructure, configuration, pipelines, and deployment processes work together as a complete system.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document technical designs and explain technical decisions.

Preferred Experience

job.title: Machine Designer
job.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Automated Machine Designer is responsible for researching, planning, and designing stations and machines using calculations, mechanical principals, and proven practices to create semi/fully automated assembly and test systems.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Researches and analyzes data such as customer request for quote, customer specifications, and proposals to develop or determine feasibility of design or application.
  • Work within design hour constraints, schedule constraints, and overall machine budget constraints.
  • Work in a collaborative environment to make sure the designs developed are the most cost effective and will meet the customer's requirements.
  • Develop/review concepts to confirm the design will meet required performance metrics including cycle time, yield, uptime, CPK and Gage R&R.
  • Design mechanisms, stations, machines using 3D modeling software (SolidWorks).
  • Works with vendors to obtain competitive quotes for major purchased components.
  • Create detailed fabrication drawings for all custom designed parts.
  • Create detailed assembly drawings identifying each individual component
  • Create a complete Bill of Material for each design/station.
  • Release completed designs to Project Management
  • Occasionally acts as Project Engineer on smaller projects
  • Supports fabrication, assembly, debug and machine qualification activities to ensure design conforms to customer requirements and specifications
  • Observe safety procedures.
EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE
  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent work experience.
  • 5 or more years' experience in an automation related field, preferred.
  • Proficient in Solidworks, AutoCAD, Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • General knowledge of GD&T, EPDM and Jig and Fixture design.
  • Occasionally required to travel up to 5%.

Job Title: Process Technician
Location: Glenville, NY
Pay Rate: $20-$25
Shift: Day and Night Shifts available

Summary:
We are seeking for Process Technicians who have experience with thin film process equipment based physical vapor deposition (PVD), chemical vapor deposition (CVD), electropolishing/electroplating processes and related test/characterization tools. job.title: Quality Systems Specialist
job.description:
Job Title: Quality Systems Specialist
Schedule: Full-Time
Salary: Upto $85k/yr
 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Quality Systems Specialist to support, maintain, and continuously improve our Quality Management System (QMS), with a strong focus on ISO 9001 compliance and certification.

In this role, you will work closely with the Quality Manager and cross-functional teams to ensure quality processes, documentation, audits, corrective actions, and quality records meet customer, regulatory, and company requirements. You will play an important role in supporting ISO 9001 certification and surveillance audits while identifying opportunities to strengthen processes and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System in accordance with ISO 9001 requirements.
  • Coordinate and support ISO 9001 certification, recertification, and surveillance audits.
  • Develop, revise, maintain, and control quality system documentation, including procedures, work instructions, forms, records, and process maps.
  • Plan and conduct internal audits, document findings, and support corrective action activities through timely and effective closure.
  • Support external customer, registrar, and supplier audits.
  • Facilitate root cause investigations and corrective/preventive action activities, including effectiveness verification.
  • Monitor and analyze quality system performance metrics and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Conduct supplier evaluations and audits, recommend corrective actions, and provide input regarding supplier quality performance and approval decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and participate in continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure quality records are properly maintained in accordance with company and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Follow all company safety, quality, and operational policies.

Qualifications

  • Associate degree or higher in Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Technology, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 3–5 years of experience supporting or maintaining a Quality Management System in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience conducting internal audits and managing corrective action processes.
  • Working knowledge of ISO 9001 requirements and quality management system principles.
  • Experience creating, revising, maintaining, and controlling quality documentation.
  • Experience participating in or leading ISO 9001 certification, recertification, or surveillance audits.
  • Experience developing or implementing QMS procedures and quality processes.
  • Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor training or certification preferred.
  • Experience with root cause analysis tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone/Ishikawa, or similar methodologies.
  • Familiarity with supplier quality management, supplier evaluations, and supplier audits.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting, leading, or participating in the achievement and ongoing maintenance of ISO 9001 certification.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and electronic document control systems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across all levels of an organization.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a manufacturing environment.

job.title: Technical Account Manager
job.description:
Nesco Data Center & Infrastructure is seeking a (TAM) Technical Account Manager in the Greater Maryland-Delaware Area who is interested in joining a premiere IT Solution Provider.

Technical Account Manager

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as a trusted technology advisor and primary point of contact for assigned clients. This position is responsible for managing the overall client relationship from a technology and service perspective, understanding business objectives, monitoring service performance, and helping clients develop and execute practical technology strategies.

The Technical Account Manager works closely with client stakeholders and internal technical teams to assess existing environments, identify risks and opportunities, develop technology roadmaps, and ensure services align with business requirements. The role requires a strong combination of technical knowledge, business understanding, communication skills, and relationship management.

The TAM will regularly lead or participate in Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), strategic planning sessions, service reviews, technology roadmap discussions, and executive-level client meetings. This individual must be comfortable translating complex technical information into clear business recommendations and coordinating internal resources to deliver measurable value to the client.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technology contact and trusted advisor for assigned client accounts.

  • Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with technical, operational, and executive-level client stakeholders.

  • Conduct technology assessments, baseline reviews, discovery activities, maturity assessments, and technology alignment exercises.

  • Evaluate client environments to identify technology risks, operational gaps, inefficiencies, lifecycle concerns, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Facilitate Quarterly Business Reviews, strategic planning meetings, service reviews, roadmap discussions, and other recurring client engagements.

  • Develop and maintain technology roadmaps that align client technology investments with business priorities and long-term objectives.

  • Assist clients with technology budgeting, lifecycle planning, prioritization, and strategic investment decisions.

  • Monitor service performance, technology initiatives, and account activities to proactively identify potential issues or areas requiring attention.

  • Coordinate resources across engineering, project management, solution architecture, cybersecurity, service delivery, sales, and other internal teams.

  • Advocate for client requirements internally and ensure appropriate resources are engaged to address customer needs.

  • Prepare executive-level presentations, technology assessments, gap analyses, strategic recommendations, roadmap presentations, and other client-facing deliverables.

  • Maintain accurate account documentation, technology roadmaps, governance materials, decision logs, service review documentation, action-item registers, risk trackers, and issue logs.

  • Document client meetings, decisions, recommendations, risks, and follow-up activities.

  • Follow established delivery methodologies, templates, playbooks, and quality standards to ensure consistent and professional client engagements.

  • Identify documentation deficiencies, service delivery issues, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve the overall client experience.

  • Work collaboratively with internal teams to develop repeatable processes, best practices, knowledge resources, and other delivery improvements.

  • Participate in strategic technology discussions and customer-success initiatives designed to increase client value and strengthen relationships.

  • Identify opportunities for additional technology services or solutions that address legitimate client requirements and provide measurable business value.

  • Ensure recommendations and technology initiatives are appropriately aligned with client business objectives, operational requirements, risk tolerance, and financial considerations.

Required Qualifications

Professional Experience

  • 3–7 years of experience in Technical Account Management, IT consulting, customer success, technology services, account management, or a related technology leadership role.

  • Experience working within an MSP, technology services organization, consulting environment, systems integrator, or enterprise IT organization preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience managing client relationships and leading technology-focused discussions with both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Experience working directly with customers on technology strategy, service delivery, infrastructure planning, or technology improvement initiatives.

Communication & Relationship Management

  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to both technical professionals and non-technical business executives.

  • Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to establish credibility and trust with clients.

  • Ability to influence stakeholders, facilitate productive discussions, and drive decisions without relying solely on direct authority.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple clients, priorities, deliverables, and deadlines simultaneously.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities.

Business Acumen

  • Understanding of business operations, strategic planning, technology investment planning, risk management, and operational efficiency.

  • Ability to translate technology recommendations into measurable business outcomes, cost considerations, risk reduction, and potential ROI.

  • Comfortable participating in executive-level conversations involving technology strategy, budgets, priorities, service performance, and business objectives.

  • Ability to understand a client's broader business goals and translate those goals into practical technology initiatives.

Technical Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of enterprise IT infrastructure, networking, cloud technologies, cybersecurity fundamentals, and IT service management.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environments preferred.

  • Understanding of technology lifecycle management, infrastructure modernization, governance, security best practices, and managed services delivery.

  • Ability to understand and discuss enterprise technology architectures, infrastructure dependencies, service-level metrics, operational performance, and technology roadmaps.

  • Ability to work effectively with engineers, architects, cybersecurity professionals, project managers, service delivery teams, and other technical specialists without necessarily serving as the hands-on technical resource.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a technically knowledgeable, business-minded professional who can operate comfortably between the client, executive leadership, and technical delivery teams. This individual should be capable of understanding complex technology environments while maintaining a strong focus on customer relationships, business outcomes, service quality, and long-term technology strategy.

The successful Technical Account Manager will be proactive rather than reactive, able to recognize emerging risks and opportunities, communicate recommendations clearly, and coordinate the appropriate internal resources to help clients achieve their technology and business objectives.

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer
job.description:
Manufacturing Engineer

Location: Middlefield, OH
Schedule: 1st Shift
Salary: $85,000–$110,000, based on experience

A growing precision manufacturing company in Middlefield, OH is seeking a hands-on Manufacturing Engineer to join its team. This is a newly created engineering opportunity with significant visibility and the ability to directly impact manufacturing processes, efficiency and future growth.

The company specializes in CNC precision machining and serves a diverse customer base, including highly regulated medical, defense and government applications. As the business continues to take on larger customers and more complex work, they are looking for someone who can evaluate existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement and turn those ideas into practical solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Spend significant time on the manufacturing floor working directly with CNC machining and production teams.
  • Develop and improve manufacturing processes for new and existing jobs.
  • Evaluate current processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality and profitability.
  • Assist with estimating process times and costs for customer quotations.
  • Support job planning, routers and production flow.
  • Troubleshoot manufacturing issues and develop practical solutions.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives, including 5S, visual management and process improvements.
  • Support new product introductions and process validations.
  • Interpret engineering drawings and GD&T requirements.
  • Support FAI, PPAP, inspection and quality requirements.
  • Assist with root cause analysis, corrective actions and nonconforming product issues.
  • Develop and improve manufacturing procedures and work instructions.
  • Work with customers to understand requirements and translate them into effective manufacturing processes.
  • Help establish processes that allow the organization to efficiently support continued growth.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of manufacturing engineering or closely related manufacturing experience.
  • Strong CNC machining/precision machining background.
  • Hands-on understanding of CNC manufacturing processes.
  • Experience with process improvement and continuous improvement.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and GD&T.
  • Experience with estimating, job planning or process development is highly desirable.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both shop-floor employees and management.
  • Self-directed and comfortable taking ownership of projects.
  • Creative, practical approach to solving manufacturing problems.

An engineering degree is not required. Candidates who have developed strong manufacturing engineering and process improvement expertise through hands-on machining and manufacturing experience are encouraged to apply.

Why This Opportunity?

This is a high-impact role with a small, growing manufacturing organization where you'll have the opportunity to make visible improvements rather than simply maintain existing processes.

The ideal candidate is someone who can walk onto the shop floor, understand how things are being done, recognize what could be better and develop a practical plan to make it happen.

If you're a CNC-focused manufacturing professional who enjoys solving problems, improving processes and being hands-on with the operation, we'd like to hear from you.

job.description:
4th Shift:
· Friday: 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM (8 hours) (shift begins Thursday night)
· Saturday: 10:00 PM – 10:00 AM (12 hours) (shift begins Friday night)
· Sunday: 10:00 PM – 10:00 AM (12 hours) (shift begins Saturday night)
· Monday: 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM (8 hours) (shift begins Sunday night)

CNC Operator
As a CNC Operator at ***, you will play a critical role in manufacturing high-precision aerospace components that support some of the world's most advanced aircraft and aerospace systems. You will be responsible for setting up, operating, and maintaining CNC machining equipment while ensuring compliance with strict quality, safety, and production standards. Success in this role requires strong technical skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering quality products in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Set up, operate, and monitor CNC 3-axis milling and turning machines to manufacture precision aerospace components.
  • Interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, work instructions, and specifications.
  • Perform machining operations including milling, drilling, tapping, boring, reaming, and turning.
  • Inspect parts using standard and specialized measuring devices to verify conformance to specifications and quality requirements.
  • Troubleshoot machining and tooling issues and make necessary machine adjustments.
  • Perform routine preventative maintenance and basic machine care to maximize equipment performance and minimize downtime.
  • Maintain accurate production and quality documentation.
  • Follow all *** safety, quality, and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with engineering, quality, and operations teams on prototype, development, and production activities.

Qualifications
YOU MUST HAVE
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a CNC or ASM machining environment, or completion of 1,800 hours of vocational machinist training with equivalent machine shop experience.
  • Experience setting up and operating CNC 3-axis milling and/or turning machines.
  • Knowledge of machining processes, tooling, and manufacturing best practices.
  • Experience performing quality inspections using precision measuring instruments and gauges.
  • Ability to perform machining operations including milling, drilling, tapping, boring, reaming, and turning.
  • Understanding of machine shop safety practices, PPE requirements, and safe operating procedures.
  • Ability to lift and move materials as required and work around oils, coolants, and other manufacturing fluids.
WE VALUE
Experience in aerospace, defense, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
Experience working in a cellular manufacturing or work-cell environment.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

job.title: Regulatory Business Analyst II
job.description:
Regulatory Business Analyst II – AxiomSL / FR 2052a & FR Y-15

Location: New York, NY
Job Type: Contract – Special Project
Department: Regulatory Projects
Industry: Banking / Financial Services

Position Overview

Our client is seeking an experienced Regulatory Business Analyst II with strong hands-on experience with AxiomSL (ControllerView) and Federal Reserve regulatory reporting, specifically FR 2052a and/or FR Y-15.

This is a key project role focused on conducting a comprehensive gap analysis of the organization's current data environment against regulatory reporting requirements. The successful candidate will identify data gaps, define sourcing requirements, develop data mapping specifications, and work closely with Finance, Data, Technology, and Regulatory stakeholders to ensure the necessary data is available and properly structured for reporting.

The ideal candidate will have 10+ years of Business Analysis experience within Corporate/Investment Banking (CIB) and a proven track record of implementing FR 2052a or FR Y-15 at a major banking institution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct "As-Is" vs. "To-Be" data analysis for FR 2052a and FR Y-15 reporting requirements.
  • Identify missing data elements, data quality issues, granularity gaps, and other reporting deficiencies.
  • Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to understand financial products, business processes, and reporting requirements.
  • Translate complex Federal Reserve regulatory requirements into clear Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs).
  • Define specific data sourcing requirements for transactional, counterparty, collateral, balance sheet, and other financial data.
  • Develop detailed source-to-target data mapping specifications.
  • Map source data into the AxiomSL Operational Data Store (ODS) and consolidated data model.
  • Work closely with Data Architects, Data Engineers, ETL teams, and upstream system owners to resolve data sourcing and transformation issues.
  • Analyze large datasets and perform data validation and reconciliation using SQL and other analytical tools.
  • Identify and communicate risks, dependencies, and data quality concerns to senior stakeholders.
  • Drive open issues and requirements through resolution while maintaining project timelines.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and guidance to business, technology, and regulatory stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related field.
  • 10+ years of Business Analysis experience within Corporate/Investment Banking (CIB).
  • Hands-on experience working with AxiomSL / ControllerView.
  • Required: Demonstrated experience implementing FR 2052a and/or FR Y-15 at a major banking institution.
  • Strong understanding of Federal Reserve regulatory reporting requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of financial products, including liquidity, lending, securities, derivatives, collateral, and balance sheet products.
  • Experience with data mapping, data lineage, data sourcing, data modeling, and data quality analysis.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
  • Experience with Power BI or similar data visualization/analytics tools.
  • Ability to develop detailed BRDs, FRDs, data mapping documents, and functional specifications.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work with senior Finance, Regulatory, Data, and Technology teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently and drive complex regulatory initiatives through completion.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who has actually implemented FR 2052a or FR Y-15 using AxiomSL at a major bank—not simply someone who has regulatory reporting experience. They should be comfortable getting into the data, understanding what the regulations require, identifying what is missing, and then working with Data and Technology teams to determine where the data needs to come from and how it needs to be mapped into Axiom.

job.description:
Woodwork Machine Operator
Monday - Friday 7am-5pm 

Position Summary
The Door/Cabinet Molder Operator is responsible for setting up, operating, and maintaining molder machines used in the production of wood doors, cabinet components, trim, and molding products. This position ensures products are manufactured to quality specifications, production schedules are met, and all safety procedures are followed.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Set up and operate molder machinery to produce doors, cabinet components, moldings, and related wood products.
  • Read and interpret work orders, blueprints, and production specifications.
  • Adjust machine settings, tooling, guides, and feed rates to meet product requirements.
  • Inspect raw materials and finished products to ensure compliance with quality standards.
  • Monitor machine performance and make necessary adjustments during production runs.
  • Change knives, cutter heads, and tooling as required.
  • Measure finished parts using calipers, tape measures, and other precision measuring instruments.
  • Identify and troubleshoot machine issues to minimize downtime.
  • Perform routine preventive maintenance and basic repairs on equipment.
  • Maintain accurate production and quality records.
  • Keep work areas clean and organized according to 5S and housekeeping standards.
  • Follow all safety policies, procedures, and OSHA regulations.
  • Collaborate with supervisors, maintenance personnel, and team members to meet production goals.
Qualifications
Education and Experience
  • High school diploma or GED preferred.
  • Minimum of 1-3 years of experience operating woodworking equipment, molders, or similar manufacturing machinery preferred.
  • Experience in door, cabinet, millwork, or woodworking manufacturing environments is highly desirable.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Knowledge of woodworking processes and equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, drawings, and work instructions.
  • Proficiency in using measuring tools and quality inspection equipment.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Basic math skills for measurements and calculations.
  • Ability to meet production deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift throughout the shift.
  • Frequently lift and move materials weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to work around machinery, dust, noise, and moving mechanical parts.
  • Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) including safety glasses, hearing protection, and steel-toed footwear.
Work Environment
  • Manufacturing or production facility.
  • Exposure to wood dust, noise, and varying temperatures.
  • Overtime and weekend work may be required based on production demands.

job.title: Electrical Engineer – Power Distribution

Lead Electrical Engineer Tulsa, OK Direct Hire $100,000–$150,000 DOE

A growing organization is seeking an experienced Lead Electrical Engineer to support multiple electric utility customers by developing plans, specifications, and engineering analyses for new construction, system improvements, and maintenance of existing electrical facilities. This is a leadership role requiring an active P.E. license and a strong background in power/high voltage engineering. The ideal candidate will have experience overseeing engineers and engineering technicians while delivering cost-effective, code-compliant solutions for cooperatives, municipalities, and investor-owned utilities.

What It Offers

Competitive Salary: $100,000–$150,000 DOE

Comprehensive Benefits Package (Medical, Vision, Dental, 401K Match)

Opportunity to Lead an Engineering Team

High-Impact Role Supporting Utility Infrastructure

Stable Organization with Long-Term Growth Opportunities

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship.

About the Role

The Lead Electrical Engineer will support multiple electric utility customers by developing plans, specifications, and engineering analyses for new construction, system improvements, and maintenance of existing electrical facilities. This role also oversees a team of engineers and engineering technicians. An active Professional Engineer (P.E.) license is required for this position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct detailed engineering analyses across planning, maintenance, design, construction, and operations for electric cooperatives, municipalities, and investor-owned utilities (IOUs).
  • Apply engineering principles and industry best practices to create cost-effective, technically sound solutions.
  • Ensure projects meet applicable industry standards and regulatory requirements (RUS, Municipal).
  • Plan, prioritize, and lead engineering assignments and project activities.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders including utility representatives, developers, and property owners regarding project design and compliance.
  • Serve as liaison across internal teams, departments, and external organizations.
  • Partner with engineering technicians to identify and implement quality-control design changes.
  • Manage project schedules across varying project scopes and customer needs.

Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer (P.E.) license with a focus in power/high voltage.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering and 5+ years of related experience in electrical engineering.
  • Strong knowledge of utility equipment, materials, systems, and operational processes.
  • High proficiency with engineering software and general computer applications.

Benefits

Our client's goal is to provide a benefits package that gives you peace of mind, helps you stay healthy, and supports you at every stage of your career. Offerings include:

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance

job.title: Workstation Systems Engineer III
job.description:
Endpoint Infrastructure Engineer – Virtualization & Endpoint Management

Location: New York 
Work Arrangement: Hybrid – 3 days onsite per week

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Endpoint Infrastructure Engineer to join the User Infrastructure team supporting a large-scale enterprise environment in the Tri-State area.

This position is ideal for a senior infrastructure professional with strong expertise in Microsoft Windows, MECM/SCCM, VMware/Omnissa Horizon, Citrix, and PowerShell. The Engineer will be responsible for supporting virtualization and workstation infrastructure, performing security remediation and patch management, developing automation, and serving as a senior technical escalation point.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively with infrastructure, security, and support teams. Strong communication, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills are essential.

Key Responsibilities

Virtualization Infrastructure

  • Provide operational support and security remediation for Citrix XenApp environments.

  • Support and maintain VMware/Omnissa Horizon VDI infrastructure.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues affecting virtual desktop environments.

  • Support the Omnissa/Horizon imaging process, including image maintenance and deployment.

  • Partner with infrastructure and support teams on virtualization-related projects and improvements.

Workstation & Endpoint Infrastructure

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Windows 10/11 workstation infrastructure.

  • Manage Windows workstation security remediation and patching using MECM/SCCM and related technologies.

  • Research, test, and deploy security updates and software packages.

  • Identify and remediate software and hardware End-of-Life (EOL) issues.

  • Perform patch management and vulnerability remediation across physical workstations and virtual desktops.

  • Develop, maintain, and deploy Active Directory Group Policy Objects (GPOs).

  • Troubleshoot complex endpoint infrastructure issues and serve as a point of escalation for IT Support.

  • Develop automation to streamline repetitive administrative tasks using PowerShell, VMware PowerCLI, Excel/Power Query, and batch scripting.

Security, Compliance & Lifecycle Management

  • Collaborate with Security and Infrastructure teams to identify, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities.

  • Support endpoint security and compliance initiatives.

  • Research emerging security risks and recommend appropriate remediation strategies.

  • Research and remediate EOL hardware and software to reduce operational and security risks.

  • Support IT audit activities by compiling and maintaining accurate technical documentation and evidence.

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Work closely with Infrastructure, Security, IT Support, and other technology teams.

  • Independently manage assigned projects and technical initiatives from planning through completion.

  • Provide clear status updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation, procedures, and support materials.

  • Translate complex technical issues into clear, understandable explanations for business stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure engineering or systems administration.

  • Strong experience supporting on-premises and hybrid IT environments.

  • Advanced knowledge of Windows 10/11 workstation operating systems.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft MECM/SCCM.

  • Strong PowerShell scripting and automation experience.

  • Significant experience with VMware and/or Omnissa Horizon environments.

  • Experience supporting Citrix XenApp or related Citrix technologies.

  • Experience with endpoint patching, vulnerability remediation, and security hardening.

  • Strong knowledge of Active Directory and Group Policy.

  • Experience with software deployment and endpoint lifecycle management.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Technical Skills

  • VMware vSphere / ESXi / vCenter

  • Omnissa Horizon

  • Omnissa/Horizon imaging and desktop pools

  • Citrix XenApp

  • Microsoft MECM/SCCM

  • PowerShell

  • VMware PowerCLI

  • Active Directory / Group Policy

  • Windows 10/11 security and patch management

  • Vulnerability and security remediation

  • Excel / Power Query

  • Batch scripting

  • Enterprise endpoint management

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a senior infrastructure engineer who can hit the ground running in a complex enterprise environment. You should be comfortable taking ownership of technical issues, working across multiple teams, managing competing priorities, and communicating effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

Experience in financial services or another highly regulated enterprise environment is strongly preferred.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to play a key role in the stability, security, and modernization of enterprise endpoint and virtualization infrastructure. The Engineer will have significant responsibility across Windows, VMware/Omnissa Horizon, Citrix, MECM/SCCM, automation, patch management, and security remediation.

Candidates with a strong background in Omnissa/VMware, PowerShell, and Citrix are strongly encouraged to apply.

job.title: Data Center Network Refresh
job.description:
Nesco Data Center & Infrastructure is seeking a Data Center Network Refresh Technician/Engineer in the Greater Atlanta Area. This is part of a nationwide Financial Institution program.

Network & Data Center Refresh Technician

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Network & Data Center Refresh Technician with proven hands-on experience supporting Client environments and executing large-scale network and data center refresh projects. This individual must understand enterprise data center operations, network infrastructure, hardware replacement, structured cabling, and the coordination required to execute refresh activities across multiple technology and channel partners.

The ideal candidate has participated in an actual end-to-end data center network refresh, not simply rack-and-stack or break/fix work. The candidate must be comfortable working in live, highly controlled enterprise environments and coordinating activities among the customer, network engineering teams, data center operations, OEMs, integrators, and multiple channel partners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute onsite activities associated with data center network refreshes, technology refreshes, and infrastructure modernization projects.

  • Perform rack-and-stack, de-rack, equipment replacement, migration, labeling, cable tracing, cable management, and hardware installation.

  • Install, replace, and validate enterprise network equipment including switches, routers, firewalls, patch panels, optics/transceivers, and associated infrastructure.

  • Support migration from legacy network equipment to new-generation platforms while following approved MOPs, SOPs, and change-management procedures.

  • Work within live production data center environments where strict adherence to change control, security, safety, and outage-prevention procedures is required.

  • Perform physical validation of equipment, ports, interfaces, cabling, power connections, rack elevations, asset tags, and network connectivity.

  • Assist network engineers with pre-change validation, cutover activities, post-change testing, troubleshooting, and remediation.

  • Trace and validate copper and fiber connections, including MPO/MTP, LC, and other high-density fiber infrastructure.

  • Coordinate equipment delivery, staging, installation, removal, asset disposition, and shipment activities.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of equipment, serial numbers, rack locations, ports, cabling, and completed work.

  • Escalate discrepancies, damaged equipment, incorrect cabling, labeling issues, configuration concerns, or unexpected network conditions to the appropriate engineering or project team.

  • Work directly with multiple channel partners, systems integrators, OEMs, subcontractors, and customer stakeholders to ensure project activities remain synchronized.

  • Participate in site walks, pre-installation surveys, readiness reviews, implementation windows, cutovers, and post-refresh validation.

Required Experience

  • Prior experience working within Client data center or network environments is required.

  • Demonstrated experience performing an enterprise data center network refresh from a physical infrastructure/network perspective.

  • Strong understanding of data center network architecture, including:

    • Core, distribution, and access switching

    • Network racks and cabinets

    • Patch panels and structured cabling

    • Fiber and copper connectivity

    • Network optics/transceivers

    • Redundant power and network paths

    • Cross-connects and interconnects

    • Out-of-band management

    • Network equipment staging and migration

  • Experience replacing legacy network equipment with new hardware while maintaining production connectivity.

  • Experience working with multiple channel partners and technology vendors simultaneously.

  • Ability to read and interpret rack elevations, network diagrams, port maps, cable schedules, MOPs, installation documentation, and project drawings.

  • Experience working within formal enterprise change-management and maintenance-window processes.

  • Strong understanding of data center security, access procedures, ESD requirements, PPE, and safety practices.

  • Ability to troubleshoot physical-layer issues involving fiber, copper, optics, patching, power, and equipment connectivity.

Preferred Technical Experience

Experience with enterprise platforms from manufacturers such as Cisco, Arista, Juniper, HPE/Aruba, Dell, or equivalent is highly desirable.

Experience with:

  • Cisco Catalyst and Nexus platforms

  • Enterprise switching and routing

  • SFP/SFP+/QSFP/QSFP28 optics

  • MPO/MTP and LC fiber

  • Fiber inspection/cleaning and testing

  • Fluke or equivalent cable/fiber test equipment

  • Console access and basic CLI troubleshooting

  • VLANs, trunks, port channels/LAGs, and network uplinks

  • Network diagrams and port-level documentation

  • DCIM or asset-management systems

  • ServiceNow or similar ticket/change-management platforms

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate is not simply a rack-and-stack technician. They should be a seasoned data center/network infrastructure professional who has already participated in significant enterprise refreshes and understands what happens before, during, and after a network migration.

The individual must be able to walk into a data center, understand the physical and logical relationship between the equipment, identify what is being replaced, understand the cabling and connectivity requirements, execute the physical work correctly, communicate effectively with network engineering, and document the completed installation.

Client experience is a hard requirement, along with demonstrated experience supporting a large-scale enterprise network/data center refresh involving multiple channel partners and stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of data center/network infrastructure experience preferred.

  • Demonstrated participation in at least one significant enterprise network or data center refresh.

  • Prior Client experience required.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently while coordinating closely with project managers, network engineers, data center operations, and third-party partners.

  • Ability to work scheduled maintenance windows, including nights, weekends, and occasional extended hours when required.

  • Ability to lift and move data center equipment in accordance with site safety requirements.

  • Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Network+, or equivalent hands-on experience are preferred but not mandatory.

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by the technician's ability to execute network refresh activities safely, accurately, and with minimal disruption to production environments, while maintaining precise documentation and effectively coordinating with the customer, network engineering teams, data center operations, and multiple channel partners.

Unloads, receives and puts away incoming product, goods, tools and/or equipment; unpacks bales, crates, and other containers; checks for damage and for discrepancies between goods and invoices.

Ability to work in a team environment and be self-motivated to accomplish assigned tasks and goals.
Demonstration of attention to detail and is safety minded.

May be required to wear various forms of protective equipment (shoes, gloves, protective eyewear, etc.)

Overtime may be required; extended day, evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand and may include little to no advanced notice.
Must be able to handle and work physical inventory; required to lift up to 25 lbs or greater with assistance following standard operating and safety procedures. Other physical requirements including, regularly being required to stand, walk, kneel, bend, crouch, crawl, climb and balance.

job.title: Loader Machine Operator
job.description:
Join a Clean, Team-Oriented Food Manufacturing Facility!

Nesco Resource has an exciting new career opportunity for you! Nesco Resource is currently hiring dependable and motivated Loader Machine Operators to join our client's team in Williamsport, PA. Multiple positions available with immediate start! If you enjoy working in a fast-paced, clean environment and take pride in quality work, we want to hear from you!

Day Shift: 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM (30 minute unpaid lunch)
Pay: $19.00 per hour

 Job Summary

The Loader Machine Operator is responsible for monitoring and operating an automated robotic system that feeds eggs into the grading machine. This position ensures smooth production by monitoring equipment performance, responding to alarms, performing basic troubleshooting, and working closely with maintenance and production teams to minimize downtime and maintain efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor the robotic loading system, conveyors, sensors, and related equipment to ensure consistent product flow.

  • Respond to equipment alarms, stoppages, and operating issues; perform basic resets and troubleshooting as needed.

  • Identify mechanical or system problems and communicate issues to maintenance promptly.

  • Perform routine equipment inspections and maintain a clean, organized work area.

  • Remove broken eggs, debris, and buildup that could affect equipment or sensor performance.

  • Work with production personnel to maintain a steady supply of product to the loading system.

  • Follow all food safety, quality, and sanitation requirements, including HACCP, FDA, and SQF standards.

  • Follow required safety procedures, PPE requirements, and lockout/tagout practices.

  • Accurately complete production records, logs, and required documentation.

  • Assist with training employees on proper operation and monitoring of the robotic loading system.

  • Support production goals by helping maintain equipment efficiency and reduce downtime.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • Previous experience in machine operation, manufacturing, food production, or packaging is preferred.

  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and recognize equipment, product-quality, and safety concerns.

  • Basic math skills and the ability to accurately complete production documentation.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

  • Ability to work safely and effectively in a fast-paced production environment.

  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.

  • Flexibility to work overtime, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

  • Ability to wear required PPE and perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation.

Physical & Work Environment

  • Ability to bend, stoop, reach, push, pull, and perform repetitive tasks.

  • Ability to lift and handle materials up to 50 pounds with assistance or approved equipment.

  • Comfortable working around moving machinery and in environments that may be noisy, wet, or subject to temperature changes.

  • Must follow all safety, food-safety, and PPE requirements.

Shift Options & Scheduling:

  • Day Shift: 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM, with a 30-minute unpaid lunch.

  • Initial Training: Employees will be trained on 1st shift but must have the flexibility to transition to 2nd or 3rd as business needs change

  • Must be available to work overtime as needed.

  • Schedule flexibility is required based on production and business needs.

Qualified? Call our office today at 570-326-1736 for immediate consideration!

job.title: Sr. Lightspeed Engineer
job.description:
Nesco Resource is in search of a Sr. Lightspeed Engineer to work for one of our clients based in Bethel, CT. 

SUMMARY:
Primarily responsible for developing technical solutions and executing projects for medical device customers using company’s advanced technology. Collaborate with a small local Lightspeed team and with Lightspeed members from other sites to complete prototype projects and lead programs through the PReP (Production Readiness Process) towards production. Lead customer communications providing technical solutions and program updates.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
•    Define, plan, and complete complex Lightspeed projects including multi-site programs per quoted conditions with innovation and urgency, ensuring product quality meets or exceeds technology specific workmanship standards.
•    Strong understanding and optimization of advanced parameters and variables on company technology that effect outputs and product quality.
•    Independently perform complex setup, system troubleshooting, and process development on company technology to produce acceptable Lightspeed product.
•    Take initiative and responsibility to lead the completion of tasks and projects, ensure high quality of deliverables, & work across several departments as required.
•    Strong productivity and independence, ability to work under minimal supervision, consistently solves problems independently prior to reaching out for help, continuously seeks out additional responsibilities.
•    Participate in project analysis, parameter development, problem solving, and solution implementation for various Lightspeed projects.
•    Lead and drive quotes to completion as assigned for complex single & multi-site projects.
•    Lead customer calls and internal meetings, communicating effectively and driving progress forward with high quality results.
•    Proactively communicate with the customer on issues with a recovery plan, status, and results of an order.
•    Able to write advanced programs to measure Lightspeed product using site specific metrology equipment and successfully execute Test Method Validations for product moving into production.
•    Read and interpret print specifications on Lightspeed projects, ensure all required visual and geometric measurements are taken and documented per Quality Systems requirements.
•    Lead multiple projects through the Production Readiness Process, from Lightspeed to Production driving a cross-functional team to project completion.
•    Provide mentorship and technical skill training to Lightspeed Technicians and Associate Engineers, and Applications Development Engineers.
•    Document process parameters and project details for each Lightspeed project accurately per company Quality Systems requirements, generating professional and easy to follow setup sheets & work instructions, and completing CAPAs as required.
•    Recognize and report unmet customer needs applicable to company technology to the Advanced Technology Group.
•    Take ownership of data & metrics that contribute to site success and enforce data integrity, monitor individual data and peer data in company digital systems for accuracy, communicating with the team if discrepancies are identified.
•    Allocate time and attention based on what is more important to achieve key goals and objectives, effectively organize and balance tasks with structure and purpose to keep multiple projects on track.
•    Seeks continuous self-improvement, open and willing to accept constructive criticism.
•    Lead and execute Advanced Technology Group activities and deliverables as assigned.
•    Participate in sales support activities including sales presentations, customer visits, and technical seminars.
•    Lead cross departmental teams in continuous improvements projects that benefit the company.
•    Understanding of all technologies and facilities across the company. 
•    Ability to adapt quickly and positively to changing priorities and processes.
•    Support the company’s overall goals and production problem solving, contributing to company programs as required.
•    Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:
•    Bachelor of Science degree in an Engineering / Science or equivalent experience.
•    Experience with company technology; high precision manufacturing equipment or equivalent (Laser Systems, CNC Machines, Grinding Machines, Tube Drawing Machines... etc.).
•    Solid understanding of materials science and materials properties, especially for common medical device materials (Nitinol, Stainless Steels, Titanium & other metals, Medical Polymers and Ceramics).
•    Experienced in applying software used on high precision micromanufacturing equipment (G-code, C++, VBA, Various Equipment Specific GUIs… etc.).
•    Ability to read and understand engineering drawings per GD&T system.
•    Ability to troubleshoot and optimize complex processes in an efficient and reliable manner.
•    Ability to generate complex drawings, models, and assemblies with 2D & 3D software using GD&T.
•    Fluent in Microsoft Office: MS Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, SharePoint... etc. 
•    Demonstrated execution and experience with the following: TMV / GRR, Process Capability, Attribute vs. Variable Data in Validation, OQs/PQs, Engineering Study / DOE.
•    Experience using computer-controlled measurement systems to create and troubleshoot programs and inspection methods to measure Lightspeed product.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
•    Familiarity with ISO certified Quality Systems in medical device manufacturing.
•    Experience in a medical device manufacturing environment.
•    Experience designing and manufacturing complex tooling or fixturing for various applications

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:
•    Direct hire with benefits
•    First shift, Monday – Friday, 8:30am – 5pm
•    Salary range: up to $120K

job.title: Corporate Paralegal - Remote
job.description:
Corporate Paralegal ***Remote ***

Locations: District of Columbia
Salary: $105,000 - $125,000 Base Salary
Required to live within 1hr drive of D.C. office

Corporate Paralegal Opportunity

Nesco Resource is partnering with a highly respected and growing law firm to identify an experienced Corporate Paralegal to join its Corporate Practice Group. This is an outstanding opportunity for a seasoned legal professional who enjoys supporting sophisticated business transactions in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

The firm offers flexibility to work remotely, while providing the opportunity to work alongside experienced attorneys on complex commercial matters.

Responsibilities

As a Corporate Paralegal, you will play an integral role in supporting attorneys throughout the lifecycle of corporate transactions. Responsibilities include:

  • Prepare and file business formation, qualification, dissolution, and related corporate filings in multiple jurisdictions.
  • Prepare franchise tax filings and assist with corporate compliance matters.
  • Register nonprofit organizations and prepare federal and state tax exemption applications.
  • Conduct legal research, lien searches, and due diligence investigations.
  • Draft routine legal correspondence, including audit response letters.
  • Assist with secured lending transactions, including UCC filings, collateral reviews, certificates, and consents.
  • Coordinate pre-closing, closing, and post-closing activities, including preparing closing checklists, organizing signature pages, assembling closing binders, and maintaining transaction files.
  • Obtain certified corporate documents and certificates of good standing.
  • Work closely with attorneys and clients to resolve issues and ensure transactions progress smoothly.
  • Provide exceptional client service while managing multiple priorities and meeting critical deadlines.

Qualifications

  • Paralegal Certificate or Associate's/Bachelor's Degree in Paralegal Studies.
  • Minimum of 5 years of Corporate Paralegal experience, preferably within a law firm.
  • Experience supporting corporate transactions, financing matters, and business entity formations.
  • Strong knowledge of UCC filings, due diligence, and corporate governance documents.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Experience with legal software such as Carpe Diem, Hummingbird, or similar document management and timekeeping systems is a plus.
  • Ability to work occasional overtime to support transaction closings.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

Remote!
  • Join a well-established, highly regarded law firm with an outstanding reputation.
  • Work on sophisticated corporate and commercial transactions alongside experienced attorneys.
  • Choose from one of three office locations: Fort Lauderdale
  • Competitive base salary of $105,000-$125,000, commensurate with experience.
  • Excellent benefits package and long-term career growth opportunities.

If you're an experienced Corporate Paralegal looking to take the next step in your career with a premier law firm, we'd love to speak with you. Apply today to learn more about this exciting opportunity through Nesco Resource.

job.title: Flight Simulator Hardware Engineer
job.description:
Description:
Flight Simulator Hardware Engineer – Air & Commercial Solutions (Client) Program

The Work
The hired engineer will be a Hardware Engineering on a development team that delivers a FAA Level D Full Flight Simulator for our customer. Primary responsibilities include:
•Complete hardware design and development activities for power and control systems, motion platform integration, visual display systems, avionics interfaces, and ancillary equipment.
•Manage end to end integration of the new simulator hardware with the existing building infrastructure, including HVAC, electrical distribution, grounding, and fire and smoke monitoring systems.
•Lead other Hardware Engineers that synchronizes engineering, procurement, production planning, manufacturing, and suppliers to ensure design is completed as scheduled. Develop innovative solutions to a range of complex problems that are consistent with the program objectives.

Basic Qualifications (BQs):
Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or related field
Experience in developing flight simulation hardware solutions on programs.
Active development of new mechanical design engineering principles and full demonstrated knowledge of industry practices and related disciplines
Issuing formal design checking approvals or non-conformance reports through the PLM tool.
Developing and generating CREO layouts and detailed drawings for ICDs, components, sub-assemblies, assemblies, and integration test articles
Developing and generating HW architectural layouts for system and lower level interfaces between systems and subsystems
Deriving Hardware and sub tier requirements from customer requirements
Building BOMs, creating parts, assemblies, and design documentation
Demonstrated ability to support cross-functional teams through major technical reviews throughout the acquisition lifecycle (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR)
Experience applying Hardware Engineering processes in an Agile environment.

Desired Skills:
Experience with Windchill, Creo, Windchill and/or Catia, Zuken and Cameo.

Knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing in accordance with ASME Y14.5 and demonstrated perform complex system-level tolerance analysis.

Knowledge of generating hardware architecture, high level interconnects, and deriving requirements from customer and system level flow downs.

Prior experience in the development, integration, and deployment of flight training systems.

Leveraged Agile tenets in the execution of the development of software intensive systems, inclusive of driving development of Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Hardware, and Test Engineering work products.

Experience adapting hardware designs to existing climate control systems, ensuring temperature/humidity stability for avionics and motion platforms.
Experience interfacing with the facility's existing fire detection and suppression infrastructure
Product design experience in the context of modular open systems architectures (e.g. SOA).

job.title: Buyer II
job.description:
Buyer II

Waukesha, WI | $65,000–$85,000 Base Salary | Fully Onsite

Direct Hire Opportunity | $500 Quarterly Performance Bonus

NESCO Resource is partnering with a well-established, privately held manufacturing company in Waukesha, WI to identify an experienced Buyer II to join its team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a purchasing professional with 5+ years of manufacturing experience who understands MRP/ERP systems, supplier management, inventory control, and the challenges of sourcing materials with extended lead times. Experience purchasing electronic components is highly desirable.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Buyer II will provide experienced purchasing support to the company's Production, Service, and Engineering departments. This position will be responsible for managing purchasing activities, maintaining strong supplier relationships, ensuring timely delivery of materials, negotiating pricing and terms, and supporting inventory and cost-control objectives.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working in a dynamic manufacturing environment and will have a proactive approach to supplier communication, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and place purchase orders for Production, Service, and Engineering.

  • Monitor orders closely to ensure on-time delivery of materials.

  • Manage purchase order acknowledgements, confirmations, past-due orders, and delivery exceptions.

  • Expedite, de-expedite, or cancel orders as needed to maintain appropriate inventory levels.

  • Maintain accurate order dates and purchasing information within the ERP system.

  • Communicate regularly with suppliers regarding delivery schedules, expectations, and issues.

  • Research and evaluate current and prospective suppliers based on pricing, service, quality, and overall value.

  • Support supplier development, qualification, and ongoing supplier performance management.

  • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, contracts, and other purchasing conditions.

  • Identify cost-saving opportunities and support inventory-turn objectives.

  • Process purchase orders for assigned suppliers, miscellaneous items, office supplies, equipment, furniture, and other departmental needs.

  • Participate in physical inventory and other inventory-control activities.

  • Maintain supplier records and documentation related to accreditation and service-level management.

  • Utilize Epicor ERP to maintain accurate supplier information and ensure transactional and data integrity.

  • Coordinate supplier information with internal departments including Accounts Payable, Quality Assurance, Engineering, and Sales.

  • Work with suppliers to improve payment terms and purchasing conditions.

  • Identify opportunities for purchasing contracts and manage small- and medium-sized contract opportunities.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within purchasing and supply chain.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of purchasing/buying experience in a manufacturing environment.

  • Previous experience working with MRP/ERP systems; Epicor experience is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with supply-chain programs such as Kanban, Vendor-Managed Inventory (VMI), JIT, or similar delivery programs.

  • Strong negotiation and vendor-management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, changing manufacturing environment.

  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills with excellent attention to detail.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers and internal teams.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and ERP systems.

  • Willingness and ability to learn new systems and processes.

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Accounting, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent manufacturing experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • C.P.M. or APICS certification is a plus.

  • Experience with Epicor ERP.

  • Experience with Power BI.

  • Experience purchasing electronic components.

  • Experience managing long-lead-time materials.

WHAT THE COMPANY OFFERS

  • $65,000–$85,000 base salary, depending on experience.

  • Up to $2,000 sign-on bonus.

  • $500 quarterly performance bonus.

  • Stable opportunity with an established manufacturing organization.

  • Collaborative, employee-focused work environment.

  • Opportunity to contribute ideas and make an impact on purchasing and supply chain processes.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • Fully onsite in Waukesha, WI — this is not a remote position.

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.

  • Direct-hire opportunity managed through NESCO Resource.

Interested? Apply through NESCO Resource and a member of our recruiting team will contact you to discuss the opportunity and company in greater detail.

job.title: MultiCloud Adminstrator
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking a MultiCloud Administrator focused on critical facilities and electrical infrastructure for computer rooms at manufacturing locations. This role will lead power-capacity planning, UPS and battery strategy, rack and room design, facilities readiness, and StruxureWare DCIM platform management.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own current and future IT power-demand planning, including kW per rack, amperage, electrical phases, peak-load assumptions, A/B feeds, redundancy paths, and growth buffers.
  • Document power-source paths, redundancy requirements, dual-feed configurations, generator transfers, and room-feeding approaches.
  • Coordinate with plant electrical and facilities teams regarding electrical capacity, panels, circuits, breakers, and phased expansions.
  • Define UPS strategies, capacity requirements, runtime targets, monitoring standards, inspection schedules, testing plans, and replacement strategies.
  • Troubleshoot UPS and battery systems and develop improvement plans for utilization or capacity risks.
  • Create and maintain rack elevations, as-built room layouts, cable paths, and capacity models.

  • Participate in root-cause analysis and remediation planning following electrical failures.
  • Establish and maintain standard operating procedures and methods of procedure for power work, UPS maintenance, rack changes, and room upgrades.
  • Provide quality oversight for contractors working on computer rooms and critical electrical systems.
  • Manage vendors supporting UPS, battery, monitoring, and electrical infrastructure.

  • Manage the StruxureWare DCIM platform.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • At least five years of experience supporting critical facilities, electrical infrastructure, data centers, or computer-room environments.
  • Hands-on experience with UPS systems, battery technologies, and electrical distribution.
  • Experience troubleshooting critical electrical infrastructure using established operational-safety procedures.
  • Demonstrated experience creating and maintaining rack elevations and physical layouts.
  • Ability to validate rack power, thermal, weight, access, and growth requirements.
  • Experience with generators, automatic transfer switches, static transfer switches, and mission-critical electrical systems.
  • Knowledge of data-center tiering concepts and reliability-oriented design.
  • Experience coordinating critical infrastructure activities with facilities teams, vendors, and contractors.

Preferred Skills or Experience

  • Experience supporting industrial or manufacturing facilities.
  • StruxureWare or comparable data-center infrastructure management platform experience.
  • Experience supporting dual-room resiliency or critical-facilities modernization programs.

Work Details

  • Onsite role.
  • Up to 10% domestic and international travel.
