job.title: Maintenance Manager
job.description:
Maintenance Manager

Reports to: Plant Manager
Location: Farmingdale and Amityville, New York (On-Site)
Pay: From $100,000 per year

POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Maintenance Manager to lead maintenance and reliability across two Long Island manufacturing facilities. This position is responsible for leading the maintenance team, improving equipment reliability, managing preventive maintenance programs, overseeing repairs and projects, maintaining regulatory compliance, and controlling maintenance-related spending.

This is not strictly an administrative position. The Maintenance Manager must be comfortable working directly with equipment, leading complex troubleshooting, reading prints and manuals, identifying and sourcing components, and ensuring critical issues are resolved effectively.

A key initial priority will be establishing and driving consistent use of a newly implemented Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS), including equipment and parts data, preventive maintenance programs, work-order standards, and maintenance reporting.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Maintenance Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, schedule, coach, and develop maintenance technicians and mechanics supporting multiple shifts and two facilities.
  • Establish daily and weekly priorities based on safety, production needs, equipment criticality, labor, and parts availability.
  • Set clear expectations for workmanship, attendance, documentation, housekeeping, shift handoffs, and communication.
  • Evaluate team performance, identify skill gaps, provide technical coaching and cross-training, and address performance concerns in coordination with HR.
  • Maintain appropriate shift and emergency coverage and ensure open repairs and production risks are communicated effectively.

CMMS & Maintenance Planning

  • Lead the implementation and ongoing administration of the maintenance department's CMMS.
  • Maintain accurate equipment records, asset hierarchy, preventive maintenance schedules, parts information, manuals, drawings, and equipment history.
  • Establish effective work-order standards, priorities, scheduling, downtime reporting, and closeout procedures.
  • Develop and continuously improve preventive and predictive maintenance programs for production equipment, utilities, buildings, and safety systems.
  • Use CMMS reporting to manage PM completion, maintenance backlog, recurring failures, equipment history, parts usage, and maintenance performance.

Troubleshooting & Equipment Reliability

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership during complex or high-impact equipment failures involving mechanical, electrical, controls, pneumatic, hydraulic, refrigeration, boiler, steam, and facility systems.
  • Troubleshoot automated production and packaging equipment, including batching and cooking systems, pumps, mixers, fillers, cappers, conveyors, coding and labeling equipment, and related utilities.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for significant breakdowns and recurring problems and ensure corrective actions are completed and effective.
  • Maintain accurate electrical and mechanical drawings, equipment documentation, control-system backups, and records of equipment changes.
  • Partner with Production and Quality during equipment startup and turnover to ensure repairs meet safety, quality, and performance expectations.

Parts, Vendors & Contractors

  • Identify, research, cross-reference, and source mechanical, electrical, controls, and facility components, including obsolete and long-lead parts.
  • Develop and maintain a critical spare-parts program based on equipment risk, failure history, lead time, and cost.
  • Maintain accurate parts inventory and storeroom records.
  • Build strong relationships with manufacturers, distributors, repair services, and technical contractors.
  • Obtain and compare quotations, coordinate contractor work, and ensure outside work meets established expectations.

Safety, Food Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure maintenance activities comply with OSHA requirements, safety policies, LOTO, machine guarding, electrical safety, and other applicable requirements.
  • Ensure repairs meet cGMP, sanitary design, food safety, allergen control, foreign-material, and sanitation standards.
  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready maintenance, inspection, calibration, contractor, and corrective-action records.
  • Support customer, regulatory, GFSI, and internal audits.

Projects, Budgeting & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead or support equipment installations, upgrades, capital projects, commissioning, and startup activities.
  • Develop project scopes, cost estimates, schedules, and risk assessments and monitor project costs and progress.
  • Manage maintenance labor, parts, repair, service contract, and capital spending.
  • Use downtime, maintenance, quality, safety, and cost data to identify reliability and continuous-improvement opportunities.
  • Provide plant leadership with clear updates on equipment condition, major breakdowns, staffing, PM status, projects, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Work closely with Production, Quality, Safety, Sanitation, HR, and plant leadership to coordinate priorities and support uninterrupted operations.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

Required Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive industrial maintenance experience, including at least 4 years supervising or managing maintenance employees in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in food, beverage, pharmaceutical, or another regulated, sanitation-sensitive manufacturing environment; food manufacturing strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success leading a multi-shift maintenance team and improving maintenance execution and equipment reliability.
  • Hands-on experience implementing, building out, or significantly improving a CMMS, including asset data, PMs, work orders, equipment history, parts, backlog management, and reporting.
  • Strong experience leading complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis on automated production and packaging equipment.
  • Proven ability to identify, research, cross-reference, and source mechanical, electrical, controls, and facility components.

Education & Technical Knowledge

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering preferred. Technical education, recognized trade training, or an equivalent combination of education and substantial hands-on experience will be considered.
  • Strong knowledge of industrial mechanical and electrical systems, motors, pumps, gearboxes, pneumatics, hydraulics, sensors, instrumentation, VFDs, PLC diagnostics, and HMI fault information.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, manuals, specifications, and parts diagrams.
  • Working knowledge of plant utilities, preventive and predictive maintenance, root-cause analysis, OSHA requirements, cGMPs, and food manufacturing safety standards.
  • Strong computer skills, including CMMS administration, Microsoft Excel, data analysis, and written reporting.

Leadership & Work Style

  • Calm and decisive under production pressure with strong organizational and follow-through skills.
  • Fair, direct, and professional when setting expectations and addressing performance concerns.
  • Able to earn the respect of experienced tradespeople through technical credibility, consistency, and hands-on leadership.
  • Strong communicator who can explain technical issues and business risks to employees, leadership, vendors, and nontechnical personnel.

SCHEDULE & WORK REQUIREMENTS

  • Full-time, on-site position with regular work at both the Farmingdale and Amityville facilities.
  • Must be available to support multiple shifts and respond to urgent plant issues outside normal working hours when required.
  • Must be able to work safely in an active manufacturing environment and comply with all required PPE, hygiene, safety, and food safety requirements.

BENEFITS

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Paid time off

job.title: Electrician - 3rd shift
job.description:
9:00PM-6:30AM
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
Perform a variety of maintenance, repairs, continuous improvement, and new installation functions on plant equipment and machinery with limited direction and guidance. Support manufacturing operations in a spirit of teamwork and cooperation. Troubleshoot and resolve issues in a timely fashion. Safely, professionally and efficiently, complete wiring projects and new installations per electrical line-up and documentation. Competencies:

  • Knowledge of industrial, mechanical and electrical codes, techniques and standards. Familiarity with government regulations for industry, and safe work practices dealing with high voltage circuits.
  • Must have strong background in electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, robotic arms, and overall machine troubleshooting skills.
  • Skilled understanding and experience with electrical schematics and ladder diagrams. Expertise with meters and diagnostic instruments used to evaluate electrical systems, both low and high voltage and AC/DC circuits.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics, specify and gather material and complete wiring installation or repairs with minimal supervision.
  • Familiarity with complex machinery, electrical circuits and plant operating equipment. Should maintain a sense of urgency, self-motivation and overall good work ethic while performing tasks in a safe manner.
  • Skilled in interpersonal relations and written and oral communications.


Key Responsibilities/Deliverables:
1. Troubleshoot and repair machinery and equipment with minimal supervision using safe electrical techniques, schematics and diagnostic instruments. Perform mechanical functions and incidental work as needed to achieve assigned task. Verify equipment as functional and leave the area clean and safe.
2. Operate in response to requests by maintenance supervisor or support personnel, and set priorities as required to maximize equipment uptime.
3. Gather and maintain a complete set of required tools, including electrical meters and diagnostic devices. Utilize diagnostic tools and electrical schematics to define problem areas and assist with resolution. Develop PLC skills to troubleshoot controls related issues.
4. Participate in preventive and predictive maintenance programs to improve operational uptime and equipment life. Recommend improvements and/or changes to PM systems/tasks when applicable.
5. Follow designated work instructions as outlined for specific functions. These include, but are not limited to; PM work orders, continuous improvement tasks, new installation line-ups and repair/refurbish assignments.
6. Update drawings/prints, suggest spare parts and suitable replacements, run conduit/wire-way and power drops. Build, label and wire panels/boxes in a professional manner per line-up and schematics.
7. Follow standard practices and governmental regulations and laws relating to powered equipment.
8. Perform other related duties as assigned by immediate supervisor and management.

Education Required/Preferred: High School Diploma or equivalent. Electrical Journeyman's card or equivalent work experience. Ability to pass an Electrician aptitude test.

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer II (NPI)
job.description:
Nesco Resource is in search of a Manufacturing Engineer II (NPI) to work for one of our clients based in Bethel, CT.
 
SUMMARY:
The Manufacturing Engineer II will serve as the New Product Introduction (NPI) Design Transfer Engineer provides support for documenting medical device component manufacturing processes for handoff from development to full scale production. This position is the bridge between R&D and manufacturing engineering. Will utilize the company’s phased design transfer process to ensure that all production release requirements are being met on schedule, including utilizing transfer checklists or project plans, and conducting phase gate reviews with functional department managers.
 
RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Coordinate closely with Development and Manufacturing Engineering to define and document component manufacturing requirements and processes as devices move through the development lifecycle
  • Work with cross-functional departments to confirm manufacturing line readiness and ensure appropriate equipment, space and staff are prepared
  • Finalize inspection procedures including defining inspection sample size and inspection techniques/gages for each lot of parts
  • Write work instructions and train production staff on procedures
  • Draft process risk assessment (PFMEA), process flow charts, and control plans
  • Perform process validation (IQ/OQ/PQ/MVP/TMV) and gage R&R activities, as required
  • Ensure bill of materials and job router accuracy
  • Solidify tooling documentation for production release using SolidWorks, including tool design updates for manufacturability and tool drawing creation/modification
  • Review process metrics to identify areas of improvement during the transfer process
  • Ensure that accurate and complete QMS/DMR records are generated through the change order process, including documentation of both finished components and raw materials
  • Monitor transfers post-release for lessons learned or process improvements
  • Provide constructive feedback to the production transfer process, and participate in continuous improvement initiatives such as creating templates for similar processes
  • Assist in driving manufacturing engineering projects to completion, including making sure the work is done satisfactorily and timely.
  • Other duties as assigned
QUALIFICATIONS:
  • BS in relevant Engineering discipline
  • 3 years’ experience in a manufacturing environment
  • Familiarity creating and modifying drawings and models using SolidWorks
  • Strong communication skills, comfortable with providing project status updates at the team level or holding phase gate meetings with functional department managers
  • Demonstrated work ethic and understanding of deadline management
  • Effective interpersonal skills and adeptness in working with a culturally diverse employee population
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Experience working in a medical device or regulated environment
  • Prior experience transferring projects from development to manufacturing
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:
  • 12 month temporary assignment (benefits available through Nesco)
  • First shift, Monday – Friday, 8:30am – 5pm (30 minute lunch)
  • Target Pay Range: $40 – 55/hour

job.title: CNC Machinist
job.description:
Position Summary
The Machinist III is responsible for programming, setting up, operating, and troubleshooting CNC and manual machining equipment to manufacture precision parts that meet engineering specifications and quality standards. This role requires advanced machining knowledge, the ability to work independently with minimal supervision, and strong communication skills to collaborate with internal teams and external vendors.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Program CNC machines using CamWorks and SolidWorks software.
Utilize knowledge of Mastercam or GibbsCAM software, with training provided for CamWorks as needed.
Perform light G-code editing at the machine to optimize programs and correct machining issues.
Set up and operate CNC mills, CNC lathes, manual lathes, and other machining equipment.
Create and modify simple machine programs directly at the machine when required.
Select tooling, establish work and tool offsets, and optimize machining processes.
Read and interpret:
Blueprints
GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing)
CAD drawings
Engineering sketches and specifications
Conduct in-process and final inspections using precision measuring instruments, including:
Micrometers
Calipers
Pin gauges
Indicators
Other precision gauges
Troubleshoot machining, tooling, and quality issues to ensure efficient production.
Perform routine machine maintenance and basic equipment repairs.
Understand material characteristics and machining requirements for various metals and other materials.
Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, productivity, and cost reduction.
Communicate effectively with supervisors, engineers, coworkers, and vendors.
Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

Required Qualifications
High school diploma or equivalent; technical or vocational training preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of machining experience in a manufacturing environment.
Experience programming CNC equipment using CAM software.
Proficiency with CamWorks and SolidWorks preferred.
Experience with Mastercam or GibbsCAM is acceptable; training on CamWorks will be provided.
Ability to read and interpret blueprints, CAD drawings, and GD&T requirements.
Working knowledge of G-code programming and machine-side editing.
Experience setting up and operating CNC and manual lathes.
Strong understanding of machining processes, tooling selection, feeds, speeds, and material properties.
Ability to use precision measuring and inspection equipment accurately.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Advanced CNC programming experience.
Experience with multi-axis machining operations.
Lean manufacturing or continuous improvement experience.
Experience communicating directly with suppliers and outside vendors.
Physical Requirements
Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift throughout the workday.
Ability to lift up to 50 pounds occasionally.
Ability to safely operate machine tools and inspection equipment.
Must be able to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to noise, moving machinery, and metalworking fluids.

Key Competencies
CNC Programming
CNC and Manual Machining
Blueprint Reading
GD&T Interpretation
Precision Measurement & Inspection
Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
Material Knowledge
Process Improvement
Communication & Teamwork
Independent Work Execution
This position is ideal for a highly skilled machinist who can independently program, set up, machine, inspect, and troubleshoot precision components while supporting quality and continuous improvement objectives.

job.title: Maintenance Technician II
job.description:
Maintenance Technician II

Position Overview

Our client is seeking a skilled and self-motivated Maintenance Technician II to support maintenance operations within a fast-paced distribution center. This position will serve as the second maintenance technician on site, making the ability to work independently, troubleshoot equipment, and prioritize maintenance activities with minimal supervision essential.

The Maintenance Technician II will be responsible for preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting mechanical and electrical equipment, completing work orders and inspections, and helping maintain reliable operation of facility and material-handling equipment.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on maintenance professional who can independently diagnose problems, perform repairs, and take ownership of equipment reliability and uptime.

Schedule & Compensation

  • Schedule: Monday–Friday

  • Shift: 2:00 PM–10:30 PM

  • Base Pay: $33.00–$38.00/hour, depending on experience

  • Shift Differential: Additional $2.00/hour for hours worked between 6:00 PM–10:30 PM

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform scheduled preventive and preventative maintenance on facility and material-handling equipment.

  • Perform corrective maintenance and repairs when equipment failures occur.

  • Troubleshoot mechanical and electrical equipment to identify the source of failures.

  • Respond to equipment breakdowns and take appropriate action to restore operations.

  • Maintain conveyor systems, forklifts, lifts, and other material-handling equipment.

  • Inspect equipment to identify potential issues before they result in unplanned downtime.

  • Complete assigned maintenance work orders accurately and in a timely manner.

  • Document maintenance activities, repairs, inspections, and equipment conditions within the CMMS.

  • Prioritize maintenance activities based on equipment condition, operational needs, and potential impact to uptime.

  • Work independently to diagnose and resolve routine and complex maintenance issues.

  • Communicate equipment issues, completed repairs, and outstanding maintenance needs to appropriate personnel.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe maintenance work area.

  • Follow all safety procedures, maintenance standards, and company policies.

  • Support continuous improvement and equipment reliability initiatives as needed.

Equipment Supported

The Maintenance Technician II will support a variety of distribution center and material-handling equipment, including:

  • Conveyor systems

  • Forklifts

  • Lifts

  • Material-handling equipment

  • Facility equipment

  • Mechanical and electrical systems

Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in industrial, manufacturing, warehouse, distribution center, or facility maintenance.

  • Strong mechanical troubleshooting and repair skills.

  • Strong electrical troubleshooting experience.

  • Experience performing preventive and corrective maintenance.

  • Ability to independently diagnose equipment problems and determine appropriate repairs.

  • Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision.

  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.

  • Ability to complete maintenance work orders and inspections accurately.

  • Strong commitment to workplace safety.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using a CMMS or computerized work-order system.

  • Experience maintaining conveyors and material-handling systems.

  • Experience troubleshooting motors, sensors, electrical components, and mechanical systems.

  • Experience working in an automated distribution or warehouse environment.

  • Familiarity with industrial controls or PLC-based equipment.

  • Experience with forklifts, lifts, or other powered material-handling equipment.

What Makes a Strong Candidate

The ideal Maintenance Technician II is an experienced, hands-on technician who does not require constant direction. Because this individual will be the second maintenance technician on site, they must be comfortable taking ownership of maintenance activities, responding to equipment issues, determining priorities, and completing repairs independently.

Candidates with strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting experience, preventive maintenance experience, and a background supporting conveyors or material-handling equipment will be highly competitive.

Work Environment

This position operates in a fast-paced distribution center where equipment uptime is critical to daily operations. The technician should be comfortable working throughout the facility, responding to equipment issues, performing hands-on repairs, and working independently during the assigned shift.

The selected candidate will be responsible for ASIC & FPGA development on R&D program. This engineer with have experience in developing, testing, and integrating digital signal processing (DSP), high speed digital design, high speed communication and system-on-chip (SOC) implemented on FPGA platforms. job.title: Technical Client Operations Specialist
job.description:
We are hiring two Technical Client Operations Specialists to help customers successfully implement, use, and get more value from a SaaS platform. This is not a traditional help desk role where you spend the day waiting for tickets to come in. You will manage an assigned group of approximately 10–15 clients and proactively work with them to understand how they are using the platform, where they may be struggling, and what can be done to improve their experience.

The position sits at the intersection of client support, software implementation, technical operations, data/database support, training, and customer success. You will work directly with customers while partnering with internal technical teams to address issues and keep implementations and client initiatives moving forward.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Help new customers through software implementation and onboarding to ensure a smooth transition onto the platform.
  • Assist clients with database and data-related questions, including investigating problems, reviewing information, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating technical resolutions when necessary.
  • Lead virtual training sessions that help customers better understand system functionality, workflows, and available features.
  • Regularly connect with assigned customers to understand how they are using the software instead of relying solely on incoming support requests.
  • Identify situations where customers are underutilizing the platform and work with them to understand the reason behind low adoption.
  • Provide practical recommendations that help clients improve software usage, engagement, and overall workflow efficiency.
  • Coordinate with internal Product, Engineering, Operations, or other technical teams when customer issues require additional expertise.
  • Maintain regular communication with customers and provide clear follow-up on open questions, problems, or implementation items.
  • Manage ongoing relationships with approximately 10–15 client organizations at a time.
  • Track customer feedback, recurring technical issues, training opportunities, adoption trends, and other themes that may improve the client experience.
  • Help build a proactive support environment focused on preventing problems and improving customer success rather than simply responding to tickets.

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience in technical operations, SaaS implementation, technical support, customer success, client services, or client-facing software support.
  • Experience working directly with customers and solving problems in a virtual environment.
  • Background supporting software implementations, onboarding customers, or assisting clients after a system has gone live.
  • Comfortable troubleshooting technical software issues and determining when additional internal resources need to become involved.
  • Experience supporting database or data-related client issues.
  • Ability to teach users how to work within a software platform and explain technical concepts without making them unnecessarily complicated.
  • Experience helping customers improve software usage, adoption, or engagement.
  • Strong communication and follow-up skills with the ability to manage several client relationships simultaneously.
  • A proactive approach to customer support someone who will identify potential problems and reach out rather than waiting for the customer to ask for help.

Experience That Would Be Helpful

  • Background working within fintech, banking technology, lending technology, or financial services software.
  • Familiarity with Loan Origination Systems (LOS) or related lending and banking platforms.
  • Experience with technologies or platforms similar to Abrigo, Baker Hill, Moody's, or nCino.
  • Previous experience supporting customers within a SaaS environment.
  • Experience analyzing customer usage patterns and developing strategies to improve adoption.
  • Experience helping clients improve workflows, platform engagement, or operational efficiency.

Work Environment

  • Fully remote position with no specific time-zone requirement.
  • Primary operating hours are Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM–2:00 PM Pacific Time.
  • Employees will work a normal eight-hour workday, with scheduling structured around the required client coverage window.
  • Occasional travel may be required for team meetings or company activities.
  • Travel could include approximately three consecutive onsite days per quarter.
  • Employees should typically receive approximately three weeks' notice before required onsite travel.

job.title: MRB Design Engineer - Secret Clearance
job.description:

As the Mechanical Review Board Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting the production programs by identifying and resolving production issues, defects, and failures.
You will work closely with cross-functional teams to develop and implement viable solutions, often in time-sensitive situations.

Your responsibilities will include:
•Participate as a key member in the Material Review Board (MRB) process, including reviewing non-conforming hardware for performance impacts, identify appropriate root cause and ensure corrective action is taken to prevent recurrence
•Coordinate effort within the Mechanical, Quality and Manufacturing team
•Support weekly meetings to review status to leadership

job.title: Supply Chain Customer Service Representative
job.description:
Nesco Resource is partnering with a global leader in the petrochemical and manufacturing industry to hire a Supply Chain Customer Service Representative for its Houston team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys being the main point of contact for customers while also working closely with supply chain, logistics, sales, and operations. This is not a traditional call-center position. The role is focused on managing B2B customer accounts, coordinating orders from start to finish, proactively communicating with customers, analyzing demand and buying trends, and resolving issues throughout the order fulfillment process.

The ideal candidate will have experience in customer service, supply chain, order management, logistics, or customer account management within a corporate, manufacturing, industrial, chemical, petrochemical, or oil & gas environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned B2B customer accounts
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication and follow-up
  • Manage customer orders and support the order-to-fulfillment process
  • Coordinate closely with supply chain, logistics, operations, sales, and other internal teams
  • Proactively contact customers regarding orders, product needs, demand changes, and service-related issues
  • Monitor customer buying patterns and identify increases or decreases in demand
  • Analyze customer and order data to anticipate needs and identify potential issues
  • Resolve order, shipment, inventory, and customer service issues while ensuring timely follow-through
  • Help identify opportunities to retain existing business and increase customer satisfaction
  • Balance customer needs with operational and business requirements
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and increased efficiency
  • Maintain accurate customer and order information within ERP and internal systems

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a corporate B2B environment
  • Experience in customer service, supply chain, order management, logistics, customer operations, inside sales support, or a related field
  • Strong customer-facing experience via phone and email
  • Ability to manage customer relationships rather than solely process transactions
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization, multitasking, and follow-through
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and basic math skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience

Highly Preferred

  • SAP or other ERP experience
  • Manufacturing, industrial, chemical, petrochemical, plastics, or oil & gas experience
  • Supply chain and order fulfillment experience
  • Experience analyzing customer demand, buying patterns, KPIs, or order trends
  • Experience working with logistics, inventory, warehouses, or transportation
  • Lean/Six Sigma or process improvement exposure
  • Bilingual or multilingual communication skills are a plus

What We're Looking For

The strongest candidate will be someone who can say, "I own the customer relationship and make sure their orders and needs are handled from beginning to end.”

We're looking for someone who is proactive, comfortable picking up the phone and contacting customers, understands how customer service connects with supply chain and operations, and can use data to anticipate customer needs—not someone whose experience is limited to simply entering orders.

This contract-to-hire opportunity offers the chance to join an established global organization with exposure to multiple areas of the business and long-term opportunities for professional growth.

job.title: Warehouse Material Handlers
job.description:
Schedules:

1st shift - Mon - Thurs 5:30am - 4pm

2nd shift - Mon - Thurs 3:45pm - 2:15am

3rd shift - Fri, Sat, Sun 6am - 6:30pm

Under close supervision, expedites the movement of parts and material between production areas by listing or otherwise moving raw materials and/or parts. Prepares and coordinates schedules for pulling and delivering materials to control the flow of goods and regulate production floor space. Safely operates appropriate equipment (forklifts, hoists, crane, etc.) required to move materials along production floor. Follows all safety rules and practices.

 

MAJOR JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (List in order of importance)

Warehouse material handlers essential duties are to perform various tasks in the warehouse such as but not limited to:

Inbound: Unload trucks, trailers, containers of freight, counting products, compare to manifest to check all shipments for damage, infestation, or production code dates. Material handlers must report shortages, damages, and mis-shipments on appropriate forms. Also be able to sign for inbound shipments when necessary. All inbound shipments are moved safely to storage locations to be efficiently stacked as store merchandise.

  • Order Picking: Ensure that the correct product number, quantity and type (lot, batch, serial number) of product are picked. Transport orders to shipping locations or delivery platforms with material handling equipment such as but not limited to fork trucks, cherry pickers, or pallet jacks. Materials handlers must be able to label, stencil, tag, mark orders, band, bundle, wrap, over-pack, and palletize as required.
  • Outbound: Compare quantity, labeling and address with order to ensure out-going shipments are complete and correct. Assign signature for outbound as necessary. Efficiently move product, cartons and or pallets into trailers, rail cars or containers.
  • Equipment: Maintain equipment in a neat, clean and orderly fashion. Operate equipment safely and efficiently. Comply with company standards and OSHA requirements.
  • Inventory: Keep accurate records and reports. Assist in physical inventories and cycle counts. Ensure proper stock rotation. May key inventory adjustments in computer.
  • Other Duties: Repack or re-box cases per customer instructions. Repair and consolidate damaged goods as required. Operate shrink-wrap machine. Charge forklift battery as needed; stack and or separate good from bad pallets when necessary; clean railcars, trailers, and truck docks, bays as requested.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS (Education/Training, Experience and Certifications)

  • High School education or GED preferred
  • OSHA Forklift and HAZMAT certification a plus


KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND ABILITIES (Those necessary to perform the job competently)

  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Must be able to use proper techniques to lift up to 75 pounds. The ability to follow directions with emphasis on safety is extremely important.
  • Must be able to handle stress caused in meeting deadlines with tight scheduling requirements.
  • Must be able to shift priorities easily.
  • Must be able to use hands and feet simultaneously and for repetitive movements.
  • Must have responsible work habits.
  • Must be familiar with warehouse systems.
  • Must be available to work any shift.


LANGUAGE SKILLS:
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret SOPs, coverage, documents, and regulations. Ability to write reports and business correspondence. Ability to effectively establish rapport, present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, customers and the public. Skill and ability to meet people and listen.


MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:
Ability to add and subtract two digit numbers and to multiply and divide with 10's and 100's. Ability to perform these operations using units of American money and weight measurement, volume, and distance. Understanding of metric system measurements is beneficial.


REASONING ABILITY:
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed and uninvolved written or oral instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.


OTHER:
Skill and ability to type. Skill and ability to operate a computer. Skill and ability to organize and prioritize work. Skill and ability to meet deadlines and operate office equipment. Skill and ability to use Microsoft office tools and company software.


ENVIRONMENTAL WORKING CONDITIONS & PHYSICAL EFFORT (Under Typical Positions)

The work environment characteristics and physical effort described here are representative of those an associate encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the associate is exposed to an industrial warehouse environment. The associate works near moving mechanical machinery and noise level in the work environment is usually loud. The job requires working in heights, exposure to changes in temperature, driving equipment, and maybe exposed to dust, fumes, or gases.


The associate is required to stand and walk for the majority of the working day. The physical requirements of the job are for associates to talk, hear, bend/stoop, squat, crawl, climb height, reach above shoulder height, crouch, kneel, balance, and push/pull. Furthermore, the job requires associates to lift/carry/push or pull up to 75 pounds with or without assistance. Associates use both hands for repetitive actions such as grasping and manipulating as well as both feet for repetitive movement operating foots controls. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

job.title: Technology Incident Manager - (Banking)
job.description:
Job Summary
The Incident Manager is responsible for leading the timely restoration of critical business services impacted by technology disruptions. This role manages cross-functional investigative teams and facilitates resolution of enterprise-level incidents through strong leadership, technical insight, and effective communication. The Incident Manager ensures that all incident response activities are executed efficiently, with a focus on minimizing business impact and improving system stability. This position may require overnight work hours and participation in a weekend on-call rotation.

Essential Functions


Lead the identification, assessment, and resolution of critical technology incidents affecting enterprise operations.
Facilitate and manage virtual incident response calls with diverse technical and business stakeholders.
Quickly assess the scope and impact of incidents and determine the appropriate support teams and escalation paths.
Guide troubleshooting efforts across multiple technology domains, including distributed systems, networks, applications, and mainframes.
Collaborate with vendors and internal teams to drive resolution and ensure accurate, timely communication.
Escalate critical issues to senior leadership and provide consistent progress updates.
Partner with the communications team to ensure incident notifications are timely and accurate.
Conduct post-incident reviews to identify root causes, process improvements, and documentation updates.
Maintain and review critical application recovery documentation for accuracy and usability
Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance incident detection, response, and recovery processes.
Participate in production readiness reviews for critical projects to ensure alignment with incident management protocols.
Adhere to ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library)-based processes and contribute to the development of incident management metrics and reporting.
Must be able to work overnight shifts.
Participation in weekend on-call rotation is required.
Performs other duties as assigned; duties, responsibilities and/or activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice
Complies with all policies and procedures, including without limitation, acting professionally at all times, conducting business ethically, avoiding conflicts of interest, and acting in the best interests of clients and company.

Education
Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field or equivalent experience. (preferred)

Work Experience
3+ years of experience leading technical projects, incident response efforts, or cross-functional technology initiatives (required)?
Experience in a high-pressure, 24/7 IT operations or incident management environment (preferred)
Familiarity with enterprise IT infrastructure and application ecosystems (required)

Licenses and Certifications
ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) Foundation certification (preferred)
Incident management, project management (e.g., PMP), or technical discipline certifications (preferred)

Skills
The ability to oversee and coordinate the response to unplanned service disruptions, ensuring timely restoration of services and minimizing business impact.
Executing structured processes to detect, assess, respond to, and recover from incidents, while coordinating across technical and business teams
Leading the organization's response during high-impact, time-sensitive events by making critical decisions, maintaining control, and ensuring continuity of operations
The process of identifying the fundamental cause of an incident to prevent recurrence and support long-term stability and improvement.
The practice of identifying, evaluating, and mitigating risks that could impact business operations, technology systems, or regulatory compliance
The ability to clearly and effectively convey information across technical and non-technical audiences, especially during high-pressure situations.
Managing and resolving disagreements or competing priorities among stakeholders to maintain focus and collaboration during incident response.
Recognizing when an incident requires higher-level attention and ensuring timely communication and involvement of senior leadership or specialized teams.
Ensuring that IT services can be recovered and maintained during and after a disruption, in alignment with business continuity and recovery objectives.
Managing cybersecurity-related incidents, including detection, containment, investigation, and recovery, while minimizing impact and ensuring compliance.
Understanding and applying organizational standards and protocols that govern the secure and effective use of IT systems and infrastructure.
Guiding cross-functional teams during incident response, making informed decisions, and maintaining composure under pressure to drive resolution.
Analyzing complex issues, identifying solutions quickly, and making sound decisions based on logic, data, and situational awareness.
Prioritizing the needs and expectations of internal and external clients during incident response to minimize disruption and maintain trust.
Accurately recording incident details, timelines, actions taken, and outcomes to support post-incident reviews, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Physical Demands
General Office - Prolonged sitting, ability to communicate face to face in person or on the phone with teammates and clients, frequent use of PC/laptop, occasional lifting/pushing/pulling of backpacks, computer bags up to 10 lbs.

Travel
Occasional travel to include overnights

job.title: Senior Finance Manager - Distribution
job.description:
Sr. Financial Manager - Distribution serves as a strategic business partner to the distribution and logistics teams. This role drives operational excellence by delivering financial analysis, forecasting, and insights that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and support decision-making across the supply chain. The analyst will play a pivotal role in translating data into actionable recommendations, developing KPI dashboards, and collaborating with cross-functional partners to optimize performance.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Analysis & Reporting

  • Prepare and deliver accurate, timely financial reports for supply chain functions (distribution, logistics, and inventory).
  • Conduct variance and trend analyses to identify cost drivers, risks, and opportunities for efficiency/profitability improvements.
  • Conduct variance analyses for freight and duty actuals vs standard
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close processes, including accruals, reconciliations, and variance commentary.
  • Develop Monthly Inventory reporting to capture inventory and SKU data by division by aging bucket including SKU productivity metrics.
  • Develop financial models to evaluate warehouse performance, capital investments, and operational initiatives.

Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Lead annual budgeting and ongoing forecasting for supply chain operations, including operating expenses, capital expenditures, and unit flows by division by order type.
  • Review and update distribution forecasts based on changing supply and demand conditions-unit flows
  • Monitor performance against forecasts, identify variances, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support long-range financial planning and scenario modeling to assess operational strategies.
  • Assist with warehouse labor planning (permanent and temporary

KPI & Dashboard Development

  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards to track KPIs for distribution, logistics, and inventory functions.
  • Partner with IT and operations teams to extract and structure data from multiple sources, ensuring integrity and consistency.
  • Train stakeholders on dashboard use and interpretation to strengthen data-driven decision-making.

Business Partnership & Collaboration

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Distribution Center management, logistics leaders, and division finance/sales teams.
  • Implement recurring monthly/quarterly cross functional meetings to review financial performance and KPI's to discuss trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate financial data into insights for non-financial stakeholders, supporting cost savings and operational improvements.
  • Participate in strategic projects, supplier negotiations, and inventory optimization initiatives.

Process Improvement & Operational Support

  • Evaluate and enhance financial reporting and planning processes for efficiency and automation.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce costs, improve service levels, and optimize distribution and operations network.
  • Support compliance, internal controls, and best practices in financial management

Qualifications & Experience

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in financial or operational analysis supporting supply chain, logistics, or distribution center operations.
  • Hands-on experience analyzing distribution center KPIs, including cost per unit (CPU), unit flow, throughput, labor productivity, and capacity utilization.
  • Proven ability to analyze and forecast inbound and outbound unit flows across freight and distribution operations.
  • Experience performing SKU-level analysis to evaluate productivity, shipment trends, and operational efficiency.

We are looking for a dependable Quality Technician to inspect parts, materials, and finished products to make sure they meet company quality standards. This is a hands-on position that involves using basic measuring tools and inspection equipment, documenting results, and working closely with the production team.

This is a great opportunity for someone with Quality Inspection, Manufacturing, Production, or similar hands-on experience who is looking to grow their skills in quality.

job.title: Senior Finance Analyst - Distribution
job.description:
Sr. Finance Analyst - Sign On Bonus
This Financial Analyst serves as a strategic business partner to the distribution and logistics teams. This role drives operational excellence by delivering financial analysis, forecasting, and insights that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and support decision-making across the supply chain. The analyst will play a pivotal role in translating data into actionable recommendations, developing KPI dashboards, and collaborating with cross-functional partners to optimize performance.


Key Responsibilities

Financial Analysis & Reporting

  • Prepare and deliver accurate, timely financial reports for supply chain functions (distribution, logistics, and inventory).
  • Conduct variance and trend analyses to identify cost drivers, risks, and opportunities for efficiency/profitability improvements.
  • Conduct variance analyses for freight and duty actuals vs standard
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close processes, including accruals, reconciliations, and variance commentary.
  • Develop Monthly Inventory reporting to capture inventory and SKU data by division by aging bucket including SKU productivity metrics.
  • Develop financial models to evaluate warehouse performance, capital investments, and operational initiatives.

Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Lead annual budgeting and ongoing forecasting for supply chain operations, including operating expenses, capital expenditures, and unit flows by division by order type.
  • Review and update distribution forecasts based on changing supply and demand conditions-unit flows
  • Monitor performance against forecasts, identify variances, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support long-range financial planning and scenario modeling to assess operational strategies.
  • Assist with warehouse labor planning (permanent and temporary

KPI & Dashboard Development

  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards to track KPIs for distribution, logistics, and inventory functions.
  • Partner with IT and operations teams to extract and structure data from multiple sources, ensuring integrity and consistency.
  • Train stakeholders on dashboard use and interpretation to strengthen data-driven decision-making.

Business Partnership & Collaboration

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Distribution Center management, logistics leaders, and division finance/sales teams.
  • Implement recurring monthly/quarterly cross functional meetings to review financial performance and KPI's to discuss trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate financial data into insights for non-financial stakeholders, supporting cost savings and operational improvements.
  • Participate in strategic projects, supplier negotiations, and inventory optimization initiatives.

Process Improvement & Operational Support

  • Evaluate and enhance financial reporting and planning processes for efficiency and automation.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce costs, improve service levels, and optimize distribution and operations network.
  • Support compliance, internal controls, and best practices in financial management

Qualifications & Experience

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field.

job.title: Senior Financial Analyst - Distribution
job.description:
The Financial Analyst - Distribution role serves as a strategic business partner to the distribution and logistics teams. This role drives operational excellence by delivering financial analysis, forecasting, and insights that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and support decision-making across the supply chain. The analyst will play a pivotal role in translating data into actionable recommendations, developing KPI dashboards, and collaborating with cross-functional partners to optimize performance.

Hybrid - (4-in, 1-remote)
Base pay up to $135K based on experience

Key Responsibilities

Financial Analysis & Reporting

  • Prepare and deliver accurate, timely financial reports for supply chain functions (distribution, logistics, and inventory).
  • Conduct variance and trend analyses to identify cost drivers, risks, and opportunities for efficiency/profitability improvements.
  • Conduct variance analyses for freight and duty actuals vs standard
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close processes, including accruals, reconciliations, and variance commentary.
  • Develop Monthly Inventory reporting to capture inventory and SKU data by division by aging bucket including SKU productivity metrics.
  • Develop financial models to evaluate warehouse performance, capital investments, and operational initiatives.

Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Lead annual budgeting and ongoing forecasting for supply chain operations, including operating expenses, capital expenditures, and unit flows by division by order type.
  • Review and update distribution forecasts based on changing supply and demand conditions-unit flows
  • Monitor performance against forecasts, identify variances, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support long-range financial planning and scenario modeling to assess operational strategies.
  • Assist with warehouse labor planning (permanent and temporary

KPI & Dashboard Development

  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards to track KPIs for distribution, logistics, and inventory functions.
  • Partner with IT and operations teams to extract and structure data from multiple sources, ensuring integrity and consistency.
  • Train stakeholders on dashboard use and interpretation to strengthen data-driven decision-making.

Business Partnership & Collaboration

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Distribution Center management, logistics leaders, and division finance/sales teams.
  • Implement recurring monthly/quarterly cross functional meetings to review financial performance and KPI's to discuss trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate financial data into insights for non-financial stakeholders, supporting cost savings and operational improvements.
  • Participate in strategic projects, supplier negotiations, and inventory optimization initiatives.

Process Improvement & Operational Support

  • Evaluate and enhance financial reporting and planning processes for efficiency and automation.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce costs, improve service levels, and optimize distribution and operations network.
  • Support compliance, internal controls, and best practices in financial management

Qualifications & Experience

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in financial or operational analysis supporting distribution center operations.
  • Hands-on experience analyzing distribution center KPIs, including cost per unit (CPU), unit flow, throughput, labor productivity, and capacity utilization.
  • Proven ability to analyze and forecast inbound and outbound unit flows across freight and distribution operations.
  • Experience performing SKU-level analysis to evaluate productivity, shipment trends, and operational efficiency.
  • Advanced Excel skills (complex formulas, large data sets, dashboard creation) and experience with Power BI or similar BI tools to build operational dashboards and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of distribution, logistics, and inventory flow, including the operational drivers behind cost and efficiency in a DC environment.
  • Experience supporting labor tracking and distribution center optimization initiatives, including monitoring labor productivity and cost per unit metrics.
  • Ability to translate operational data into actionable insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional partners.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with distribution, logistics, inventory planning, and operations teams.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills with a proactive, continuous improvement mindset.

job.title: Mechanical Technician IV
job.description:
Position Summary
The Mechanical Technician IV supports engineering projects related to manufacturing capacity additions, line installations, equipment debug, and mechanical readiness for operations receivership. This role supports manufacturing engineering projects during development and execution to ensure timely, error-free mechanical support for multi-line equipment installations. The role also works closely with cross-functional internal and external teams, vendors and suppliers on a daily basis to resolve technical issues and protect project scope, timing, cost, and overall installation goals by providing and applying mechanical expertise.

Applicants must have strong technical knowledge in mechanical engineering, troubleshooting and design processes to proactively identify root causes, resolve technical issues, and implement robust, industrialized solutions that improve equipment and manufacturing performance.
Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain safe work practices, inform others of hazardous conditions or personal practices as expressed on project team
  • Manage installation and debugging activities to meet milestone & timeline objectives for successful capacity additions
  • Design & implement mechanical solutions and process changes to improve capability of manufacturing equipment.
  • Solve mechanical and process issues through data analysis, experience, and collaboration with subject matter experts
  • Manage spare part identification and storeroom entry as recommended by suppliers or peer engineers; noting available spares within (2)-plant footprint
  • Develop and update engineering and operations documentation
  • Support training for operations workforce regarding equipment or operations changes
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting, diagnosis, and repair of mechanical systems, equipment, and machinery (e.g., pumps, motors, conveyors, hydraulics, pneumatics, etc.)
  • Align, test, and calibrate mechanical systems after installation
  • Diagnose complex mechanical failures and recommend effective solutions
  • Interpret blueprints, schematics, and technical manuals to support troubleshooting and repair activities
  • Identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability, efficiency, and safety
  • Collaborate with other departments to implement process improvements

Required Qualifications

  • Education:
    • Associates degree in relevant field (mechanical, technical, engineering)
  • Years/ Area of Experience:
    • At least 5 years' experience in new equipment installations in a manufacturing environment; start-up experience a plus

Additional Certifications

  • Relevant mechanical or industrial certifications (e.g., millwright, or welding) are a plus
  • OSHA or other safety certifications may be required

Required Skills

  • Strong technical fundamentals and mechanical engineering skills
  • Expertise in mechanical systems such as hydraulics, pneumatics, motors, gear systems, and conveyor systems
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and schematics
  • Ability to learn new technology and processes quickly
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize work on an independent basis in a fast-paced project install manufacturing environment
  • Proficiency with PC software, including Microsoft Office Suite and CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems)
  • Proficiency in using hand tools, power tools, and diagnostic equipment
  • Knowledge of safety regulations and practices in an industrial setting

Soft Skills

  • Ability to work and effectively collaborate within a team
  • Ability to allocate/supervise resources to accomplish aggressive project milestones and timeline within specification and cost
  • Able to shift tasks quickly
  • Able to prioritize and multitask
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Detail oriented and able to perform with limited supervision

Desired Skills

  • Project leadership/management experience
  • Experience in vendor/supplier management on-site/off-site
  • Experience with CAD

Travel Requirements:

  • Project locations will range multiple locations within a small locale from Newton to Hickory, North Carolina.

Hours of work/work schedule/flex-time

  • 40 hrs (overtime periodically expected). Due to the project timing; overtime and off-hours coverage may be necessary to successfully complete workload and keep in-line with project goals.

job.title: Multi-Craft Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Job Summary
The Multi Craft Maintenance Technician is responsible for troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining production and facility equipment in a sheet metal fabrication environment. This role requires broad expertise across mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and basic automation systems to ensure safe, efficient, and reliable plant operations.

Key Responsibilities
Maintenance & Repair
  • Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance on equipment
  • Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and electromechanical failures
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, hydraulic diagrams, P&IDs, and mechanical drawings
  • Install, align, and rebuild industrial equipment
  • Work closely with operations, engineering, and maintenance planning teams
  • Support production startup, changeovers, and emergency repairs
Safety & Compliance
  • Follow all safety procedures including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), hot work, confined space, and fall protection
  • Maintain compliance with OSHA, plant safety standards, and environmental regulations
  • Participate in safety audits, job hazard analyses, and continuous improvement initiatives
Continuous Improvement
  • Identify recurring equipment issues and recommend corrective actions or upgrades
  • Support reliability-centered maintenance initiatives
  • Document maintenance activities accurately in the CMMS
Required Qualifications
Education & Experience
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • 3–7+ years of multi craft maintenance experience in steel, metal processing, or heavy manufacturing
Technical Skills
  • Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting capability
  • Working knowledge of:
    • Industrial hydraulics and pneumatics
    • Welding/fabrication (MIG, Stick preferred)
    • Bearings, lubrication systems, and alignment
  • Basic PLC troubleshooting experience required
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs regularly and more with assistance
  • Ability to climb ladders, work at heights, and work in confined spaces

The role supports stable operations, continuous improvement, and production scale-up in a fast-growing manufacturing environment.

Applicants must have historical, hands-on experience in 3D modelling, design, printing, and testing of mechanical components, as well as be able to service and diagnose issues with 3D printing equipment.

Key Responsibilities

Operations & Process Support

  • Operate, monitor, and optimize cleanroom-based optical ribbon and cable manufacturing processes

3D Printing, Modelling & Equipment Support

  • Create, print and test 3D models in Autodesk Inventor modeling software

job.title: Optical Fabricators and Assemblers - Rochester NY
job.description:
Job Title: Optical Assembly Technician
Multiple positions available!
B-Shift/2nd Shift Opening with hours of 2:00pm-10:30pm
$23-26/hr

About the role:
The Optical Assembly Technician performs advanced optical assembly and alignment operations requiring micron- and sub-micron-level accuracy. This role is responsible for actively aligning optical elements to mechanical housings, verifying optical and mechanical performance, and permanently securing optics using high-precision tools and metrology. Work is performed in a controlled clean-room manufacturing environment and requires significant technical skill, judgment, and independence in the execution of high-performance optical products.

Key Responsibilities:
· Perform active alignment of lenses and optical elements into metal housings using precision fixturing.
· Use alignment and metrology tools such as air-bearing spindles, autocollimators, alignment telescopes, precision stages, and indicators to achieve required tolerances.
· Adjust decenter, tip, tilt, and axial position to meet defined optical and mechanical specifications.
· Apply adhesives and permanently secure optics while maintaining alignment during cure.
· Inspect optical elements for defects including scratches, digs, chips, and coating defects.
· Inspect machined metal housings for burrs, surface damage, and dimensional inconsistencies.
· Evaluate cosmetic and functional acceptability using defined optical inspection criteria.
· Determine fitness-for-use of optics and hardware prior to assembly and escalate issues as required.
· Measure critical features using high-precision metrology tools including micrometers, bore gauges, comparators, and dial indicators.



Job Title: Optical Fabricator
Multiple positions available!
B-Shift/2nd Shift Opening with hours of 2:00pm-10:30pm
$25-28/hr

About the Role
In this role, you will manufacture custom lens assemblies and optical systems that meet precise specifications. The ideal candidate has experience in optical systems and glass fabrication, along with strong problem-solving skills using root cause analysis tools.

Key Responsibilities
• Generate precision curves using CNC equipment to meet optical specifications and tolerances.
• Perform CNC centering operations to ensure accurate alignment of optical components.
• Hand bevel and block lenses for grinding and polishing processes.
• Execute hand grinding and CNC/conventional polishing to achieve required surface quality.
• Conduct optical inspection and metrology to verify compliance with specifications.
• Maintain cleanliness of machines, tools, and work areas to ensure quality and safety.
• Plan and schedule work for generation, blocking, grinding, and polishing areas.
• Comply with all health, safety, and PPE requirements.
• Support company values through ethical conduct and integrity in all actions.
• Perform other duties as assigned to support production and continuous improvement.

Equipment Utilized
• CNC and conventional polishing machines
• Optical inspection and metrology equipment
• Personal computer and JDE MRP software
• Personal protective equipment (PPE) and cleanroom attire
• Standard office equipment (calculator, copier, fax, etc.)

Education & Experience
• High school diploma or GED preferred
• Minimum of two years of related optical fabrication experience and/or training
Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities
• Proficiency in operating CNC curve generation machines and CNC centering equipment.
• High degree of accuracy and alertness when using micrometers, interferometers, and high-speed cutting wheels
• Familiarity with optical manufacturing terminology and processes
• Skilled in using conventional polishing machines and performing hand grinding and beveling.
• Ability to perform optical inspection and metrology using precision instruments such as micrometers, interferometers, and other optical measurement tools.
• Familiarity with JDE MRP software and basic computer operations.
• Comfortable using standard office equipment (calculator, copier, fax, etc.).
• Understanding of cleanroom protocols and proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
• Knowledge of optical manufacturing terminology and processes.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under high-speed cutting conditions.

job.description:
3rd Shift: 10pm - 6am Monday through Friday

Position Summary

The Maintenance Technician III is responsible for maintaining equipment reliability, minimizing downtime, and performing mechanical and electrical repairs on production and facility equipment. This role supports preventive maintenance initiatives, troubleshoots equipment issues, and helps ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality manufacturing operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support and execute the Preventive Maintenance (PM) program to reduce unscheduled equipment downtime.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and PLC-controlled equipment issues.
  • Perform maintenance and repairs on production machinery and facility support systems.
  • Inspect, test, and operate equipment to identify malfunctions and verify completed repairs.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot motors, instrumentation, distribution systems, and feed control systems.
  • Develop and implement sustainable solutions to recurring equipment issues.
  • Complete assigned work orders accurately and within established timeframes.
  • Document all maintenance activities using work order systems, software, and maintenance logs.
  • Assist with equipment changeovers, line startups, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Identify replacement parts, maintain inventory levels, and update reorder lists as needed.
  • Collaborate effectively with production and cross-functional teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and provide recommendations to enhance processes and equipment performance.
  • Ensure all products are manufactured to established quality standards.
  • Follow all company policies and procedures, including:
    • Lockout/Tagout (LOTO)
    • Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs)
    • Food Safety Standards
    • OSHA Regulations
    • Company Safety Policies and Procedures

Qualifications

  • Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience working with PLC-controlled equipment and industrial electrical systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, schematics, and maintenance manuals.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced production environment.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry 50-80 lbs.
  • Ability to stand, walk, and perform repetitive motions for extended periods.
  • Must be able to climb ladders and stairs and safely operate manlifts/scissor lifts at elevated heights.
  • Comfortable working in a non-air-conditioned manufacturing environment.

  • Frequent exposure to oils, greases, and coolants.

  • Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, and maintain balance when required.

We are seeking a skilled Assembly Technician to join our manufacturing team. Position Overview

We are seeking a Quality Inspector to join the manufacturing team of a local client. job.title: Continuous Improvement Consultant
job.description:
Job Summary
The Continuous Improvement (CI) Leader is responsible for driving operational excellence by leading process improvement initiatives across the organization. This role utilizes Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and other continuous improvement methodologies to eliminate waste, improve quality, increase productivity, reduce costs, and enhance customer satisfaction. The CI Leader works collaboratively with cross-functional teams to develop a culture of continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead and facilitate continuous improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and other improvement methodologies.
• Identify process improvement opportunities through data analysis, value stream mapping, and performance metrics.
• Develop and implement strategies to improve productivity, quality, safety, and operational efficiency.
• Facilitate Kaizen events, workshops, and problem-solving sessions.
• Coach and mentor employees on Lean principles and continuous improvement tools.
• Monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and ensure achievement of improvement targets.
• Standardize processes and ensure sustainability of implemented improvements.
• Conduct root cause analysis using tools such as:
o 5 Why Analysis
o Fishbone (Ishikawa) Diagram
o Pareto Analysis
o Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
• Collaborate with department managers to prioritize improvement initiatives.
• Support change management activities and encourage employee engagement.
• Prepare reports and presentations for leadership on project progress, savings, and business impact.
• Promote a culture of operational excellence and continuous learning.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
• 5–10 years of experience in Continuous Improvement, Operations, Manufacturing, or Process Excellence.
• Experience leading cross-functional improvement projects.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication, facilitation, and leadership abilities.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
Preferred Qualifications
• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt Certification.
• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification (preferred).
• Experience with ERP systems and business intelligence tools.
• Knowledge of ISO 9001, IATF 16949, or other quality management systems (industry dependent).

Key Skills
• Lean Manufacturing
• Six Sigma
• Kaizen
• Value Stream Mapping (VSM)
• Root Cause Analysis
• DMAIC Methodology
• Process Mapping
• Statistical Analysis
• Change Management
• Project Management
• Data Analysis
• Team Leadership
• Stakeholder Management
• Continuous Improvement Strategy
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
• Cost savings achieved through improvement initiatives.
• Reduction in process cycle time.
• Improvement in Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) (where applicable).
• Reduction in defects and rework.
• Increased productivity and throughput.
• Employee engagement in CI initiatives.
• On-time completion of improvement projects.
• Customer satisfaction improvements.

job.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a customer-focused Medical Front Office Coordinator to serve as the first point of contact for patients while providing exceptional front office support in a busy healthcare practice. This role is responsible for patient check-in and check-out, appointment scheduling, insurance verification, medical record management, and delivering outstanding customer service to ensure a positive patient experience.

The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced medical office environment.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Check-In

  • Greet patients and visitors in a professional and welcoming manner.
  • Register and check in patients for scheduled appointments.
  • Verify and update patient demographics, insurance information, and authorizations.
  • Verify medical insurance eligibility and benefits.
  • Contact insurance companies and primary care physicians to obtain referrals and prior authorizations.
  • Coordinate with patients regarding insurance coverage and benefit information.
  • Collect co-payments, balances, and self-pay payments at the time of service.
  • Obtain and enter new provider information into the electronic medical record (EMR).
  • Accurately enter and maintain patient information within the EMR system.
  • Scan and upload patient documentation into electronic medical records.

  • Assist with training new front office staff.

Patient Check-Out

  • Check patients out following appointments.
  • Schedule follow-up appointments according to office protocols.
  • Maintain provider schedules and appointment calendars.
  • Post patient charges and maintain accurate payment records.
  • Fax clinical notes to referring physicians and primary care providers.
  • Collect outstanding patient balances and co-payments.
  • Scan supporting documentation into patient charts.

Administrative Support

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for patients and visitors.
  • Answer telephones and provide exceptional customer service.
  • Optimize provider schedules through efficient appointment management.
  • Communicate scheduling updates and changes to providers and office leadership.

job.title: Demand Planner
job.description:
Job Summary
Client is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Demand Planner to support accurate forecasting, inventory optimization, and cross-functional supply chain alignment in a fast growing, fast paced dynamic organization. This role is responsible for developing demand forecasts, analyzing sales and market trends, supporting S&OP processes, and partnering with Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and Customer Service teams to ensure product availability while minimizing excess inventory.

Key Responsibilities
• Develop, maintain, and improve short- and long-range demand forecasts using historical sales data, customer input, market trends, seasonality, promotions, and business intelligence.
• Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Production Planning, Procurement, and Finance to build a consensus demand plan that supports business objectives.
• Monitor forecast accuracy, forecast bias, inventory performance, service levels, and demand variability; identify root causes of gaps and recommend corrective actions.
• Support monthly S&OP and demand review processes by preparing forecast reports, presenting key assumptions, and highlighting risks, opportunities, and changes in demand.
• Collaborate with supply planning and operations teams to align demand requirements with production capacity, material availability, and inventory targets.

The Manufacturing Associate will safely perform the tasks required to facilitate the efficient production of our products.
