job.title: Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to design, develop, and support firmware for IoT and video-streaming products. This role will own major firmware components throughout the product lifecycle and collaborate with hardware, cloud, mobile, QA, and manufacturing partners to deliver reliable, production-ready devices.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, debug, and maintain embedded firmware for IoT and video-streaming products.
  • Own major firmware components and features from initial design through production.
  • Develop and integrate device drivers, communication protocols, RTOS components, and platform firmware.
  • Collaborate with hardware, cloud, mobile, QA, and original design manufacturer partners on system integration and product delivery.
  • Troubleshoot complex firmware, hardware, and system-level issues.
  • Optimize firmware for performance, memory usage, power consumption, resource utilization, and reliability.
  • Review board schematics, component datasheets, and hardware documentation to support development and debugging.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and root-cause analysis.
  • Evaluate SoCs, image sensors, wireless modules, and other components for future products.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and process improvements.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • 7+ years of embedded firmware development experience.
  • Strong Embedded C and C++ programming skills.
  • Software development experience across RTOS and Embedded Linux platforms.
  • Understanding of real-time multimedia applications, including video and audio processing, compression, and streaming technologies such as H.264 and H.265.
  • Multithreaded and multitasking embedded software development experience.
  • Experience developing and debugging embedded device drivers.
  • Strong embedded-system debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Experience optimizing embedded software for performance and resource utilization.
  • Working knowledge of TCP, UDP, HTTP/HTTPS, RTP, RTSP, SIP, and WebRTC.
  • Experience with Wi-Fi, BLE, and LTE wireless technologies.
  • Familiarity with IoT communication architectures and cloud-connected devices.
  • Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers.
  • Experience using Git or a comparable source-control system.

Preferred Skills or Experience

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Firmware development experience involving consumer IoT, smart-home, networking, or video-streaming products.
  • Experience with Zigbee, Z-Wave, Thread, or Matter.
  • Knowledge of Linux memory management, file systems, and bootloaders such as U-Boot.
  • Python, Perl, or Lua scripting experience.
  • Experience supporting products through manufacturing and production.

Work Details

  • Remote role within California, USA

job.title: Senior Data Management Business Analyst
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking a Senior Data Management Business Analyst to support enterprise data initiatives, modernization efforts, data governance programs, and Data Supply Chain delivery. This role will translate business needs into actionable data requirements, analyze complex data environments, document current- and future-state data flows, and coordinate delivery across business, data, architecture, governance, and engineering teams.

Core Responsibilities

  • Lead stakeholder discovery sessions, workshops, interviews, and data requirements discussions.
  • Gather, analyze, document, and validate data sourcing requirements, business rules, Critical Data Elements, metadata requirements, data quality expectations, and lineage considerations.
  • Translate business needs into source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, data quality controls, and consumption requirements.
  • Perform data profiling, impact analysis, root-cause analysis, gap analysis, and data validation.
  • Analyze source systems, data relationships, integrations, ETL processes, and downstream consumption patterns.
  • Document end-to-end data lineage and traceability across reporting, analytics, governance, and operational platforms.
  • Analyze existing Ab Initio graphs, transformation logic, balancing routines, reconciliation processes, and operational workflows.
  • Create and maintain current- and future-state data flow diagrams, source-to-target mappings, integration documentation, and business process documentation.
  • Partner with Data Engineers, Data Modelers, Data Architects, Product Owners, Data Owners, Data Stewards, and governance teams.
  • Support metadata management and enterprise data catalog activities using Alation.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, solution design, implementation planning, project intake, prioritization, and Business Planning Estimates.
  • Support Agile delivery through requirements clarification, UAT, data validation, defect triage, and implementation readiness.

job.title: Maintenance Technician (Mechanic) - 3rd shift
job.description:
Position is responsible for ensuring equipment integrity and timely repair.
- Effectively support the Preventative Maintenance (PM) program with a goal of continually reducing unscheduled downtime.
- Analyze problems and interpret technical information necessary to make required repairs (troubleshooting of equipment issues).
- Perform mechanical and electrical maintenance and repairs on production machinery and facility support equipment.
- Inspect, operate and test machinery or equipment to diagnose machine malfunction and validate work performed.
- Ensure safety by following all company policies including safety rules, procedures and Lock-out / Tag-out procedures, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP's), personal safety standards, food safety standards as well as OSHA standards.
- Troubleshoot PLC controlled equipment as well as all plant electrical and mechanical systems including motors, instrumentation, distribution, feed control systems and develop sustainable solutions accordingly.

- Assure that all products are manufactured to the highest standard of quality.
- Participates in Continuous Improvement, also provides suggestions to improve processes and participates on team projects.

Physical Requirements

- Ability to lift 50-80 lbs. Performs highly repetitive motions, stand for eight plus hours, talk, and hear.
- Ability to Climb ladders, stairways, use a manlift/scissorlift at ceiling heights or above with proper safety equipment and work in non-air conditioned environment.
- While performing job duties, the associate will frequently walk, use hands to feel or handle, and to reach with hands and arms. Frequent exposure to oils and greases or coolants.
- While performing job duties, the associate will occasionally sit, climb or balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl and smell. Occasional exposure to wet and/or humid conditions; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; outside weather conditions; extreme heat; and vibration.

job.title: Lead EHS Specialist
job.description:
Position Summary
The Lead EHS Specialist is responsible for implementing and completing EHS initiatives for manufacturing and lab operations. This role requires a high level of understanding of OSHA Guidelines regulations and general safety requirements. Teamwork and communication skills are essential skills for this role as it requires close interaction with the operations and engineering teams to ensure any issues get communicated and resolved in a timely manner. This position will report to the EVP, Global Manufacturing. The ideal candidate should be self-motivated, able to handle multiple project assignments and willing to learn and adapt within a fast-paced organization. Occasional travel is required; 10-15%. The position is located at the Lafayette, IN, facility; remote work is generally not available.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

  • Help to implement and monitor EHS activities with the operations team
  • Complete routine safety inspections (fire extinguishers, cranes, emergency eye wash stations/showers, forklift, etc.), including required electronic checklists, tracking audit findings, responses and audit close-outs; maintains records.
  • Deliver training to employees including EHS new hire orientation.
  • Coordinate training and licenses for cranes and forklifts.
  • Completes JSAs for new equipment and processes.
  • Collaborate with supervisors to document PPE assessments
  • Participate in incident investigations and ensure incident management system is current
  • Track investigations and run trend reports.
  • Maintain chemical inventory database that cross-references GHS Safety Data Sheets. Responsible for ensuring that each SDS is current and approved within the system and accessible to all employees.
  • Where applicable, help establish a Chemical Hygiene Plan for safe operation in laboratory spaces.
  • Participate in daily operation meetings and Gemba walks as assigned.
  • Communicate consistently and effectively to all cross-functional team members to ensure EHS improvements and changes are understood, and questions are answered to move projects forward.
  • Build and maintain knowledge of Client technology.
  • Possess a detailed understanding of global and EHS legal requirements (i.e.: Regulations, Codes, Standards, Directives, and Administrative Policies) and provide regulatory knowledge, technical expertise, EHS engineering knowledge, best practices and EHS management systems
  • Work well with limited supervision while being responsible for project management, compliance assurance and program rollout
  • Prioritize and manage multiple technically complex assignments concurrently
  • Represent Client in a professional manner at all times and in all interactions
  • Perform all other duties as assigned

Education and Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in environmental health and safety or related degree, would consider relevant experience in lieu of a degree
  • 5+ years of experience in EHS or related field
  • Ability to interpret regulations and implement requirements in the work environment
  • Knowledge of hydrogen and other flammable chemicals and broad background with Safety and Health programs
  • Ability to analyze information, develop and deliver training programs, adapt policies, create reporting, and offer recommendations for continuous improvement
  • Working knowledge of data collection and statistics
  • Experience with Microsoft Office suite, including Excel.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to role model high standards of professionalism.
  • Must be driven and self-motivated with excellent follow-through.
  • Must possess the highest ethical standards and a commitment to work quality.
  • Capability to present information effectively to diverse audiences and stakeholders while responding to questions from groups of managers, employees and the leadership team
  • Ability to write reports and procedural manuals
  • Ability to manage complex projects and multi-task effectively

job.title: Sheet Metal Repair Technician
job.description:
Aircraft Structures Technician – Low Observable (LO) / Sheet Metal Repair Technician

Position Type: Contract
Industry: Aerospace / Defense
Work Environment: Aircraft Maintenance, Modification & Repair
Experience Level: Experienced Aerospace Technician

Position Overview

We are seeking experienced Aircraft Structures Technicians with strong 5th Generation Fighter Aircraft sheet metal, structural repair, and/or Low Observable (LO) coating experience to support aircraft restoration, repair, and modification programs.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience interpreting aircraft engineering drawings, performing structural repairs, fabricating aircraft components, applying bonding processes, and working within strict aerospace quality and safety standards.

This role requires technicians who are comfortable working on complex military aircraft structures where procedures may require advanced problem-solving, precision workmanship, and the ability to operate independently using technical documentation, engineering drawings, and repair manuals.

Candidates with experience supporting F-22, F-35, LO coatings, stealth technology, or military aircraft structural maintenance are highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Aircraft Structural Repair & Fabrication

  • Perform aircraft structural repairs, modifications, and restoration activities.
  • Interpret and apply information from:
    • Aircraft engineering drawings
    • Technical manuals
    • Structural Repair Manuals (SRM)
    • Engineering specifications
    • Technical orders
  • Identify aircraft locations using:
    • Station numbers
    • Butt lines
    • Water lines
  • Fabricate and install aircraft structural components including:
    • Shims
    • Splices
    • Gussets
    • Angles
    • Brackets
    • Doublers
    • Stiffeners
    • Patches

Aircraft Sheet Metal Operations

Perform precision aircraft sheet metal fabrication including:

  • Layout and fit-up of aircraft components.
  • Cutting, trimming, drilling, and forming sheet metal parts.
  • Removing burrs and surface imperfections.
  • Installing aircraft structures using:
    • Riveting
    • Drilling
    • Fastening
    • Fitting operations
  • Maintain critical dimensions, edge distances, and aircraft contours.

Low Observable (LO) / Composite Bonding Operations

  • Perform bonding operations on aircraft components and assemblies.
  • Apply LO coatings and materials according to aerospace specifications.
  • Work with advanced aircraft materials and repair processes.
  • Determine proper repair methods when:
    • Procedures are incomplete
    • Tooling is unavailable
    • Engineering guidance requires interpretation
  • Perform bonding repairs while maintaining:
    • Surface contour requirements
    • Material specifications
    • Structural integrity
    • Stealth performance requirements

Tools & Equipment

Operate a variety of aerospace fabrication and repair equipment including:

  • Pneumatic riveters
  • Drills
  • Angle drills/motors
  • Drill presses
  • Shears
  • Precision measuring tools:
    • Micrometers
    • Calipers
    • Tape measures
    • Standard scales

Additional experience with:

  • Material testers
  • Mixing equipment
  • Bonding application tools
  • Aircraft shop aids and fixtures

Documentation & Quality

  • Record repair data and procedural information for future reference.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of:
    • Repairs performed
    • Materials used
    • Processes completed
    • Inspection requirements
  • Verify completed work meets:
    • Engineering requirements
    • Technical specifications
    • Quality standards

Safety Responsibilities

  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment.
  • Maintain a strict FOD-free workspace.
  • Follow all aerospace safety procedures.
  • Properly utilize required PPE, including:
    • Full-face respirators
    • Tyvek suits
    • Gloves
    • Protective equipment required for LO/coating applications

Required Qualifications

Candidates should have one or more of the following:

Military Aircraft Experience

  • 5th Generation Fighter Aircraft structural experience preferred.
  • Military aircraft maintenance background including:
    • USAF AFSC 5- or 7-level
    • Navy NEC
    • Marine MOS structural discipline rating

OR

Civilian Aerospace Experience

  • FAA Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) Certification

OR

  • Equivalent aerospace aircraft structures experience:
    • Minimum 5 years aircraft sheet metal/structures experience

Preferred Qualifications

Highly preferred experience includes:

  • F-22 aircraft experience
  • F-35 aircraft experience
  • Low Observable (LO) coating application
  • Stealth aircraft repair
  • Composite bonding
  • Military fighter aircraft modifications
  • Aircraft structural restoration

Ideal Candidate Backgrounds

Strong candidates may come from:

  • Aircraft Structures Mechanic
  • Aircraft Sheet Metal Mechanic
  • Aircraft Structural Repair Technician
  • LO Technician
  • Stealth Coatings Technician
  • F-35/F-22 Structural Technician
  • Military Aircraft Maintenance Technician
  • Aerospace Fabrication Technician
  • A&P Mechanic with structures experience

Recruiter Search Keywords

Aircraft Structures

  • Aircraft Structures Technician
  • Aircraft Structural Mechanic
  • Sheet Metal Mechanic
  • Aircraft Sheet Metal
  • Structural Repair Technician
  • Aircraft Modification Technician

Military / Defense

  • F-35
  • F-22
  • Fighter Aircraft
  • 5th Generation Aircraft
  • USAF
  • Navy NEC
  • Marine MOS
  • Military Aircraft Maintenance

LO / Stealth

  • Low Observable
  • LO Coatings
  • Stealth Coatings
  • Radar Absorbent Material
  • RAM
  • Composite Bonding
  • Aircraft Bonding

Technical Skills

  • Structural Repair Manual (SRM)
  • Engineering Drawings
  • Blueprint Reading
  • Riveting
  • Aircraft Fabrication
  • Sheet Metal
  • Composite Repair
  • Bonding
  • A&P
  • Aircraft Modification

Candidate Profile Summary

The ideal candidate is an experienced aerospace structures professional with hands-on experience repairing and modifying advanced military aircraft. They must be comfortable working from technical drawings, performing precision fabrication, applying bonding processes, and supporting LO/stealth aircraft requirements while maintaining strict aerospace quality and safety standards.

This role is best suited for technicians with fighter aircraft, F-35/F-22, military maintenance, or advanced aerospace structural repair backgrounds.

job.title: Workday Payroll Implementation Consultant
job.description:
Job Description: Client-Side Workday Payroll Expert
Summary: We require a highly skilled, hands-on Workday Payroll Expert who has a strong background working at an Implementation Vendor but will act strictly as our internal subject matter expert (SME) and client advocate. Your most critical priority is to independently drive Payroll-specific gap analysis, early issue detection, and meticulous verification of vendor configurations. The successful candidate will actively collaborate with internal stakeholders to define needs, clearly communicate them to the vendor, and dive directly into vendor documents, internal rules, legacy systems, and the Workday tenant itself. Your focus will be on proactively identifying discrepancies, issuing actionable correction requests to the vendor, and rigorously confirming that the implemented fixes truly realize our specific business, functional, and operational requirements.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Root Cause Analysis & Solution Proposal ( "Client Hat "): Actively identify, confirm, and determine the exact root causes of actual problems in the requirements, design, implementation, and testing phases specifically for US, Canada, and Expat Payroll. Clearly explain these issues and provide actionable solution proposals to both the implementation vendor and internal HR teams.
  • Early Issue Detection & Payroll Gap Analysis: Proactively monitor and analyze all phases of the Workday Payroll implementation to detect potential logic issues, missing requirements, and configuration blockers at the earliest possible stage. Conduct thorough gap analyses between specific business operations and the vendor's proposed Workday configurations.
  • Hands-on Configuration & Data Validation: Perform rigorous, hands-on reviews of all vendor-created documents against internal corporate documents and legacy systems, log directly into Workday to physically inspect configurations, and conduct pre-checks of system behaviors.
  • Actionable Correction Requests & Verification: Formulate concrete solution proposals, issue clear correction requests to the vendor, and directly verify that the vendor has successfully implemented the corrections into the system without merely accepting completion reports.
  • Business-Driven Test Design & Execution: Review and validate vendor's test designs, actively participate in executing testing (including UAT and Payroll Parallel Runs) targeting company-specific requirements, and meticulously track defect resolution.
  • Internal Stakeholder Alignment: Actively collaborate with the HR department to confirm current operations, translate complex business requirements into clear specifications for the vendor, and ensure no operational gaps are left behind.
Required Qualifications:
  • Implementation Vendor Leadership Experience: Must have a proven track record working at an Implementation Vendor as a Payroll Domain Leader. Must have participated in at least two end-to-end Workday implementation projects (from project initiation to completion) for large-scale multinational companies.
  • Domain Expertise (US, Canada & Expat): Deep, practical understanding of US, Canadian, and Expat Payroll processing, statutory labor and tax laws, social insurance, and general HR business operations.
  • Workday Expertise & Hands-on Capability: Minimum 3+ years of proven hands-on experience supporting and configuring Workday Payroll. Deep proficiency in Workday configuration, data structure, and integrations, with the ability to directly navigate the system to verify settings.
  • Testing Experience: 4+ years of experience in testing Workday implementations, including the review of detailed test plans, comprehensive E2E test cases, and management of Payroll Parallel testing.
  • Problem Solving & Communication: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to independently identify problems, conceptualize solutions, and drive vendor actions. Proven ability to communicate effectively, accurately gather internal requirements, and strongly negotiate with vendors.
Working Conditions & Professional Standards:
  • Working Hours: Must be available to work full-time, Monday through Friday, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST.
  • Data Privacy & Security: Proven ability to strictly handle and protect Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and other highly sensitive data with the utmost security and compliance.
  • Professional Ethics: Must possess strong common sense, high moral standards, and strict professional ethics.

job.title: Maintenance Technician I 2nd shift
job.description:
Maintenance Technician

Location: Tampa, FL
Shift: 2nd Shift | Monday–Friday | 3:00 PM–11:30 PM

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Maintenance Technician to support our Tampa, FL facility. This position is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, repairing, and improving mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and electronic equipment used throughout the plant.

The ideal candidate will be a strong hands-on troubleshooter who can independently diagnose equipment problems, perform preventive and predictive maintenance, read P&IDs and equipment drawings, and work safely in a production environment.

This is an important role in maintaining equipment reliability, production uptime, safety, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, remove, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain plant equipment including pumps, agitators, chillers, compressors, piping, valves, pneumatic systems, motors, and electrical components.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, electrical, and electronic equipment using appropriate tools and test equipment.
  • Diagnose equipment issues through inspection, testing, and systematic troubleshooting.
  • Perform preventive, predictive, corrective, and reactive maintenance to maximize equipment uptime.
  • Work with electrical components including wiring, contactors, relays, motor starters, switches, and sensors.
  • Read and interpret P&IDs, mechanical drawings, electrical diagrams, and equipment documentation.
  • Develop or update drawings of existing systems when needed for troubleshooting and equipment installation.
  • Use hand tools, power tools, lifting equipment, precision measuring tools, and electronic test equipment.
  • Assist with equipment installation, commissioning, system improvements, and process development.
  • Investigate recurring equipment problems and support Root Cause Analysis and Continuous Improvement initiatives.
  • Utilize CMMS and accurately document maintenance activities, repairs, inspections, and equipment history.
  • Help coordinate and direct contractors performing scheduled maintenance or facility work.
  • Follow Process Safety Management (PSM) requirements and all applicable safety procedures.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Work independently while communicating effectively with maintenance, operations, engineering, and other plant personnel.
  • Prioritize multiple maintenance requests in a fast-paced, time-sensitive production environment.
  • Work overtime and weekends when required to support business and production needs.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma/GED with a trade or technical background, or equivalent relevant maintenance experience.
  • Associate degree in a STEM-related field with maintenance experience is preferred.
  • Strong industrial/manufacturing maintenance experience.
  • Demonstrated critical-thinking and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to read and interpret P&IDs and mechanical/electrical drawings.
  • Knowledge of mechanical and piping systems.
  • Experience troubleshooting electrical devices and industrial equipment.
  • Working knowledge of pneumatic and hydraulic systems.
  • Familiarity with sensors, instrumentation, relays, contactors, and motor starters.
  • Experience with CMMS, preventive/predictive maintenance, Root Cause Analysis, and Continuous Improvement preferred.
  • Good computer skills, including Microsoft Office.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong safety mindset and attention to detail.
  • Leadership skills and the ability to coordinate or direct others are preferred.

Physical & Work Environment

  • Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 lbs.
  • Comfortable working in hot, cold, dusty, indoor, and outdoor environments.
  • May work around hazardous and non-hazardous materials, including chemicals or bio-substances.
  • Must be willing to use required PPE, which may include respirators, FR clothing, chemical-resistant gloves, hard hats, safety eyewear, and face shields.
  • Must be able to work safely around production and process equipment.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The strongest candidates will have a well-rounded industrial maintenance background with hands-on experience troubleshooting mechanical equipment, pumps, piping, valves, electrical systems, pneumatics, hydraulics, and instrumentation.

Candidates coming from chemical, pharmaceutical, biotech, food manufacturing, industrial manufacturing, utilities, or other process-driven environments may be particularly well suited for this position.

job.title: Payroll Tax Manager
job.description:
Payroll Tax Manager

Location: Greenville, SC
Schedule: Hybrid (Monday & Friday Remote | Tuesday–Thursday Onsite)
Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Payroll Tax Manager to oversee all payroll tax activities within the Payroll Operations team, including support for mergers and acquisitions. This role partners closely with Payroll Leadership, Accounting, Treasury, and external managed service providers to ensure payroll tax compliance, reporting accuracy, reconciliations, and timely tax filings across multiple federal, state, and local jurisdictions.

The ideal candidate will have extensive payroll tax expertise, strong analytical skills, and experience managing complex payroll tax compliance in a large, multi-state organization.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Tax Management

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Payroll Tax, State Unemployment, Workers' Compensation, and Escheatment.
  • Oversee payroll tax administration across multiple federal entities, state jurisdictions, and local tax jurisdictions.
  • Ensure payroll tax funding, reporting, and filings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Research and resolve payroll tax discrepancies, including overpayments, underpayments, refunds, credits, and tax notices.
  • Manage payroll tax account registrations and maintenance.

Financial Reporting & Reconciliation

  • Support Corporate Accounting with payroll tax and General Ledger reconciliations.
  • Produce payroll tax reports and ad hoc reporting for business leaders.
  • Review payroll schedules and validate payroll tax reporting.
  • Assist with payroll tax integration for acquisitions and business mergers.
  • Generate monthly, quarterly, and annual payroll tax reporting.

Compliance & Audit

  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local payroll tax regulations.
  • Review quarterly and annual W-2 filings and validate wage type mapping.
  • Stay current on payroll tax legislation and implement required system updates.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation.
  • Ensure SOX compliance, confidentiality, data privacy, and security standards are maintained.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Accounting, Treasury, HR, Payroll, and external payroll service providers.
  • Support payroll funding activities and escheatment processes.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify reporting requirements and resolve payroll tax issues.
  • Provide exceptional customer service to internal and external business partners.
  • Participate in special projects and continuous process improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • Extensive experience managing multi-state payroll tax operations.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Federal payroll tax regulations
    • State and local payroll taxes
    • State Unemployment Insurance (SUI)
    • Workers' Compensation
    • Escheatment
  • Experience supporting payroll tax activities related to mergers and acquisitions.
  • Experience with payroll tax reconciliations and General Ledger support.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet critical deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with large, multi-entity organizations.
  • Experience partnering with managed payroll service providers.
  • Knowledge of SOX compliance and internal controls.
  • Experience with payroll reporting, tax registrations, and payroll system implementations.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

job.title: CNC Programmer Specialist
job.description:
RPO - DIRECT HIRE
1st Shift - (Monday through Friday, 7 am to 3 pm),
(may need to flex their schedule occasionally to support the end of 3rd shift (Sunday through Thursday, 11 pm to 7 am) and/or the start of our 2nd shift (Monday through Friday, 3 pm to 11 pm))

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
1. Provides programming support for machining parts, tools, or sheet metal on numerically controlled machine tools by writing complex programs of machine instructions in symbolic language to encode numerical control tape or direct numerical control database to regulate movement of machine along cutting path. Changes, updates and/or initiates manufacturing processes.
2. Safely and economically produces a part to the manufacturing engineering specification or drawing by selecting proper cutting tools for each part, taking into consideration such factors as speeds, types of cutters, feeds, and control system limitations.
3. Selects program routines for the most efficient computer calculation of dimensional and machining requirements for each part buy computing angular and linear dimensions, radii, and curvatures, and outlining sequence of operations required to machine the part.
4. Determines dimension and configuration of difficult cuts, selection of cutting tools, and machine speeds and feed rates by analyzing drawings, sketches, and design data of part.
5. Coordinates and oversees tape tryouts, including complete follow up on all cycle related procedures, documentation and communications. Assures accuracy by comparing encoded tape or computer printout with original program sheet.
6. Shows location of reference points and direction of cutting paths by preparing geometric layout on graph paper or using computer assisted drafting software.
7. Modifies existing parts programs for engineering changes or program improvements. Eliminates instruction errors or omissions by revising program.
8. Analyzes proposed changes in methods and materials and contributes to continuous improvement and key lean manufacturing/production activities. Recommends actions by analyzing and interpreting data and making comparative analyses. May lead special projects in applying continuous improvement techniques and implementing changes.
9. Maintains technical knowledge by attending educational workshops and reviewing technical publications.
10. May provide leadership to others in department. Acts as prime contact on high level projects. Establishes goals and objectives required to complete projects. Trains and mentors less experienced employees.
11. Shares specialized knowledge with others. Serves as a resource to others in resolving a variety of problems. Supports the team by accomplishing related results as needed. Work assignments may include cross functional or project team responsibilities. Job

Requirements:
QUALIFICATIONS Education and Experience Completion of related trade school program, AA, or equivalent external training in NC Programming. Demonstrated ability to perform the essential functions of the job typically acquired through seven or more years of directly related experience.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Extensive knowledge of key numerical control programming principles, concepts, and techniques. Knowledge of CNC programming language.
  • Thorough knowledge of N/C tooling, proper speeds and feeds for the material to be machined and proper machine sequences.
  • Ability to correct and optimize N/C programs. Thorough knowledge of manufacturing processes and routines.
  • Ability to develop part processes that better integrate programming practices.
  • Ability to effectively apply continuous improvement methods to design and manufacturing functions (e.g. process mapping, design to production automation).
  • Ability to work on a variety of problems of diverse scope and complexity where analysis and evaluation of various outcomes require tradeoffs.
  • Ability to solve a wide range of difficult problems in imaginative and practical ways and evaluate alternative solutions that may require coordination across multiple teams.
  • Ability to establish goals and objectives to complete projects.
  • May require ability to use standard business software applications and/or specialized design, data analysis, or database tools.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret policies and recommend changes to procedures.
  • Ability to effectively communicate and present information to team members, team leaders, and top management.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Ability to effectively demonstrate team member competencies and participate in goal setting, performance feedback, and self development activities.

The engineer will support both in-house developed and commercial/government off-the-shelf (COTS/GOTS) solutions, ensuring systems meet customer requirements, technical specifications, and performance expectations.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, system-level testing, electrical measurements, troubleshooting, and hardware/software integration. Experience with RF/Microwave systems, test equipment development, and aerospace/defense environments is highly preferred.

job.title: Welder
job.description:
Welder / Fabricator

Location: Tulsa, Oklahoma
Employment Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

A growing Tulsa-area manufacturer is seeking experienced Welders/Fabricators to support the production of custom industrial equipment and fabricated assemblies.

This position is responsible for fitting, welding, and assembling structural components according to drawings and production specifications. The ideal candidate can read fabrication prints, produce quality welds, and work independently in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Fit, weld, and assemble fabricated metal components and structural assemblies.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, shop drawings, weld symbols, and dimensional specifications.
  • Perform welding using MIG and flux-core processes.
  • Measure, position, align, and secure components before welding.
  • Inspect materials and completed welds for accuracy, quality, and conformance to specifications.
  • Use grinders, saws, torches, clamps, measuring devices, and other fabrication tools.
  • Complete tack welding, final welding, grinding, and finishing as required.
  • Verify dimensions using tape measures, squares, levels, and other inspection tools.
  • Identify drawing discrepancies, material issues, or fabrication concerns and communicate them to supervision.
  • Follow established welding procedures, production instructions, and quality requirements.
  • Maintain an organized and safe work area.
  • Assist with general fabrication, material handling, and assembly duties as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous welding or metal fabrication experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Proficiency with MIG or flux-core welding.
  • Ability to read and interpret fabrication drawings and weld symbols.
  • Experience fitting and welding structural steel or fabricated assemblies.
  • Ability to accurately read a tape measure and use basic inspection tools.
  • Understanding of weld preparation, joint fit-up, and distortion control.
  • Ability to pass a hands-on welding test.
  • Ability to work safely with minimal supervision.
  • Reliable attendance and the ability to meet production deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Vocational or technical training in welding.
  • Experience welding carbon steel.
  • Experience fabricating frames, skids, platforms, enclosures, or similar industrial assemblies.
  • Familiarity with fillet welds, groove welds, multi-pass welds, and out-of-position welding.
  • Experience using overhead cranes, hoists, forklifts, or other material-handling equipment.
  • Familiarity with welding procedure specifications and manufacturing quality standards.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, bend, kneel, climb, and work in different positions throughout the shift.
  • Ability to lift and move materials and equipment commonly used in a fabrication environment.
  • Ability to work around welding fumes, sparks, heat, noise, and moving equipment.
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment.

Work Environment

This position is based in an industrial manufacturing and fabrication facility. Employees will work around welding equipment, machinery, fabricated steel, cranes, and material-handling equipment.

job.title: Senior Lab Technician – Power Electronics
job.description:
Senior Lab Technician – Power Electronics

Andover, MA 01810
Engineering 
Salary: $75,000 – $80,000

About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Engineering Aide to support advanced power electronics testing in a dynamic lab environment. You’ll work directly with engineers to evaluate DC-DC and AC-DC power supply performance, build and refine test setups, and help drive product validation from concept to qualification.

This is a highly technical, lab-focused role where problem-solving, creativity, and precision matter every day.

What You’ll Do

  • Support engineering teams in evaluating and qualifying power supply components and assemblies

  • Run detailed testing to measure temperature rise vs. electrical load and cooling conditions

  • Design, build, and improve electrical, mechanical, and thermal test setups

  • Modify and fabricate custom test fixtures to enhance lab efficiency and accuracy

  • Collect, analyze, and summarize test data using Excel, PowerPoint, and internal systems

  • Work across engineering groups to troubleshoot product and setup challenges

  • Ensure test equipment calibration and lab readiness standards are maintained

  • Prepare and install thermocouples and precision measurement setups

job.title: Production Operator I - (Biotech/Biomedical)
job.description:
Schedule: 5am-3:30pm

This position is responsible for the production of high quality medical devices within a manufacturing cell. Working under close supervision, may perform a combination of assembly, repair, and test operations on pacemakers, implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICDs), leads, and related medical device assemblies. Performs routine assignments according to specified and/or standardized procedures. Work is closely and continually reviewed. Ensure that relevant job documentation for cell operations and functions is accurate and up to date. Be able to clearly communicate ideas, problems and solutions to all levels of manufacturing management in both written and oral form. Maintain a positive attitude when interacting with internal customers and external customers such as tours. Follow safety guidelines and utilize appropriate safety devices when performing all operations. Participate in continuous improvement/quality initiatives in order to enhance production processes to achieve quality and profitability metrics. Maintain accurate records to ensure traveler and quality documents are accurate, all parts are traceable and quality issues can be addressed to assure the quality of all products. Demonstrates a basis understanding of Lean Manufacturing. Participate with the Manufacturing Supervisor/Manager in setting and monitoring individual goals and cell performance metrics that continuously seek to improve the quality of operations. Support all Divisional initiatives as identified by divisional management and in support of Quality Management Systems (QMS), Environmental Management Systems (EMS), and other regulatory requirements Ability to read, comprehend, and follow written procedures; understand and follow verbal instructions - Understanding of and ability to utilize electronic data collection systems and computer software packages. Ability to prioritize work by determining the sequencing and timing of different jobs based on precedence and importance. Ability to handle and maneuver small components and parts. Ability to make critical decisions and judgments with minimal supervision. High school degree or equivalent preferred. Required dress code for tour during interview and on-the job: Clothing must be non-shedding and free of frayed hems or loose threads. Tassels, fringes, glitter, sequins (sewn or glued on), and any other items that could become dislodges are not allowed on clothing. To verify a fabric can be worn: pull at the fabric tightly with fingers, if fibers are dislodged, the garment may not be worn in the production area. Sweaters, sweater vests, loose fiber garments, loose knit, or fleece may not be worn. All clothing must be clean and free of visible contamination (sand, mud, dirt, lint, etc.). All clothing, from the waist up, must fit under the lab coat/gown. Turtle necks or high-necked clothing shall not stick out above the neck of the lab coat/gown. Sleeves shall not stick out beyond the cuff of the lab coat/gown. Caps, hats, scarves or bandanas shall not be worn under the bouffant. Head wraps/scarves worn to accommodate customs: Must be covered with the bouffant and the tail end of the scarf must be fully covered by the lab coat/gown. Must be of tightly woven fabric, be clean, and laundered. Loose fitting clothing shall not be worn around machinery or soldering/brazing torches. Shoes must be worn at all times in the production area. Stockings or socks are required. The heel of a shoe must not be pointed or higher than 2 inches. Sandals, clogs, slippers, open toe, or open heel shoes are not allowed. Shoes with straps or weave where toes can be seen are not allowed. Changing shoes in the production area, other than a gowning room, is not allowed. Torsos, upper arms, and legs must be covered. Pants (above the ankle), skirts (above the ankle), skirts with slits, short shirts (above the navel), and sleeveless tops are not allowed. Skirts at the ankle are allowed, but full-length stockings, leggings, or pants must be worn under them. Nail polish, acrylic, artificial nails, or similar nail coatings are not allowed. Jewelry or body piercings that can pierce gloves or cannot be covered under gowning materials will not be allowed in the production area. Makeup shall not be worn. Lip balm in stick form is acceptable, when applied outside of production areas and prior to hand washing. Scented personal use products shall not be worn, except deodorant. Lotions shall not be applied after hand washing. Cover any open or bleeding wound with a bandage. Dont wear anything that could be offensive."

Nesco Resource is now hiring for a experienced Key Account Manager.

The Account Manager supports the Business Development and Sales team by managing key customer relationships and guiding new projects from concept to launch. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, customer-focused, and skilled at working across teams to drive projects forward and deliver successful product launches.

job.title: Senior IT Engineer
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking a Senior IT Engineer to architect, deploy, and support IT and operational technology solutions for a mission-critical semiconductor manufacturing site in Richardson, Texas. This role requires proven, hands-on Kubernetes experience supporting real production environments, along with strong Windows Server, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, VMware, and enterprise infrastructure expertise.

Core Responsibilities

  • Architect, deploy, and support physical and virtual server infrastructure in a mission-critical manufacturing environment.
  • Implement, administer, and expand Kubernetes container environments supporting production applications.
  • Provide operational support for Windows Server and Red Hat Enterprise Linux server ecosystems.
  • Support VMware virtualization technologies, including vSphere, vSAN, VCF, and NSX.
  • Support hyper-converged infrastructure platforms such as Dell VxRail.
  • Troubleshoot performance issues affecting physical servers, virtual servers, containers, and infrastructure workloads.
  • Implement new infrastructure technology stacks and migrate workloads from physical servers to virtualized environments.
  • Develop and support server automation and infrastructure-as-code solutions.
  • Work with semiconductor process and equipment vendors to improve infrastructure performance, availability, and fault tolerance.
  • Participate in technical meetings with site, manufacturing, security, and corporate IT teams.
  • Support IT and OT infrastructure in accordance with corporate and semiconductor cybersecurity standards.
  • Maintain documentation for infrastructure environments, system configurations, and automation scripts.
  • Support backup, disaster recovery, and technology resilience strategies and processes.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise server ecosystems.
  • 5+ years of experience with Windows Server operating systems and RHEL Linux 5–9.X.
  • 3+ years of experience with ServiceNow or a similar formal service management platform or methodology.
  • 3+ years of experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware, vSphere, vSAN, VCF, or NSX.
  • 1+ years of experience with Docker and Kubernetes container orchestration.
  • Proven, hands-on experience implementing and managing Kubernetes in production environments.
  • Experience with server automation, infrastructure as code, or scripting using Tanium, Chef, JSON, PowerShell, Ruby, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of network fundamentals, including firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, subnetting, IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, NAT, routing, and switching.
  • Experience with backup, disaster recovery, and technology resilience processes.
  • Ability to document infrastructure, automation scripts, and system configurations.

Preferred Skills or Experience

  • Advanced degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience with Dell VxRail or similar hyper-converged infrastructure.
  • Experience with Tanium, Windows patching, operating system hardening, and Windows security standards.
  • Experience supporting the software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, coding, testing, and production support.
  • Experience supporting Cisco Nexus or Catalyst switches.
  • Experience with Rubrik or similar data recovery platforms.
  • Experience supporting IT/OT environments, network segmentation, equipment integration, automation, or manufacturing execution systems.
  • Understanding of SCADA, industrial network architectures, and manufacturing-focused Windows servers and workstations.
  • Experience supporting semiconductor or other advanced manufacturing environments.

Work Details

  • Onsite in Richardson, Texas, with some remote work allowed.

job.title: Senior Network Engineer
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking a Network Engineer to architect, deploy, and support IT and operational technology infrastructure for a mission-critical semiconductor manufacturing site in Richardson, Texas. This role will support Cisco-based LAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, and IoT communications while developing secure network solutions that enable manufacturing automation, equipment integration, fault detection, and advanced process control.

Core Responsibilities

  • Provide operational support for physical and virtual manufacturing and site network infrastructure.
  • Support network communications ranging from the corporate SD-WAN environment through factory equipment, tools, sensors, and IoT devices.
  • Design, develop, and deploy Special Use Networks to segment and isolate mission-critical manufacturing operations from the corporate network.
  • Support Cisco-based LAN, WLAN, routing, switching, firewall, and network monitoring technologies.
  • Migrate the site from a global authentication model to a site-level domain controller authentication model.
  • Partner with process, equipment, manufacturing, and factory systems engineering teams to enable equipment integration and automation.
  • Troubleshoot network performance and communication issues across IT and OT architecture layers.
  • Implement switches, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, monitoring tools, and other network technologies.
  • Support network resilience, redundancy, disaster recovery, high availability, and Quality of Service.
  • Collaborate with corporate IT and security teams to ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • Experience with firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, subnetting, IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, NAT, routing, and switching.
  • Experience implementing high availability, redundancy, and Quality of Service protocols.

We are seeking an experienced Certified Welder to join an aerospace manufacturing team supporting the fabrication and welding of high-performance components and assemblies. This role requires strong hands-on experience with manual GTAW/TIG and orbital GTAW welding, particularly working with exotic aerospace alloys.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of aerospace welding standards, welding procedures, equipment setup, inspection requirements, and the ability to consistently produce high-quality welds in a safety- and quality-driven manufacturing environment.

Key Requirements

Candidates must have the following technical experience to be considered for an interview:

  • Manual GTAW (TIG) certification to AWS D17.1, Group IIb, IIIB, VII, 1G position, or equivalent. 1G certification is the required minimum.
  • Hands-on experience setting up, programming, and operating orbital GTAW equipment, such as Orbitalum, AMI, or equivalent.
  • Experience welding exotic aerospace alloys, including:
    • Haynes 188
    • Hastelloy X (HAST-X)
    • Inconel 718
    • L-605 / Cobalt alloys
  • Experience with purge systems and backing gas control.
  • Knowledge of post-weld inspection methods.
  • Experience working from and executing WPS, WPQ, and QTR documentation.
  • Ability to troubleshoot welding equipment and adjust welding parameters within established procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Set up and operate manual and automated welding systems according to work instructions, procedures, and established welding practices.
  • Set up fixtures, attachments, and workpieces using visual inspection, hand tools, and measuring equipment.
  • Adjust welding parameters within approved procedural limits to achieve required quality standards.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, weld symbols, procedures, and quality requirements.
  • Perform proper pre-weld cleaning, preparation, and handling of aerospace components.
  • Inspect completed and in-process hardware using visual inspection and measuring equipment.
  • Perform welding equipment setup, troubleshooting, and basic maintenance.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and FOD-free work environment.
  • Maintain all required welding qualifications and certifications.
  • Follow all applicable safety, quality, and manufacturing procedures.
  • Assist and provide guidance to less-experienced welders when needed.
  • Support welding skill development, safety, and technical training.
  • Work with Engineering to develop welding processes and resolve welding-related issues.
  • Troubleshoot welding equipment and collaborate with team members to maintain production requirements.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 8+ years of welding or related experience, or demonstrated ability to successfully perform the responsibilities of the position.
  • Aerospace welding experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience with exotic aerospace alloys required.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required AWS D17.1 welding qualifications.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, weld symbols, WPS/WPQ/QTR documentation, and quality requirements.
  • Strong manual dexterity and hand-eye coordination.
  • Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations and apply machine-shop mathematics.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Effective English verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Pre-Employment & Job Requirements

This is a safety-sensitive position and is subject to random drug testing.

Candidates must be able to successfully complete:

  • Eye examination
  • FAA drug test
  • Manual welding performance test
  • Company-administered welding qualification/WPS-QTR testing

Candidates must be able to successfully complete the required company welding performance qualification within two weeks.

Required Prescreen Questions

Candidates must have answers to the following questions included on their resume at the time of submission:

  1. Are you AWS D17.1 certified? If yes, which groups and positions?
  2. How many years of hands-on welding experience do you have, including total welding experience and experience specifically with aerospace/exotic alloys?
  3. Have you programmed and operated Orbitalum or AMI orbital GTAW systems? Yes/No
  4. Can you read and work from WPS and WPQR documents? Yes/No
  5. Are you able to pass a company-administered weld performance qualification (WPS/QTR) within a two-week period? Yes/No

Interview Instructions

Candidates should arrive no more than 5 minutes before their scheduled interview. There is no lobby/waiting area, so candidates will need to remain outside until they are welcomed into the facility.

Important: Candidates should be prepared for the eye exam, FAA drug testing, and manual weld test requirements associated with this position.

job.title: Machinist - 2nd Shift
job.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced CNC Lathe Setup Machinist to join our manufacturing team on second shift. This role is responsible for setting up, operating, and troubleshooting CNC lathes to produce high-precision components while maintaining strict quality standards and maximizing production efficiency. The ideal candidate has experience performing machine setups, reading complex blueprints, machining to tight tolerances, and conducting in-process inspections using precision measuring equipment.

Candidates with MAZAK machine controls, Mazatrol programming, and Y-Axis machining experience are highly preferred. Experience in aerospace or other high-precision manufacturing environments is a strong advantage.

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 1:45 PM – 11:15 PM
Pay: $30.00-$35.00/hour (based on experience) + $2.00/hour shift differential

Key Responsibilities

CNC Setup & Machining

  • Perform complete setup and operation of CNC lathes for production machining.
  • Install and align tooling, fixtures, and workholding devices.
  • Set tool and work offsets to ensure accurate part production.
  • Perform first-piece inspections and make machine adjustments as needed.
  • Operate multiple production machines while maintaining productivity and quality standards.
  • Adjust feeds, speeds, and depth of cut to optimize machining performance.
  • Perform machining operations including turning, drilling, boring, reaming, deburring, and finishing precision components.
  • Monitor machine performance and identify tooling or equipment issues before they impact production.

Blueprint Interpretation

  • Read and interpret engineering blueprints, technical drawings, route sheets, and work instructions.
  • Understand dimensions, tolerances, and manufacturing specifications to ensure parts meet customer requirements.
  • Follow established manufacturing methods and production processes.

Quality Inspection

  • Perform in-process and final inspections on precision machined parts.
  • Verify product quality using precision measuring equipment including:
    • Calipers
    • Micrometers
    • Bore Gauges
    • Height Gauges
    • Surface Plates
    • Optical Comparators
    • Microscopes
    • Additional inspection equipment as required
  • Inspect parts for dimensional accuracy, surface finish, burrs, and cosmetic defects.
  • Record inspection results and maintain Statistical Process Control (SPC) documentation.

Continuous Improvement

  • Support Lean Manufacturing initiatives including 5S, waste reduction, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve productivity, quality, and efficiency.
  • Participate in team problem-solving and process improvement efforts.

Equipment Maintenance & Safety

  • Perform routine machine cleaning and preventive maintenance.
  • Monitor tooling condition and replace worn or damaged tooling.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Follow all company safety policies and standard operating procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Minimum 3 years of CNC machining experience.
  • Experience performing CNC Lathe setups independently.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering blueprints and manufacturing documentation.
  • Experience machining precision components to tight tolerances.
  • Proficient using precision measuring instruments.
  • Strong understanding of machine shop mathematics, including basic trigonometry.
  • Ability to troubleshoot machining issues and make machine adjustments.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Comfortable working independently with limited supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with MAZAK CNC controls.
  • Experience using Mazatrol programming.
  • Y-Axis machining experience.
  • Aerospace, defense, medical device, or other high-precision manufacturing experience.
  • Knowledge of G-Code editing.
  • Familiarity with GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing).
  • Experience with AS9100, AS9102 First Article Inspection (FAI), or other regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Experience with Statistical Process Control (SPC).
  • Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement experience.

Technical Skills

  • CNC Lathe Setup & Operation
  • Precision Machining
  • Blueprint Reading
  • GD&T Interpretation
  • Tool & Work Offsets
  • G-Code Editing
  • Tooling Selection & Adjustment
  • Tight Tolerance Machining
  • Machine Troubleshooting
  • Quality Inspection
  • SPC Documentation
  • Lean Manufacturing
  • Machine Shop Mathematics

Materials Experience Preferred

Experience machining one or more of the following materials:

  • Titanium
  • Inconel
  • Stainless Steel
  • Aluminum
  • Other aerospace or high-performance alloys

job.description:
Overview:
The Quality Management Systems (QMS) and Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Manager has primary responsibility for maintaining the Management Systems and is the key interface between Operations, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Sales, and third-party compliance partners to ensure QMS and EH&S requirements are met.
Responsible for ensuring the existing system is implemented and followed and will also be instrumental in improving the QMS and EH&S system as applicable. Lead quality system audits, audit readiness activities, improvements or initiatives, and collaborate with site manufacturing and operations teams.
The QMS and EH&S Manager will develop, update, and train employees in EHS policies and procedures and lead company health and safety initiatives. As required, the QMS and EH&S Manager will audit/inspect, collect and analyze data required for environmental and safety reporting compliance with federal, state, and local regulations
Key Responsibilities:

  • Owner of management systems documents and their repository
  • Control, maintain and improve the QMS and EHS Management System, maintaining certifications.
  • Work with functional leads, process leads/owners for updates, revision to system documentation (Internal, master document list, SharePoint portal).
  • Evaluate, develop, update and maintain quality and environmental policies and procedures in accordance with industry standards and regulations.
  • Ensure management systems for Performance Seats are followed and the site maintains adherence to all quality policies, processes and procedures.
  • Perform audit readiness activities by evaluating documentation and records and ensure personnel are audit ready.
  • Identify and lead system improvements, focusing on effectiveness, efficiency, and when applicable, drive simplification.
  • Provides expertise for and guidance to site personnel on management system policies and procedures.
  • Assist in writing and submitting 8-Ds in a timely manner.
  • Work with management to build a proactive safety culture in the organization.
  • Conduct and/or oversee EHS assessments/audits at the facility. Identify areas for improvement and lead corrective actions.
  • Develop, present and/or oversee EHS related training in compliance with regulatory compliance or industry best practices. Document all training sessions.
  • Prepare, maintain, and comply with federal, state, and local agency environmental reporting and permitting with organizational standards.
  • Advise management on EHS legislation and legal requirements and ensure organization is compliant.
  • Investigate injuries/illness, near-miss, 3rd party and environmental incidents. Record and maintain OSHA 300 and 301 logs for organization.
  • Lead Internal Audit team for IATF 16949 and ISO 14001; review and audit processes and quality systems
  • Report on the status of the management systems at the management review.
  • Ability to act with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education & Experience:
  • 4 - 7 Years' experience with a bachelor's degree, or

Knowledge & Specialized Training:
  • IATF 1649 Certification
  • ISO 14001 Certification
Skills & Abilities:
  • Strong writing skills
  • Proficient in use of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Experience in PLEX ERP software system is desired.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects or priorities

job.title: Mechanical Installation Technician (Travel)
job.description:
Position Overview

This is a hands-on Mechanical Project Technician role supporting the installation, modification, startup, and troubleshooting of production equipment within a manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will have experience with mechanical equipment installation, automation systems, machine builds, equipment commissioning, and manufacturing floor support.

The technician will spend the majority of their time working directly on equipment, assisting with new equipment installations, machine conversions, debugging, and turnover to operations.

Key Responsibilities

Equipment Installation & Commissioning

  • Install, modify, and support startup of new and existing production equipment.
  • Perform hands-on mechanical assembly, alignment, troubleshooting, and equipment adjustments.
  • Support equipment builds from construction/installation through final operational turnover.
  • Execute equipment setup, debug, testing, and performance verification.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical issues and coordinate repairs or component replacements.

Project Support

  • Support project timelines, installation plans, and equipment deployment activities.
  • Assist with equipment moves, demolition, installation, and conversions.
  • Work with machine builders, integrators, engineering teams, and contractors.
  • Supervise and provide direction to maintenance personnel and outside trades during installation activities.
  • Ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and according to quality standards.

Mechanical Troubleshooting

  • Diagnose and resolve equipment issues involving:
    • Mechanical drives
    • Pneumatic actuators
    • Mechanical assemblies
    • Process equipment
    • Production machinery
    • Alignment and positioning systems
  • Interpret engineering drawings, mechanical drawings, schematics, and P&IDs.
  • Modify mechanical components to improve reliability, reduce costs, or resolve design issues.

Documentation & Engineering Support

  • Create and update installation documentation.
  • Redline drawings and update equipment documentation packages.
  • Review machine specifications, layouts, installation checklists, and parts lists.
  • Assist with procurement and expediting of materials needed for equipment installation.

Required Qualifications

Education

Preferred:

  • Associate Degree in Mechanical Engineering Technology
  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering Technology
  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering

Equivalent hands-on manufacturing/mechanical experience may be considered.

Required Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience installing and troubleshooting mechanical equipment.
  • Ability to use:
    • Hand tools
    • Measurement tools
    • Alignment equipment
    • Mechanical inspection tools
  • Ability to read and interpret:
    • Mechanical drawings
    • Schematics
    • Equipment layouts
    • P&IDs
  • Understanding of:
    • Mechanical drive systems
    • Pneumatics
    • Process piping
    • Flow, pressure, temperature, level, and rate variables
  • Experience supporting equipment startup and commissioning.

Preferred Experience

Strong candidates will have experience in:

  • Manufacturing equipment installation
  • Automation equipment
  • Machine integration
  • Industrial construction
  • Equipment commissioning
  • Mechanical maintenance
  • Process equipment
  • Production lines

Software:

  • AutoCAD
  • Inventor
  • MS Project
  • Excel
  • Word
  • PowerPoint
  • Teams

Additional preferred:

  • Optical fiber manufacturing experience
  • Laser alignment equipment
  • Precision positioning systems
  • Fluke meters
  • Calibration equipment
  • Industrial lifting/moving equipment

Ideal Candidate Backgrounds

Environment / Logistics

Travel: Possible travel to manufacturing sites:

  • Concord, NC

CNC Milling Programmer

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced CNC Milling Programmer to join our manufacturing team. This position will be responsible for developing, writing, and maintaining CNC programs for milling operations, as well as supporting continuous improvement initiatives throughout the manufacturing process. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of CNC milling equipment and programming and be comfortable working with Mastercam and/or G-code.

  • Create and maintain finished assembly setup sheets and tooling lists.
  • Collaborate closely with the Manufacturing Supervisor to support production requirements and resolve programming or machining challenges.
  • Ensure CNC programs are accurate, efficient, and aligned with quality and production standards.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts to optimize machining processes, reduce cycle times, and improve overall productivity.

Qualifications

  • Approximately 3–5 years of CNC programming experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong understanding of CNC milling machines and machining processes.
  • Ability to independently write and modify CNC programs.
  • Experience with Mastercam and/or G-code.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, revisions, and technical specifications.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with manufacturing and production teams.
  • Aerospace experience is preferred but not required.

Description:
This Mechanical Engineer role merges HVAC design, system commissioning, and Building Management System (Client) controls. You will deliver comprehensive engineering packages from calculating initial cooling/heating loads to programming sequences of operation and validating final system performance.

Plans, designs and oversees the reconfiguration, maintenance, and alteration of equipment, machinery, buildings, structures, and other facilities. Gathers and reviews data concerning facility or equipment specifications, company or government restrictions, required completion date, and construction feasibility. Coordinates with architecture/engineering firms in developing design criteria and preparing layout and detail drawings. Prepares bid sheets and contracts for construction and facilities acquisition. Reviews and estimates design costs including equipment, installation, labor, materials, preparation, and other related costs. Inspects or directs the inspection of construction and installation progress to ensure conformance to established drawings, specifications, and schedules.

Basic Qualifications:
1) Bachelor's Degree (in Mechanical Engineering)
2) 5+ years experience in Mechanical Engineer role merges HVAC design
3) 5+ years experience in Building Management System (Client)
4) Experience delivering comprehensive engineering packages from calculating initial cooling/heating loads to programming sequences of operation and validating final system performance.

LM will provide safety eyewear. Safety shoes are required for this position.

job.title: CNC Programmer/Toolmaker
job.description:
Nesco Resource is looking for a CNC Programmer/Toolmaker located in Bethel, CT. This is a temp to perm opportunity for the right candidate.

Shift: Monday-Friday 7AM-3PM

Pay: $31-$49/hour depending on experience

Position Overview: Are you an experienced CNC Programmer/Toolmaker looking to work with advanced machining equipment and challenging, precision-driven projects? We are seeking a skilled professional to program, set up, and operate a variety of CNC machines while supporting prototype development, process improvements, and precision manufacturing. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong programming experience, particularly with 5-axis machining, who enjoys solving complex manufacturing challenges and producing high-quality parts.

Responsibilities

  • Program, set up, and operate CNC milling machines (3-axis and 5-axis), CNC lathes, Wire EDM, and waterjet equipment.
  • Interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, and work instructions to develop efficient machining processes.
  • Manufacture complex, tight-tolerance precision components using a variety of materials.
  • Select, preset, adjust, and replace cutting tools to optimize machining performance.
  • Design and build custom fixtures and work holding solutions to improve production efficiency.
  • Inspect finished parts using precision measuring equipment, including micrometers, calipers, indicators, gauges, and optical inspection equipment.
  • Troubleshoot machining issues and implement corrective actions to improve quality and productivity.
  • Provide design-for-manufacturability (DFM) feedback to engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with engineers and production teams to develop and improve manufacturing processes.
  • Create labor and material estimates from engineering drawings.
  • Complete manufacturing documentation and in-process inspections accurately.
  • Train and support machinists and operators as needed.
  • Perform routine maintenance on machines, tooling, and fixtures.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment while following all quality and safety standards.
Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Associate degree in a machining or manufacturing-related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of CNC programming and machining experience.
  • Strong experience programming 5-axis CNC machines.
  • Experience with CNC mills, lathes, Wire EDM, and/or waterjet equipment.
  • Proficiency with CAD/CAM software such as Mastercam, GibbsCAM, or Esprit.
  • Strong understanding of G-Code, M-Code, GD&T, blueprint reading, and machinist math.
  • Experience using precision inspection equipment, including micrometers, calipers, indicators, gauges, microscopes, and optical measuring equipment.
  • Ability to design tooling, fixtures, and work holding solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with tight-tolerance precision machining.
  • Knowledge of ISO quality systems or regulated manufacturing environments is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.

job.title: Production Associate
job.description:
Position Summary
Immediate need for a production associate in Canfield, OH. This position is responsible for supporting the processing and finishing of steel coils through various production operations. Team members work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while ensuring quality, safety, and productivity standards are met.
This is an excellent opportunity for individuals with manufacturing, warehouse, steel processing, or machine operation experience who are looking to grow with an established company.

Position rotates weekly with shift hours being
11:00 pm - 7:00 am
7:00 am -  3:00 pm 
3:00 pm -  11:00 pm
Essential Responsibilities

  • Operate production equipment used in the processing, coating, and finishing of steel products.
  • Load, unload, and move steel coils and materials using overhead cranes, forklifts, or other material handling equipment (training provided where applicable).
  • Perform quality inspections to verify product specifications, dimensions, and surface quality.
  • Read and interpret work orders, production schedules, and measuring devices.
  • Monitor equipment performance and report mechanical issues or production concerns.
  • Assist with machine setup, changeovers, and routine adjustments.
  • Package finished materials for shipment according to customer specifications.
  • Maintain accurate production records and complete required documentation.
  • Keep work areas clean and organized while following 5S and housekeeping standards.
  • Follow all company safety policies, procedures, and PPE requirements.
  • Work collaboratively with supervisors and team members to meet daily production goals.
Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED preferred.
  • Previous manufacturing, warehouse, machine operation, or steel processing experience preferred.
  • Experience operating overhead cranes and/or forklifts is a plus.
  • Ability to accurately read a tape measure and perform basic math.
  • Mechanical aptitude and the ability to learn manufacturing equipment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work.
  • Reliable attendance and strong work ethic.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Physical Requirements
  • Frequently stand, walk, bend, lift, and perform repetitive movements throughout the shift.
  • Lift up to 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Work safely around moving machinery, steel products, and industrial equipment.
  • Ability to work in varying temperatures within a manufacturing environment.
Work Environment
  • Manufacturing and steel processing facility.
  • Fast-paced production environment with exposure to noise, moving equipment, and industrial machinery.
  • Required use of personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, hearing protection, steel-toe boots, and other PPE as required.
Preferred Skills
  • Manufacturing or production experience
  • Machine operation
  • Overhead crane operation
  • Forklift operation
  • Steel or metal processing experience
  • Tape measure proficiency
