job.title: Process Engineer
job.description:
Overview

Join a leading aerospace manufacturing company in Chandler, AZ, specializing in precision investment casting and machining for aerospace and industrial gas turbine components. We are seeking an experienced professional to enhance and optimize our investment casting processes, ensuring high-quality production and compliance with industry standards.

Responsibilities

  • Lead process development and continuous improvement initiatives for investment cast products.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain manufacturing processes to meet customer and internal quality specifications.
  • Improve product yields through data analysis, process optimization, mold design improvements, and gating enhancements.
  • Establish process guidelines and provide technical direction to manufacturing and engineering teams.
  • Support new product introductions from tooling through production launch.
  • Analyze casting defects, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
  • Develop and maintain manufacturing procedures, work instructions, and engineering documentation.
  • Train production personnel on new and revised manufacturing processes.
  • Collaborate with Product Engineering to achieve project milestones and meet production schedules.
  • Provide technical support for manufacturing issues related to casting processes, metallurgy, and inspections.
  • Participate in customer meetings and technical discussions regarding process development and quality improvements.
  • Support fixture development and ensure manufacturing tooling effectiveness throughout the casting process.
  • Serve as a technical resource for production teams and provide engineering support as needed.
  • Track engineering objectives and report progress to engineering leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience supporting products from tooling design through production launch.
  • Strong knowledge of investment casting processes.
  • Experience with aerospace or industrial gas turbine components, including airfoils, blades, vanes, and vacuum cast components.
  • Experience with defect analysis, Pareto analysis, MRB reviews, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of metallurgical requirements, casting specifications, blueprints, and material specifications.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interface directly with customers.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Project.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Extensive investment casting experience.
  • Proven track record of supporting products from tooling development through full-rate production.
  • Strong technical problem-solving abilities.

job.title: Systems Integration TestEngineer
job.description:
Client is seeking a System Integration Test Engineer to support the integration, verification, and testing of software-intensive systems within a Hardware-in-the-Loop system integration laboratory. This role will own multiple system capabilities from requirements decomposition through test development, execution, anomaly resolution, failure-mode testing, and test automation.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own the integration and testing activities for multiple assigned system capabilities.
  • Decompose system requirements and develop test cases that verify each requirement.
  • Perform manual system testing within a Hardware-in-the-Loop system integration laboratory.
  • Record test results using the designated test log tool.
  • Create anomaly reports for defects and issues identified during testing.
  • Partner with software engineers to document, troubleshoot, and resolve anomaly reports.
  • Develop and execute failure-mode testing for assigned capabilities.
  • Support the development and implementation of automated system tests.
  • Help the test automation team translate manual test scenarios into automated test coverage.
  • Develop and communicate long-term hardware integration strategies.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • 10+ years of experience integrating and/or testing software-intensive systems within a Hardware-in-the-Loop system integration laboratory.
  • 5+ years of experience with one or more tracking and development tools, including JIRA, GitLab, or GitHub.
  • 5+ years of experience with Eggplant, Cucumber, or Python.
  • 5+ years of experience with Omniview and Mission Planning concepts of operations.
  • Experience developing requirements-based system test cases.
  • Experience performing system integration, manual testing, failure-mode testing, and anomaly investigation.
  • Ability to develop and communicate long-term hardware integration strategies.
  • Active Secret clearance with an investigation completed within the last 5 years and Continuous Evaluation enrollment.
  • Required special access must be in place before starting.

Work Details

  • Full-time onsite role in Fort Worth, Texas.
  • 4/10-B work schedule.
  • Non-exempt position.
  • The role requires access to ECI information.

job.title: Payroll Specialist
job.description:
Position Overview

The Payroll & Billing Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of client payroll and billing functions. This role reviews payroll and invoice data for accuracy, finalizes payroll and billing, prepares customer packets for distribution, and ensures all payrolls and invoices are completed within required deadlines. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, organized, and committed to providing exceptional customer service while maintaining accuracy and compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Processing

  • Review client payroll data for accuracy, including taxing jurisdictions and payroll balances across multiple databases.
  • Finalize payroll processing and print payroll checks.
  • Ensure payrolls are completed accurately and within required banking timeframes.
  • Balance payroll records against accounting statements to ensure accuracy.

Billing & Invoicing

  • Review client invoices for accuracy and verify supporting payroll information.
  • Finalize invoicing and print customer invoices.
  • Balance invoicing records with accounting statements.
  • Ensure invoices are generated accurately and distributed on time.

Customer & Administrative Support

  • Prepare payroll and invoice packets for shipment to customers.
  • Assist with customer service inquiries related to payroll and billing.
  • Support additional departmental functions as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous payroll, billing, accounting, or payroll processing experience preferred.

Required Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with multiple databases and systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Customer service-oriented with the ability to build positive relationships.
  • Ability to meet strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team.

Success Measures

  • Payrolls are processed accurately and within required banking deadlines.
  • Client invoices are generated accurately and on time.
  • Payroll and invoicing records reconcile accurately with accounting statements.
  • Customer packets are prepared and shipped accurately and on schedule.
  • Work is completed in compliance with company policies and procedures while supporting a collaborative team environment.

Core Values

  • Act with integrity in all interactions.
  • Deliver outstanding customer service and build trusted relationships.
  • Continuously seek process improvements and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate effectively and support team success.
  • Take ownership and deliver on commitments.
  • Treat others with professionalism, respect, and dignity.

job.title: Client Support Specialist
job.description:
Nesco Data Center & Infrastructure is seeking a Client Support Specialist in the Greater Columbus OH area.

Position Summary

We are seeking a motivated and customer-focused Client Support Specialist to support a confidential enterprise client and an internal Project Manager. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys customer service, mobile technology, and solving technical challenges while building a long-term career in project management.

The position begins as a full-time, in-office role to ensure comprehensive training and client support. After approximately six months, there is potential to transition to a hybrid schedule based on successful performance, demonstrated proficiency, and client satisfaction.

This role offers significant career development opportunities. Successful candidates will receive cross-functional training in Customer Service, Help Desk Operations, Product Implementation, Project Management, Logistics, and Client Support. Individuals who excel in this position will have the opportunity to advance into a Project Management Support role, with long-term potential to become a Project Manager.

Key Qualifications

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Professional and customer-focused
  • An excellent verbal and written communicator
  • Reliable with outstanding attendance and dependability
  • Comfortable handling customer service calls and resolving client issues
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Passionate about technology, particularly mobile devices and enterprise mobility solutions

Essential Responsibilities

Mobile Device Ordering & Asset Management

  • Receive and process mobile device requests for new hires.
  • Create and submit wireless device orders through carrier and customer portals.
  • Track device shipments and coordinate delivery prior to employee start dates.
  • Maintain inventory and manage backfill device stock.

Device Activation & Customer Support

  • Provide Tier 1 support for mobile device activations and activation troubleshooting.
  • Activate new devices and manage personal-to-corporate account transfers.
  • Deliver Tier 2 support for mobile device configuration, corporate email setup, and authentication issues.
  • Educate users on self-service tools and available support resources.

Technical & Administrative Support

  • Configure and support enterprise mobile devices.
  • Install and troubleshoot Microsoft Authenticator, Microsoft Intune, and related applications.
  • Support Mobile Device Management (MDM) enrollment and configuration.
  • Assist users with portal access, account issues, and authentication problems.
  • Serve as a liaison between internal IT teams and wireless carriers, including Telecommunication and Telecommunication.
  • Maintain documentation, knowledge articles, and SharePoint resources.

Client & Project Coordination

  • Coordinate mobile device offboarding activities with Human Resources and internal stakeholders.
  • Participate in recurring client and project meetings.
  • Support customer training sessions and informational workshops.
  • Assist Project Managers with ongoing initiatives, special projects, and operational activities.
  • Support emergency response and Continuity of Operations (COOP) activities when required.

Wireless Service Management

  • Manage wireless device and service requests.
  • Process upgrades, replacements, cancellations, and service modifications.
  • Generate wireless reporting, including active line reports and usage information.
  • Coordinate monthly cancellation activities for inactive services.

Compliance

  • Follow all client policies, security requirements, and operational procedures.
  • Handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

 

Technical Skills

  • Experience activating and supporting mobile devices.
  • Working knowledge of Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms, preferably Microsoft Intune.
  • Experience supporting Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), including Microsoft Authenticator.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Experience using Microsoft Teams, WebEx, or similar collaboration platforms.
  • Experience with ServiceNow or similar ticketing systems is preferred.

Professional Skills

  • Outstanding customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams and clients.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and safeguard sensitive information.

Career Growth Opportunity

This position is designed as a career development role for individuals interested in advancing into Project Management. High-performing employees will receive exposure to multiple business functions, including:

  • Customer Service & Help Desk Operations
  • Product Implementation
  • Logistics & Asset Management
  • Client Success
  • Project Coordination
  • Project Management

job.title: Embedded S/W Engineer
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer to design, develop, integrate, and test real-time embedded software. This role will analyze algorithm descriptions and an existing software codebase to determine appropriate architectural changes. Development is primarily performed in C++, with some existing algorithms written in Ada, targeting Linux and Rocky Linux environments.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement real-time embedded software.
  • Analyze algorithm descriptions provided by systems engineering.
  • Review the existing software codebase and determine appropriate architectural changes.
  • Develop software using C++ within an Agile development environment.
  • Support software development from requirements analysis through integration, acceptance testing, and delivery.
  • Integrate and test software with associated hardware.
  • Develop software for Linux and Rocky Linux targets using Linux, Rocky Linux, and Windows development hosts.
  • Collaborate with systems engineering, hardware engineering, software engineering, and testing teams.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • Active Secret clearance with the most recent investigation completed within the last 5 years.
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.
  • Real-time embedded software development experience using C++ and Linux.
  • Software and hardware integration and testing experience.
  • Experience supporting requirements analysis, software development, integration, and acceptance testing.

Preferred Skills or Experience

  • Knowledge of RTI Data Distribution Services.
  • Knowledge of publish/subscribe communication protocols.
  • Common Object Request Broker Architecture experience.
  • CMake development experience.
  • Familiarity with embedded real-time Ada programming.
  • Experience working on multidisciplinary software engineering teams.
  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

Work Details

  • Onsite full-time position.
  • 4/10A, first-shift work schedule.

job.title: Care Coordinator(Fully Remote)
job.description:
Non-Clinical Occupational Medicine (OccMed) Care Coordinator

Schedule: Shift : M-F 8a-11p; S-S 10a-4p - Must be available to work 40 hours a week within these time frame
Work Arrangement: Remote

Position Overview

The Non-Clinical OccMed Care Coordinator serves as a key liaison in the coordination of patient cases within the workers' compensation process. This role ensures accurate review of medical documentation, alignment of treatments with authorized care plans, and effective communication with providers, employers, and internal stakeholders to support high-quality, compliant care delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Case Coordination & Documentation Review

  • Review provider transcripts and medical documentation to ensure treatments align with authorized care plans

  • Identify discrepancies, missing information, or additional treatments within records

  • Communicate with providers to clarify documentation and verify treatment accuracy

  • Maintain and verify Occupational Medicine data within the EMR system

Workers' Compensation Support

  • Manage and document workers' compensation claims and referrals in the EMR system

  • Provide required work status reports to employers and insurance carriers in compliance with state regulations

  • Communicate with employers, adjusters, and nurse case managers regarding:

    • Work restrictions

    • Missing documentation

    • Denials and claim updates

Customer Service & Stakeholder Communication

  • Serve as a liaison between patients, employers, providers, and insurance companies

  • Provide timely responses to employer and patient inquiries, including medical record requests

  • Support appointment reminders and communicate missed appointment details as needed

  • Build strong relationships with employer clients to resolve concerns and ensure satisfaction

Billing & Process Support

  • Audit charges to ensure accurate billing and clean claim submission

  • Identify and resolve missing codes or documentation issues

  • Collaborate with internal teams to support drug screen reporting and employer account setup

Program & Operational Support

  • Assist OccMed Sales Team with establishing and maintaining employer protocols in the EMR system

  • Maintain daily communication with OccMed team members and leadership

  • Participate in staff meetings, audits, and process improvement initiatives

  • Support coordinated care efforts across clinics, patients, and employers

Compliance & Standards

  • Ensure adherence to company policies, including HIPAA and compliance program standards

  • Follow OSHA and workplace safety protocols

  • Maintain strict confidentiality of patient and business information

  • Adhere to company Code of Conduct, mission, and values

Education

  • High School Diploma required

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred

Experience

  • Occupational Medicine or related business experience required

  • Experience with Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems preferred

  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to review and interpret medical documentation

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)

  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities

Additional Qualifications

  • Professional, personable demeanor

  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills

  • Ability to collaborate across multiple stakeholders and departments

  • Commitment to delivering high-quality, service-oriented support

job.title: Metal Control Operator I
job.description:
Description:
*Long Term Contract
*1st Shift (Monday - Friday 6am - 2pm)

JOB SUMMARY
Work as a team member to take a rough casting and condition it to the specifications that meet the customer's requirements by performing metal cleaning, finishing, and dimensional inspection and FPI inspection.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
•Must be able to read and interpret Product Criteria (PC) and Activity Instructions (AI).
•Operate hand grinding tools (both belt and stone).
•Operate metal cleaning equipment, water flow and sonic equipment.
•Adjust parts by use of presses, heat or other dimensional tooling.
•Operate hand sandblast and auto blast units.
•Prolonged gripping standing or sitting and pushing, pulling and lifting.
•Moderate length of concentration.
•Must be able to function as a member of a team and be able to work under general supervision.
•Must be able to work and function in a fast-paced environment.
•Basic knowledge of computers.
•Must be able to maintain expected quality levels.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
Job responsibilities and duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:

To become cross trained in order to perform ALL or MOST OF the duties listed below. When necessary, individual may be required to move castings to designated area or perform other work-related duties as assigned:
Metal Cleaner
•Sandblast part by the A.I./P.C.
•Fill and clean the blasting unit.
•Inspect castings for possible scrap.
•Maintain the correct pressure and speed of the blast cabinets by the AI's and PC's.
•Operate glass bead/table clean unit.
Metal Finisher
•Finish castings to PC using stones, burrs, belts, templates and gauges.
•Sandblast to surface finish.
•Conduct visual operation and primary inspection of casting.
•Input data in computer for collection.
•Use boroscope for inspection and fiber light.
•Perform decap/deburr operation.
•Perform sonic operation.
•Map weld areas.
•Operate Comco machine.
•Operate water flow.
Dimensional
•Use of calipers, micrometer, height gauges, shim stock, scissors, pin, go no/go, step gages, sonic equipment.
•Input data for record keeping.
•Adjusting castings for PC compliance.
•Working with engineering on deviant castings and reworking to engineer's instructions.
•Datum "C” drilling-Stators Cell Only-(considered add-a-skill op.).
•Fixture Gauging /Adjusting -(considered add-a-skill op.).
•Reroute nonconforming castings.

*Employees are expected to work overtime as needed.
JOB SPECIFICATIONS
1.Education:
High School Diploma or GED equivalency required.

2.Skills and Abilities:
Employee must be able to:
•Read parts to the .0001
•Understand gauging and templates.
•Have finishing skills, (stones, burrs, belts, etc.).
•Work independent as well as with a team.
•Able to read and follow written and verbal instruction.

3.Experience:
No previous experience required.

4.Physical Demands:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Employee is required to execute the following:
•Occasional bending, reaching, pushing, and pulling when retrieving and moving various items
•Lifting approximately 30% of the time. Typically, assistance would be provided for weights exceeding 35 pounds.
•Good manual dexterity.
•Position may require more than eight hours daily and more than five days weekly to complete work assignments.
•Sitting in chairs (swivel, padded, and adjustable) for 70% of the workday.
•Squatting / crouching when retrieving stored items from lower shelves and file cabinets, making equipment / product inspections, etc.
•Standing intermittently.
•Visual requirements for this position are close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
•Clean work areas and maintain a clean work environment; perform 5S cleaning activities as required.

5.Equipment Used:
•Hand grinding tools.
•Auto gauges.
•Metal cleaning equipment.
•Sonic Equipment.
•Template Haze blast.
•Computers.
•Glass bead.
•Boroscope.
•Belt gun.
•Comco.
•Hoists.

6.Work Environment:
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Duties are performed in a manufacturing setting where compliance with applicable safety rules is required.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be required to work near moving mechanical parts and exposed to fumes or airborne particles, rather confined space, and some degree of extreme heat during summer months. The noise level is moderate.

7.Contacts:
Internal: This position interfaces routinely with all HLC personnel.
External:This position interfaces occasionally with outside vendors.

8.Supervision:
This position supervises no other.

9.EHS Requirements
•Expected to assist in the implementation of EHS Values and policy statements and accompanying principals.
•Comply with all department, facility, corporate and regulatory EHS regulations.
•Wear all required personal protective equipment (PPE).
•Report all job-related illness and injuries (Per Employee Handbook).
•Report all safety, health and environmental concerns to your supervisor in a timely manner.
•Attend all EHS training.

10.Quality Statement
The products we manufacture are used in important industries - transporting goods and people; the defense of our country; critical energy infrastructure for hospitals and public safety. Livelihoods and lives depend upon the products we manufacture. What we do as an organization is important and the first, and best, "line of defense” against non-conforming products escaping to our customers is you. A simple message: don't take it, don't make it, and don't pass it.

JOB IMPACT
1.Contribution of Job
This position contributes to the overall performance and profitability of the company through improving techniques and processes. This position is also responsible for contributing to department and company metrics, such as LU and PVA.

job.description:
Oil Shaker Line Operator

Schedule: 1st Shift

Production Machine Operator – 1st Shift

Monroe, CT | $18.00–$18.50 per hour | Monday–Friday | 7:00 AM–3:30 PM

Looking for a stable 1st shift opportunity with room to grow?

We're seeking a dependable Production Machine Operator to join a growing manufacturing team in Monroe, CT. This is a hands-on role where you'll operate production equipment, perform quality inspections, and help ensure products are manufactured safely and efficiently. If you enjoy working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and take pride in producing quality work, we'd love to meet you!

What You'll Do

  • Operate and monitor heat treat production equipment.
  • Set up production lines according to work orders and operating procedures.
  • Perform routine equipment inspections and basic maintenance before startup.
  • Monitor oil and water filtration systems and replace filters as needed.
  • Inspect parts throughout the production process to ensure quality standards are met.
  • Load, unload, and stage materials while preventing product mix-ups.
  • Prepare finished products for inspection, packaging, and shipment.
  • Complete production documentation accurately.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

Qualifications

  • Previous manufacturing, production, or machine operating experience preferred.
  • Ability to read and follow written and verbal work instructions.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to troubleshoot basic production issues.
  • Forklift and overhead crane experience are a plus.
  • Reliable attendance and a positive, team-oriented attitude.

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently lift up to 25 pounds and occasionally up to 50 pounds.
  • Comfortable working around machinery, noise, and heat in a manufacturing environment.
  • Must be able to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, steel-toe shoes, gloves, and hearing protection.

Why You'll Love This Opportunity

Apply today and take the next step in your manufacturing career! We look forward to hearing from you.

job.title: RF Engineer-Secret Clearance
job.description:
RF Engineer – Production Support | Weekend Shift

Important: Please do not submit duplicate candidates to request numbers #19839, #20302, #20306, #22115, or #22116.

Location: Chelmsford, MA
Schedule: Thursday–Sunday, 7:00 AM–5:30 PM
Job Type: Contract
Clearance: Active Secret Clearance Required to Start

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced RF Engineer to support the production, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and sustainment of complex RF and microwave electronic modules used in high-reliability aerospace and defense applications.

This is a highly hands-on engineering position for an RF professional who enjoys working directly with hardware, test equipment, manufacturing teams, and cross-functional engineering groups. The engineer will support products throughout the full life cycle while independently troubleshooting complex technical issues and developing innovative solutions to production and integration challenges.

The ideal candidate will have experience with RF/microwave systems, hands-on hardware troubleshooting, RF test equipment, microwave simulation tools, production support, and failure investigations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the production and sustainment of complex multi-function RF and microwave modules.
  • Troubleshoot RF hardware, designs, integration issues, and production-related technical problems.
  • Perform hands-on testing, debugging, analysis, and evaluation of RF and microwave systems.
  • Utilize RF/microwave test equipment and simulation tools to identify issues and validate solutions.
  • Support products throughout all phases of the product life cycle.
  • Independently investigate and resolve technical issues associated with operational products.
  • Lead or support failure investigations and root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with hardware, systems, circuit design, manufacturing, industrial engineering, and technical support teams.
  • Work directly with manufacturing personnel and production operators to resolve technical issues.
  • Review and interpret technical documentation, including specifications, schematics, drawings, and test data.
  • Develop practical and innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges.
  • Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and solutions to internal teams and customers.
  • Prepare and deliver technical presentations when required.
  • Support production efficiency, quality, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret Clearance required to start.
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or another STEM-related field, plus 5+ years of relevant professional engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience working with RF and microwave hardware.
  • Experience troubleshooting designs and resolving integration issues in a production or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience using RF/microwave test equipment.
  • Experience with microwave/RF simulation tools.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong presentation skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related technical field.
  • Significant experience in the defense electronics or aerospace industry.
  • Prior RF design engineering experience.
  • Expertise with RF subsystems and components, including:
    • Antennas
    • Transmitters and receivers
    • Microwave components
    • Low-noise amplifiers (LNAs)
    • High-power amplifiers (HPAs)
    • RF amplifiers
    • Mixers
    • Switches
    • Frequency generation circuits
    • Frequency conversion circuits
    • Advanced electronic modules
  • Experience with microelectronics assembly techniques.
  • Strong knowledge of RF and microwave circuit design.
  • Experience leading technical failure investigations and root-cause analysis.
  • Experience with customer interface and technical presentations.
  • Strong understanding of engineering documentation, including specifications, schematics, drawings, and test data.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing engineers, industrial engineers, technicians, and production operators.

Schedule & Training Requirements

The selected contractor must complete approximately 6 weeks of first-shift training before transitioning to the regular weekend shift.

Training Schedule:
Monday–Thursday | 6:00 AM–4:30 PM

Regular Weekend Schedule:
Thursday–Sunday | 7:00 AM–5:30 PM

Important: Please do not submit duplicate candidates to request numbers #19839, #20302, #20306, #22115, or #22116.

job.title: Mechanical Equipment / Piping Engineer- Direct Hire
job.description:
Position Snapshot

Job Title

Mechanical Equipment / Piping Engineer

Location

Houston, TX

Employment Type

Direct Hire / Full-Time

Compensation

$90,000–$135,000 base salary + 10%–20% performance-based bonus

Important recruiting requirement: Salary expectations must be added to the top of the candidate's resume in this format:

Base Salary Expectation: $XXX,XXX + Bonus Expectation: XX% | Total Desired Compensation: $XXX,XXX

Candidate Requirements

  • Must be a local Houston candidate
  • No relocation
  • No sponsorship
  • U.S. work authorization requirements should be confirmed during screening
  • 3–15 years of experience considered
  • Priority given to candidates with 5+ years
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering preferred
  • PE license is not required, but strongly favored for senior candidates
  • EPC experience strongly preferred
  • Modular engineering/design experience required
  • Strong piping stress and mechanical equipment experience required
  • Subsea experience is not required
  • Subsea is considered an analogous background
  • Data center experience is ideal but not mandatory

Important Submission Restriction

This is a refresh posting for 1SLBJP00003284.

Do not resubmit any candidate who previously interviewed or was rejected.

What This Engineer Will Actually Do

The engineer will own or support the mechanical equipment and piping scope for large-scale data center modules.

They will be involved in:

Design → Engineering → Procurement → Manufacturing → Assembly → Testing → Installation → Commissioning

This is important because the engineer must understand how a design works in the real world.

They are not just sitting in front of CAD software creating drawings.

They will also:

  • Review designs
  • Check calculations
  • Review vendor equipment
  • Support manufacturing
  • Help resolve construction problems
  • Respond to RFIs
  • Support installation
  • Assist with commissioning
  • Interact with customers
  • Provide technical guidance to other engineers

Core Technical Focus

1. Piping Engineering

This is one of the most important areas of the role.

The candidate should understand:

  • Piping system design
  • Pipe routing
  • Piping layout
  • Line sizing
  • Piping components
  • Specialty items
  • Valves
  • Fittings
  • Supports
  • Brackets
  • Fasteners
  • Bolting
  • Mounting systems
  • Piping insulation
  • Coatings and painting systems

The engineer will prepare or review:

  • Valve lists
  • Equipment lists
  • Piping line lists
  • Piping layouts
  • Piping calculations
  • Piping specifications
  • Piping stress studies

2. Piping Stress Analysis

This is a major technical requirement.

The engineer will perform or check:

  • Pipe stress analysis
  • Flexibility analysis
  • Thermal expansion analysis
  • Piping loads
  • Equipment nozzle loads
  • Support loads
  • Seismic loads
  • Wind loads
  • Pressure loads
  • Thermal loads
  • Operating loads
  • Occasional loads

The engineer will also provide piping load information to structural engineering.

Key software:

  • CAESAR II
  • NozzlePro
  • FEPipe

A candidate with strong piping stress experience but no direct data center background could still be highly relevant.

3. Mechanical Equipment

The engineer will work with and design around critical mechanical equipment such as:

  • Chillers
  • Cooling towers
  • Direct evaporative cooling systems
  • Indirect evaporative cooling systems
  • Pumps
  • Fans
  • Vessels
  • Valves
  • Coolers
  • Mechanical control systems
  • Other critical data center mechanical equipment

The candidate needs to understand how equipment interacts with the piping systems around it.

For example:

  • What are the equipment connection requirements?
  • What are the nozzle loads?
  • How does thermal expansion affect the system?
  • What type of supports are required?
  • What are the vibration concerns?
  • How will the equipment be installed and maintained?

4. EPC Experience

The ideal candidate has worked in an EPC environment.

They should understand the relationship between:

Engineering

Designing and calculating the system.

Procurement

Preparing technical requisitions, reviewing vendor quotes, and specifying equipment.

Construction

Supporting field installation, RFIs, and construction issues.

This is a full project lifecycle role.

5. Modular Engineering

This is a particularly important part of the position.

The company produces modular data center infrastructure.

The engineer must understand how equipment and piping will be:

  • Designed
  • Fabricated
  • Assembled
  • Transported
  • Installed
  • Tested
  • Commissioned

This means designs must consider:

  • Space limitations
  • Modular assembly
  • Transport requirements
  • Equipment access
  • Maintenance access
  • Piping connections
  • Structural support
  • Installation sequence

Candidates with experience in the following may transfer well:

  • Modular construction
  • Skid packages
  • Packaged equipment
  • Offshore modules
  • Subsea systems
  • Oil & gas modules
  • Process skids
  • Industrial equipment packages
  • E-houses
  • Fabricated mechanical systems

Subsea Experience

Subsea experience is not mandatory.

However, it is considered analogous because subsea engineers often work with:

  • Complex mechanical systems
  • Piping
  • Pressure systems
  • Equipment interfaces
  • Tight design tolerances
  • Stress analysis
  • Reliability requirements
  • Harsh operating environments
  • Complex fabrication and assembly

A strong subsea engineer with piping stress and mechanical equipment experience could be a very strong candidate.

Technical Documents and Deliverables

The engineer will prepare, review, or approve:

Equipment Lists

Including:

  • Equipment identification
  • Equipment specifications
  • Capacity
  • Materials
  • Operating conditions

Valve Lists

Including:

  • Valve type
  • Size
  • Pressure rating
  • Materials
  • Service

Piping Line Lists

Including:

  • Line number
  • Size
  • Service
  • Design pressure
  • Design temperature
  • Material
  • Insulation requirements

Piping Stress / Flexibility Studies

Including:

  • Load cases
  • Stress results
  • Equipment loads
  • Support requirements

Mechanical Equipment Datasheets

Used to define:

  • Equipment requirements
  • Operating parameters
  • Design conditions
  • Vendor requirements

MTOs

Material Take-Offs for:

  • Piping
  • Valves
  • Fittings
  • Supports
  • Mechanical equipment

BOMs

Detailed Bills of Materials supporting manufacturing and assembly.

Design Basis Responsibilities

The engineer may create or review the project-specific Design Basis document.

This document may incorporate:

  • Applicable codes
  • Client specifications
  • Company scope of supply
  • Approved exceptions
  • Project design requirements

The Design Basis helps establish the technical rules used throughout the project.

Vendor and Procurement Support

The engineer will support procurement by:

  • Preparing Technical Requisitions
  • Reviewing vendor quotations
  • Reviewing vendor technical data
  • Evaluating equipment against specifications
  • Providing feedback to procurement
  • Supporting equipment selection

This means the candidate needs to understand both:

What the equipment needs to do and how to evaluate whether a vendor's equipment meets the requirement.

Manufacturing and Plant Support

The engineer will support the manufacturing plant during production.

They may:

  • Review fabrication issues
  • Answer technical questions
  • Clarify drawings
  • Resolve design conflicts
  • Review as-built conditions
  • Support assembly teams
  • Assist with manufacturing changes

This is an excellent role for someone who enjoys being connected to the physical product rather than working exclusively on design documents.

Construction and Commissioning Support

The engineer will provide technical support during:

  • Construction
  • Installation
  • Testing
  • Commissioning

They may:

  • Respond to RFIs
  • Troubleshoot piping issues
  • Resolve equipment problems
  • Attend site visits
  • Participate in project meetings
  • Support commissioning teams
  • Review as-built drawings
  • Re-run or verify calculations

Customer-Facing Responsibilities

The engineer may represent the company during customer meetings.

Responsibilities include:

  • Presenting technical information
  • Responding to customer questions
  • Explaining design decisions
  • Addressing concerns
  • Supporting design reviews
  • Maintaining strong customer relationships

Strong communication is important because this role requires explaining complex technical information clearly.

Codes and Standards

The candidate should have experience with or familiarity with relevant industry standards, including:

  • AISI
  • ANSI
  • ASME
    • Section VIII
    • Section IX
    • B31.3
  • ASTM
  • AWS
  • IBC
  • MFMA
  • Client
  • OSHA
  • NACE
  • NFPA
  • PFI

The strongest candidates will have experience applying codes to real-world design and engineering decisions.

Education

Preferred

Bachelor of Science in:

  • Mechanical Engineering

Other degrees may be considered:

  • Industrial Engineering
  • Mechatronics Engineering
  • Other engineering disciplines

However, candidates with non-mechanical degrees should have stronger relevant experience in:

  • Mechanical equipment
  • Piping
  • Stress analysis
  • Data center infrastructure
  • EPC engineering

Software Requirements

Most Important Software

CAESAR II

Critical for piping stress and flexibility analysis.

NozzlePro

Used for equipment nozzle and local stress evaluation.

FEPipe

Used for piping analysis and stress evaluation.

These three are among the strongest technical screening tools for this role.

Additional Software

The candidate may also have experience with:

  • SAP engineering modules
  • SolidWorks
  • AutoCAD
  • Revit
  • BIM 360
  • Navisworks Manager
  • Navisworks Freedom
  • 3E Plus
  • Pipe Data Pro
  • COMPRESS
  • Microsoft Office 365
  • Adobe
  • Foxit

Strong Candidate Backgrounds

Best Fit

  • Mechanical Engineer
  • Piping Engineer
  • Mechanical Equipment Engineer
  • Piping Stress Engineer
  • Mechanical Design Engineer
  • Senior Piping Engineer
  • Mechanical Project Engineer

Strong Industries

  • Data centers
  • EPC
  • Oil & gas
  • Petrochemical
  • Client
  • Subsea
  • Offshore
  • Power generation
  • Industrial manufacturing
  • Chemical processing
  • Heavy industrial
  • Modular construction

job.title: Systems Engineer - (Biotech/Diagnostics)
job.description:
Position Summary
Client Diagnostics develops and produces medical tests and digital tools that provide information to help healthcare professionals find the right treatment for patients and deliver the best patient care to improve, prolong, and save lives.

The Client Sequencing team is seeking a passionate Systems Engineer II to join the Systems Integration Group supporting Next Generation Sequencing, or NGS, products. This is a hands-on role in which the Systems Engineer II will contribute to feasibility, development, and integration activities for end-to-end NGS solutions.
As a member of the Systems Integration team, this individual will work with the Single Molecule Sequencing platform to optimize operating protocols, design and perform wet-lab experiments, support integration of system subcomponents, and help improve the overall sequencing solution.

Key Responsibilities
Design, execute, analyze, and document experiments to support feasibility, development, integration, verification, and validation of NGS workflows.
Perform sample preparation, library preparation, sequencing-related experiments, and verification studies.
Use the Single Molecule Sequencing platform to optimize final operating protocols and support system-level integration activities.
Interpret experimental results using appropriate experimental design and statistical analysis methods.
Troubleshoot instrument, workflow, or assay-related failures using standard root cause analysis methods.
Collaborate with subject matter experts to understand failure modes and identify appropriate solutions.
Develop, execute, and document test cases based on product requirements for verification and validation activities.
Maintain accurate, well-organized, and concise laboratory records using best laboratory practices.
Work cross-functionally with assay, instrumentation, software, bioinformatics, and systems teams to resolve integration challenges.
Support continuous improvement of sequencing performance, including coverage, throughput, robustness, reproducibility, and overall system reliability.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, science, engineering, or a related field with 5 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree in a related field with 1–3+ years of relevant experience.
Demonstrated hands-on experience with PCR, DNA sequencing methods, raw sample preparation, nucleic acid extraction, library preparation, and/or NGS sequencing.
At least 2 years of experience using MATLAB, Git, Python, or similar tools for data analysis and/or automation.
Experience with statistical tools and methods, such as Python, JMP, regression analysis, and ANOVA.
At least 2 years of experience with Design of Experiments methodology and application of statistical process control.
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot technical issues and identify root causes in laboratory, instrument, or workflow settings.
Strong documentation skills and commitment to following best laboratory practices.
Preferred Qualifications
Proven track record of performing in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across functions.
Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions and stakeholders without direct authority.
Experience solving unique, ambiguous, or unpredictable problems that may impact project or organizational goals.
Strong planning, prioritization, multitasking, and follow-through skills.
Highly energetic, focused, and adaptable working style.
Strong interpersonal, verbal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships with key stakeholders.
Location
This position is based on-site in Santa Clara, CA.
This is not a hybrid position.
Relocation benefits are not available for this role.
Compensation
Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.
Interview: 1.phone 2. In-person

Job description
The role of Electrical Engineer is to support the Engineering Lead and Product Engineering Manager. They will be accountable for the electrical scope and systems in large scale data centers across the design, construction, assembly, testing, installation, and commissioning phases. The Electrical Engineer will be responsible for checking and approving drawings / designs; interface communication, and ensuring the accuracy, reliability, efficiency, and safety of the electrical scope of work for Hyperscale Data Center Modules meets customer's requirements and Industrial Standards.

The Electrical Engineer will play a critical role with supporting the plant during the manufacturing stage. They will also be assisting various stakeholders in troubleshooting site installation and commissioning problems.

Roles and Responsibilities
The Engineer will support the goals and programs established by the management team. These roles and responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Checking and approving drawings, information, and documentation which meets Industrial standards to enable the manufacturing group and other departments to produce Data Center Infrastructure Modules.
Attend and initiate Design and Development Planning and Review session to meet customer's and industry's need.

Review vendor quotations and provide feedback to procurement team.
Prepare and complete various electrical engineering deliverable drawings, documents, and calculations such as electrical load list, cable sizing / schedule, single line diagrams.
Design and complete earthing protection systems.
Design and complete lighting studies and system.
Prepare bulk MTOs (Material Take Offs) and detailed BOMs (Bill of Materials).
Ability and willingness to think outside of the box to find creative and innovative solutions to reduce costs while managing impact to quality, cost, or schedule.
Keeps informed of new developments and requirements affecting the organization for the purpose of recommending changes in programs and applications.
Interprets, organizes, executes assignments in a self-driven and self-sufficient manner.
Makes decisions independently on technical problems and methods and represents the organization in meetings to resolve important questions.
Applies advanced or state-of-the-art knowledge and experience to resolve crucial issues and/or unique conditions. The knowledge and expertise required for this level of work usually results from progressive experience.
Supervision received is essentially administrative, with assignments given in terms of broadgeneral objectives and limits.

Analyze electrical systems to identify and resolve issues, including load balancing, capacity planning, and power consumption optimization.
Stays up to date with advancements in electrical engineering and data center technologies
and recommend new technologies to improve the reliability and efficiency of our data center product line.
Represent company with customers during review meetings. Act as the primary point of contact for clients, responding to their inquiries and concerns in a timely and professional manner.

Experience with high-density data centers and hyperscale environments
Understand the principle of electrical power and its components, procedures, and standards for power system equipment sizing and design.

Knowledge of industry standards, codes, and regulations, including but not limited to
o IEC – International Electrotechnical Commission

Experience working with computer-aided design (CAD) and building information modeling (BIM) software.
Fast track design/build projects and or multiple significant upgrade projects
Detailed understanding of UPS (uninterruptable power sources), diesel generators, medium and low voltage electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, electrical control systems, low voltage rectification systems, and other critical electrical equipment found within data centers.

job.title: Warehouse Supervisor
job.description:
Warehouse Supervisor

Position Overview

We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Warehouse Supervisor to oversee daily warehouse operations, including shipping, receiving, inventory control, documentation, and team coordination. This role is responsible for ensuring that materials are shipped and received accurately and on time while maintaining a safe, efficient, and quality-focused work environment.

The ideal candidate will have experience in warehouse, shipping and receiving, logistics, inventory, or materials operations and must have hands-on experience using SAP or a comparable ERP system. This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and effective communication.

Key Responsibilities

Warehouse, Shipping & Receiving Operations

  • Oversee daily warehouse operations and ensure efficient workflow.
  • Prepare and maintain daily status reports.
  • Prepare Bills of Lading, customs documentation, and shipping labels using SAP.
  • Set up and schedule shipments.
  • Schedule export loading appointments.
  • Record all shipping and receiving transactions accurately in the ERP system.
  • Track shipments and coordinate with internal teams to resolve shipping, receiving, and documentation discrepancies.
  • Ensure all shipping and receiving activities are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Maintain accurate and timely shipping and receiving records.

Documentation & Recordkeeping

  • File and maintain all shipping documentation in a timely and organized manner.
  • Maintain accurate records of process orders.
  • Ensure process order documentation is properly filed and maintained.
  • Maintain and update shipping and receiving Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Perform quality documentation audits and ensure required records are complete and accurate.
  • Prepare and maintain documentation necessary to support warehouse and logistics operations.

Inventory Management

  • Maintain accurate consumable inventories.
  • Oversee regular inventory checks and help ensure inventory accuracy.
  • Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies.
  • Ensure inventory transactions and records are accurately maintained in the appropriate ERP system.
  • Support effective inventory control practices and material accountability.

Safety Responsibilities

Safety is the number one priority.

  • Recognize and address safety problems, issues, and deficiencies as observed or directed.
  • Follow all applicable safety procedures and requirements.
  • Promote a safe working environment and ensure warehouse activities are performed safely.
  • Support a culture of safety throughout all warehouse and shipping/receiving activities.

Quality Responsibilities

Quality is the second-highest priority after safety.

  • Maintain a working knowledge of applicable quality procedures.
  • Ensure warehouse, shipping, and receiving procedures are followed correctly.
  • Perform quality documentation audits.
  • Ensure records and documentation meet established quality requirements.
  • Identify and communicate quality issues or documentation deficiencies.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • SAP experience required.
  • Approximately 2–5 years of warehouse, shipping/receiving, logistics, inventory, materials, or related experience preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Basic computer skills, including email and Microsoft Office programs.
  • Ability to read, comprehend, and follow operating directions and procedures.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent attendance and reliability.
  • Strong attention to detail.

Physical & Schedule Requirements

  • Ability to work an 8-hour day shift.
  • Occasional overtime may be required.
  • Ability to perform the physical requirements associated with warehouse and shipping/receiving operations.
  • Must be able to work safely and effectively in a warehouse or industrial environment.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is an organized and dependable warehouse or logistics professional with hands-on SAP experience and a strong understanding of shipping, receiving, inventory control, and warehouse documentation.

This individual should be comfortable coordinating shipments, maintaining accurate records, resolving discrepancies, supporting inventory checks, and working with internal teams. The successful candidate will be safety-focused, quality-minded, reliable, and able to work independently while effectively communicating with others.

Key Skills:

Warehouse Operations | Shipping & Receiving | SAP | ERP Systems | Inventory Control | Bills of Lading | Customs Documentation | Export Shipments | Shipping Documentation | Process Orders | Inventory Checks | SOPs | Quality Audits | Safety | Microsoft Office | Problem Solving | Communication

job.title: Inpatient Coder (Remote)
job.description:
Nesco Resource has partnered with a well-established healthcare organization in their pursuit to hire Inpatient Coders. 
Fully Remote
Full-Time | Flexible Scheduling Options Availableccc 
Competitive Compensation – Up to $65,000 + Excellent Benefits
The Inpatient Coder is responsible for accurately coding and abstracting diagnoses, procedures, and clinical information from inpatient medical records. This individual ensures compliance with established coding guidelines while maintaining high standards of data quality, integrity, productivity, and accuracy.

Essential Responsibilities

The Inpatient Coder plays a key role in ensuring accurate and compliant coding of inpatient medical records. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Assign ICD-10-CM/PCS diagnosis and procedure codes in accordance with Official Coding Guidelines, AHA Coding Clinic, CMS, and other regulatory requirements.
  • Apply Uniform Hospital Discharge Data Set (UHDDS) definitions to determine principal diagnoses, secondary diagnoses, and procedures.
  • Utilize MS-DRG and APR-DRG reimbursement methodologies to ensure accurate code assignment.
  • Assign Present on Admission (POA) indicators for inpatient diagnoses.
  • Identify and accurately code Hospital-Acquired Conditions (HACs) supported by physician documentation.
  • Verify patient data and discharge disposition to ensure coding compliance.
  • Prepare compliant physician queries to clarify conflicting or incomplete documentation following current industry guidelines.
  • Abstract required clinical information into coding and abstracting systems.
  • Review and resolve coding edits, pre-bill edits, and missing documentation to support timely billing.
  • Collaborate with Health Information Management (HIM) staff and Clinical Documentation Improvement Specialists (CDIS) to ensure complete and accurate documentation.
  • Utilize electronic medical record (EMR), coding, and abstracting software to meet established productivity and quality standards.
  • Participate in continuing education and maintain required coding certifications and CEUs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of inpatient coding experience using ICD-10-CM/PCS.
  • Extensive experience with MS-DRG and APR-DRG reimbursement methodologies.
  • AHIMA certification preferred (RHIA, RHIT, CCS, or equivalent).
  • Associate's degree or higher in Health Information Management or a related field preferred.
  • Experience coding within a large acute care hospital system (500+ beds).
  • Experience with Epic EMR and 3M coding software preferred.
  • Experience coding complex acute care cases, including:
    • Level I Trauma
    • Teaching hospitals
    • Kidney, Liver, and Pancreas Transplants
    • General Surgery
    • Orthopedics
    • Cardiothoracic Surgery
    • Vascular Surgery
    • Bariatric Surgery
    • Gynecology
    • Neurology
    • Urology
    • Colorectal Surgery
    • Behavioral Health
    • Gastroenterology
    • Wound Care
  • Ability to consistently meet coding productivity and accuracy standards.
  • Successful completion of a pre-employment coding assessment.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to remain seated for extended periods while working at a computer.
  • Frequent use of a computer, keyboard, and other office equipment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to review electronic medical records and other digital documents for extended periods.
  • Occasional movement within the workspace to access office equipment or materials.

Work Environment

  • Dedicated, secure, and distraction-free home office or workspace that protects patient confidentiality (PHI).
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection (minimum 200 Mbps).
  • Professional home office environment suitable for remote work.

job.title: Systems Analyst II - Hybrid
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking an Oracle Global Data Warehouse Senior Analyst to support an enterprise data warehouse environment serving finance, procurement, reporting, and analytical applications. This role is primarily focused on production support, advanced SQL troubleshooting, data warehouse operations, ETL processes, data security, and coordination of offshore technical teams.

Core Responsibilities

  • Provide production support for the Oracle Global Data Warehouse and related reporting and analytical applications.
  • Investigate, coordinate, and resolve complex data, application, integration, and system issues.
  • Write complex SQL queries from scratch and optimize or enhance existing queries.
  • Analyze stored procedures, troubleshoot performance issues, and collaborate with database administrators on performance recommendations.
  • Support data warehouse and ETL processes across Oracle, Hyperion, Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, and related applications.
  • Oversee deployments, customizations, enhancements, process changes, and technical support activities.
  • Ensure system development, change control, audit, compliance, and cybersecurity standards are followed.
  • Support system upgrades, acquisitions, technology expansions, and legacy system integrations.
  • Lead and coordinate offshore technical teams, providing direction, oversight, and quality control.
  • Ensure technical deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Partner with business users, technical teams, infrastructure teams, and external support partners.
  • Support business processes involving finance, accounts receivable, credit, procurement, project accounting, order-to-cash, and procure-to-pay.
  • Lead intake discussions, communicate technical recommendations, and present relevant information to leadership.
  • Proactively identify issues, correct errors early, and recommend system enhancements, process improvements, or replacement solutions.
  • Maintain ITIL artifacts, CMDB records, knowledge articles, architecture diagrams, audit documentation, disaster recovery documentation, and support procedures.
  • Collaborate with IT architecture resources to define and maintain application roadmaps.
  • Manage small to large projects, including requirements, schedules, budgets, risks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Allocate approximately 70% of responsibilities to production support and 30% to project work.
  • Support stakeholder engagement consisting of approximately 40% leading intake calls, 10% presenting to leadership, and 50% managing offshore teams.
  • Operate with approximately 90% ownership, with some guidance from a more senior team member.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
  • Minimum of 5 years of Information Technology experience.
  • Advanced proficiency writing and executing SQL.
  • Ability to write complex SQL queries from scratch and optimize existing queries.
  • Working knowledge of data warehousing concepts.
  • Working knowledge of ETL processes.
  • Working knowledge of data security concepts.
  • Demonstrated technical aptitude, independent problem-solving, thought leadership, ownership, and accountability in previous roles.
  • Experience investigating and resolving complex production data or application issues.
  • Ability to lead and coordinate offshore technical resources.
  • Ability to provide oversight for deployments, enhancements, and technical deliverables.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity vulnerabilities and their potential impact on applications and data.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Preferred Skills or Experience

  • 2 or more years of experience supporting data warehouse solutions.
  • Experience with Oracle E-Business Suite or Oracle ERP environments.
  • Experience with Oracle R12 (12.2).
  • Experience with Oracle 19c databases.
  • Experience with PL/SQL and stored procedure analysis.
  • Experience with SQL performance tuning and query optimization.
  • Working knowledge of Linux environments.
  • Experience with Oracle ERP modules supporting Finance, Project Accounting, Procurement, Order-to-Cash, or Procure-to-Pay.
  • Experience supporting data feeds or integrations involving Hyperion, Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, or other reporting and visualization platforms.
  • Understanding of the software development life cycle.
  • Experience working as a member of a project team.
  • Experience evaluating alternate technical solutions.
  • Strong leadership, organizational, written communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Work Details

  • Work location: 201 Isabella Street, Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania 15212, or an assigned plant location.
  • Corporate office schedule: Hybrid, with onsite work Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
  • Plant location schedule: Onsite Monday through Friday.
  • First-shift Eastern Time schedule, with working hours falling between a 7:00 a.m. start and a 6:00 p.m. end.

job.title: IPC Assembler
job.description:
Description: ## Position Overview
The Hand Soldering Technician is responsible for producing reliable, high quality solder connections that comply with industry standards for electronics manufacturing, aerospace, and medical device applications. The role involves precision hand soldering, de soldering, and component level repair on electronic and electromechanical assemblies, ensuring adherence to stringent quality, safety, and documentation requirements.

## Key Responsibilities
- **Soldering Operations:**
- Perform hand soldering, de soldering, and rework on printed circuit boards (PCBs), wire harnesses, and mechanical assemblies using soldering irons, hot air tools, and precision hand tools.
- Apply industry approved solder alloys (e.g., Sn Ag Cu) and fluxes to meet IPC A 610, MIL STD 883, and ISO 13485 specifications.

- **Quality Assurance:**
- Inspect solder joints visually and with magnification tools; perform functional testing as required.
- Document all work per traceability matrix; report non conformances and corrective actions.

- **Equipment Maintenance:**
- Calibrate and maintain soldering equipment, tip cleaning, and temperature control.
- Participate in scheduled deep cleaning and preventive maintenance of workstations.

- **Technical Documentation:**
- Generate and update work instructions, process sheets, and repair logs.
- Ensure compliance with cleanroom or controlled environment protocols when applicable.

- **Collaboration & Continuous Improvement:**
- Work closely with Engineering, Quality, and Manufacturing teams to refine processes and reduce rework.
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and training of new technicians.

## Required Skills & Qualifications
- High school diploma or GED; technical certification (e.g., IPC 610A, IPC J STD 001) preferred.
- 2+ years of hands on soldering experience in electronics, aerospace, or medical device manufacturing.
- Proficiency with soldering irons, solder paste dispensing, hot air rework stations, and de soldering tools.
- Strong understanding of solder joint reliability, thermal management, and contamination control.
- Ability to read schematics, assembly drawings, and BOMs.
- Excellent manual dexterity, visual acuity, and attention to detail.
- Knowledge of ESD safety practices and Cleanroom procedures is a plus.

## Preferred Experience
- Experience with IPC 2221/IPC 2222 design standards.
- Familiarity with aerospace (AS9100) or medical device (ISO 13485) quality management systems.
- Prior involvement in process audits, root cause analysis, and corrective action implementation.

## Physical & Working Conditions
- Standing for prolonged periods; occasional lifting of up to 20 lb.
- Exposure to solder fumes; must wear appropriate PPE and use fume extraction.
- Work may be performed in cleanroom or regulated environments.

job.title: Laptop Scan & Pack
job.description:
Nesco Data Center is seeking a Laptop Scan & Pack Tech in the Greater Bentonville AR area for a short-term Project.

Laptop Asset Scanning & Packaging Technician

Location: Bentonville, AR
Project Duration: Ongoing Project
Schedule: Recurring Project (Approximately Every Other Week)
Typical Volume: 300–500 Laptops Per Project Cycle

Position Summary

We are seeking a reliable, detail-oriented Laptop Asset Scanning & Packaging Technician to support an ongoing IT asset processing project in Bentonville, Arkansas. This role will be responsible for scanning, validating, documenting, and preparing laptop assets for secure shipment.

The ideal candidate will have strong attention to detail, experience working with inventory systems, and the ability to safely handle, organize, and package large volumes of technology equipment. This position requires consistency, accuracy, and the ability to become familiar with the customer's laptop environment, asset tracking portal, and software workflow to properly document project progress.

The preference is for the same technician or team of technicians to support each recurring project cycle to maintain consistency, process familiarity, and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Laptop Asset Scanning & Documentation

  • Perform onsite scanning and inventory validation of laptops and related IT equipment.
  • Capture and verify asset information, including serial numbers, asset tags, model information, and other required inventory details.
  • Utilize customer-provided asset management portals and software platforms to accurately document scanned equipment.
  • Become familiar with customer-specific scanning procedures, workflows, and reporting requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records of completed assets and provide progress updates throughout each project cycle.
  • Identify discrepancies, missing information, damaged equipment, or inventory exceptions and escalate appropriately.
  • Maintain a high level of accuracy while processing 300–500 laptops per project cycle.

Laptop Preparation & Packaging

  • Prepare scanned laptops for shipment according to established customer guidelines and procedures.
  • Properly organize and stage laptops for transportation.
  • Package laptops securely using approved packing methods and materials.
  • Load laptops into Gaylord containers using proper protective padding and spacing techniques to prevent damage during transportation.
  • Ensure equipment is properly positioned, protected, and secured within large shipping containers.
  • Apply shrink wrap, pallet wrap, and other packaging materials as required.
  • Assist with pallet preparation and shipment readiness.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area throughout the project.

Logistics & Shipping Support

  • Support preparation of equipment for scheduled outbound transportation.
  • Follow documented packing, labeling, and handling procedures.
  • Coordinate with onsite project contacts regarding completed inventory and shipment readiness.
  • Assist with loading preparation when required.
  • Ensure all assets remain properly accounted for throughout the scanning and shipping process.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in IT asset management, inventory control, warehouse operations, logistics, or technology deployments preferred.
  • Experience using barcode scanners, inventory systems, or asset tracking software.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to process large quantities of equipment accurately.
  • Basic computer skills with the ability to learn new software platforms and customer portals.
  • Ability to follow detailed procedures and maintain consistent documentation.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage repetitive processes efficiently.
  • Reliable attendance and willingness to support recurring project schedules.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work independently or as part of a team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience handling laptops, desktops, or other IT hardware.
  • Experience with IT asset disposition (ITAD), hardware refreshes, or technology rollouts.
  • Familiarity with inventory reconciliation and asset tracking processes.
  • Previous packing, palletizing, or warehouse shipping experience.
  • Experience using shrink wrap, pallet wrap, and other shipping preparation materials.
  • Experience safely handling electronic equipment for transportation.

Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM
Work Arrangement: Remote

Position Overview

The Non-Clinical OccMed Care Coordinator serves as a key liaison in the coordination of patient cases within the workers' compensation process. This role ensures accurate review of medical documentation, alignment of treatments with authorized care plans, and effective communication with providers, employers, and internal stakeholders to support high-quality, compliant care delivery.

Case Coordination & Documentation Review

  • Identify discrepancies, missing information, or additional treatments within records

  • Communicate with providers to clarify documentation and verify treatment accuracy

  • Maintain and verify Occupational Medicine data within the EMR system

Workers' Compensation Support

  • Manage and document workers' compensation claims and referrals in the EMR system

  • Provide required work status reports to employers and insurance carriers in compliance with state regulations

  • Communicate with employers, adjusters, and nurse case managers regarding:

    • Work restrictions

    • Missing documentation

    • Denials and claim updates

Customer Service & Stakeholder Communication

  • Provide timely responses to employer and patient inquiries, including medical record requests

  • Support appointment reminders and communicate missed appointment details as needed

Billing & Process Support

  • Audit charges to ensure accurate billing and clean claim submission

  • Collaborate with internal teams to support drug screen reporting and employer account setup

Program & Operational Support

  • Maintain daily communication with OccMed team members and leadership

  • Participate in staff meetings, audits, and process improvement initiatives

Compliance & Standards

  • Follow OSHA and workplace safety protocols

  • Maintain strict confidentiality of patient and business information

  • Adhere to company Code of Conduct, mission, and values

Education

  • High School Diploma required

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred

Experience

  • Occupational Medicine or related business experience required

  • Experience with Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems preferred

  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)

Additional Qualifications

  • Professional, personable demeanor

  • Ability to collaborate across multiple stakeholders and departments

  • Commitment to delivering high-quality, service-oriented support

5 or more years of experience

Sets up and operates CNC lathes/mills on all product parts with proven and unproven programs. Produces machined fittings per blueprint specifications and work instructions. job.title: Jr. Systems Test Analyst
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking a motivated junior Systems Test Analyst to join an Advanced Engineering team. This role will support platform requirements analysis, test workflow evaluation, test automation using Python and Robot Framework, and Power BI dashboard development for automotive software platform testing.

Core Responsibilities

  • Analyze automotive software platform requirements, workflows, and system capabilities to identify automation and process improvement opportunities.
  • Review current test procedures and scheduling limitations, and recommend solutions using Robot Framework and Python.
  • Work with software engineers and system architects to understand user requirements and translate them into structured automated test cases.
  • Evaluate and document defects, system anomalies, and workflow gaps found during testing.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders to support timely defect and issue resolution.
  • Assess test coverage, system reliability, and execution efficiency, and propose improvements based on findings.
  • Participate in design reviews for test automation solutions.
  • Contribute to standardized test automation best practices across the platform team.
  • Analyze and interpret test execution data from automotive software platform runs.
  • Design and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards for test results, pass/fail metrics, and platform quality KPIs.
  • Present data-driven findings and system analysis recommendations to engineering teams and management.
  • Evaluate patterns and anomalies in platform data to identify system quality risks and recommend corrective actions.
  • Define data models and metrics frameworks to support ongoing platform systems analysis and continuous quality improvement.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • Master's degree in Information Technology Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Basic working knowledge of Python programming.
  • Familiarity with data manipulation using pandas or similar libraries.
  • Exposure to Power BI or comparable data visualization tools such as Tableau or Grafana.
  • Awareness of test automation concepts.
  • Foundational understanding of software workflows and testing principles, including unit, integration, and regression testing.
  • Ability to analyze platform data, test results, defects, anomalies, and workflow gaps.
  • Ability to summarize findings for mixed technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Skills or Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Robot Framework or pytest.
  • Exposure to automotive software, embedded Linux, or connected vehicle systems.
  • Basic familiarity with Git.
  • Awareness of CI/CD concepts.
  • Coursework or project experience in statistical modeling, data analysis pipelines, or anomaly detection.
  • Awareness of automotive or safety standards such as ISO 26262 or ASPICE.
  • Experience in an Agile/Scrum team setting, including internships or academic group projects.

Work Details

  • Onsite role.
