job.title: Quality Assurance Technician - (Food Manufacturing)
job.description:
6 am to 02:30 pm Monday through Friday. Occasionally 6 am to 06:30 pm. However, can also be required to work weekends.

PURPOSE STATEMENT:
Performs the activities related to microbiological, analytical, performance and sensory evaluation using established methods and procedures. Understands, trains in and enforces BRC Global Standards for Food Safety including but not limited to formula control, data integrity, HACCP, GMPs, process monitoring, communication and document control, customer specifications, regulatory, RPC Quality and reliability standards

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Monitors and audits product and processes from receiving through shipping to ensure all food safety and quality requirements are met.
  • Supports and adheres to all company safety rules and programs to provide safe working conditions for all associates.
  • Conducts microbiological, analytical, performance and organoleptic testing on ingredients, packaging, work in process and finished products to ensure all materials meet standard quality requirements.
  • Assists in maintaining database of required lab data.
  • May be required to observe processes and work closely with plant personnel and Corporate R&D to develop and maintain detailed and accurate plant floor work instructions for formulas and product specifications.
  • May help train batch operators, filling operators and other plant personnel on formula and specification requirements, GMPs, processing, laboratory and evaluation procedures.
  • Verifies that process controls, weight control, HACCP and finished product specifications are adhered to by regularly auditing procedures and paperwork.
  • May assist plant and R&D personnel to test and commercialize new products or changes to existing products, collect and send process data and product samples to authorized RPC associates and external customers.
  • Initiates, documents and tracks changes to products and processes, including those related to supplier changes for ingredients & packaging material and engineering changes to equipment and/or processes.
  • Demonstrate high moral character and ethics.
  • Adheres to company codes of conduct.
  • Works closely with plant Production Teams to monitor product runs, investigate and solve product quality issues, ensure compliance to GMP practices, sanitation programs, BRC Standards, product safety and all RPC, Kosher/Halal and regulatory requirements.
  • Initiates holds of ingredients or finished products that do not meet RPC product safety or quality requirements.
  • Ensures that the Hold and Release program is properly followed.
  • Recommends improvements in manufacturing methods, sanitation practices, laboratory practices, testing methods and equipment to the management team.
  • Keeps informed of latest manufacturing technologies, systems, and quality control practices.
  • Maintains a comprehensive understanding of all products manufactured by the plant as well as the raw materials, packaging materials, and operations required in the manufacturing process including quality specifications and standards.
  • Participates in QA 6S meetings and PIT (Process Improvement Teams) to discuss quality and sanitation issues and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Helps set goals and establish timetables to meet project guidelines and business objectives.
  • Performs other related responsibilities, as needed, to support *** Corporation's business objectives.
  • Notifies management of all deviations.


Skills/Experience:
Degree in Biology, Food Science, Food Technology or related field preferred.
3+ years experience in a food-processing, pharmaceutical or chemical manufacturing industry.
Experience in Dairy or Non-Dairy manufacturing is HIGHLY desired.
Demonstrated knowledge and application of quality assurance techniques and tools and quality management principles in a food, chemical or pharmaceutical manufacturing environment
Demonstrated knowledge of efficient and safe manufacturing operations to include GMPs, HACCP, product and associate safety, product quality, and cost control (minimizing downtime and waste, optimizing yield)
Demonstrated ability to train associates as well as plan, monitor and schedule tasks and projects
Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems
Demonstrated ability to formulate and understand basic statistical analysis.
Proficient using Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook. Proficient or ability to become proficient in Microsoft Access, MiniTab, QAD, SAP, OPTIVA.

Food Safety Responsibilities

  • Follow all GMPs, food safety, and quality policies.
  • Ensures all GMP and all Food hygiene and Food safety standards are in compliance.
  • Report all food safety incidents such as GMP violations, ingredient and product contamination, metal detector, screen, or magnet deficiencies, glass breakage, and pest harborage.
  • Review food defense and quality records for precision, accuracy, and conformance to document control procedures, providing written verification as required.
  • Ensure employee compliance in the areas of food defense, food regulations, and product / process quality; provide adequate coaching as needed.
  • Provide immediate and long-term corrective action in the event of non-compliance to food defense and quality policies.
  • Record accurate and legible results on documentation
  • Provide adequate housekeeping at all times.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Will be required to perform tasks such as lifting up to 25 Kilograms (55.12 pounds), walking, standing, climbing, reaching, stooping, pulling, pushing, grasping, and balancing as part of production activities out on the floor. Will be required to see and hear well enough to understand associates questions and respond to their concerns, answer phones and greet customers, vendors, Corporate Associates, etc. Will be required to work in both warm and cold environments, near noisy machinery, and near confined spaces as part of daily production activities.

job.title: Corporate Paralegal - $100K - $125K
job.description:
Corporate Paralegal

Locations: Garden City, NY | Albany, NY | Stamford, CT
Salary: $100,000 - $125,000 Base Salary

Corporate Paralegal Opportunity

Nesco Resource is partnering with a highly respected and growing law firm to identify an experienced Corporate Paralegal to join its Corporate Practice Group. This is an outstanding opportunity for a seasoned legal professional who enjoys supporting sophisticated business transactions in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

The firm offers flexibility to work from Garden City, NY, Albany, NY, or Stamford, CT, while providing the opportunity to work alongside experienced attorneys on complex commercial matters.

Responsibilities

As a Corporate Paralegal, you will play an integral role in supporting attorneys throughout the lifecycle of corporate transactions. Responsibilities include:

  • Prepare and file business formation, qualification, dissolution, and related corporate filings in multiple jurisdictions.
  • Prepare franchise tax filings and assist with corporate compliance matters.
  • Register nonprofit organizations and prepare federal and state tax exemption applications.
  • Conduct legal research, lien searches, and due diligence investigations.
  • Draft routine legal correspondence, including audit response letters.
  • Assist with secured lending transactions, including UCC filings, collateral reviews, certificates, and consents.
  • Coordinate pre-closing, closing, and post-closing activities, including preparing closing checklists, organizing signature pages, assembling closing binders, and maintaining transaction files.
  • Obtain certified corporate documents and certificates of good standing.
  • Work closely with attorneys and clients to resolve issues and ensure transactions progress smoothly.
  • Provide exceptional client service while managing multiple priorities and meeting critical deadlines.

Qualifications

  • Paralegal Certificate or Associate's/Bachelor's Degree in Paralegal Studies.
  • Minimum of 5 years of Corporate Paralegal experience, preferably within a law firm.
  • Experience supporting corporate transactions, financing matters, and business entity formations.
  • Strong knowledge of UCC filings, due diligence, and corporate governance documents.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Experience with legal software such as Carpe Diem, Hummingbird, or similar document management and timekeeping systems is a plus.
  • Ability to work occasional overtime to support transaction closings.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Join a well-established, highly regarded law firm with an outstanding reputation.
  • Work on sophisticated corporate and commercial transactions alongside experienced attorneys.
  • Choose from one of three office locations: Garden City, NY, Albany, NY, or Stamford, CT.
  • Competitive base salary of $105,000-$125,000, commensurate with experience.
  • Excellent benefits package and long-term career growth opportunities.

If you're an experienced Corporate Paralegal looking to take the next step in your career with a premier law firm, we'd love to speak with you. Apply today to learn more about this exciting opportunity through Nesco Resource.

job.title: DRG Validator
job.description:
DRG Validation Specialist

Position Summary

The DRG Validation Specialist requires extensive experience in inpatient DRG coding and a thorough understanding of the MS-DRG and APR-DRG reimbursement systems. This role is responsible for auditing inpatient medical records to ensure the accuracy of coding, clinical documentation, and DRG assignment while maintaining compliance with applicable coding guidelines and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform concurrent and retrospective clinical, MS-DRG, and APR-DRG validation reviews in accordance with UHDDS, Medicare guidelines, and applicable federal and state regulations.
  • Review and validate ICD-10-CM diagnosis and ICD-10-PCS procedure code assignments.
  • Utilize EMRs, encoders, abstracting systems (e.g., 3M, Epic) and auditing tools (e.g., TruCode, 3M Standalone) to perform accurate audit determinations.
  • Prepare clear, concise, and well-supported audit rationales.
  • Draft physician queries to obtain documentation clarification when appropriate.
  • Provide coding education and feedback based on audit findings.
  • Review coding and DRG denial letters and prepare well-supported appeal responses to third-party auditors and insurance carriers.
  • Develop written recommendations to optimize coding accuracy and DRG/SOI assignment.
  • Stay current on regulatory updates, Official Coding Guidelines, AHA Coding Clinic guidance, and reimbursement changes.
  • Meet or exceed established productivity, quality, and accuracy standards, maintaining a quality accuracy rate of 95–100%.
  • Communicate effectively with physicians, CDI specialists, coders, and other clinical staff regarding documentation and coding guidelines.

Qualifications

  • AHIMA certification required (CCS, RHIT, or RHIA).
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in inpatient DRG validation, clinical validation, quality assurance, recovery auditing, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience with ICD-10-CM/PCS, MS-DRG, and APR-DRG coding.
  • Extensive knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy and physiology, ICD-10-CM/PCS coding guidelines, CPT coding, modifiers, and payer reimbursement methodologies.
  • Expert understanding of Official Coding Guidelines, Coding Clinic guidance, CMS regulations, and other applicable compliance standards.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and industry-standard coding platforms including 3M and TruCode.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent analytical, research, and critical thinking abilities.
  • Ability to educate physicians, coders, and healthcare professionals on coding and documentation best practices.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to manage priorities and consistently meet deadlines.

Position Details

  • Full-time
  • Remote
  • Standard 8-hour workday

job.title: Production Planner - (Aerospace)
job.description:
Planner
Shift hours: 5AM, 6AM,7AM or 8AM start

Must be a U.S. Citizen. Due to the nature of the work and access requirements associated with U.S. Government contracts, only U.S. Citizens are eligible for this position

SUMMARY:
Ensures performance to the master production schedule to achieve division objectives for customer service, inventory levels, and configuration management.
Plans, prepares, issues, and controls basic production schedules and material requirements to ensure a controlled flow of approved materials timed to meet production requirements.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
Identifies common raw material and component requirements for production from engineering and production specifications.
Ensures accurate item master schedules and bill of materials.
Advises management of the status of work in progress, material availability, and potential production problems to ensure that personnel, equipment, materials, and services are provided as needed.
Confirms materials supply is available to meet demand. Prepares work orders or purchase requests for the production or purchase of components or parts to support master production schedule, shop load, and inventory requirements.
Coordinates material movements between internal work and storage areas and/or outside processing or suppliers to ensure materials are available when needed.
Schedules and expedites the movement of parts by means of move orders and/or stock transfers to meet customer shipping dates.
Projects hardware availability for assembly build schedule update and development of monthly sales plan objectives.
Analyzes inventory usage, scrap, and waste, and identifies and quantifies potential problems and causes that would impact the ability to achieve inventory level objectives.
Advises and assists management in resolving problems concerning over shipments, shortages, engineering changes, and cancellation of orders. Monitors component shortage status.
May prepare detailed layouts of component shortage requirements on assigned programs over three-month horizon.
Maintains configuration control on all open orders and appropriate data files as required by division policies and procedures.
Coordinates cross-functional activities with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Purchasing, Engineering, Inventory Control, Shipping/Receiving, and Contract Administration to ensure a smooth flow of materials through the production process and consistent information regarding status and priorities.
Recommends changes to improve product or process efficiency and/or reduce cost using continuous improvement principles.
Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing technical and/or trade publications, establishing networks, and/or participating in professional associations.
Complies with federal, state, and aerospace industry regulations; ensures adherence to requirements and advises management on needed actions. Complies with policies and procedures in Government/Commercial Practices Manual (GPM/CPM).
Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed. Work assignments may include cross-functional or project team responsibilities (e.g., continuous improvement).

QUALIFICATIONS:
Professional entry level position at least 1 year of experience
Bachelor's degree in business administration or a related field;
CPIM Ceritification a plus
Knowledge of general manufacturing and business operations and key manufacturing resources planning theories and principles including continuous improvement methods (e.g., pull systems, process mapping, JIT).
General knowledge of legal and regulatory requirements related to production control.
General knowledge of manufacturing resource planning systems and standard business application software.
Ability to research and analyze data and develop recommendations or resolve problems by drawing on internal information and referring to prior decisions.
Ability to work with only general work direction and instructions regarding the scope of assignments and determine priority and order of assignments.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret financial reports and policies.
Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community.

job.title: Welder Fabricator
job.description:
Welder Fabricator
Location: Perrysburg, OH
Position Type: Full time
Pay: $18 – $20 per hour (based on experience)
Shift: A shift 5am – 3:30pm B shift 8am – 5:30pm

Job Summary

Our client is seeking a skilled Welder Fabricator to support fabrication and production operations. This role involves MIG welding, reading detailed blueprints, and ensuring high-quality welds that meet specifications. Candidates must be comfortable working in a physically demanding manufacturing environment and demonstrate strong attention to detail and measurement accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform MIG welding using flux-core wire (1/16th) on steel and metal components.
  • Fabricate and assemble parts by cutting, bending, tacking, and welding materials to specification.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, including weld symbols, to complete weld tests and production work accurately.
  • Measure materials using standard tools (tape measures, squares, levels) to ensure precision.
  • Prepare materials for welding by cleaning and positioning components.
  • Inspect finished welds to ensure quality standards and tolerances are met.
  • Maintain welding equipment and perform basic troubleshooting as needed.

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of hands-on MIG welding experience, preferably in a production or structural environment.
  • Ability to read and understand blueprints and weld symbols.
  • Strong knowledge of measurements and use of measuring tools.
  • Experience working with fabrication equipment and tools.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and stand for extended periods.
Comfortable working in an industrial/manufacturing setting.

Equipment & Safety Requirements

Candidates must provide their own weld helmet and steel-toed boots.
PPE: Safety glasses, ear protection, weld gloves/sleeves are provided (optional weld jackets must be self-supplied).

job.title: Senior Project Manager(Fully Remote)
job.description:
Position Summary

The Senior Project Manager I is responsible for overseeing all aspects of multiple medium to large projects with moderate to high complexity. This role takes projects from original concept through completion, serving as the single point of accountability and ensuring alignment with established project controls and standards.

The Senior Project Manager I demonstrates a strong commitment to stakeholder relationships by proactively communicating, identifying risks and issues, and facilitating timely, effective resolutions. Moderate travel may be required depending on project needs.

Reports To: Senior Project Manager II or above
Supervises: None

Key Responsibilities

  • Organize project activities into manageable work efforts and determine effective approaches to completing project objectives as outlined in the project plan.

  • Develop and facilitate strategic documents such as Project Charters, Education and Communication Plans, and detailed project plans.

  • Present project updates and progress reports to business owners and stakeholders.

  • Clearly define and manage project scope while motivating team members.

  • Manage relationships with multiple business owners and team members to accomplish project objectives.

  • Proactively identify and manage risks, issues, and cross-project dependencies.

  • Monitor and report project activities and status within established timelines.

  • Coach team members to clarify task assignments, milestones, and deliverables.

  • Ensure completion of high-quality, professional deliverables as required by each project plan.

  • Facilitate the creation of toolkits to support field-based implementations.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Organization

  • Maintains focus and proactively prioritizes initiatives

  • Effectively manages tasks and resources

  • Demonstrates strong scheduling and multi-tasking abilities

Project Management

  • Applies structured project controls to define scope, goals, timelines, and performance metrics

  • Ensures projects remain on schedule and meet quality standards

  • Communicates project scope and progress clearly and effectively

Gaining Commitment

  • Uses effective interpersonal techniques to gain buy-in

  • Adapts communication style to suit tasks, situations, and stakeholders

Tactical Execution

  • Effectively leverages project controls to manage initiatives

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency or willingness to learn:

    • Microsoft Office (OneNote, OneDrive, Excel, Word, Access, Visio, Outlook, PowerPoint including Office Timeline add-on)

    • Online collaboration tools (WebEx, conference calling platforms, online facilitation tools)

    • Project management and scheduling tools (Microsoft Project, MS Planner, Agile tools, or equivalent systems)

Core Competencies

Integrity

  • Acts honestly and follows through on commitments

  • Maintains consistency between actions and words

Compassion

  • Demonstrates empathy and professionalism, even in challenging situations

  • Actively listens and anticipates the needs of others

Accountability

  • Takes ownership of outcomes and impact

  • Builds strategic relationships across the organization

  • Supports cross-departmental collaboration

  • Demonstrates awareness of organizational dynamics

Respect

  • Treats all individuals with dignity

  • Embraces diversity

  • Listens attentively and seeks to understand different perspectives

Excellence

  • Takes initiative to improve service, quality, and performance

  • Pursues ongoing personal and professional development

  • Collaborates effectively to exceed expectations

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience preferred

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of project management experience

job.title: Mechanical Inspector
job.description:
Excellent opportunity to jump on board with one of Long Island's finest manufacturers as a Mechanical Inspector in their Quality Assurance dept. Great work culture and generous benefits package! A place where you can develop a long-term career and be rewarded for your hard work and dedication. This position is located in Melville, NY.

Position Description:

Responsible for the systematic inspection, evaluation, and analysis of production and customer-returned product to identify failure modes and determine root causes. Supports continuous improvement initiatives by generating accurate, data-driven findings that inform multifunctional team consisting of engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

  • Perform visual, dimensional, and functional inspections on production and customer returned units to assess the nature and extent of defects or failures.
  • Identify recurring issues and escalate complex failures to Product Quality Manager.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Production, and Procurement teams to communicate findings and support the development of corrective and preventive actions.
  • Operate and maintain measuring and test equipment (calipers, micrometers, CMM, GD&T, gauges, torque tools, etc.)
  • Review and inspect Device History Records to ensure document accuracy, verify that product quality meets standards and proposes release of the product for distribution.
  • Assist Technical Returns Evaluation Manager with development or revision of repair procedures and work instructions.
  • Participate in Lean or continuous improvement initiatives to reduce turnaround time and defects.
  • Performs Internal Quality Systems Audits.
  • Ensures compliance with Department procedures.
  • Analyzes and interacts with areas related to KPIs such as: First-Pass-Yield, defect/complaint trends, audit findings, CAPA effectiveness evaluations, etc.

Work Experience Requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a quality, manufacturing, or product inspection role.
  • Well versed with CMM and GD&T
  • Prior experience with RMA processes and root cause analysis methodologies strongly preferred.

Core Skills Requirements:

  • Proficiency with precision measurement tools (calipers, micrometers, gauges, CMM).
  • Working knowledge of ERP systems for logging and tracking (experience with Epicor or similar a plus).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail.
  • Advanced Excel skills, able to analyze data and build complex reports and graphics.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, and product specifications.
  • Familiarity with quality standards such as ISO 9001, 13485, or equivalent.

job.title: UX Designer II
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking a UX Researcher to lead mixed-method research across a complex hardware and software ecosystem, including consumer IoT applications, heavy-equipment controls, and technical B2B portals. This role will own the full research lifecycle and translate qualitative and quantitative findings into actionable product insights.

Core Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end qualitative and quantitative UX research initiatives.
  • Design research plans, methodologies, study materials, and participant recruitment strategies.
  • Conduct contextual inquiries, user interviews, usability testing, and other mixed-method studies.
  • Research diverse B2B and B2C user groups across digital interfaces and physical environments.
  • Analyze and synthesize research data into clear findings, recommendations, and actionable insights.
  • Communicate findings through data-driven storytelling to Product, Engineering, and UX Design teams.

job.description:
Location: Mentor, OH

Job Overview:
Join the Client Gas Turbine Fuel Systems Division as a Mechanical Engineer and be part of a dynamic team dedicated to advancing aerospace technology. In this role, you will have the opportunity to support mechanical systems, testing initiatives, and hydraulic applications in our R&D Test Lab. Collaborate closely with experienced engineers to enhance lab capabilities, conduct critical development and certification testing, and contribute to innovative aerospace projects. Our team fosters a strong learning culture, where knowledge sharing and professional development are highly encouraged. This role suits someone who can work independently while taking direction from senior engineers and contributing in a high-performance team environment.

Key Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with the R&D Lab team by taking direction from senior engineers on active projects.
• Design pressure, flow, and spray test stands and upgrades, focusing on improved automation using control valves and pressure & flow sensors.
• Develop and improve test stand control hardware and safety circuitry to enhance operational efficiency.
• Assist calibration efforts for lab and production test stands to ensure accuracy and reliability.
• Participate actively in a High-Performance Team environment, contributing to various functions as needed.
• Present project plans, data, and results to the team, generating detailed reports to facilitate informed decision-making.
• Support fellow engineers with projects and tasks, fostering a collaborative work environment.
• Maintain a safe working environment, adhering to a zero-incident culture.

Required Qualifications:
• Education: Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or a closely related field.
• Hands-On Skills: Experience in mechanical systems design, fabrication, and troubleshooting.
• Communication: Excellent skills for presenting to both technical and non-technical audiences, along with precise scientific documentation abilities.
• Interpersonal Skills: Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment, fostering collaboration and innovation.
• Travel: Willingness to travel occasionally to Parker facilities, local universities, and suppliers.
• Citizenship: Must be a U.S. Person.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Master's/Ph.D. in mechanical engineering or a closely related field.
• Experience with mechatronics/automation; test instrumentation and data acquisition, solder/fabrication equipment.
• Programming/analysis tools such as MATLAB, Python, LabVIEW, and/or ANSYS.
Leveling Guide:
• Mechanical Engineer I: Meets required qualifications; supports tasks and projects with guidance; builds proficiency in test stand design, testing, and documentation.
• Mechanical Engineer II: Demonstrates increased autonomy; leads small-to-medium lab projects or workstreams; delivers complete test solutions (design through validation/documentation); typically 2+ years of relevant experience.

job.title: Automated Systems Technician
job.description:
Automated Systems Technician

Position Summary

We are seeking a skilled and safety-focused Automated Systems Technician to join our manufacturing team. In this role, you will contribute to the production of high-quality aluminum and metal architectural façade panels by operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting automated production equipment. You will be responsible for safely using aluminum and metal forming machinery to cut, bend, and weld panels while ensuring production efficiency, quality, and compliance with company safety standards.

This position requires a strong mechanical and technical aptitude, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Install, calibrate, maintain, and repair automated systems and industrial equipment.

  • Diagnose and troubleshoot issues involving PLCs, HMIs, sensors, drives, and other automation components.

  • Read and interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, equipment manuals, and engineering documentation.

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance to maximize equipment reliability and minimize production downtime.

  • Assist with equipment upgrades, retrofits, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Collaborate with Engineering, Maintenance, and IT teams to support automation integration and system optimization.

  • Ensure all work is completed in accordance with company safety policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, equipment history, and parts inventory documentation.

  • Safely load, operate, and monitor automated machinery and production equipment.

  • Perform production line startup and shutdown procedures.

  • Operate press brakes to form aluminum and sheet metal components.

  • Use a TIG welder to secure bent sheet metal corners and complete façade panel assemblies.

  • Start machine programs and monitor equipment to ensure proper operation and product quality.

  • Clean equipment and perform routine operator maintenance.

  • Follow all company policies, including the Group Code of Conduct, Group Compliance Manual, and Compliance requirements outlined in KNA-SOP-1705 Compliance Roles and Responsibilities.

  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Supervisor.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Associate degree or technical certification in Electrical Engineering Technology, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience working with industrial automation systems (preferred).

  • Strong applied mathematics and problem-solving skills.

  • Basic understanding of drafting principles and technical drawings.

  • Proficient with computers and manufacturing software.

  • Experience starting machine programs, safely loading equipment, and performing production line startup and shutdown procedures.

  • Ability to interpret technical documentation and troubleshoot automated equipment.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

  • Experience using diagnostic tools and automation software.

  • Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a manufacturing or production line environment.

  • TIG welding experience.

  • Forklift certification.

  • Familiarity with Salvagnini machinery or similar automated metal fabrication equipment.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull up to 20 pounds.

  • Frequently exert up to 10 pounds of force.

  • Constantly perform light physical activities associated with operating machinery and handling materials.

  • Ability to sit for extended periods while also walking and standing as needed throughout the shift.

  • Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to noise, dust, odors, varying temperatures, and humidity.

  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

job.title: Facilities Technician
job.description:
Facilities Technician – Parker Aerospace

Role Overview

Parker Aerospace is looking for a Facilities Technician to maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and improve manufacturing equipment and plant systems. This is a highly hands-on maintenance role supporting production equipment such as mills, lathes, compressors, hydraulic systems, electrical/electronic controls, sensors, and motion-control equipment.

The technician will be responsible for both preventive/predictive maintenance and emergency troubleshooting, with a strong emphasis on equipment reliability, safety, and minimizing production downtime.

Compensation & Schedule

  • Salary: $54,000–$66,500 based on experience
  • Bonus: 5% annual bonus
  • Hourly position with overtime available
  • Typical schedules:
    • 7:00 AM–3:00 PM
    • 8:00 AM–4:00 PM
  • Must be flexible for occasional nights, weekends, variable schedules, and additional hours

What They Will Actually Be Doing

Manufacturing Equipment Maintenance

  • Troubleshoot and repair production machinery including:
    • Mills
    • Lathes
    • Heavy manufacturing equipment
    • Hydraulic presses/systems
    • Compressors
    • Air dryers
    • Pneumatic systems
    • Electrical/electronic equipment
    • Sensors and control components
  • Perform mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and electronic repairs.

Electrical Troubleshooting

  • Read and interpret advanced electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and symbols.
  • Troubleshoot industrial electrical systems using:
    • Multimeters
    • Oscilloscopes
    • Ammeters
    • Other diagnostic equipment
  • Diagnose issues involving fuses, switches, sensors, voltage drops, control panels, and motion-control components.

Hydraulic Maintenance

  • Install, assemble, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair hydraulic systems.
  • Diagnose and repair:
    • Hydraulic pumps
    • Motors
    • Valves
    • Cylinders
    • Hydraulic lines
    • Proportional valves
  • Understand hydraulic contamination control, flushing, and proper system restart procedures.

Preventive / Predictive Maintenance

  • Follow established PM procedures and maintain accurate maintenance records.
  • Determine appropriate PM, PdM, or run-to-failure strategies based on equipment criticality and failure history.
  • Help establish PM requirements for new machinery.
  • Investigate recurring equipment failures and identify root causes.

Facilities / Plant Support

  • Maintain plant utilities and infrastructure, including:
    • Air compressors
    • Air dryers
    • Gas systems
    • Water systems
    • Vacuum systems
    • HVAC
    • Plumbing
    • Alarm systems
    • Building and grounds equipment

Continuous Improvement / Safety

  • Participate in 5S and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce downtime, improve equipment reliability, and eliminate safety hazards.
  • Follow OSHA and plant safety requirements.
  • Immediately report unsafe conditions, injuries, and near misses.
  • Maintain a clean and organized maintenance area.

Operator Training

  • Help establish basic autonomous maintenance procedures.
  • Train machine operators on routine maintenance such as:
    • Fluid checks
    • Cleaning
    • Basic inspections
    • Identifying abnormal machine conditions

Ideal Candidate

MUST-HAVES

Look for someone with:

  • 5+ years of industrial/manufacturing maintenance
  • Strong mechanical troubleshooting
  • Strong hydraulic troubleshooting/repair
  • Strong pneumatic experience
  • Strong industrial electrical troubleshooting
  • Ability to read advanced electrical schematics
  • Experience troubleshooting manufacturing machinery
  • Experience with mills, lathes, presses, CNC or similar production equipment
  • Experience with motors, pumps, valves, sensors, switches, controls
  • Preventive maintenance experience
  • Experience using a multimeter
  • Ability to troubleshoot electrical problems systematically
  • OSHA/safety knowledge
  • Technical school, vocational degree, or equivalent experience

NICE-TO-HAVES

  • Oscilloscope experience
  • Ammeter experience
  • PLC/control troubleshooting
  • Electronic motion controls
  • Proportional hydraulic valves
  • CNC maintenance
  • Compressor/air dryer experience
  • HVAC
  • Welding
  • Forklift certification
  • Scissor lift/JLG/Jenny boom experience
  • Aerospace/manufacturing experience
  • 5S / Lean / continuous improvement

job.title: Electromechanical Engineer II
job.description:
Onsite role

POSITION SUMMARY
This position supports the design, development and testing of induction and permanent magnet motors used in fans, pumps and compressors requiring innovative engineering solutions that enhance new product performance and reliability. The successful candidate will apply strong electromechanical engineering fundamentals, analytical expertise, and a collaborative mindset to support our customers' needs.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
Supports the department's Subject Mater Expert (SME) in the sizing, design, mechanical drawings and testing of electric motors operating at speeds up to 70,000 rpm used in our fans, pumps and compressors.
Performs electromagnetic, thermal, and mechanical analysis using simulation tools (FEA/CFD).
Creates detailed CAD models, drawings, and manufacturing documentation.
Develops motor performance specifications and validation test plans. Conducts performance testing (efficiency, torque, speed, thermal, vibration, noise).
Analyzes and optimize motor efficiency.
Works closely with manufacturing to ensure design for manufacturability
Solves problems related to the assembly, repair and testing of development and production hardware.
Works with colleagues in the department and in other departments.
Writes reports as required.
Presents designs to peers, other engineers and customers.

QUALIFICATIONS
Education: Bachelor's degree (BS) in Mechanical, Electrical, or a related technical discipline from accredited college or university required.
3 to 5 years of experience in electric motor design and development.
Strong knowledge of electromagnetic theory and motor design principles.
Experience with motor simulation tools.
Hands-on experience with motor teardown.
Proficiency in CAD software (SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor)
Understanding of winding techniques, lamination stacks, magnets, and insulation systems.
Familiarity with motor manufacturing processes and materials.
Ability to interpret and create detailed engineering drawings applying ASME Y14.5M.
Works under constant supervision. Performs assignments of mild complexity and assists other Engineers.
Must have knowledge of drawing and drafting standards.
Experience in the development of military or aerospace equipment is a strong plus.
Understanding of military specifications, environmental specifications, and test specifications a plus.
Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
Hands-on test and hardware experience is required. General machine shop experience is a plus.
Must be a US Citizen.

job.title: Maintenance Manager
job.description:
Maintenance Manager

Location: Chandler, AZ

Overview

A well-established advanced manufacturing company is seeking a Maintenance Manager to lead maintenance operations at its Chandler facility. This individual will be responsible for equipment reliability, facility maintenance, capital projects, preventive maintenance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who can effectively manage a maintenance team while driving operational efficiency, safety, and equipment uptime.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of maintenance technicians in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Establish and execute preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and control system issues.
  • Manage facility infrastructure and utility systems, including HVAC, compressed air, water treatment, and related equipment.
  • Drive root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to reduce downtime and improve performance.
  • Lead capital equipment installations, upgrades, and facility improvement projects.
  • Utilize a computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track maintenance activities, equipment history, and asset performance.
  • Develop and manage maintenance budgets while identifying cost-saving opportunities.
  • Partner with Production, Engineering, Quality, and Environmental Health & Safety teams to support operational goals.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum 5 years of maintenance leadership experience within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong experience leading maintenance teams and managing plant-wide maintenance programs.
  • PLC troubleshooting and controls experience required.
  • Proven experience managing capital projects and equipment improvement initiatives.
  • Hands-on knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and automated manufacturing equipment.
  • Experience utilizing CMMS software and maintenance planning systems.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems for maintenance purchasing and documentation.
  • Strong understanding of preventive maintenance, equipment reliability, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Knowledge of OSHA and environmental compliance requirements.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Experience

job.title: Maintenance Technician (Mechanic) - US
job.description:
Position Summary

The Industrial Maintenance Technician is responsible for ensuring the reliability, safety, and continuous operation of production equipment and facility systems. This role supports manufacturing uptime by performing preventive maintenance, troubleshooting equipment failures, and executing timely mechanical and electrical repairs. The technician works in a fast-paced production environment where minimizing downtime and maintaining equipment integrity are critical to operational success.

Key Responsibilities

Equipment Maintenance & Repair

  • Perform mechanical and electrical repairs on production machinery and facility systems
  • Troubleshoot and repair motors, pumps, conveyors, compressors, sensors, and control systems
  • Diagnose equipment failures and restore equipment to full operational condition
  • Inspect, operate, and test machinery to validate repairs and ensure proper function

PLC & Electrical Troubleshooting

  • Troubleshoot PLC-controlled equipment and automated production systems
  • Work with electrical distribution systems, control circuits, and instrumentation
  • Identify root causes of electrical and mechanical failures and implement sustainable solutions

Preventive Maintenance (PM) & Reliability

  • Execute preventive and predictive maintenance tasks according to schedule
  • Support continuous improvement of PM programs to reduce unscheduled downtime
  • Participate in reliability initiatives to improve equipment lifespan and performance

Work Orders & Documentation

  • Complete assigned work orders within required timeframes
  • Maintain accurate maintenance logs, CMMS records, and service documentation
  • Communicate maintenance status clearly across departments and shifts

Production Support & Startups

  • Assist with equipment changeovers, line startups, and production ramp-ups
  • Troubleshoot issues during startup and production transitions
  • Ensure equipment is properly calibrated and operating to specification

Parts & Inventory Support

  • Identify required replacement parts during repairs and troubleshooting
  • Maintain awareness of inventory levels and support reordering processes
  • Recommend spare parts and maintenance improvements when needed

Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all OSHA regulations, company safety policies, and GMP standards
  • Adhere strictly to Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures
  • Maintain a safe work environment in compliance with food safety and quality standards
  • Ensure all work is performed safely and in accordance with operational guidelines

Qualifications

Required

  • High school diploma or GED
  • 2–5+ years of industrial maintenance experience (manufacturing preferred)
  • Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills
  • Experience working with industrial machinery and facility systems
  • Ability to read schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals
  • Familiarity with CMMS or maintenance tracking systems

Preferred

  • Experience troubleshooting PLC-controlled equipment
  • Background in food manufacturing or regulated production environments
  • Industrial electrical or maintenance certifications (a plus)

Technical Skills

  • Motors, pumps, compressors, conveyors, and mechanical systems
  • Electrical systems, control circuits, and industrial power distribution
  • PLC troubleshooting (Allen Bradley or similar systems preferred)
  • HVAC and facility support systems
  • Preventive and predictive maintenance systems
  • CMMS / work order management software
  • Blueprint and schematic interpretation

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift 50–80 lbs regularly
  • Stand and walk for extended periods (8+ hours)
  • Climb ladders, stairs, and use manlifts/scissor lifts
  • Work in industrial environments including heat, humidity, noise, and mechanical areas
  • Frequent bending, kneeling, reaching, and overhead work
  • Exposure to oils, lubricants, chemicals, and vibration
  • Ability to work safely in confined or elevated areas when required

Work Environment

This position operates in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where production uptime is critical. The technician will work both independently and as part of a maintenance and operations team. Flexibility for shift work, overtime, and emergency response situations may be required based on production needs.

job.title: Payroll Business Systems Analyst
job.description:
The Payroll Business Systems Analyst plays a key role in the support and development of core systems and technical projects as well as communication of business ideas/problems into technical requirements. As part of the IT team, you'll collaborate with business partners within the organization to understand their needs in addition to defining system requirements, building technical specifications, quality assurance testing and production deployments.

Strategic Focus
Assumes responsibility for evaluating and assessing best practices to meet operational and business objectives and develops strategies to meet established goals. Conducts analysis of data to identify opportunities for performance improvement and links performance outcomes to financial and business endeavors. Typically performs business analysis activities using a variety of techniques in initiatives of varying scope. Identifies the current state of processes, elicits useful and harmful attributes of each, documents models of the processes and facilitates stakeholder groups to consensus regarding new business process designs. This individual will perform in a proactive manner to assist in identifying impacts and linkages to the business strategies, organization and its people, data and systems, business policies and business rules, as well as the physical assets of the business.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Evaluating business processes, anticipating requirements, uncovering areas for improvement, and developing and implementing solutions.
  • Leading ongoing reviews of business processes and developing optimization strategies.
  • Staying up-to-date on the latest process and IT advancements to automate and modernize systems.
  • Sourcing and implementing new business technology.
  • Collaborating with stakeholders and users to understand and anticipate their needs and translate them into product requirements.
  • Managing the product backlog and prioritizing them based on changing requirements.
  • Defining the vision for the team's products/applications.
  • Prioritizing efforts based on business needs and requirements.
  • Creating a product/application road map based on this vision.
  • Conducting meetings and presentations to share ideas and findings.
  • Documenting and communicating the results of your efforts.
  • Effectively communicating your insights and plans to cross-functional team members and management.
  • Providing leadership, training, coaching, and guidance to junior staff.
  • Leading user acceptance testing.
  • Managing projects, developing project plans, and monitoring performance.
  • Documenting, updating, implementing, and maintaining procedures.
  • Analyzing data to inform business decisions.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Exceptional analytical and conceptual thinking skills.
  • The ability to influence stakeholders and work closely with them to determine acceptable solutions.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent documentation skills.
  • Competency in Microsoft applications including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Excellent planning, organizational, and time management skills.

Education and Experience:

  • 5+ years of support for Payroll/HR applications.
  • 5+ years in a business application support/management experience.
  • 2+ years of support for ERP applications.
  • Degree in computer engineering, business administration, or related field.
  • 7+ years in a technology-driven role.
  • Experience creating detailed reports and giving presentations.
  • Experience leading and developing top-performing teams.
  • A history of leading and supporting successful projects.
  • A track record of following through on commitments.

job.title: Financial Analyst - (Biotech)
job.description:
This position is NonExempt. Hours over 40 will be paid at Time and a Half.

Job Description

Client Point of Care is a global leader in providing critical medical diagnostic and informatics products for rapid blood analysis that are intuitive, reliable, and cost-effective. Our i-STAT System is an advanced, portable diagnostic tool that provides real-time, lab-quality results within minutes to accelerate patient-care decision-making as well as optimize resource utilization for our customers and the patients that they serve. The i-STAT System has the industry's most comprehensive menu of tests in a single, with-patient platform, including tests for respiratory,
metabolic, coagulation, hematology, glucose, and cardiac function. By delivering lab-quality results in minutes, on just a few drops of blood, our i-STAT System fosters a collaborative, patient-centered environment while driving improved operational performance.

Client Point of Care has a new opening for a Sr. Financial Analyst. This role will support the Division FP&A HQ team with providing financial planning & analysis for the business by building and managing financial reports, preparing analysis for business reviews and other adhoc request.

Responsibilities include:
  • Prepare financial analysis and reports (such as Plans, Latest Best Estimate (LBE's) and Long Range
  • Projections (LRP)) for P&L and balance sheet metrics that meet the timing and quality of presentation requirements, facilitate management review and decision making while ensuring integrity of data and compliance with GAAP as well as Client's operating policies
  • Maintain an effective and efficient planning process for the division and functional areas being supported, including the coordination of a planning calendar with key dates and deliverables
  • Develop flexible, comprehensive tools and templates to support the consolidation and timely completion of corporate schedules as well as develop system solutions and process improvements that meet the needs of the financial planning and/or reporting requirements
  • Support the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process by managing the reporting of monthly financial performance metrics such as: sales and expense variances, cash conversion cycle (CCC), Integrated Business Planning (IBP), etc
  • Provide financial support to Global Marketing organization. Partner with marketing team to create annual budget and forecast
  • Complete month-end close activities: tie out monthly revenue, prepare journal entries, expense summaries, and project spend analysis
  • Prepare and analyze daily and weekly sales reporting / projections
  • Maintain finance scorecard on deliverables from other APOC finance organizations
  • Perform adhoc requests and drive cross-business analytic projects for senior management, with financial modeling, data mining and presentation support
Education Requirements:
Bachelor's degree, preferably in accounting or finance, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.

Minimum Qualifications:
  • Position requires 7+ years of finance experience to include roles of increasing responsibility in accounting and/or finance
  • Strong Excel skills, demonstrate initiative, analytical thinking, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated ability to provide data and analysis to support decision making, methodical approach to problem solving and rational ideas supporting them, ability to keep learning and to teach others, traditional
  • accounting knowledge and facilitator of management needs, streamlining functions within the department and an efficient work ethic
Qualities Needed:
  • Organized
  • Detail oriented
  • Eager to learn
  • Proactive- self starter
  • Collaborative- team player
  • Mfg experience
  • Fortune 500 company
  • Dynamic roles
  • Consolidation experience
  • System mindset

job.title: Aftermarket Sales Representative
job.description:
Nesco Resource is in search of an Aftermarket Sales Representative for one of our clients based in East Windsor, CT. Our client is the leading manufacturers' representative of thermal energy solutions in the Northeast.
 
SUMMARY
In search of a multi-talented individual to sell parts and service, as well as maintain relationships with customers for all the solutions offered. Seeking candidates with a sales background in the boiler or trades industries. For those in the trades, instead of solving problems with a wrench, you will be resolving issues with your technical knowledge.
 
If you are people-oriented, love everything about a boiler room, and take pride in your ability to figure out and solve complicated thermal situations, this job may be ideal for you. You'll spend most of your time in the field, visiting customers 3-5 times per day. You must be a self-starter, as this is mostly a self-directed job, requiring you to organize your own route each day, packing in as many targets as you can. 
 
This role is responsible for providing aftermarket support and sales through existing accounts and new accounts. Key tasks include business development, customer relationship management, and brand awareness. You will focus on large end users in the industrial, institutional, and municipal markets who have central plant water and thermal systems. Organizations include but are not limited to: universities, colleges, hospitals, correctional facilities, food processing, semiconductor, chemical, paper mills and more.
 
RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Apply strategic expertise to drive client's brand awareness of all boiler, water systems, and MRO solutions to channel.
  • Locating, developing, and defining new and existing business relationships to Client and close opportunities to sell mechanical MRO parts and supplies, equipment replacement/upgrade, equipment service, and maintenance.
  • Effectively drive sales; meeting or exceeding sales targets for assigned territory (CT, Western Massachusetts, lower VT).
  • Assist in the development of business objectives, strategies and plans specific to clients within assigned territory.
  • Manage relationships with key accounts by effectively delivering customer value for sustained growth.
  • Use consultative approach to provide customers with best solutions.
  • Maintain CRM tool with contacts, pipeline, opportunities and forecasts.
  • Maintain a high level of activity in relevant trade groups/associations.
  • Develop specifications, proposals, submittals and effective presentations.
  • Support corporate goals and initiatives.
  • Collect and share information on competitive, market and industry trends with corporate.
  • Develop and maintain excellent relationships with key decision makers, influencers, manufacturers and personnel.
REQUIREMENTS
  • Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline.
  • Results oriented, highly organized sales professional with experience in sales/marketing of thermal energy solutions.
  • Proven abilities in customer service and sales skills, excellent communication, follow up and organizational skills.
  • Knowledge of CRM tools; NetSuite a plus.
  • Valid driver's license with proven safe driving record.
  • This position requires frequent travel but overnight travel is limited.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
  • Direct hire with 401k, generous health benefits, paid time off, company paid life/ AD&D, company paid training with future advancement opportunities.
  • 1st shift, Monday – Friday with flexible start time
  • Salary + commission
  • Car allowance, gas card and cell phone provided

As a mission-driven company focused on improving access to care and supporting underserved populations, they are committed to fostering strong, community-based partnerships and delivering innovative solutions to complex health challenges.   • Maintain current knowledge and understanding of Medicaid and local transformation.

  • Experience in accounting or business 
  • 2 years of healthcare claims billing experience
  • Medicaid knowledge preferred.
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and solve problems effectively.
  • Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.

job.title: Electronics Technician
job.description:
Description:
Sets up test apparatus and conducts tests of electronic circuit card assemblies, RF circuits and subassembly units following methods, procedures, standards, and sequences; lays out and assembles units for production electronic equipment according to designs and specifications. Adjusts and calibrates electronic assembly systems as required. Corrects malfunctions by making adjustments or replacing parts or components as directed. Uses hand and small power tools, and various measuring and testing devices in performing job duties. Determines types of tests to be performed, approves and suggests modifications to testing equipment, and analyzes test results to evaluate performance of products and equipment. Assists engineers in design and development of test procedures for new products and recommends product improvements or manufacturing modifications. May monitor and verify quality in accordance with statistical process or other control procedures.
Troubleshoots to the component level. Utilizes schematic diagrams to isolate failures on Analog and Digital circuitry. Requires a strong knowledge of Solid State devices and micro-circuitry. job.title: Mechanical Installation Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: Mechanical Engineer III
Onsite - Wilmington, NC

Project Engineer Role: Mechanical
Provide mechanical discipline support in the construction, installation, debug, and startup of equipment and automated systems including hands-on to the point of turnover to operations at both domestic and international manufacturing sites; majority of time be spent on the floor working on equipment.
Supervise and provide direction to internal or contract engineering techs, internal maintenance, and outside contract trades during all aspects of equipment installation and conversion such as demolition, construction, installation, testing, and debug of production equipment.

Project Engineer Responsibilities: Mechanical
Develop and use project plans and timelines to achieve project goals without sacrificing safety, intellectual property, or quality. Adhere to all corporate, business unit and site guidelines
Safety – Ensure that all the project team has safety training, safety is analyzed in job plans and all safety requirements are met. Identify potential safety issues. Report and investigate all safety incidents.
Develop understanding of process and equipment functions in area of responsibility
Analyze and correct equipment installation practices to improve efficiencies, specifically directed toward enhancing installation schedules.
Develop and use project plans and timelines to achieve project goals without sacrificing safety, intellectual property, or quality.
Re-design mechanical components to reduce installation cost, solve equipment interferences, and correct inadequate designs.
Interface with external system integrators and machine builders to successfully deliver fully integrated process equipment systems to plants on-time, on-budget and that satisfy performance measures
Perform hands-on troubleshooting, direct engineering techs and trades as necessary to replace defective components and execute changes to solve equipment/process issues.
Provide training to internal or contract engineering techs, internal maintenance, and outside contract trades on new equipment installation procedures as required for successful execution of installation activities.
Review, "redline , and modify existing installation checklists, machine part lists, illustrations, machine specs, schedules, and complete drawing packages including follow-up with drafting services.
Provide direction to technicians
Create and modify existing documentation to complete drawing packages, installation checklists, machine part lists, illustrations, and machine specs of production equipment.
Procure and expedite materials needed to build or install new or modified equipment.
Assess condition and usability of existing equipment for fit and function with new installation plans.

Required Education / Skills: Mechanical
BS Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent, with minimum 3+ years manufacturing experience working with manufacturing equipment.
Ability to work hands-on with the equipment using typical hand tools, instruments, and measurement/alignment devices.
Must be flexible with the ability to manage multiple work streams in a team environment adjusting to changing priorities with a strong focus on job site safety and proactive safety approach.
Process variable understanding: flow, temperature, rate*** pressure, level
Determines and recommends best solution from a series of alternatives within plant guidelines.
Translates engineering solutions to requirements, then further to process and/or equipment designs which deliver required performance criteria as well as interpreting drawings and schematics to aid in troubleshooting.
Works well with other disciplines (IT, Mechanical, and Process engineering) to fully understand manufacturing system functionality and design requirements.
Familiar with process piping system design, including P&IDs
Thorough understanding of mechanical drive trains, electrical and pneumatic actuators.
Works well in a team environment, is a self-starter and results oriented & effective in various settings to provide and present necessary information to project, department, and site leaders.

Desired Skills: Mechanical
Equipment or software experience preferred: AutoCAD , Inventor, Power Point, Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams, and MS Project
Experience working on a manufacturing floor or construction environment, with a strong focus on job site safety and proactive safety approach.
Displays a bias for action in situations of uncertainty, addresses issues and problems proactively.
Effective communication and presentation skills.
Project management experience, including developing project scope, budgets and schedules.
Knowledge of the Optical Fiber manufacturing process.

Travel Requirements
Typical travel can range from a few days to a few weeks during the project initiation phase. During the deployment phase of the project, travel may be full-time.
Planning, Development and/or Deployment phases typically range from 3-9 months but can extend to 1+ years.

Travel will be required to Optical Fiber and Cable Manufacturing sites in North Carolina (Concord, Winston-Salem, Hickory, Newton, and Wilmington) and overseas sites in India, China, and Europe.

Hours of Work/Work Schedule
40 hours+ M-F, adjusted hours and weekends may be required based on where the project is in the project life cycle.

job.title: CET Design Manager
job.description:
Nesco Resource a national staffing company, has an immediate need for a CET Design Manager

Design Leadership

  • Lead, manage, and develop the CET design team to ensure exceptional project execution and client satisfaction.
  • Establish and maintain design standards, workflows, best practices, and quality control procedures.
  • Review and approve design drawings, specifications, layouts, renderings, and installation documents.
  • Provide creative direction and technical guidance to designers throughout the design process.
  • Champion innovative workplace design solutions aligned with industry trends and client objectives.
  • Confidently present design concepts, solutions, and recommendations to clients, Account Managers, and internal stakeholders.

Quality Assurance & Technical Support

  • Serve as the primary resource for designers regarding furniture applications, product specifications, and design-related questions.
  • Conduct furniture pre-checks and quality reviews to ensure design accuracy and compliance.
  • Verify installation drawings, field verification requirements, and project documentation for completeness and accuracy.
  • Ensure compliance with manufacturer standards, client specifications, and industry requirements.
  • Maintain consistency and quality across all project deliverables.
  • Develop and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance design quality and efficiency.

CET Standards & Software Management

  • Manage and maintain CET standards, libraries, symbols, templates, and configuration settings.
  • Develop and optimize workflows to maximize productivity and design accuracy.
  • Provide CET software training, troubleshooting, and ongoing support to the design team.
  • Ensure the team remains proficient in current CET capabilities and best practices.

Furniture & Product Expertise

  • Maintain comprehensive and current knowledge of furniture products, applications, and manufacturer offerings from key vendor partners.
  • Ensure products are specified appropriately to meet client requirements, budget objectives, and manufacturer standards.
  • Guide designers in product selection, application, and specification strategies.
  • Stay informed of industry trends, product innovations, and manufacturer updates.

Project Management

  • Oversee project schedules, deliverables, resource allocation, and design workloads.
  • Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring deadlines and client expectations are met.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Project Management, Installation, Operations, and Leadership teams.
  • Partner with executive leadership on strategic initiatives and special projects as assigned.

Team Development & Mentorship

  • Recruit, onboard, train, mentor, and evaluate design staff.
  • Conduct performance reviews and establish individual development plans.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and professional growth.
  • Provide ongoing coaching in design processes, product knowledge, workplace design principles, and CET proficiency.
  • Balance team workloads and staffing requirements to support operational objectives.

Training & Process Improvement

  • Develop and deliver training programs, presentations, and educational materials for design teams.
  • Introduce and implement new processes, tools, and best practices to improve operational effectiveness.
  • Promote adherence to established design methodologies and project standards.
  • Continuously evaluate and enhance departmental procedures to improve quality, efficiency, and client outcomes.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with executive leadership on strategic business initiatives and special projects.
  • Support organizational goals through cross-functional partnerships and process improvements.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements
  • BFA, BA or BS in interior design, architecture and planning from an accredited college or equivalent combination of education and industry experience.
  • 8-10 years of design experience in contract furniture working with cross functional teams including a proven track record of training or mentoring others.
  • Demonstrated skill using 2D/3D software, AutoCAD, CET Designer and Microsoft Suite. Possess a high level of graphic presentation skills.
  • Understanding of building systems, building codes, electrical, cabling and meeting ADA compliance with furniture.
  • Mastery in navigating and curating solutions from an expansive product portfolio, including furniture systems, ancillary, accessories, and bespoke.
  • Innovative Problem-Solver: Able to address unique challenges in workplace design and find creative solutions that align with the company's vision.
  • Team Player: Work well as a member of a group, understand your role, welcome collaboration, hold yourself accountable, accept feedback gracefully, maintain flexibility, uphold a positive attitude, and commit to the team.
  • Self-Starter: Actively seeks out ways to assist team without being told
  • Teaching Skills: Demonstrate patience and guide designers to develop their ability to understand the designer role. Ability to give constructive feedback and follow-up to ensure the designer understands.
  • Communication Skills: Strong communicator and able to present design processes in training and design meetings.
  • Reliable, good work ethic, and high integrity.

job.title: 5S Facilitator
job.description:
Position Summary
The 5S Facilitator is a temporary, site-based role responsible for leading the end-to-end implementation of the 5S methodology across the facility. The site currently does not have a formal 5S system in place and is targeting a full, structured 5S implementation within a six-month timeline, followed by focused stabilization, sustainment, and capability transfer.
This role will lead 5S Kaizen events, execute the site rollout plan, and embed 5S standards in alignment with the Operational Excellence framework, working closely with the Operational Excellence Coach, site leadership, and operations teams. A key responsibility of the role is to prepare and transition long-term ownership of 5S sustainment to a designated site specialist or junior engineer before the end of the assignment.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
5S Implementation & Deployment
• Lead the design and execution of a site-wide 5S rollout aligned to the Operational

Excellence framework.
• Drive implementation of all five pillars of 5S (Sort, Set in Order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain) within a targeted six-month deployment window.
• Develop and execute a detailed rollout plan by area, including sequencing, milestones, and ownership.
• Ensure 5S standards are practical, visual, and integrated into daily operations.

Kaizen Leadership
• Plan and lead 5S Kaizen events across manufacturing, warehouse, maintenance, and support areas.
• Facilitate cross-functional teams during Kaizens, ensuring engagement, accountability, and timely completion of actions.
• Track and report Kaizen outcomes, including improvements in safety, efficiency, visual management, and space utilization.

Coaching, Capability Building & Handoff
• Train supervisors, operators, and support teams on 5S principles, standards, and expectations.
• Coach leaders on sustaining 5S through leader standard work, Gemba walks, and tiered accountability.
• Develop and mentor a site-based specialist or junior engineer who will assume long-term ownership of 5S sustainment.
• Create clear documentation, standard work, audit routines, and visual management tools to enable independent sustainment.
• Execute a structured handoff plan to ensure long-term ownership is fully transitioned prior to the end of the 12 month assignment.

Sustainment & Governance
• Establish 5S audit processes, visual scorecards, and escalation mechanisms.
• Support site leadership in embedding 5S into daily management systems.
• Identify sustainment risks and lead corrective actions to prevent regression during and after the transition period.

Communication & Change Management
• Serve as the primary site point of contact for 5S implementation.
• Communicate progress, risks, and support needs to site leadership through clear, data-driven updates.
• Reinforce a culture of ownership, discipline, and continuous improvement.
________________________________________
Qualifications & Experience
• Proven experience leading 5S implementations or Lean initiatives in a manufacturing or operations environment.
• Strong facilitation skills with experience leading Kaizen events and cross-functional teams.
• Working knowledge of Lean, visual management, and operational excellence systems (experience with structured frameworks preferred).
• Ability to operate with urgency and structure in change-intensive environments.
• Strong communication and coaching skills across all organizational levels.
• Hands-on, shop-floor-oriented leadership style.
________________________________________
Key Success Factors
• Site-wide 5S implementation completed within six months.
• Clear, visual, and standardized 5S practices adopted by operations.
• A trained site specialist or junior engineer capable of independently sustaining and improving 5S.
• Measurable improvements in safety, organization, flow, and visual control.

This opening is for one 5S Facilitator.
Must have experience leading 5S implementations or Lean initiatives in a manufacturing or operations environment.

Day Shift - 8am - 4:30pm
