job.title: Maintenance Technician II - 2nd Shift
job.description:
Job Description:

Our client is at the forefront of advancing power solutions, charged and driven by a committed, dynamic team, tackling complex challenges, and creating innovative solutions. We're looking for motivated, driven, and talented individuals eager to be part of the future of power. Safety and integrity aren't just buzzwords, they are the north star guiding us as we aspire to wow our customers every day. We've created power solutions that are not only durable and unique but are also the result of exciting teamwork from every corner of our organization. Individually and collectively, every team member plays for each other and strives to deliver unmatched value and 100% accuracy to our customers every single day. Our cutting-edge headquarters is in Faribault, MN, a facility that is partially solar- and wind-powered by our own microgrid! You'll find that we're also pushing boundaries across the country at our additional facilities in Troy, MI; Houston, TX; Merrimack, NH; Burnsville, MN; and Charolette, NC.

Our team members are our most important asset, we are in search of a Maintenance Technician - II for our Faribault, MN facility. This role is critical to achieving our strategic objectives and supporting our mission to deliver unmatched value and reliability to our customers.

Under the direction of the Maintenance Manager, the Maintenance Technician II will complete preventive maintenance (PM's), troubleshoot, repair, and rebuild company equipment without direct supervision. They will also document the work being done on equipment.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Performs duties in a safe manner using all approved safety equipment as instructed.
  • Identifies equipment for repairs and upgrades.
  • Able to troubleshoot without direct supervision.
  • Able to contact equipment manufacturer technical service for troubleshooting guidance, as needed.
  • Perform PM's as required.
  • General fabrication skills including welding (MIG&TIG), plasma cutting, oxygen acetylene torch cutting, and ban saw cutting.
  • Able to apply general mechanical knowledge/abilities in basic electrical blueprints and meters without supervision.
  • Able to read and understand blueprints, mechanical schematics, and diagrams used in diagnosing mechanical problems without direct supervision.
  • Able to disassemble and diagnose mechanical failures and perform the necessary repairs without direct supervision.
  • Able to install machinery and maintain all equipment.
  • Able to apply general plumbing skills to maintain equipment and facilities (E.g. Installing new water, air and drain lines. Repairing Sinks, drain lines, toilets, urinals).
  • Able to apply general HVAC skills to maintain equipment and facilities (E.g. Repairing unit heaters, radiant tube heaters, furnaces, air conditioning systems, make up air units, industrial ovens, and exhaust fans).
  • Assist outside contractors repairing and installing machinery.
  • Knowledge of pneumatics (E.g. Repair and replace airlines, air fittings, valves, and cylinders. Rebuild cylinders).
  • Knowledge of hydraulics (E.g. Replacing hoses, pumps, valves, pumps, motors).
  • Able to safely operate forklifts, and scissor lifts.
  • Able to apply general mechanical knowledge/abilities in basic electrical blueprints and meters without direct supervision.
  • Maintains an effective working relationship will all employees
  • Maintains a neat and clean working area throughout the day.
  • Inventory and control stock of supplies.
  • Participates in Continuous Improvement efforts by understanding team's performance and actively identifies and supporting process improvements.

Job Requirements:

The Performance Insights Consultant will play a critical role in transforming operational and financial data into clear, actionable insights that support key business decisions. job.title: Technical Writer - On Site
job.description:
Technical Writer - Chemical Company SOP's

Position Overview

The Technical Writer serves as a dedicated documentation resource embedded within a GMP pharmaceutical and specialty manufacturing operation. The role exists to support the rapid growth of the site's production portfolio by authoring, revising, and routing the controlled documents that govern day-to-day manufacturing — including specifications, batch records, production tickets, and operating procedures.
The position has become a critical enabler of on-time batch execution. Since the role was established, instances of batch delays caused by documentation gaps have dropped significantly. The Technical Writer acts as a key point of contact for Regulus document routing and partners closely with Operations, Quality, and Regulatory stakeholders to ensure all controlled documents are drafted, reviewed, and approved well in advance of scheduled batches.
This individual is a hands-on, detail-oriented contributor who can independently navigate change control workflows, translate technical input from operators and engineers into clear procedural language, and support continuous-improvement initiatives that reduce errors, ambiguity, and unnecessary jargon in production documentation.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Specification & Batch Record Authoring

  • Address anomalies with LACTEL specifications as they transfer into the LPF-QA templates and systems.
  • Draft and route Glucose Star Polymer child specifications and other product family specifications through full review and approval.
  • Author new batch records to support system transfers and product onboarding.
  • Support batch transfers across equipment scales (e.g., 10-gallon to 65CV or 8CV) for GMP production.
  • Document and process specifications for products that have been ordered but were not part of the original transfer plan, including LACTEL items and raw materials that cannot be released due to system differences.

Change Control & Document Routing

  • Draft, review, and shepherd change controls through approval prior to any specification or ticket change being routed in Regulus.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for Regulus document routing, tracking documents through review and approval cycles.
  • Operate as an active TrackWise user, managing change control records and associated workflows.
  • Handle deviation actions associated with production record clarity, ensuring root causes are accurately captured and corrective documentation is updated.

Production Ticket & Procedure Improvement

  • Support Kaizen and Kaikaku style ticket formatting and styling initiatives across the operation.
  • Identify and improve ticket flow to enhance operator clarity and execution efficiency.
  • Eliminate historically tolerated but minor clerical errors that compound across batches.
  • Eliminate confusing or confounding instructions and reduce unnecessary technical jargon in production documents.
  • Provide drafting support to Operations as procedural updates are identified by floor staff.

Batch Preparedness & Cross-Functional Support

  • Serve as an active member of batch preparedness reviews, ensuring all involved parties clear document reviews and approvals well in advance of scheduled batch execution.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Quality Assurance, Regulatory, and Engineering teams to surface and resolve document gaps before they impact production.
  • Maintain accurate records and version control across all assigned documents.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned in support of site documentation needs.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • Three (3) or more years of technical writing experience in a regulated manufacturing environment (pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, or specialty chemical).
  • Demonstrated experience authoring and revising GMP-controlled documents — specifications, batch records, SOPs, and production tickets.
  • Hands-on experience with change control processes, including drafting and routing change controls through approval.

Systems & Tools

  • Active working knowledge of TrackWise (or comparable QMS / change control platform).
  • Experience with Regulus or similar document management and routing systems is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and document templating tools.

Core Competencies

  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical input into clear, executable procedural language.
  • High attention to detail and a systematic approach to managing concurrent document workflows.
  • Familiarity with continuous improvement methodologies (Kaizen, Kaikaku) and their application to documentation systems.
  • Self-directed and capable of operating independently across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Strong interpersonal skills suited to coordinating with Operations, QA, Regulatory, and Engineering teams.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, scientific, or communications discipline preferred; equivalent experience in a regulated manufacturing setting will be considered.

Work Arrangement

  • Location: Birmingham, Alabama.
  • Schedule: Hybrid — three (3) days on-site per week, two (2) days remote.
  • Engagement Type: Full-time.

Interview Process

  • One (1) in-person interview at the Birmingham site.

The primary role of this position is to serve as a crucial liaison between business associates and legal counsel, facilitating the effective management of contract processes and documentation throughout the organization. This position encompasses overseeing the Enterprise's Contract Lifecycle Management systems, ensuring compliance with legal standards, and supporting cross-functional projects related to contracts, all while providing guidance on legal operations and maintaining the integrity of critical contract data. job.description:
Job Responsibilities

job.title: Numerical Control (N/C) Programmer - Secret Clearance
job.description:
Description:
Develops and writes programs for numerically controlled machines using engineering specifications and drawings. Analyzes engineering drawings to define configuration of parts and determine type and sequence of machine operations. Monroe has an average of 100 employees, working across one shift

Position Overview

The Sleep Scheduling Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for scheduling sleep-related appointments for new and existing patients. This role supports practices, hospital departments, and ancillary services across the health system. The Coordinator relays patient concerns, processes medication refill requests, and communicates with clinical and office staff per protocol through the designated EMR system.

This position requires a strong customer service mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to manage complex scheduling requests while maintaining compliance with HIPAA and regulatory standards. Coordinators must remain calm in stressful situations, prioritize patient needs effectively, and ensure accuracy when entering patient information, verifying insurance, and coordinating care.

Clerical medical experience is a plus but not required.

Essential Responsibilities

1. Appointment Scheduling & Coordination

  • Coordinate and schedule appointments for sleep consults, sleep studies, follow-ups, daytime studies, and home sleep testing.

  • Utilize department software systems (Cerner Scheduling, Excel, PowerChart, PowerChart Ambulatory, RevCycle, and other systems as required).

  • Manage cancellations, reschedules, and related communication with patients and providers.

  • Fill open and same-day appointment slots in accordance with department guidelines.

  • Collaborate with clinical team leaders to identify appropriate scheduling options.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

  • Use ICD-10 and CPT codes to verify medical necessity.

  • Coordinate with internal teams regarding insurance authorizations.

  • Process medical record requests and maintain accurate documentation.

2. Customer Service & Communication

  • Deliver high-quality customer service to patients, community members, and internal teams.

  • Answer incoming calls and respond to inquiries professionally.

  • Greet patients courteously in person and over the phone.

  • Use appropriate tone and clearly identify oneself during phone communication.

  • De-escalate difficult situations and escalate concerns appropriately.

  • Demonstrate strong active listening and clear verbal/written communication skills.

  • Meet or exceed established service standards and patient satisfaction guidelines.

3. Medical Records Management

  • Process medical record requests and release of information forms.

  • Adhere to regulatory standards regarding medical record releases.

  • Document all communication and actions related to medical record requests.

4. Patient Check-In & Check-Out

  • Ensure all required paperwork is completed and properly documented.

  • Ensure patient understanding of rights, responsibilities, and privacy policies.

  • Support departmental operations by completing additional duties as assigned.

  • Maintain professional appearance and demeanor.

job.title: Value Engineering
job.description:
As a Value Engineer, you will support value engineering initiatives across raw and packaging materials to reduce cost while maintaining product quality, functionality, and sustainability.
Working closely with site teams, procurement, packaging engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will help identify opportunities, perform technical evaluations, and support implementation of agreed value initiatives across selected product portfolios.
This is an individual contributor role focused on analysis, execution support, and collaboration under guidance from senior engineers or managers.

Key Responsibilities
Value Opportunity Identification & Analysis
• Support identification of value engineering opportunities across raw and packaging materials, including:
o Alternative materials
o Specification optimization
o Process or application changes
o Material type changes
• Assist in building opportunity cost analyses while ensuring product quality and brand requirements are maintained.
• Work with processing and formulation teams to understand recipes, raw material usage, and complexity drivers.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work with site teams, procurement (global and local), and packaging engineers to:
o Collect material specifications
o Analyze packaging variants and complexity
o Support consolidation opportunities
• Participate in cross-functional discussions to align on selected initiatives and next steps.
• Support development of execution plans and protocols for approved projects.

Project Execution Support
• Assist site teams during implementation of value initiatives.
• Track progress of assigned projects and help maintain project documentation.
• Support preparation of reports, and presentations for internal stakeholders and management.
• Monitor savings delivery versus targets.

Continuous Improvement
• Participate in idea generation workshops and contribute improvement concepts.
• Support collection and documentation of best practices.
• Assist with benchmarking activities (internal and external) to identify improvement opportunities.
• Contribute to knowledge sharing across sites and teams.

Compliance & Standards
• Ensure assigned projects comply with internal quality standards, regulatory requirements, and sustainability guidelines.
• Follow established engineering and change management processes.

Experience and Skills

Experience
• 4–6 years of experience in engineering, value engineering, packaging, process engineering, or related manufacturing roles.
• Exposure to FMCG, food & beverage, chemicals, or consumer goods manufacturing preferred.
• Experience working in cross-functional environments
• Excellent problem-solving abilities
• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
• Proficient in using relevant software and tools

Soft Skills
• Collaborative mindset with strong communication skills.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
• Comfortable working with ambiguity and learning on the job.
• Proactive, detail-oriented, and execution focused.
• Empowering the team Members and build consensus

Technical Skills
• Understanding of material specifications, packaging systems, or manufacturing processes.
• Ability to perform basic cost analysis and technical evaluations.
• Comfortable working with data, reports, and structured project documentation.

Stakeholders:
Internal:
• Manufacturing,
• Procurement,
• Commercial (Sales and Marketing)
• Supply Chain and customer service
• Quality and Product development

job.title: Oil Measurement Analyst
job.description:
About the Role:
We are seeking a skilled Analyst to ensure accuracy, integrity, and timely reporting of volumetric and quality data for oil, gas, and liquid hydrocarbons. This role involves validating flow data, reconciling system imbalances, and ensuring all measurement activities comply with contractual and regulatory standards.

This role requires the candidate to work on-site at our clients' office in San Antonio, TX.

Responsibilities:
  • Data Validation & Editing: Utilize FLOWCAL to monitor, validate, and edit hourly and daily measurement data from field devices (RTUs, Flow Computers).
  • System Balancing: Analyze and maintain Lost & Unaccounted (L&U) gas records. Investigate and resolve discrepancies between field SCADA, accounting systems, and custody transfer points.
  • Monthly Closing: Coordinate the month-end closing process by finalizing volumetric data for billing and revenue accounting.
  • Quality Analysis: Review gas sampling results to ensure BTU values and hydrocarbon compositions meet contract specifications.
  • Field Support & Troubleshooting: Act as a liaison for field technicians to troubleshoot equipment issues, such as transmitter failures or communication gaps in SCADA.
Requirements:
Required
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Good critical thinking and communication skills
  • Achieving 100% on-time completion of monthly volumetric closings with the capacity to meet strict deadlines.
Preferred
  • Education: Bachelor's or associate degree in computer science, Information Systems, Business, Finance, or a related technical field; a High School Diploma with relevant work experience will also be considered .
  • Mastery of MS Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, data analysis).
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software: FLOWCAL, SCADA (CygNet/Ignition), or TESTit.
  • Knowledge of measurement hardware: Orifice meters, Ultrasonic meters, and Coriolis meters.
  • Proficient in scripting languages such as SQL, Python, R
  • Creating Dashboards using Data Vizualization software e.g. Power BI, Tableau


This is an exciting opportunity to work directly with a Fortune 200 oil and gas company. If you are a passionate and motivated Data Analyst, we encourage you to apply for this position.

job.title: Production
job.description:
Position Overview:

The Manufacturing Laborer plays a critical role in supporting manufacturing operations across multiple production areas, including bagging, crushing, and drying. This position is responsible for operating equipment safely, maintaining production flow, and ensuring product quality through accurate documentation and sample collection. Employees must adhere to strict safety protocols, perform routine inspections, and assist with material handling to keep operations efficient and compliant. The role requires physical stamina, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, outdoor industrial environment.

Key Responsibilities May Include:

Bag Production

Operate bagging equipment safely and efficiently.

Transfer bags from conveyor to pallet, preventing product backup.

Complete production sheets accurately.

Stencil customer-specific information onto bags or sacks.

Clean bins before and after use.

Operate front-end loader to fill hopper.

Collect and label required customer samples.

Crushing Production

Safely operate yard truck for material hauling.

Operate crushing equipment in compliance with safety standards.

Remove scrap metal and debris from scrap bins.

Perform pre- and post-shift inspections and lubrication as needed.

Complete crusher documentation, including inspection and production sheets.

Dryer Production

Maintain hopper bin levels for continuous drying.

Remove finished product to prevent contamination between bins.

Clear dumped product from pads to avoid overflow and road blockage.

Conduct shift inspections and greasing as required.

Complete dryer documentation accurately.

Manage dust removal and ensure bags are sealed and removed promptly.

Collect and label shift samples.

Screening Production

Operate screening equipment safely and efficiently.

Perform routine inspections, greasing, and equipment checks to identify issues early.

Efficiently to maintain consistent material flow.

Complete production documentation accurately.

Clean bins before and after use.

Operate front-end loader to fill hopper.

Collect and label required customer samples.

Mobile Equipment Operator

Operate mobile equipment such as forklift, front-end loader, and skid steer.

Follow all plant safety rules, operate equipment with caution, and maintain constant awareness of pedestrians in work areas.

Inspect equipment at the start and end of each shift and document findings.

Feed production equipment (e.g., screens, crushers, bagging areas) with the correct material.

Maintain safe travel paths by clearing spilled material, keeping pads and staging zones free of obstructions.

Desired Qualifications

High school diploma or equivalent.

Ability to follow safety protocols and work in a fast-paced environment.

Basic mechanical aptitude for operating equipment.

Attention to detail for accurate documentation and labeling.

Physical Demands:

Prolonged periods standing and walking and frequently pulling, pushing, and bending.

Able to stoop, kneel, push, pull, twist and lift/carry up to 50 pounds.

Walk on uneven surfaces/unpaved ground.

Capable of working at heights up to 15 feet on top of railcars.

20/20 vision with corrective lenses if necessary.

Work Environment

This position involves working in a production manufacturing setting, including outdoor open-air buildings.

Conditions are dusty and dirty, requiring adherence to safety and cleanliness standards.

job.title: Maintenance Technician - 2nd Shift
job.description:
2nd Shift (3pm - 11:30pm; Rotational: Sun-Thurs, Mon-Sat)

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Position is responsible for ensuring equipment integrity and timely repair.
- Effectively support the Preventative Maintenance (PM) program with a goal of continually reducing unscheduled downtime.
- Analyze problems and interpret technical information necessary to make required repairs (troubleshooting of equipment issues).
- Perform mechanical and electrical maintenance and repairs on production machinery and facility support equipment.

- Identify required parts and maintain current inventories, and parts reorder lists.
- Assure that all products are manufactured to the highest standard of quality.- Participates in Continuous Improvement, also provides suggestions to improve processes and participates on team projects.

Physical Requirements
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

- Ability to lift 50-80 lbs. Performs highly repetitive motions, stand for eight plus hours, talk, and hear.
- Ability to Climb ladders, stairways, use a manlift/scissorlift at ceiling heights or above with proper safety equipment and work in non-air conditioned environment.- While performing job duties, the associate will frequently walk, use hands to feel or handle, and to reach with hands and arms. Frequent exposure to oils and greases or coolants.
- While performing job duties, the associate will occasionally sit, climb or balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl and smell. Occasional exposure to wet and/or humid conditions; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; outside weather conditions; extreme heat; and vibration.

job.title: CNC Machine Operator - 1st Shift
job.description:
Monday-Thursday 5am-3:30pm

Overview

We are seeking a skilled CNC Machine Operator to join a fabrication team focused on producing high-quality components in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This role plays a critical part in ensuring precision, efficiency, and consistency across machining operations.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical ability, attention to detail, and a commitment to safety and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Machine Setup & Operation

  • Set up and operate CNC and manual machining equipment, including CNC mills, manual lathes, drill presses, end mills, and laser welders
  • Load tools, fixtures, and materials; ensure machines are calibrated and aligned for accurate operation
  • Execute machining processes such as milling, turning, and drilling according to specifications

Programming & Technical Execution

  • Load and modify CNC programs using G and M code as needed
  • Interpret blueprints and technical drawings to determine setup, tooling, and machining requirements
  • Read and work from SolidWorks drawings for accurate part production

Quality Control

  • Inspect finished parts using precision measuring tools (calipers, micrometers, gauges)
  • Ensure all components meet required tolerances and quality standards

Material Handling & Production

  • Load and secure raw materials properly for machining
  • Monitor production runs to maintain efficiency and address any issues in real time

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Perform routine maintenance on machines and tooling
  • Identify and resolve machining issues such as tool wear, misalignment, or equipment malfunctions

Documentation & Reporting

  • Accurately document production data, machine settings, and maintenance activity
  • Complete daily reports, including production counts and scrap tracking

Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve cycle times, efficiency, and product quality
  • Follow and contribute to standard operating procedures (SOPs)

Safety

  • Follow all safety protocols and properly use required PPE
  • Maintain a clean and organized work environment

Qualifications

Basic Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum 2 years of CNC machining experience, including setup and operation
  • Experience in a manufacturing or fabrication environment
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical drawings
  • Working knowledge of CNC programming fundamentals (G-code)
  • Experience operating both CNC and manual machines
  • Proficiency with precision measuring instruments
  • Understanding of common materials (aluminum, steel, stainless steel, copper, etc.)
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs regularly
  • Ability to read, write, and follow instructions in English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical or trade school education
  • Experience with SolidWorks and/or Mastercam
  • Strong mechanical aptitude
  • Basic math skills for interpreting measurements and production data

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • Frequent standing, bending, lifting, and reaching
  • Ability to work in a manufacturing environment
  • Must comply with all PPE and safety requirements

Benefits

  • 401(k) with company match
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Disability insurance
  • Paid time off (PTO) and sick time
  • Paid holidays
  • Employee appreciation programs

job.title: CNC Machine Operator
job.description:
The CNC Machine Operator proficiently operates a manual lathe & mill, CNC mill, laser welder, end mill, and drill press. Has knowledge of G and M codes. Has strong problem-solving skills, and high attention to detail. CNC Machine Operator will have knowledge and experience with a wide variety of hand tools.

  • Machine Setup: Prepare and set up CNC machines by loading the appropriate tools, fixtures, and materials. Ensure the machine is properly calibrated and aligned for precise operation.
  • CNC Program Use: Modify, or load CNC programs into the machine's control system, specifying the dimensions, shapes, and tolerances required for the specific components.
  • Material Handling: Load and secure raw materials onto the machine's worktable, ensuring proper positioning and alignment for accurate machining.
  • Machining Operations: Operate CNC machines to perform milling, turning, drilling, or other machining processes, following the programmed instructions.
  • Quality Control: Conduct regular inspections of finished parts using precision measuring instruments, such as calipers, micrometers, and gauges, to verify accuracy and quality.
  • Tool Maintenance: Perform routine maintenance tasks on CNC tools and replace worn or damaged cutting tools to ensure optimal performance and minimize downtime.
  • Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues that may arise during the machining process, such as tool wear, material irregularities, or machine malfunctions.

Job Requirements:

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • High school diploma
  • 2 years of experience in CNC machine operation, programming, set up, and mechanical ability and aptitude to understand how manufacturing equipment works together in a line to produce high quality products
  • 2 years of experience working in a manufacturing environment or have general knowledge of metalworking, bending and tooling.
  • Ability to interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and work instructions to determine machine setup, tooling requirements, and part specifications.
  • Ability to operate both manual and CNC Machines (Manual lathe & Mill, CNC Mill)
  • Understanding of G code and CNC Programming Basics, experience editing programs is a plus.
  • Skilled in the use precision measuring instruments and inspection techniques.
  • Knowledge of different materials and their properties. (Aluminum, steel, stainless steel, copper, & Fiber board)
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds on a regular basis.
  • Must be able to read, write and comprehend plant directives written in English

job.title: Chemical Operations Technician
job.description:
This position starts with day shifts for a month and then rotates to 12-hour day/night shifts. The schedule is rotational.

Candidates must have chemical manufacturing experience.

Position Overview

This is a contractor position reporting directly to the Torrance Operations Manager. The primary responsibility is the packaging and shipment of Finished Goods. Additional duties include loading, unloading, and cleaning equipment, packaging products, maintaining a safe and orderly work area, assisting other production areas as needed, and overall plant housekeeping.

Activities

  • Yard responsibilities: sampling, weighing and inspecting loads, loading and shipping trucks, railcars, and iso-containers, filling and packaging drums & totes, and general plant housekeeping.
  • Follow Operating Discipline principles, procedures, and practices to ensure safe and efficient operation.
  • Operate and field check process equipment. Monitor process conditions, equipment, and control systems.
  • Perform tasks assigned to operations (e.g., field checks, equipment preparation, samples, etc.).
  • Ensure operational activities and process performance are aligned with plant and business goals.
  • Use troubleshooting skills to resolve process-related deviations and problems; initiate work requests in SAP as needed.
  • Use process knowledge and skills to make improvements in plant performance and Operating Discipline.
  • Perform process equipment troubleshooting, improvements, and preventative maintenance utilizing appropriate processes and disciplines.
  • Expected to use or develop computer skills and participate in procedure writing/verification and other AIMS activities.
  • Utilize troubleshooting skills to identify issues and report them for repair (e.g., small leaks, replace valves, steam traps, etc.).
  • Participate in Immediate Response Training and the IR team as required.
  • Support BU safety initiatives and programs.
  • Participate on EH&S improvement teams and complete related action items as required.
  • Identify potential safety issues, communicate hazards, and complete follow-up actions to mitigate.
  • Complete Operator Minor Maintenance activities to reduce maintenance costs and production loss events.
  • Contribute to the Business and Site AIMS Initiative.
  • Improve Unit Operating Efficiencies and reduce energy consumption by monitoring equipment and recognizing abnormal situations.
  • Ensure waste material/hazardous waste is disposed of properly and receive annual RCRA training.
  • Maintain a healthful and safe working environment and participate in HSEQ activities provided by site management.
  • Identify and communicate potential gains and possible improvements related to the work environment and management system through employee suggestion programs, during group meetings, or through other identified communication tools.
  • Remain in compliance with the rules, standard procedures, and work instructions related to the specific job title and site location.
  • Complete assigned training through the learning management system or attendance at assigned Web-Ex or Instructor Led Training (ILT) classes.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Context and Environment

This is a plant-based position located in Torrance, CA. This job requires working scheduled and unscheduled overtime.

Accountabilities

This role is generally the first to see a truck when it arrives at the site and the last to see a truck when it is ready to depart. The role generally resides at the truck entry point to the loading/receiving site and confirms loading has been completed to the greatest extent possible.

Key Competencies

  • Responsible Care: Work safely, protect the environment, and fully participate in the plant's EH&S program.
  • Initiative: Self-starters who seek out work and improve the plant will do well in this role.
  • Work Process Discipline: Access and utilize well-documented plant safety and operating procedures.
  • Productivity Focus: Improve the productivity of the plant by being close to the process.
  • Teamwork: Share the workload, effectively communicate with many people, and participate in achieving the team's goals.

Qualifications/Experience Required

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Previous chemical or manufacturing experience and computer skills are preferred.
  • Must be able to follow written and verbal instructions, have good math skills, work independently, execute strenuous physical activities, work indoors and outdoors, and work any shift.

HSEQ Responsibilities

  • Comply with the HSEQ Policy.
  • Comply with Regulations, Legal, and Internal Requirements as made known by the site and by the business unit (BU).
  • Comply with the rules of the specific location to which one is assigned as well as the rules set by the business unit (BU) and the company.
  • Comply with all standard procedures and work instructions to ensure productivity, quality assurance, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Review work areas for potential losses and report hazards to the direct supervisor.
  • Report Near Misses to the direct supervisor.
  • Report Incidents or Accidents to the direct supervisor.
  • Identify and communicate potential gains or possible improvements to the management system.

Must be flexible to work an 8 or 9 hour shift. Hiring for 1st, 2nd & 3rd shift. Contract-to-Hire.

Proficiency in English is required for speaking, reading, writing, and participating in training sessions led by an instructor.

Comfortable using microscopes.
Ability to follow policies and procedures.
Ability to read, write, and interpret information.
Ability to use microscopes.
Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide.
Ability to use hand tools to manipulate, handle or feel.
Ability to sit/walk/stand for up to 10 hours a day.
Ability to intermittently crawl. Squat, climb, twist, bend, stoop, push or pull.
Must possess visual acuity, i.e., close, distance, and color vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.
Ability to lift/carry items less than 50 pounds.

job.title: Mechanical Assembler- 1st Shift
job.description:
Looking for dedicated, responsible, and reliable people willing to learn. This is an Manufacturing / Warehouse environment.

Schedule: Monday-Friday 5:00AM - 3:30PM
Pay Rate: $15.50/hr to start. Contract-to-Hire.
(10 hrs of OT at $23.25/hour)

Job Summary
The Assembler is responsible for performing a variety of assembly and production-related tasks under the direction of a supervisor or designated lead. This role supports daily manufacturing operations, ensures product quality, and assists with maintaining workflow efficiency across the production floor.

Essential Functions

  • Read and interpret blueprints, drawings, and work instructions.
  • Assemble components using hand and power tools such as drills, screwdrivers, wrenches, and pneumatic tools.
  • Fit, fasten, and secure parts to finished products.
  • Install components such as casters, plates, brackets, or hardware into designated locations.
  • Bend, align, and secure interlocking parts using hand tools or mallets.
  • Perform basic touch-up work, including paint or finish application as needed.
  • Inspect parts and finished products for defects such as scratches, dents, or other imperfections.
  • Prepare and package completed products for shipment.
  • Load and unload production lines as required.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.
  • Assist in other departments or areas of the facility as needed to support production flow.

Marginal / Additional Responsibilities

  • Operate material-handling equipment such as hand trucks or forklifts (if certified).
  • Complete basic production paperwork including time tracking, job tickets, and quality documentation.
  • Perform basic equipment or workstation maintenance.
  • Assist with general housekeeping and facility upkeep.
  • Use basic computer systems for data entry or production tracking (training provided if needed) based on business needs.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned


Requirements & Physical Demands

  • Ability to read, understand, and follow written and verbal instructions in English.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, push, pull, and grasp throughout the shift.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds regularly.
  • Must be dependable with consistent attendance, including the ability to work overtime when required.
  • Ability to follow all safety rules and regulations, including wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses, ear protection, safety shoes, and other protective gear as required.

job.title: Warehouse Associate -2nd shift
job.description:
Shift: 2nd Shift Monday through Friday, 12:00 PM – 8:30 PM (or until work is completed)
Overtime: Potential for overtime; occasional Saturdays may be required at the end of the quarter
Employment Type: Contract with potential to convert

Equipment Experience

  • Stand-up Crown forklift experience required

    • Minimum: 1 year

    • Preferred: 2+ years

  • Forklift certification preferred

Requirements

  • Steel-toe, puncture-resistant boots required prior to start date

    • Please confirm puncture-resistant footwear before submitting candidates

  • High school diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience

  • Minimum of 1 year of related shipping, receiving, or warehouse experience

Job Responsibilities

Under general supervision, the Material Handler performs manual and clerical duties related to the shipment and receipt of materials, supplies, equipment, and finished products, including:

  • Receiving goods and verifying shipments against documentation

  • Inspecting incoming materials for condition and accuracy

  • Gathering, verifying, and packing items for shipment according to specifications and transportation methods

  • Recording received and shipped items in accordance with established procedures

  • Routing materials, supplies, and equipment to inspection or designated stock areas

  • Completing required written and computerized documentation
